`native/title/autostart.c`:

```c
/* SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
 * NiakPS5 optional autostart payload for the already-jailbroken console.
 * NOT a ShellUI replacement, memory patch, hbldr, SceSysCore hook, or GUI.
 * Opt-in only. The homebrew title remains a normal app with a normal exit.
 */
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <sys/syscall.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <arpa/inet.h>
#include <netinet/in.h>
#include <sys/socket.h>
#include <sys/select.h>
#include <sys/time.h>
#include <time.h>
#include "redirect_gate.h"
#include "title_permissions.h"
#include "socket_guard.h"
#include "loopback_connect.h"
#include "launch_policy.h"
#include "broker_inventory.h"
#include "broker_snapshot.h"

#define NIAK_TITLE "PPSA99386"
/* Legacy marker is tolerated but no longer required: PLDmgr's explicit
 * autoload.txt entry is itself the opt-in. A freshly dropped payload must
 * not silently exit merely because ftp_install.py was never executed. */
#define NIAK_ENABLED "/data/niakps5-autostart.enabled"
#define NIAK_DISABLED "/data/niakps5-autostart.disable"
#define NIAK_LOG "/data/niakps5-autostart.log"

extern int sceKernelUsleep(unsigned int microseconds);
extern int sceUserServiceGetForegroundUser(int *user_id);
extern int sceUserServiceInitialize(void *params);
extern int sceSystemServiceLaunchApp(const char *title_id,
                                     const char **arguments,
                                     NiakLaunchContext *params);
extern int sceLncUtilInitialize(void);
extern int sceLncUtilLaunchApp(const char *title_id,
                              const char **arguments,
                              NiakLaunchContext *params);
extern int sceSystemServiceGetAppIdOfRunningBigApp(void);
extern int sceKernelLoadStartModule(const char *path,size_t argc,
                                   const void *args,uint32_t flags,
                                   uint32_t options,int *result);
extern int sceKernelDlsym(int handle,const char *name,void **target);

typedef struct {
    uint32_t size;
    uint32_t user;
} NiakShellSettingsArgs;
/* Fixed, owner-initiated settings request via the ALREADY resident broker.
 * The sandbox cannot load this private ShellUIUtil module. No custom URI,
 * arbitrary path or general command execution is accepted over loopback.
 */
static int niak_open_settings_from_broker(void) {
    int result=0;
    const int module=sceKernelLoadStartModule(
        "/system_ex/common_ex/lib/libSceShellUIUtil.sprx",
        0,NULL,0,0,&result);
    if(module<0)return module;
    void *initialize=NULL,*launch=NULL;
    if(sceKernelDlsym(module,"sceShellUIUtilInitialize",&initialize)<0 ||
       !initialize)return -10;
    if(sceKernelDlsym(module,"sceShellUIUtilLaunchByUri",&launch)<0 ||
       !launch)return -11;
    int user=-1;
    const int got=sceUserServiceGetForegroundUser(&user);
    if(got<0||user<0)return got<0?got:-12;
    const int started=((int(*)(void))initialize)();
    if(started<0)return started;
    NiakShellSettingsArgs args={sizeof(args),(uint32_t)user};
    return ((int(*)(const char*,NiakShellSettingsArgs*))launch)(
        "pssettings:play?mode=settings",&args);
}

/* One checked entry point for both autostart and the local Jouer action.
 * Logs the raw status of both APIs; a positive LncUtil app id is accepted
 * by the local protocol as success, never sent as a launch error.
 */
static void report(const char *msg,int result);
static int launch_title_as_user(const char *title,int user) {
    NiakLaunchResult launch=niak_launch_with_fallback(
        title,user,sceSystemServiceLaunchApp,sceLncUtilLaunchApp);
    report("sceSystemServiceLaunchApp",launch.system_rc);
    if(launch.method==2)
        report("sceLncUtilLaunchApp accepted app id",launch.lnc_rc);
    else if(launch.lnc_rc==0)
        report("sceLncUtilLaunchApp returned invalid app id",0);
    else if(launch.lnc_rc!=NIAK_LAUNCH_NOT_TRIED)
        report("sceLncUtilLaunchApp refused",launch.lnc_rc);
    return launch.result;
}
static int is_regular_file(const char *path) {
    struct stat st;
    return lstat(path,&st)==0 && S_ISREG(st.st_mode);
}
static void report(const char *msg,int result) {
    FILE *out=fopen(NIAK_LOG,"a");
    if(out) {
        fprintf(out,"%s rc=0x%08x\n",msg,(unsigned)result);
        fclose(out);
    }
}
#define NIAK_RESUME "/data/niakps5-return-after-game.enabled"
#define NIAK_RESUME_DISABLED "/data/niakps5-return-after-game.disable"

/* Import only the foreground user's existing PNG, if one exists.
 * Never collect accounts, credentials, PSN tokens or any other user's media.
 * Source is the local PS5 profile cache; destination is one private app asset.
 */
static int copy_profile_image(const char *source,const char *dest,
                              const unsigned char *magic,size_t signature_size) {
    FILE *in=fopen(source,"rb");
    if(!in)return 0;
    struct stat st;
    if(fstat(fileno(in),&st)!=0||!S_ISREG(st.st_mode)||
       st.st_size<144||st.st_size>2*1024*1024) {fclose(in);return 0;}
    const size_t size=(size_t)st.st_size;
    unsigned char *data=(unsigned char*)malloc(size);
    if(!data){fclose(in);return 0;}
    int ok=fread(data,1,size,in)==size && memcmp(data,magic,signature_size)==0;
    fclose(in);
    if(ok) {
        struct stat folder;
        if(lstat("/data/homebrew/PPSA99386/assets",&folder)==0 &&
           S_ISDIR(folder.st_mode)) {
            char temp[256];
            const int label=snprintf(temp,sizeof(temp),"%s.XXXXXX",dest);
            if(label<=0 || label>=(int)sizeof(temp))ok=0;
            else {
                // mkstemp creates a fresh O_EXCL file for each attempt.
                // Fixed *.tmp names could permanently block later updates.
                const int fd=mkstemp(temp);
                if(fd<0)ok=0;
                else {
                    size_t written=0;
                    while(written<size) {
                        const ssize_t n=write(fd,data+written,size-written);
                        if(n<0 && errno==EINTR)continue;
                        if(n<=0)break;
                        written+=(size_t)n;
                    }
                    ok=written==size && fchmod(fd,0644)==0 && fsync(fd)==0;
                    if(close(fd)!=0)ok=0;
                    if(ok)ok=rename(temp,dest)==0;
                    if(!ok)unlink(temp);
                }
            }
        }else ok=0;
    }
    free(data);return ok;
}
/* Bind each cached avatar to the actual local foreground account and image
 * type. No PSN identifier or personal image leaves this console. */
static void mark_profile_asset(int user,const char *format) {
    if(user<0 || !format)return;
    const char *dst="/data/homebrew/PPSA99386/assets/niak-profile-source.txt";
    char temp[]="/data/homebrew/PPSA99386/assets/.niak-profile-source-XXXXXX";
    int fd=mkstemp(temp);
    if(fd<0)return;
    char identity[32];
    const int n=snprintf(identity,sizeof(identity),"0x%08X %s\n",
                         (unsigned)user,format);
    int ok=n>0 && n<(int)sizeof(identity) &&
           write(fd,identity,(size_t)n)==n &&
           fchmod(fd,0644)==0 && fsync(fd)==0;
    if(close(fd)!=0)ok=0;
    if(!ok || rename(temp,dst)!=0)unlink(temp);
}
/* Invalidate the generic file's owner BEFORE replacing its bytes.
 * If permissions prevent invalidation, do not overwrite the old image:
 * another profile could otherwise inherit a mismatched owner marker. */
static int invalidate_profile_asset(void) {
    const char *path="/data/homebrew/PPSA99386/assets/niak-profile-source.txt";
    const int fd=open(path,O_WRONLY|O_CREAT|O_TRUNC|O_NOFOLLOW,0600);
    if(fd<0)return 0;
    const int ok=fchmod(fd,0644)==0 && fsync(fd)==0;
    return close(fd)==0 && ok;
}
static int copy_current_avatar_png(int user) {
    if(user<0)return 0;
    if(!invalidate_profile_asset()) {
        report("Avatar owner invalidation denied", -1);
        return 0;
    }
    char profile[256],source[320];
    snprintf(profile,sizeof(profile),
             "/system_data/priv/cache/profile/0x%08X",(unsigned)user);
    static const unsigned char png[8]={137,80,78,71,13,10,26,10};
    static const unsigned char dds[4]={'D','D','S',' '};
    snprintf(source,sizeof(source),"%s/avatar.png",profile);
    if(copy_profile_image(source,"/data/homebrew/PPSA99386/assets/niak-profile.png",png,8)) {
        mark_profile_asset(user,"png");
        report("Current user PNG avatar staged",0);
        return 1;
    }
    for(int i=0;i<3;++i) {
        const char *name=i==0?"avatar128.dds":i==1?"avatar260.dds":"avatar64.dds";
        snprintf(source,sizeof(source),"%s/%s",profile,name);
        if(copy_profile_image(source,"/data/homebrew/PPSA99386/assets/niak-profile.dds",dds,4)) {
            mark_profile_asset(user,"dds");
            report("Current user DDS avatar staged",0);
            return 1;
        }
    }
    report("Current user avatar inaccessible: no image staged",0);
    return 0;
}

/* The user-authorized PLDmgr one-shot stays resident as a narrow, LOCAL-ONLY
 * launch broker. Native titles cannot reliably start other games from their
 * sandbox. No remote bind, no files / commands / arbitrary title IDs accepted.
 * This is not an exploit, ShellUI hook or remote control service.
 */
static int permitted_title(const char *id) {
    static const char *const roots[]={
        "/user/app/","/system_ex/app/","/data/homebrew/",
        "/mnt/ext0/user/app/","/mnt/ext1/user/app/"
    };
    return niak_title_is_launchable(
        id,NIAK_TITLE,roots,sizeof(roots)/sizeof(roots[0]));
}
static uint64_t niak_monotonic_ms(void) {
    struct timespec clock_time;
    if(clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC,&clock_time)!=0)return 0;
    return (uint64_t)clock_time.tv_sec*1000u+
           (uint64_t)clock_time.tv_nsec/1000000u;
}
/* PLDmgr may execute the same ELF twice. Check whether OUR local protocol
 * already owns the port instead of reporting a second broker as a failure. */
static int broker_already_ready(void) {
    const int probe=socket(AF_INET,SOCK_STREAM,0);
    if(probe<0)return 0;
    niak_socket_guard(probe);
    struct timeval timeout={0,200000};
    (void)setsockopt(probe,SOL_SOCKET,SO_RCVTIMEO,&timeout,sizeof(timeout));
    (void)setsockopt(probe,SOL_SOCKET,SO_SNDTIMEO,&timeout,sizeof(timeout));
    struct sockaddr_in peer={0};
    peer.sin_family=AF_INET;
    peer.sin_port=htons(19187);
    peer.sin_addr.s_addr=htonl(0x7f000001u);
    int ok=niak_connect_bounded(probe,(struct sockaddr*)&peer,sizeof(peer),100)==0;
    if(ok)ok=niak_socket_send(probe,"PING\n",5)==5;
    char reply[5]={0};size_t got=0;
    while(ok && got<sizeof(reply)) {
        const ssize_t n=recv(probe,reply+got,sizeof(reply)-got,0);
        if(n<=0){ok=0;break;}
        got+=(size_t)n;
    }
    close(probe);
    return ok && got==5 && memcmp(reply,"PONG\n",5)==0;
}
static void serve_launch_requests(void) {
    if(broker_already_ready()) {
        report("Local broker already running",0);
        return;
    }
    const int fd=socket(AF_INET,SOCK_STREAM,0);
    if(fd<0){report("Local launch broker socket unavailable",fd);return;}
    niak_socket_guard(fd);
    int yes=1;(void)setsockopt(fd,SOL_SOCKET,SO_REUSEADDR,&yes,sizeof(yes));
    struct sockaddr_in addr={0};
    addr.sin_family=AF_INET;
    addr.sin_port=htons(19187);
    addr.sin_addr.s_addr=htonl(0x7f000001u);
    if(bind(fd,(struct sockaddr*)&addr,sizeof(addr))!=0) {
        const int problem=errno;
        if(problem==EADDRINUSE && broker_already_ready())
            report("Local broker already running",0);
        else report("Local launch broker bind refused",problem);
        close(fd);return;
    }
    if(listen(fd,3)!=0) {
        report("Local launch broker listen refused",errno);close(fd);return;
    }
    report("Local launch broker ready (127.0.0.1 only)",0);
    /* The ELF loader may host the payload in a differently named process.
     * Record actual PID and one low-frequency heartbeat instead of assuming
     * it appears under niakps5.elf in a process scanner.
     */
    report("NiakPS5 broker process PID",(int)getpid());
    NiakRedirectGate gate;
    int gate_ready=0,return_user=-1;
    // Listen for launcher PING/GAMES immediately. Previously a 12x3-second
    // autostart polling loop delayed the launch broker by up to 36 seconds.
    unsigned startup_attempts=0;
    int startup_done=0,profile_checked=0,staged_profile_user=-1;
    uint64_t next_start_ms=0, next_heartbeat_ms=0, next_avatar_ms=0;
    uint64_t started_at_ms=0;
    // The original 21,600 two-second iterations silently stopped the
    // launch service after roughly twelve hours. Keep the opt-in broker
    // alive until the user disables it or the console shuts down.
    for(;;) {
        if(is_regular_file(NIAK_DISABLED))break;
        const uint64_t now=niak_monotonic_ms();
        if(now>=next_heartbeat_ms) {
            // PING may be blocked by the sandbox, while the UI can read our
            // existing /data log. Publish a read-only game ID snapshot
            // separately so no TCP or root privilege is required in the UI.
            char inventory[8192]={0};
            const int count=niak_broker_inventory(inventory,sizeof(inventory),"");
            if(count>=0) {
                const long long stamp=(long long)time(NULL);
                /* Stage to the mounted title's assets so /app0 can read it
                 * without depending on sandbox access to the /data root. */
                if(niak_snapshot_write(NIAK_SNAPSHOT_APP_SOURCE,inventory,
                                       count,stamp)==0)
                    report("NiakPS5 app snapshot installed titles",count);
                else report("NiakPS5 app snapshot write refused",errno);
                if(niak_snapshot_write(NIAK_SNAPSHOT_FILE,inventory,
                                       count,stamp)==0)
                    report("NiakPS5 legacy snapshot installed titles",count);
                else report("NiakPS5 legacy snapshot write refused",errno);
                // Preserve media/app category from the privileged, live
                // installed manifests. The old GAMES socket only sends IDs.
                char app_ids[8192]={0};
                const int apps=niak_broker_apps_from_inventory(
                    inventory,app_ids,sizeof(app_ids),"");
                if(apps>=0) {
                    (void)niak_snapshot_write(NIAK_APPS_SNAPSHOT_APP_SOURCE,
                                              app_ids,apps,stamp);
                    (void)niak_snapshot_write(NIAK_APPS_SNAPSHOT_FILE,
                                              app_ids,apps,stamp);
                    report("NiakPS5 verified installed applications",apps);
                }
            } else report("NiakPS5 broker inventory roots inaccessible",count);
            // The active profile cache may become readable AFTER the GUI
            // starts or after a profile switch. Retry on the already bounded
            // heartbeat without touching an unrelated account's image.
            int avatar_user=-1;
            if(sceUserServiceGetForegroundUser(&avatar_user)==0 &&
               avatar_user>=0 &&
               (!profile_checked || avatar_user!=staged_profile_user) &&
               now>=next_avatar_ms) {
                profile_checked=copy_current_avatar_png(avatar_user);
                staged_profile_user=avatar_user;
                next_avatar_ms=now+30000u;
            }
            report("NiakPS5 broker heartbeat PID",(int)getpid());
            // Timestamp each heartbeat so offline FTP diagnostics can tell
            // an old journal from evidence of recent service activity.
            FILE *heartbeat=fopen(NIAK_LOG,"a");
            if(heartbeat) {
                fprintf(heartbeat,"NiakPS5 broker heartbeat epoch=%lld pid=%u\n",
                        (long long)time(NULL),(unsigned)getpid());
                fclose(heartbeat);
            }
            next_heartbeat_ms=now+120000u;
        }
        // The title may be registered by ShadowMountPlus AFTER the 36-second
        // PLDmgr startup window. Retain a bounded ten-minute readiness window,
        // with slow follow-up attempts and no interruption of another big app.
        // After the window the broker stays resident for PING/GAMES/LAUNCH.
        if(!started_at_ms)started_at_ms=now?now:1;
        const uint64_t elapsed_ms=now>=started_at_ms?now-started_at_ms:0;
        if(!startup_done && elapsed_ms<600000u && now>=next_start_ms) {
            ++startup_attempts;
            next_start_ms=now+(startup_attempts<=12?3000u:30000u);
            const int running=sceSystemServiceGetAppIdOfRunningBigApp();
            if(running<=0) {
                int user=-1;
                const int user_rc=sceUserServiceGetForegroundUser(&user);
                if(user_rc==0 && user>=0) {
                    if((!profile_checked || user!=staged_profile_user) &&
                       now>=next_avatar_ms) {
                        profile_checked=copy_current_avatar_png(user);
                        staged_profile_user=user;
                        next_avatar_ms=now+30000u;
                    }
                    const int rc=launch_title_as_user(NIAK_TITLE,user);
                    if(rc==0)startup_done=1;
                } else report("Foreground user unavailable",user_rc);
            }
        }
        fd_set pending;FD_ZERO(&pending);FD_SET(fd,&pending);
        struct timeval tv={2,0};
        const int available=select(fd+1,&pending,NULL,NULL,&tv);
        if(available>0 && FD_ISSET(fd,&pending)) {
            int client=accept(fd,NULL,NULL);
            if(client>=0) {
                niak_socket_guard(client);
                struct timeval client_timeout={2,0};
                (void)setsockopt(client,SOL_SOCKET,SO_RCVTIMEO,
                                 &client_timeout,sizeof(client_timeout));
                (void)setsockopt(client,SOL_SOCKET,SO_SNDTIMEO,
                                 &client_timeout,sizeof(client_timeout));
                char request[24]={0};
                size_t count=0;
                while(count<sizeof(request)-1) {
                    ssize_t n=recv(client,request+count,sizeof(request)-1-count,0);
                    if(n<=0)break;
                    count+=(size_t)n;
                    if(memchr(request,'\n',count))break;
                }
                if(count==6 && memcmp(request,"GAMES\n",6)==0) {
                    char titles[8192];
                    const int n=niak_broker_inventory(titles,sizeof(titles),"");
                    report("Local installed title inventory",n);
                    if(n<0)(void)niak_socket_send(client,"DENIED\n",7);
                    else {
                        (void)niak_socket_send(client,"GAMES\n",6);
                        size_t pos=0,len=strlen(titles);
                        while(pos<len) {
                            const ssize_t sent=niak_socket_send(client,titles+pos,len-pos);
                            if(sent<=0)break;
                            pos+=(size_t)sent;
                        }
                        if(pos==len)(void)niak_socket_send(client,"END\n",4);
                    }
                    close(client);
                    continue;
                }
                // Fixed settings deep link from the already privileged
                // broker; no arbitrary URI or client-controlled parameters.
                if(count==9 && memcmp(request,"SETTINGS\n",9)==0) {
                    const int settings_rc=niak_open_settings_from_broker();
                    report("NiakPS5 broker system settings",settings_rc);
                    char response[24];
                    const int length=snprintf(response,sizeof(response),
                        "RC %08X\n",(unsigned)settings_rc);
                    if(length==12)
                        (void)niak_socket_send(client,response,12);
                    close(client);continue;
                }
                // Exact local status: broker PID, not arbitrary process enumeration.
                if(count==7 && memcmp(request,"STATUS\n",7)==0) {
                    char status[20];
                    const int n=snprintf(status,sizeof(status),"PID %08X\n",
                                         (unsigned)getpid());
                    if(n>0 && n<(int)sizeof(status))
                        (void)niak_socket_send(client,status,(size_t)n);
                    close(client);
                    continue;
                }
                // A read-only PING makes actual PLDmgr residency testable
                // without launching anything or depending on historical logs.
                if(count==5 && memcmp(request,"PING\n",5)==0) {
                    (void)niak_socket_send(client,"PONG\n",5);
                    close(client);
                    continue;
                }
                int result=-3;
                if(count==17 && memcmp(request,"LAUNCH ",7)==0 &&
                   request[16]=='\n') {
                    char title[10]={0};
                    memcpy(title,request+7,9);
                    if(permitted_title(title)) {
                        int user=-1;
                        if(sceUserServiceGetForegroundUser(&user)==0&&user>=0) {
                            const int source_app=sceSystemServiceGetAppIdOfRunningBigApp();
                            result=launch_title_as_user(title,user);
                            report("Local title launch request",result);
                            // The return gate is opt-in, and only the launch
                            // we explicitly requested may arm it. Merely
                            // seeing some other bigapp never arms a redirect.
                            /* Only an explicit Niak launch can arm this one-shot
                             * redirect. An opt-out marker disables it. */
                            gate_ready=niak_redirect_arm_after_launch(
                                &gate,!is_regular_file(NIAK_RESUME_DISABLED),
                                source_app,result);
                            return_user=gate_ready?user:-1;
                            report("Return gate source app",source_app);
                            report("Return gate armed",gate_ready);
                        }
                    }
                }
                char response[32];
                int n=snprintf(response,sizeof(response),
                               "RC %08X\n",(unsigned)result);
                if(n>0&&n<(int)sizeof(response))
                    (void)niak_socket_send(client,response,(size_t)n);
                close(client);
            }
        }
        if(is_regular_file(NIAK_RESUME_DISABLED)) {
            gate_ready=0;
            return_user=-1;
            continue;
        }
        if(!gate_ready)continue;
        const int running=sceSystemServiceGetAppIdOfRunningBigApp();
        if(!niak_redirect_tick(&gate,running,niak_monotonic_ms()))continue;
        int user=-1;
        const int user_rc=sceUserServiceGetForegroundUser(&user);
        if(user_rc==0 && niak_redirect_same_user(return_user,user)) {
            const int rc=launch_title_as_user(NIAK_TITLE,user);
            report("Optional game-exit return",rc);
        } else {
            // A changed or unreadable profile must never receive an
            // unsolicited home switch from the previous user's game.
            report("Optional game-exit return cancelled (user changed)",user_rc);
        }
        gate_ready=0;
        return_user=-1;
    }
    close(fd);
    report("Local launch broker shutdown",0);
}
int main(void) {
    /* On PS5 this FreeBSD syscall names the executing payload thread, which
     * is visible in common process/thread scanners instead of payload.elf.
     * The external ELF loader may still control the executable filename. */
#ifdef SYS_thr_set_name
    (void)syscall(SYS_thr_set_name,-1,"NiakPS5");
#endif
    if(is_regular_file(NIAK_DISABLED))return 0;
    report("NiakPS5 optional autostart start",0);
    /* Raw PLDmgr ELFs do not inherit a UI title's UserService init.
     * Without this, GetForegroundUser fails with 0x80960002. */
    const int user_service_rc=sceUserServiceInitialize(NULL);
    report("UserService initialize",user_service_rc);
    /* LncUtil has a separate initializer on firmware 13.60. The fallback
     * cannot be assumed usable merely because UserService is initialized. */
    const int lnc_init_rc=sceLncUtilInitialize();
    report("LncUtil initialize",lnc_init_rc);
    // The local broker becomes available before console autostart attempts.
    // A manually launched UI can contact it even while the payload is still
    // waiting for the current foreground user or a free big-app slot.
    serve_launch_requests();
    return 0;
}
```

`native/title/avatar_dds.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// Small, offline DXT5 (BC3) decoder for PS5 profile avatar DDS files.
#include "avatar_dds.hpp"
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <vector>
namespace {
uint32_t le32(const uint8_t *p) {
  return uint32_t(p[0])|(uint32_t(p[1])<<8)|(uint32_t(p[2])<<16)|(uint32_t(p[3])<<24);
}
uint16_t le16(const uint8_t *p) {return uint16_t(p[0])|(uint16_t(p[1])<<8);}
void rgb565(uint16_t v,uint8_t *out) {
  const int r=(v>>11)&31,g=(v>>5)&63,b=v&31;
  out[0]=uint8_t((r*255+15)/31);
  out[1]=uint8_t((g*255+31)/63);
  out[2]=uint8_t((b*255+15)/31);
}
}
bool niak_decode_avatar_dds(const uint8_t *data,std::size_t size,
                            int &w,int &h,std::vector<uint8_t> &pixels) {
 w=h=0;pixels.clear();
 // DDS magic, standard 124-byte header, standard 32-byte pixel-format,
 // FOURCC "DXT5" (BC3); reject unrecognized layouts.
 if(!data||size<144||le32(data)!=0x20534444u||le32(data+4)!=124||
    le32(data+76)!=32||le32(data+84)!=0x35545844u)return false;
 uint32_t width=le32(data+16),height=le32(data+12);
 if(width<16||height<16||width>512||height>512)return false;
 std::size_t cols=(width+3)/4,rows=(height+3)/4;
 if(cols*rows>(size-128)/16)return false;
 pixels.resize(std::size_t(width)*height*4);
 const uint8_t *ptr=data+128;
 for(std::size_t row=0;row<rows;++row)for(std::size_t col=0;col<cols;++col){
   uint8_t alphas[8]={ptr[0],ptr[1]};
   if(alphas[0]>alphas[1])for(int i=1;i<=6;++i)
     alphas[i+1]=uint8_t(((7-i)*int(alphas[0])+i*int(alphas[1]))/7);
   else{
     for(int i=1;i<=4;++i)
       alphas[i+1]=uint8_t(((5-i)*int(alphas[0])+i*int(alphas[1]))/5);
     alphas[6]=0;alphas[7]=255;
   }
   uint64_t alpha_bits=0;
   for(int j=0;j<6;++j)alpha_bits|=uint64_t(ptr[2+j])<<(j*8);
   uint8_t colors[4][3]{};
   rgb565(le16(ptr+8),colors[0]);rgb565(le16(ptr+10),colors[1]);
   for(int j=0;j<3;++j){
     colors[2][j]=uint8_t((2*int(colors[0][j])+int(colors[1][j]))/3);
     colors[3][j]=uint8_t((int(colors[0][j])+2*int(colors[1][j]))/3);
   }
   const uint32_t rgb_bits=le32(ptr+12);
   for(int i=0;i<16;++i){
     const unsigned x=unsigned(col*4+i%4),y=unsigned(row*4+i/4);
     if(x>=width||y>=height)continue;
     const auto off=(std::size_t(y)*width+x)*4;
     const unsigned a=unsigned((alpha_bits>>(3*i))&7u);
     const unsigned color=(rgb_bits>>(2*i))&3u;
     for(int ch=0;ch<3;++ch)pixels[off+ch]=colors[color][ch];
     pixels[off+3]=alphas[a];
   }
   ptr+=16;
 }
 w=int(width);h=int(height);
 return true;
}
```

`native/title/broker_catalog.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#include "niak/broker_catalog.hpp"
#include "niak/socket_guard.h"
#include "niak/loopback_connect.h"
#include "niak/broker_snapshot.h"
#include <arpa/inet.h>
#include <netinet/in.h>
#include <sys/socket.h>
#include <sys/time.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>

static int niak_scan_broker_socket(NiakGame *games,std::size_t cap) {
 if(!games||!cap)return -1;
 const int fd=socket(AF_INET,SOCK_STREAM,0);
 if(fd<0)return -1;
 niak_socket_guard(fd);
 sockaddr_in address{};
 address.sin_family=AF_INET;
 address.sin_port=htons(19187);
 address.sin_addr.s_addr=htonl(0x7f000001u);
 if(niak_connect_bounded(fd,reinterpret_cast<sockaddr*>(&address),
                         sizeof(address),100)<0){close(fd);return -1;}
 timeval tv{0,300000};
 setsockopt(fd,SOL_SOCKET,SO_RCVTIMEO,&tv,sizeof(tv));
 setsockopt(fd,SOL_SOCKET,SO_SNDTIMEO,&tv,sizeof(tv));
 if(niak_socket_send(fd,"GAMES\n",6)!=6){close(fd);return -1;}
 char response[8192]={};
 std::size_t got=0;
 while(got<sizeof(response)-1) {
  const ssize_t n=recv(fd,response+got,sizeof(response)-1-got,0);
  if(n<=0)break;
  got+=static_cast<std::size_t>(n);
  response[got]=0;
  if(std::strstr(response,"\nEND\n"))break;
 }
 close(fd);
 if(got<10||std::strncmp(response,"GAMES\n",6)!=0 ||
    !std::strstr(response,"\nEND\n"))return -1;
 /* A caller asking for one item must still validate the entire stream.
  * Refuse duplicates, our own app and an unexpected suffix after END.
  */
 char seen[NIAK_SNAPSHOT_MAX_GAMES][10]{};
 std::size_t validated=0,stored=0;
 const char *p=response+6;
 while(*p) {
  if(std::strncmp(p,"END\n",4)==0)
   return p[4]=='\0'?int(stored):-1;
  const char *end=std::strchr(p,'\n');
  if(!end || end-p!=9 || validated>=NIAK_SNAPSHOT_MAX_GAMES)return -1;
  char id[10]{};
  std::memcpy(id,p,9);
  if(!niak_snapshot_valid_id(id))return -1;
  for(std::size_t i=0;i<validated;++i)
   if(std::strcmp(id,seen[i])==0)return -1;
  std::memcpy(seen[validated++],id,10);
  if(stored<cap) {
   NiakGame &game=games[stored++];
   std::memset(&game,0,sizeof(game));
   std::memcpy(game.id,id,9);
   std::memcpy(game.title,id,9);
  }
  p=end+1;
 }
 return -1;
}

int niak_scan_broker_games(NiakGame *games,std::size_t cap) {
    if(!games || !cap)return -1;
    const int live=niak_scan_broker_socket(games,cap);
    if(live>=0)return live;
    // The PS5 title is sandboxed and may have no TCP/fcntl permissions.
    // The PLDmgr broker writes this small fixed-root inventory periodically;
    // file reading is read-only, checked for freshness, and never launches
    // code or accepts commands from untrusted clients.
    const int mounted=niak_snapshot_read(NIAK_SNAPSHOT_APP_FILE,games,cap);
    if(mounted>=0)return mounted;
    // Some PS5 title setups expose /data/homebrew directly rather than /app0.
    const int direct=niak_snapshot_read(NIAK_SNAPSHOT_APP_SOURCE,games,cap);
    if(direct>=0)return direct;
    return niak_snapshot_read(NIAK_SNAPSHOT_FILE,games,cap);
}
```

`native/title/broker_inventory.h`:

```h
/* SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
 * Read-only fixed-root installed title inventory. No paths or user files
 * pass between the PLDmgr ELF and the sandboxed graphical application.
 */
#ifndef NIAK_BROKER_INVENTORY_H
#define NIAK_BROKER_INVENTORY_H
#include <dirent.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <stddef.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include "title_category.h"
static inline int niak_broker_id(const char *id) {
 if(!id||strlen(id)!=9)return 0;
 if(strncmp(id,"PPSA",4)&&strncmp(id,"CUSA",4)&&
    strncmp(id,"LAPY",4)&&strncmp(id,"FAKE",4)&&
    strncmp(id,"NPXS",4))return 0;
 for(int i=4;i<9;i++)if(id[i]<'0'||id[i]>'9')return 0;
 return 1;
}
static inline int niak_broker_is_file(const char *p) {
 struct stat st;return lstat(p,&st)==0&&S_ISREG(st.st_mode);
}
/* NPXS includes shell services: expose only explicitly categorized media. */
static inline int niak_broker_media(const char *path,const char *id) {
 FILE *f=fopen(path,"rb");if(!f)return 0;
 char json[32769];const size_t n=fread(json,1,sizeof(json),f);
 const int complete=feof(f);fclose(f);
 if(!complete || n<10 || n>=sizeof(json))return 0;
 json[n]=0;
 return niak_is_installed_media_category_for_title(json,id);
}
static inline int niak_broker_is_dir(const char *p) {
 struct stat st;return lstat(p,&st)==0&&S_ISDIR(st.st_mode);
}
/* Each record is EXACTLY 9 ASCII ID bytes and newline; NUL terminator.
 * Cap the result at 512 IDs. -1 means all fixed roots were inaccessible.
 * Nonempty root is used by host filesystem fixture tests only. */
static inline int niak_broker_inventory(char *out,size_t cap,const char *root) {
 static const char *const roots[]={"/user/app","/system_ex/app",
   "/mnt/ext0/user/app","/mnt/ext1/user/app","/data/homebrew"};
 if(!out||cap<12||!root)return -1;
 size_t used=0;int accessible=0,total=0;out[0]=0;
 for(size_t k=0;k<sizeof(roots)/sizeof(roots[0]);++k) {
  char top[512];
  int n=snprintf(top,sizeof(top),"%s%s",root,roots[k]);
  if(n<0||(size_t)n>=sizeof(top))continue;
  DIR *dir=opendir(top);
  if(!dir)continue;
  accessible=1;struct dirent *entry;
  while((entry=readdir(dir)) && total<512) {
   const char *id=entry->d_name;
   if(!niak_broker_id(id)||strcmp(id,"PPSA99386")==0)continue;
   char base[576],meta[640],eboot[640],pkg[640];
   n=snprintf(base,sizeof(base),"%s/%s",top,id);
   if(n<0||(size_t)n>=sizeof(base)||!niak_broker_is_dir(base))continue;
   snprintf(meta,sizeof(meta),"%s/sce_sys/param.json",base);
   snprintf(eboot,sizeof(eboot),"%s/eboot.bin",base);
   snprintf(pkg,sizeof(pkg),"%s/app.pkg",base);
   if(!niak_broker_is_file(meta)&&!niak_broker_is_file(eboot)&&
      !niak_broker_is_file(pkg))continue;
   if(strncmp(id,"NPXS",4)==0) {
     // ShadowMount and native media installers may stage the verified
     // param.json under /user/appmeta. This is NOT proof of installation:
     // the independently checked live /user/app or /system_ex/app folder
     // above is still mandatory.
     int verified=niak_broker_is_file(meta)&&niak_broker_media(meta,id);
     if(!verified) {
       char appmeta[640];
       const int m=snprintf(appmeta,sizeof(appmeta),
                          "%s/user/appmeta/%s/param.json",root,id);
       if(m>0 && (size_t)m<sizeof(appmeta) &&
          niak_broker_is_file(appmeta))
         verified=niak_broker_media(appmeta,id);
     }
     if(!verified)continue;
   }
   int duplicate=0;
   for(size_t pos=0;pos+10<=used;pos+=10)
    if(memcmp(out+pos,id,9)==0){duplicate=1;break;}
   if(duplicate||used+11>cap)continue;
   memcpy(out+used,id,9);out[used+9]='\n';
   used+=10;out[used]=0;total++;
  }
  closedir(dir);
 }
 return accessible?total:-1;
}
/* A second, bounded inventory records only application IDs from the
 * already-validated live GAMES list. Homebrew param.json often uses native
 * game category 0 even for utility launchers. A verified media category or
 * recognized launcher title in its OWN installed manifest makes it an app.
 * Unknown NPXS shell services remain excluded by niak_broker_inventory.
 */
static inline int niak_broker_apps_from_inventory(const char *ids,
                                                  char *apps,size_t cap,
                                                  const char *root) {
 if(!ids||!apps||cap<2||!root)return -1;
 static const char *const roots[]={"/user/app","/system_ex/app",
   "/mnt/ext0/user/app","/mnt/ext1/user/app","/data/homebrew"};
 apps[0]=0;size_t used=0;int count=0;
 const char *cursor=ids;
 while(*cursor) {
  if(strlen(cursor)<10 || cursor[9]!='\n')return -1;
  char id[10];memcpy(id,cursor,9);id[9]=0;cursor+=10;
  if(!niak_broker_id(id))return -1;
  int is_app=0;
  for(size_t k=0;k<sizeof(roots)/sizeof(roots[0]);++k) {
   char file[800];
   const int n=snprintf(file,sizeof(file),
       "%s%s/%s/sce_sys/param.json",root,roots[k],id);
   if(n<=0||(size_t)n>=sizeof(file)||!niak_broker_is_file(file))continue;
   FILE *f=fopen(file,"rb");if(!f)continue;
   char json[32769]={0};
   const size_t size=fread(json,1,sizeof(json)-1,f);
   const int complete=feof(f);
   fclose(f);
   if(!complete||size<12||size>=sizeof(json))continue;
   if(niak_is_installed_media_category_for_title(json,id)) {
       is_app=1;break;
   }
   // Only apply these named launchers to non-NPXS *installed* titles.
   // Strings here classify shelf presentation, not execution rights.
   if(strncmp(id,"NPXS",4)!=0 &&
      (strstr(json,"ShadowMount")||strstr(json,"shadowmount")||
       strstr(json,"Eden Encore")||strstr(json,"Eden-Encore")||
       strstr(json,"Mes vid")||strstr(json,"My Videos")||
       strstr(json,"NiakTV")||strstr(json,"CleanMyPS5")||
       strstr(json,"PS5 Game Updater")||strstr(json,"PS5-Xplorer"))) {
       is_app=1;break;
   }
  }
  if(!is_app && strncmp(id,"NPXS",4)==0) {
    char verified[800];
    const int n=snprintf(verified,sizeof(verified),
                         "%s/user/appmeta/%s/param.json",root,id);
    if(n>0 && (size_t)n<sizeof(verified) &&
       niak_broker_is_file(verified))
       is_app=niak_broker_media(verified,id);
  }
  if(is_app) {
   if(used+11>cap)return -1;
   memcpy(apps+used,id,9);apps[used+9]='\n';
   used+=10;apps[used]=0;++count;
  }
 }
 return count;
}
#endif
```

`native/title/broker_snapshot.h`:

```h
/* SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
 * One-way, read-only installed-ID inventory from opt-in PLDmgr broker.
 * PS5 titles may be forbidden to use fcntl or TCP by their sandbox.
 * No user-provided paths or commands, no privilege transfer.
 */
#ifndef NIAK_BROKER_SNAPSHOT_H
#define NIAK_BROKER_SNAPSHOT_H
#include "catalog.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <unistd.h>

/* The payload can update the native title's own existing assets folder.
 * The sandboxed UI reads the same bytes via its mounted /app0 path.
 * Keep /data as a backward-compatible fallback on older installations.
 */
#define NIAK_SNAPSHOT_FILE "/data/niakps5-games.snapshot"
#define NIAK_SNAPSHOT_APP_SOURCE "/data/homebrew/PPSA99386/assets/niakps5-games.snapshot"
#define NIAK_SNAPSHOT_APP_FILE "/app0/assets/niakps5-games.snapshot"
#define NIAK_APPS_SNAPSHOT_APP_SOURCE "/data/homebrew/PPSA99386/assets/niakps5-apps.snapshot"
#define NIAK_APPS_SNAPSHOT_APP_FILE "/app0/assets/niakps5-apps.snapshot"
#define NIAK_APPS_SNAPSHOT_FILE "/data/niakps5-apps.snapshot"
#define NIAK_SNAPSHOT_MAX_AGE 600LL
#define NIAK_SNAPSHOT_MAX_GAMES 512
#define NIAK_SNAPSHOT_VERSION "NIAKPS5-GAMES-1"

static inline int niak_snapshot_valid_id(const char *id) {
    if(!id || strlen(id)!=9 ||
       (strncmp(id,"PPSA",4)&&strncmp(id,"CUSA",4)&&
        strncmp(id,"LAPY",4)&&strncmp(id,"FAKE",4)&&
        strncmp(id,"NPXS",4)))return 0;
    for(int i=4;i<9;i++)if(id[i]<'0'||id[i]>'9')return 0;
    return strcmp(id,"PPSA99386")!=0;
}

/* Only the PLDmgr payload calls this on its FIXED private snapshot file.
 * Caller provides the read-only fixed-root inventory, not a client request.
 * Atomic replace prevents the title seeing a half-written inventory.
 */
static inline int niak_snapshot_write(const char *path,const char *ids,
                                      int count,long long epoch) {
    if(!path || !ids || count<0 || count>NIAK_SNAPSHOT_MAX_GAMES ||
       epoch<=0 || strlen(ids)>8192)return -1;
    char temp[256];
    const int name_len=snprintf(temp,sizeof(temp),"%s.XXXXXX",path);
    if(name_len<=0 || name_len>=(int)sizeof(temp))return -1;
    /* A crashed broker must never leave a predictable PID-named temp that
     * prevents all subsequent refreshes. mkstemp creates a unique O_EXCL file.
     */
    int fd=mkstemp(temp);
    if(fd<0)return -1;
    int ok=fchmod(fd,0644)==0;
    FILE *out=fdopen(fd,"wb");
    if(!out){close(fd);unlink(temp);return -1;}
    if(fprintf(out,NIAK_SNAPSHOT_VERSION " %lld %d\n",epoch,count)<0)ok=0;
    const char *p=ids;
    for(int i=0;ok && i<count;++i) {
        if(strlen(p)<10 || p[9]!='\n') {ok=0;break;}
        char name[10];memcpy(name,p,9);name[9]=0;
        if(!niak_snapshot_valid_id(name)) {ok=0;break;}
        if(fwrite(p,1,10,out)!=10)ok=0;
        p+=10;
    }
    if(ok && *p!=0)ok=0;
    if(ok && fputs("END\n",out)<0)ok=0;
    if(ok && fflush(out)!=0)ok=0;
    if(ok && fsync(fd)!=0)ok=0;
    if(fclose(out)!=0)ok=0;
    if(ok && rename(temp,path)==0)return 0;
    unlink(temp);
    return -1;
}

/* Read-only, strictly bounded. A copied old snapshot cannot masquerade as
 * a live broker; bad paths, duplicates, symlinks and stale data fail closed.
 * At most cap game IDs are returned; count may exceed cap.
 */
static inline int niak_snapshot_read(const char *path,NiakGame *games,
                                     size_t cap) {
    if(!path || !games || !cap || cap>NIAK_SNAPSHOT_MAX_GAMES)return -1;
    /* Open first, verify the SAME descriptor afterwards. Never pair a
     * pre-open lstat with a path-based open: that is a TOCTOU window.
     * O_NONBLOCK also prevents a swapped FIFO from blocking on open.
     */
    const int fd=open(path,O_RDONLY|O_NOFOLLOW|O_NONBLOCK);
    if(fd<0)return -1;
    struct stat opened;
    if(fstat(fd,&opened)!=0 || !S_ISREG(opened.st_mode) ||
       opened.st_size<20 || opened.st_size>8192) {
        close(fd);return -1;
    }
    FILE *in=fdopen(fd,"rb");
    if(!in){close(fd);return -1;}
    char line[96];long long stamp=0;int count=-1;int result=-1;
    int header_bytes=0;
    if(!fgets(line,sizeof(line),in) ||
       sscanf(line,NIAK_SNAPSHOT_VERSION " %lld %d",&stamp,&count)!=2 ||
       count<0 || count>NIAK_SNAPSHOT_MAX_GAMES || stamp<=0)goto done;
    /* sscanf alone accepts extra trailing data. Require the writer's
     * exact canonical single-line header, including the final newline.
     */
    char expected_header[96];
    header_bytes=snprintf(expected_header,sizeof(expected_header),
        NIAK_SNAPSHOT_VERSION " %lld %d\n",stamp,count);
    if(header_bytes<=0 || header_bytes>=(int)sizeof(expected_header) ||
       strcmp(line,expected_header)!=0)goto done;
    {
        const time_t now=time(NULL);
        if(now<=0 || stamp>(long long)now+60 ||
           (long long)now-stamp>NIAK_SNAPSHOT_MAX_AGE)goto done;
    }
    /* Validate ALL IDs, not only the caller's cap: a small catalogue probe
     * must not accidentally accept duplicates beyond its output buffer.
     */
    char seen[NIAK_SNAPSHOT_MAX_GAMES][10];
    for(int i=0;i<count;++i) {
        if(!fgets(line,sizeof(line),in)||strlen(line)!=10 ||
           line[9]!='\n')goto done;
        line[9]=0;
        if(!niak_snapshot_valid_id(line))goto done;
        for(int k=0;k<i;++k)
            if(strcmp(seen[k],line)==0)goto done;
        memcpy(seen[i],line,10);
        if((size_t)i<cap) {
            memset(&games[i],0,sizeof(games[i]));
            memcpy(games[i].id,line,9);
            memcpy(games[i].title,line,9);
        }
    }
    if(!fgets(line,sizeof(line),in) || strcmp(line,"END\n")!=0 ||
       fgetc(in)!=EOF)goto done;
    result=count<(int)cap?count:(int)cap;
done:
    fclose(in);
    return result;
}
#endif

```

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// Optional pre-cached LaunchBox retail PS4/PS5 case print.
#include "niak/case_art.hpp"
#include "niak/lodepng.h"
#if defined(__PROSPERO__)
#include <webp/decode.h>
#endif
#include "niak/case_texture_scale.hpp"
#include "niak/case_auto_art.hpp"
#include "niak/case_footer_alpha.hpp"
#include "niak/asset_stats.hpp"
extern "C" {
#include "niak/catalog.h"
}
#include "gfx/renderer.hpp"
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <utility>
#if defined(__PROSPERO__)
#include <condition_variable>
#include <deque>
#include <mutex>
#include <thread>
#include <unordered_set>
#endif
namespace {
// Texture creation and release always run on the graphics thread.
std::unordered_map<std::uint32_t,std::uint64_t> tracked_case_textures;
void track_case_texture(std::uint32_t texture,unsigned w,unsigned h){
 if(!texture)return;
 const auto bytes=std::uint64_t(w)*h*4u;
 tracked_case_textures[texture]=bytes;
 niak::case_media_stats.case_texture_bytes+=bytes;
}
// Private CDN PNGs are valid only after their .source marker is committed.
// Earlier interrupted writes must never displace the fallback box art.
bool valid_download_source(const std::string &image_path) {
 const std::string marker=image_path+".source";
 FILE *f=std::fopen(marker.c_str(),"rb");
 if(!f)return false;
 char name[64]{};
 const std::size_t length=std::fread(name,1,sizeof(name),f);
 const bool ended=std::feof(f)!=0;
 std::fclose(f);
 if(!ended)return false;
 const bool r2=length>=3 && std::memcmp(name,"r2_",3)==0;
 const std::size_t offset=r2?3u:0u;
 if(length!=offset+40u && length!=offset+41u)return false;
 for(std::size_t i=offset;i<offset+36;i++){
   const char c=name[i];
   if(!((c>='0'&&c<='9')||(c>='a'&&c<='f')||
        (c>='A'&&c<='F')||c=='-'))return false;
 }
 const std::string ext(name+offset+36,length-offset-36);
 return ext==".jpg"||ext==".jpeg"||ext==".png";
}
} // namespace
void niak_track_case_texture(std::uint32_t texture,unsigned width,unsigned height){
 track_case_texture(texture,width,height);
}
static bool niak_prepare_case_pixels(
        const char *id,const char *side,
        std::vector<unsigned char> &prepared,unsigned &out_w,unsigned &out_h) {
 if(!niak_valid_title_id(id)||!side ||
    (std::strcmp(side,"front") && std::strcmp(side,"back") &&
     std::strcmp(side,"logo") && std::strcmp(side,"spine") &&
     std::strcmp(side,"poster") && std::strcmp(side,"hero") &&
     std::strcmp(side,"shot1") && std::strcmp(side,"shot2")))return false;
 // Do not let a stale/corrupt private PNG shadow another valid source.
 std::vector<std::string> paths;
 char file[384];
#if defined(__linux__)
 if(const char *preview=std::getenv("NIAK_CASE_PREVIEW_ASSETS")) {
     if(preview[0]) {
         std::snprintf(file,sizeof(file),"%s/%s-%s.png",preview,id,side);
         paths.emplace_back(file);
     }
 }
#endif
 // Native CDN WebP cache takes precedence over old PNG, if provenance is valid.
 std::snprintf(file,sizeof(file),"/download0/niak-case-%s-%s.webp",id,side);
 paths.emplace_back(file);
 // A verified CDN replacement takes priority over older FTP artwork.
 // Without this ordering a downloaded PS5 back could stay invisible behind
 // the previously installed PS4/PC fallback after a successful upgrade.
 std::snprintf(file,sizeof(file),"/download0/niak-case-%s-%s.png",id,side);
 paths.emplace_back(file);
 // Prefer WebP FTP art when present; retain PNG for older installations.
 for(const char *format:{
     "/data/homebrew/PPSA99386/assets/niak-cases/%s-%s.webp",
     "/app0/assets/niak-cases/%s-%s.webp",
     "/data/homebrew/PPSA99386/assets/niak-cases/%s-%s.png",
     "/app0/assets/niak-cases/%s-%s.png"}) {
     std::snprintf(file,sizeof(file),format,id,side);
     paths.emplace_back(file);
 }
 if(std::strcmp(side,"front")==0) {
     std::snprintf(file,sizeof(file),
         "/data/homebrew/%s/assets/box-front.png",id);
     paths.emplace_back(file);
 }
 const bool logo=std::strcmp(side,"logo")==0;
 const bool spine=std::strcmp(side,"spine")==0;
 const bool landscape=std::strcmp(side,"hero")==0 ||
                      std::strcmp(side,"shot1")==0 ||
                      std::strcmp(side,"shot2")==0;
 for(const std::string& filename:paths) {
     // The FTP override and packaged scans have independent provenance.
     // Only worker-generated PNGs require the atomic .source sidecar.
     if(filename.rfind("/download0/niak-case-",0)==0 &&
        !valid_download_source(filename))continue;
     FILE *fp=std::fopen(filename.c_str(),"rb");
     if(!fp)continue;
     if(std::fseek(fp,0,SEEK_END)!=0){std::fclose(fp);continue;}
     const long size=std::ftell(fp);
     if(size<33||size>3*1024*1024||
        std::fseek(fp,0,SEEK_SET)!=0){std::fclose(fp);continue;}
     std::vector<unsigned char> png(static_cast<std::size_t>(size));
     const bool okay=std::fread(png.data(),1,png.size(),fp)==png.size();
     std::fclose(fp);if(!okay)continue;
     if(png.size()<24)continue;
     const bool webp=std::memcmp(png.data(),"RIFF",4)==0 &&
                     std::memcmp(png.data()+8,"WEBP",4)==0;
     unsigned width=0,height=0;
     if(webp) {
#if defined(__PROSPERO__)
         int iw=0,ih=0;
         if(!WebPGetInfo(png.data(),png.size(),&iw,&ih) ||
            iw<=0||ih<=0)continue;
         width=unsigned(iw);height=unsigned(ih);
#else
         continue; // Host preview retains PNG-only fixtures.
#endif
     } else {
         if(std::memcmp(png.data(),"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n",8)!=0)continue;
         width=(unsigned(png[16])<<24)|(unsigned(png[17])<<16)|
               (unsigned(png[18])<<8)|png[19];
         height=(unsigned(png[20])<<24)|(unsigned(png[21])<<16)|
                (unsigned(png[22])<<8)|png[23];
     }
     if(width<(logo?32u:spine?16u:64u)||
        height<(logo?20u:100u)||
        width>(logo?1400u:landscape?2048u:1024u)||
        height>1536u)continue;
     if(!logo) {
         const float ratio=float(width)/float(height);
         if(spine?ratio>0.25f:
            landscape?(ratio<1.15f||ratio>3.1f):
                      (ratio<0.55f||ratio>0.90f))continue;
     }
     std::vector<unsigned char> pixels;unsigned w=width,h=height;
     if(webp) {
#if defined(__PROSPERO__)
         pixels.resize(std::size_t(w)*h*4u);
         if(!WebPDecodeRGBAInto(png.data(),png.size(),pixels.data(),
                                pixels.size(),int(w*4u)))continue;
#else
         continue;
#endif
     } else if(lodepng::decode(pixels,w,h,png)!=0||
               w!=width||h!=height||
               pixels.size()!=std::size_t(w)*h*4u)continue;
     if(!niak_scale_case_rgba(pixels,w,h,
         logo?768u:spine?96u:landscape?768u:512u,
         landscape?512u:768u))continue;
     out_w=w;out_h=h;
     prepared=std::move(pixels);
     return true;
 }
 // Pure CPU helper. Work is queued separately on PS5 and previews load
 // read-only fixtures synchronously on the host.
 return false;
}

#if defined(__PROSPERO__)
// Latest-selected-title worker. This owns no GPU handles or catalogue items;
// only one resized RGBA image is retained until the graphics thread polls it.
struct PreparedCaseArt {
    std::mutex mutex;
    std::condition_variable wake;
    std::deque<std::string> queued_sides;
    std::unordered_set<std::string> in_flight;
    std::string selected_id;
    std::uint64_t generation=0;
    bool started=false,completed=false;
    std::string completed_id,completed_side;
    std::vector<unsigned char> completed_pixels;
    unsigned completed_width=0,completed_height=0;
};
static PreparedCaseArt &prepared_case_state() {
    static auto *state=new PreparedCaseArt;
    return *state;
}
static void prepared_case_worker() {
    auto &state=prepared_case_state();
    for(;;) {
        std::string id,side;
        std::uint64_t generation=0;
        {
            std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lock(state.mutex);
            state.wake.wait(lock,[&] {
                return !state.completed && !state.queued_sides.empty();
            });
            id=state.selected_id;
            generation=state.generation;
            side=std::move(state.queued_sides.front());
            state.queued_sides.pop_front();
        }
        std::vector<unsigned char> pixels;
        unsigned width=0,height=0;
        const bool ready=niak_prepare_case_pixels(
            id.c_str(),side.c_str(),pixels,width,height);
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(state.mutex);
            // A different game was selected while a large scan decoded.
            // Its decoded bytes must never be uploaded to an old GPU owner.
            if(generation!=state.generation || id!=state.selected_id)
                continue;
            if(!ready) {
                state.in_flight.erase(side);
                continue;
            }
            state.completed_id=std::move(id);
            state.completed_side=std::move(side);
            state.completed_width=width;
            state.completed_height=height;
            state.completed_pixels=std::move(pixels);
            state.completed=true;
        }
    }
}
static void queue_prepared_case_art(const char *id,const char *side) {
    auto &state=prepared_case_state();
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(state.mutex);
    if(state.selected_id!=id) {
        state.selected_id=id;
        ++state.generation;
        state.queued_sides.clear();
        state.in_flight.clear();
        state.completed=false;
        state.completed_pixels.clear();
        state.completed_id.clear();
        state.completed_side.clear();
    }
    // At most eight distinct face requests per game.
    if(state.in_flight.size()>=8 || !state.in_flight.emplace(side).second)
        return;
    state.queued_sides.emplace_back(side);
    if(!state.started) {
        state.started=true;
        std::thread([] {prepared_case_worker();}).detach();
    }
    state.wake.notify_one();
}
#endif

void niak_invalidate_prepared_case_art(const char *id) {
#if defined(__PROSPERO__)
    if(!id)return;
    auto &state=prepared_case_state();
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(state.mutex);
    if(state.selected_id!=id)return;
    // CDN completed a NEW face while an older copy was queued, decoded or
    // waiting for upload. Invalidate all old-generation pixels and restart
    // the 11-stage hydration against the current atomic cache.
    ++state.generation;
    state.queued_sides.clear();
    state.in_flight.clear();
    state.completed=false;
    state.completed_pixels.clear();
    state.completed_id.clear();
    state.completed_side.clear();
    state.wake.notify_one();
#else
    (void)id;
#endif
}
std::uint32_t niak_load_case_art(hui::gfx::Renderer &renderer,
                                 const char *id,const char *side,float *aspect) {
#if defined(__PROSPERO__)
    // Preserve the established 11-stage prioritization but no filesystem
    // reads, PNG/WebP decompression or CPU scaling on the GL thread.
    if(!niak_valid_title_id(id)||!side ||
       (std::strcmp(side,"front") && std::strcmp(side,"back") &&
        std::strcmp(side,"spine") && std::strcmp(side,"logo") &&
        std::strcmp(side,"poster") && std::strcmp(side,"hero") &&
        std::strcmp(side,"shot1") && std::strcmp(side,"shot2")))return 0;
    queue_prepared_case_art(id,side);
    (void)renderer;(void)aspect;
    return 0;
#else
    // Original host preview remains eager and deterministic.
    std::vector<unsigned char> pixels;
    unsigned w=0,h=0;
    if(!niak_prepare_case_pixels(id,side,pixels,w,h))return 0;
    const auto handle=renderer.create_texture(int(w),int(h),pixels.data());
    if(!handle)return 0;
    if(aspect)*aspect=float(w)/float(h);
    track_case_texture(handle,w,h);
    return handle;
#endif
}

// Drop mismatched completions BEFORE the GPU allocation, not after it.
// There is no renderer work, file read or socket call on an empty poll.
std::uint32_t niak_take_prepared_case_art(
        hui::gfx::Renderer &renderer,const char *expected_id,
        char (&side)[16],float *aspect) {
    side[0]=0;
#if defined(__PROSPERO__)
    auto &state=prepared_case_state();
    std::vector<unsigned char> pixels;
    std::string selected_side;
    unsigned w=0,h=0;
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(state.mutex);
        if(!state.completed)return 0;
        const bool selected=expected_id &&
            state.completed_id==expected_id &&
            state.selected_id==expected_id;
        selected_side=std::move(state.completed_side);
        if(selected) {
            pixels=std::move(state.completed_pixels);
            w=state.completed_width;
            h=state.completed_height;
        }
        state.completed_pixels.clear();
        state.completed=false;
        state.completed_id.clear();
        state.in_flight.erase(selected_side);
    }
    state.wake.notify_one();
    if(pixels.empty() || selected_side.size()>=sizeof(side) ||
       !w || !h || w>2048u || h>1536u ||
       pixels.size()!=std::size_t(w)*h*4u)return 0;
    std::memcpy(side,selected_side.c_str(),selected_side.size()+1u);
    const auto handle=renderer.create_texture(int(w),int(h),pixels.data());
    if(handle) {
        if(aspect)*aspect=float(w)/float(h);
        track_case_texture(handle,w,h);
    }
    return handle;
#else
    (void)renderer;(void)expected_id;(void)aspect;
    return 0;
#endif
}

void niak_destroy_case_texture(hui::gfx::Renderer &renderer,
                               std::uint32_t &texture){
 if(!texture)return;
 const auto it=tracked_case_textures.find(texture);
 if(it!=tracked_case_textures.end()){
     const auto bytes=it->second;
     auto &total=niak::case_media_stats.case_texture_bytes;
     total=total>=bytes?total-bytes:0;
     tracked_case_textures.erase(it);
 }
 renderer.destroy_texture(texture);
 texture=0;
}
namespace {
bool template_attempted[6]={};
std::uint32_t template_textures[6]={};
}
void niak_release_case_templates(hui::gfx::Renderer &renderer) {
 for(int i=0;i<6;++i) {
  niak_destroy_case_texture(renderer,template_textures[i]);
  template_attempted[i]=false;
 }
}
std::uint32_t niak_load_case_template(hui::gfx::Renderer &renderer,
                                      const char *platform,const char *part) {
 // Exactly six static, user-supplied files. Never form untrusted paths.
 const char *platforms[]={"ps4","ps5"};
 const char *parts[]={"front","back","spine"};
 int generation=-1,side=-1;
 for(int i=0;i<2;++i)
     if(platform && std::strcmp(platform,platforms[i])==0)generation=i;
 for(int i=0;i<3;++i)
     if(part && std::strcmp(part,parts[i])==0)side=i;
 if(generation<0||side<0)return 0;
 const int index=generation*3+side;
 if(template_attempted[index])return template_textures[index];
 template_attempted[index]=true;
 char file[512]{};
#if defined(__linux__)
 const auto fail=[&](const char *reason)->std::uint32_t{
     std::fprintf(stderr,"[NiakPS5 preview] fixed template %s-%s: %s [%s]\\n",
                  platform,part,reason,file);
     return 0;
 };
#else
 const auto fail=[&](const char *)->std::uint32_t{return 0;};
#endif
 FILE *fp=nullptr;
#if defined(__linux__)
 const char *fixture=std::getenv("NIAK_CASE_TEMPLATE_ASSETS");
 if(fixture && fixture[0]) {
     std::snprintf(file,sizeof(file),"%s/%s-%s.png",fixture,platform,part);
     fp=std::fopen(file,"rb");
 }
#endif
 if(!fp) {
     std::snprintf(file,sizeof(file),
        "/data/homebrew/PPSA99386/assets/niak-templates/%s-%s.png",platform,part);
     fp=std::fopen(file,"rb");
 }
 if(!fp) {
     std::snprintf(file,sizeof(file),
        "/app0/assets/niak-templates/%s-%s.png",platform,part);
     fp=std::fopen(file,"rb");
 }
 // User-provided PNG originals always win over the built-in compressed
 // WebP defaults. This works entirely inside the NiakPS5 native title.
#if defined(__PROSPERO__)
 if(!fp) {
     std::snprintf(file,sizeof(file),
        "/data/homebrew/PPSA99386/assets/niak-templates/%s-%s.webp",
        platform,part);
     fp=std::fopen(file,"rb");
 }
 if(!fp) {
     std::snprintf(file,sizeof(file),
        "/app0/assets/niak-templates/%s-%s.webp",platform,part);
     fp=std::fopen(file,"rb");
 }
#endif
 if(!fp)return fail("not found"); // Optional on offline PS5, required in CI.
 if(std::fseek(fp,0,SEEK_END)!=0){std::fclose(fp);return 0;}
 const long size=std::ftell(fp);
 if(size<33 || size>3*1024*1024 || std::fseek(fp,0,SEEK_SET)!=0)
     {std::fclose(fp);return 0;}
 std::vector<unsigned char> bytes(static_cast<std::size_t>(size));
 const bool complete=std::fread(bytes.data(),1,bytes.size(),fp)==bytes.size();
 std::fclose(fp);if(!complete)return 0;
 if(bytes.size()<24)return 0;
 const bool webp=std::memcmp(bytes.data(),"RIFF",4)==0 &&
                  std::memcmp(bytes.data()+8,"WEBP",4)==0;
 unsigned width=0,height=0;
 if(webp) {
#if defined(__PROSPERO__)
     int iw=0,ih=0;
     if(!WebPGetInfo(bytes.data(),bytes.size(),&iw,&ih) ||
        iw<=0||ih<=0)return 0;
     width=unsigned(iw);height=unsigned(ih);
#else
     return fail("WebP template unsupported by host preview");
#endif
 } else {
     if(std::memcmp(bytes.data(),"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n",8)!=0)return 0;
     width=(unsigned(bytes[16])<<24)|(unsigned(bytes[17])<<16)|
           (unsigned(bytes[18])<<8)|bytes[19];
     height=(unsigned(bytes[20])<<24)|(unsigned(bytes[21])<<16)|
            (unsigned(bytes[22])<<8)|bytes[23];
 }
 // Wide brand header/back legal strip or narrow tall spine; do not decode
 // accidentally swapped art, malicious PNG dimensions or an icon.
 // The standard GitHub OpenGL preview carries two *downscaled* copies
 // of the owner's real footer blocks (PS4 232x130, PS5 280x115).
 // They have the same artwork/aspect as the genuine larger originals.
 // Only the HOST preview may accept this lower resolution. Actual PS5
 // installations retain strict full-size footer validation.
#if defined(__linux__)
 const bool host_small_footer=side==1 && width>=180 && height>=90 &&
                              width<=1600 && height<=900 &&
                              float(width)/float(height)>=1.5f &&
                              float(width)/float(height)<=2.8f;
#else
 const bool host_small_footer=false;
#endif
 const bool valid=side==2?(width>=40 && width<=200 && height>=350 && height<=1600):
                  side==0?(width>=450 && width<=2000 && height>=60 && height<=400):
                          ((width>=450 && width<=1600 &&
                            height>=220 && height<=900) || host_small_footer);
 if(!valid || std::size_t(width)*height>2500000u) {
#if defined(__linux__)
     std::fprintf(stderr,
       "[NiakPS5 preview] %s-%s invalid template geometry %ux%u\\n",
       platform,part,width,height);
#endif
     return fail("invalid dimensions");
 }
 std::vector<unsigned char> pixels;
 unsigned w=width,h=height;
 unsigned decode_error=0;
 if(webp) {
#if defined(__PROSPERO__)
     pixels.resize(std::size_t(w)*h*4u);
     if(!WebPDecodeRGBAInto(bytes.data(),bytes.size(),pixels.data(),
                            pixels.size(),int(w*4u)))decode_error=1;
#else
     decode_error=1;
#endif
 } else {
     decode_error=lodepng::decode(pixels,w,h,bytes);
 }
 if(decode_error || w!=width || h!=height ||
    pixels.size()!=std::size_t(w)*h*4) {
#if defined(__linux__)
    std::fprintf(stderr,
        "[NiakPS5 preview] decode %s-%s error=%u expected=%ux%u decoded=%ux%u\\n",
        platform,part,decode_error,width,height,w,h);
#endif
    return fail("PNG decoding failed");
 }
 // Restore the supplied PS4/PS5 lower block above our continuous sheet.
 // Legacy opaque blocks contain their own white/anthracite paper: key it
 // out, preserving the actual logos, pictograms, labels and image details.
 if(side==1 && !niak_footer_paper_to_alpha(pixels,w,h,generation==0))
     return fail("footer paper cannot be safely separated from source art");
 // Shared mastheads/footers also avoid needless original-size GPU textures.
 if(!niak_scale_case_rgba(pixels,w,h,side==2?96u:1024u,
                          side==2?768u:512u))return fail("resampling failed");
 template_textures[index]=renderer.create_texture(int(w),int(h),pixels.data());
 if(template_textures[index])
     track_case_texture(template_textures[index],w,h);
 else
     return fail("GPU texture allocation failed");
 return template_textures[index];
}
```

```cpp
// Automatic, bounded, private cover hydration. App is usable offline.
// The rendering thread enqueues only; HTTPS, JPEG decoding and PNG cache
// writes all happen on one background worker. PNG appears on next launch.
#include "niak/case_auto_art.hpp"
#if defined(__PROSPERO__)

    "/app0/assets/niak-launchbox-cases.tsv",
    "/data/homebrew/PPSA99386/assets/niak-launchbox-cases.tsv"};

struct SourceStamp {
 std::uint64_t size=0,mtime=0,ctime=0,inode=0;
 bool present=false;
 bool operator==(const SourceStamp &x)const{
   return size==x.size && mtime==x.mtime && ctime==x.ctime &&
          inode==x.inode && present==x.present;
 }
};
std::array<SourceStamp,2> index_stamps(){
 std::array<SourceStamp,2> result{};
 for(std::size_t i=0;i<result.size();++i){
   struct stat st{};
   if(::stat(INDEX_SOURCES[i],&st)!=0 || !S_ISREG(st.st_mode))
     continue;
   result[i]={static_cast<std::uint64_t>(st.st_size),
      static_cast<std::uint64_t>(st.st_mtime),
      static_cast<std::uint64_t>(st.st_ctime),
      static_cast<std::uint64_t>(st.st_ino),true};
 }
 return result;
}
using ArtSlots=std::array<std::vector<std::string>,7>;

};
bool transient_network_failure(int error){
 return (error<0 && error!=-100 && error!=-103 && error!=-200) ||
        error==408 || error==429 || (error>=500 && error<=599);
}

 std::deque<Task> retries;

     network_failed{0},decode_failed{0},write_failed{0},unmatched{0};

int side_index(const std::string& side){
 const char *names[]={"front","back","spine","logo","hero","shot1","shot2"};
 for(int i=0;i<7;++i)if(side==names[i])return i;
 return -1;
}
bool valid_id(const char *id){
 if(!id || std::strlen(id)!=9)return false;
 const bool prefix=std::strncmp(id,"PPSA",4)==0 ||
                   std::strncmp(id,"CUSA",4)==0;
 if(!prefix)return false;
 for(int i=4;i<9;++i)if(id[i]<'0'||id[i]>'9')return false;
 return true;
}
bool valid_filename(const std::string& name){
 const std::size_t offset=name.rfind("r2_",0)==0?3u:0u;
 if(name.size()<offset+40 || name.size()>offset+41)return false;
 for(std::size_t i=offset;i<offset+36;++i){
   const char c=name[i];
   if(!((c>='0'&&c<='9')||(c>='a'&&c<='f')||
        (c>='A'&&c<='F')||c=='-'))return false;
 }
 const std::string ext=name.substr(offset+36);
 return ext==".jpg" || ext==".png" || ext==".jpeg";
}

bool existing(const std::string& path,const std::string& source){
 const std::string marker=path+".source";
 FILE *f=std::fopen(marker.c_str(),"rb");
 if(!f)return false;
 char value[90]{};
 const std::size_t size=std::fread(value,1,sizeof(value)-1,f);
 std::fclose(f);
 if(std::string(value,size)!=source)return false;
 f=std::fopen(path.c_str(),"rb");
 if(!f)return false;
 if(std::fseek(f,0,SEEK_END)!=0){std::fclose(f);return false;}
 const long length=std::ftell(f);
 if(length<33 || length>3*1024*1024 ||
    std::fseek(f,0,SEEK_SET)!=0){std::fclose(f);return false;}
 std::vector<unsigned char> raw(static_cast<std::size_t>(length));
 const bool complete=std::fread(raw.data(),1,raw.size(),f)==raw.size();
 std::fclose(f);
 if(!complete || raw.size()<20 ||
    std::memcmp(raw.data(),"RIFF",4)!=0 ||
    std::memcmp(raw.data()+8,"WEBP",4)!=0)return false;

    iw<16||ih<20||iw>2048||ih>1536||
    std::uint64_t(iw)*std::uint64_t(ih)>2500000u)return false;
 // A complete decode prevents corrupt or truncated WebP from acquiring
 // authoritative cache status and hiding an otherwise valid fallback.
```
