```cpp
                          pixels.size(),iw*4)!=nullptr;
}
std::unordered_map<std::string,ArtSlots> read_index(){
 std::unordered_map<std::string,ArtSlots> index;
 // The packaged LaunchBox index must remain authoritative after a PS5
 // update. An old private FTP overlay may add/replace valid media per side,
 // but missing fields must NEVER hide a newer packaged entry.
 for(const char *source:INDEX_SOURCES) {
 FILE *f=std::fopen(source,"rb");
 if(!f)continue;
 char line[8192];
 while(index.size()<50000 && std::fgets(line,sizeof(line),f)){
   if(!std::strchr(line,'\n') && !std::feof(f)){
     int ch;while((ch=std::fgetc(f))!=EOF&&ch!='\n'){}
     continue;
   }
   std::vector<std::string> columns;
   char *begin=line;
   for(char *p=line;*p && columns.size()<10;++p){
     if(*p=='\t'||*p=='\n'){
       columns.emplace_back(begin,std::size_t(p-begin));
       if(*p=='\n')break;
       begin=p+1;
     }
   }
   if(columns.size()<9 || !valid_id(columns[0].c_str()))continue;
   ArtSlots parts{};
   for(int i=0;i<7;++i) {
     const auto& col=columns[std::size_t(i+2)];
     std::size_t begin=0;
     while(begin<col.size() && parts[std::size_t(i)].size()<8) {
       const auto end=col.find(';',begin);
       const std::string candidate=col.substr(
           begin,end==std::string::npos?end:end-begin);
       const auto colon=candidate.find(':');
       if(colon!=std::string::npos) {
         const std::string filename=candidate.substr(colon+1);
         auto &sources=parts[std::size_t(i)];
         if(valid_filename(filename) &&
            std::find(sources.begin(),sources.end(),filename)==sources.end())
            sources.push_back(filename);
       }
       if(end==std::string::npos)break;
       begin=end+1;
     }
   }
   bool usable=false;
   for(const auto &part:parts)usable|=!part.empty();
   if(!usable)continue;
   auto &current=index[columns[0]];
   for(std::size_t i=0;i<current.size();++i) {
     // Keep newly shipped official metadata first; a private FTP re-index
     // contributes missing candidates instead of replacing better ones.
     for(const auto &candidate:parts[i]) {
       if(current[i].size()>=12)break;
       if(std::find(current[i].begin(),current[i].end(),candidate)
          ==current[i].end())current[i].push_back(candidate);
     }
   }
 }
 std::fclose(f);
 }
 return index;
}
bool convert_webp(const std::vector<std::uint8_t>& bytes,
                 const std::string& source,const std::string& side,
                 std::vector<unsigned char>& output){
 // Eden accepts full retail scans before resizing them for its cache.
 if(bytes.size()<33 || bytes.size()>16u*1024u*1024u)return false;
 unsigned w=0,h=0;
 std::vector<unsigned char> pixels;
 // Trust the verified image signature, not only LaunchBox's filename
 // extension. Regional entries can point to a differently encoded CDN blob.
 const bool jpeg=bytes[0]==0xff && bytes[1]==0xd8 && bytes[2]==0xff;
 const bool png=std::memcmp(bytes.data(),"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n",8)==0;
 if(!jpeg && !png)return false;
 if(jpeg){
   int jw=0,jh=0,ch=0;
   if(!stbi_info_from_memory(bytes.data(),int(bytes.size()),&jw,&jh,&ch) ||
      jw<16 || jh<20 || jw>4096 || jh>4096 ||
      std::uint64_t(jw)*std::uint64_t(jh)>3840u*2160u)return false;
   stbi_uc *raw=stbi_load_from_memory(bytes.data(),int(bytes.size()),
                                      &jw,&jh,&ch,4);
   if(!raw)return false;
   w=unsigned(jw);h=unsigned(jh);
   pixels.assign(raw,raw+std::size_t(w)*h*4u);
   stbi_image_free(raw);
 } else {
   const unsigned iw=(unsigned(bytes[16])<<24)|(unsigned(bytes[17])<<16)|
                      (unsigned(bytes[18])<<8)|bytes[19];
   const unsigned ih=(unsigned(bytes[20])<<24)|(unsigned(bytes[21])<<16)|
                      (unsigned(bytes[22])<<8)|bytes[23];
   if(iw<16||ih<20||iw>4096||ih>4096||
      std::uint64_t(iw)*ih>3840u*2160u)return false;
   if(lodepng::decode(pixels,w,h,bytes)!=0||w!=iw||h!=ih)
     return false;
 }
 const float aspect=float(w)/float(h);
 const bool spine=side=="spine",logo=side=="logo";
 const bool landscape=side=="hero"||side=="shot1"||side=="shot2";
 if(spine?(h<100||aspect>0.25f):
    logo?(w<32||h<20):
    landscape?(w<320||h<180||aspect<1.15f||aspect>3.1f):
              (h<200||aspect<0.55f||aspect>0.90f))return false;
 if(!niak_scale_case_rgba(pixels,w,h,
       spine?96u:logo?768u:landscape?768u:512u,
       landscape?512u:768u))return false;
 // WebP quality 80; it does not imply an 80% saving for every picture.
 // RGBA preserves transparency in spine and other eligible artwork.
 std::uint8_t *encoded=nullptr;
 const std::size_t size=WebPEncodeRGBA(pixels.data(),int(w),int(h),
                                       int(w*4u),80.f,&encoded);
 if(!encoded||size==0)return false;
 if(size>3u*1024u*1024u){WebPFree(encoded);return false;}
 output.assign(encoded,encoded+size);
 WebPFree(encoded);
 return true;
}
bool write_atomic(const std::string &path,
                  const unsigned char *data,std::size_t size) {
 if(!data || size==0 || path.size()>180)return false;
 char temp[256];
 const int n=std::snprintf(temp,sizeof(temp),"%s.XXXXXX",path.c_str());
 if(n<=0||std::size_t(n)>=sizeof(temp))return false;
 const int fd=mkstemp(temp);
 if(fd<0)return false;
 FILE *f=fdopen(fd,"wb");
 if(!f){close(fd);std::remove(temp);return false;}
 bool ok=std::fwrite(data,1,size,f)==size;
 if(std::fflush(f)!=0)ok=false;
 if(ok && fsync(fd)!=0)ok=false;
 if(std::fclose(f)!=0)ok=false;
 if(!ok || std::rename(temp,path.c_str())!=0){
   std::remove(temp);return false;
 }
 return true;
}
bool save(const Task& task,const std::string& name,
          const std::vector<unsigned char>& webp){
 const std::string path=cache_path(task);
 const std::string marker=path+".source";
 // Stage both files BEFORE invalidating the current cache entry.
 // A new PNG must never be advertised by an obsolete .source marker.
 const std::string staged_png=path+".pending";
 const std::string staged_source=marker+".pending";
 if(!write_atomic(staged_png,webp.data(),webp.size()))return false;
 if(!write_atomic(staged_source,
       reinterpret_cast<const unsigned char*>(name.data()),name.size())){
   (void)std::remove(staged_png.c_str());
   return false;
 }
 (void)std::remove(marker.c_str());
 if(std::rename(staged_png.c_str(),path.c_str())!=0){
   (void)std::remove(staged_png.c_str());
   (void)std::remove(staged_source.c_str());
   return false;
 }
 if(std::rename(staged_source.c_str(),marker.c_str())!=0){
   // A PNG without committed provenance is never reusable.
   (void)std::remove(path.c_str());
   (void)std::remove(staged_source.c_str());
   return false;
 }
 return true;
}
void queue_retry(State &s,Task task){
 // Bound retries even when the index is temporarily unavailable at boot.
 if(task.attempt>=2){++s.exhausted;return;}
 ++task.attempt;
 task.retry_at=std::chrono::steady_clock::now()+
     std::chrono::seconds(task.attempt==1?20:60);
 std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(s.mutex);
 if(task.generation!=s.generation)return;
 s.retries.push_back(std::move(task));
 s.queued.store(static_cast<unsigned>(s.tasks.size()+s.retries.size()));
}
void work(){
 std::unordered_map<std::string,ArtSlots> index;
 std::array<SourceStamp,2> loaded_stamps{};
 bool index_loaded=false;
 unsigned indexed_attempt=0,media_generation=~0u;
 bool official_front_ready=false,official_back_ready=false;
 State &s=state();
 for(;;){
   Task task;
   {
     std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lock(s.mutex);
     // Selected-game downloads have priority over due retries.
     for(;;){
       if(!s.tasks.empty()){
         task=std::move(s.tasks.front());s.tasks.pop_front();
         s.queued.store(static_cast<unsigned>(s.tasks.size()+s.retries.size()));
         break;
       }
       if(s.retries.empty()){s.cv.wait(lock);continue;}
       const auto next=std::min_element(s.retries.begin(),s.retries.end(),
           [](const Task &a,const Task &b){return a.retry_at<b.retry_at;});
       const auto due=next->retry_at;
       if(std::chrono::steady_clock::now()>=due){
         task=std::move(*next);s.retries.erase(next);
         s.queued.store(static_cast<unsigned>(s.tasks.size()+s.retries.size()));
         break;
       }
       s.cv.wait_until(lock,due);
     }
   }
   {
     std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(s.mutex);
     if(task.generation!=s.generation || task.id!=s.selected)
       continue; // navigation cancelled old work
   }
   if(media_generation!=task.generation){
     media_generation=task.generation;
     official_front_ready=false;
     official_back_ready=false;
   }
   // The screenshots are unused with an official BACK. A missing FRONT
   // can still use the hero artwork even when the BACK is already present.
   // Skip hero only once both official faces are ready.
   if(((task.side=="shot1"||task.side=="shot2") &&
        official_back_ready) ||
      (task.side=="hero" && official_front_ready &&
        official_back_ready) ||
      (task.side=="logo" && official_front_ready))
     continue;
   // Compare two cheap local file stamps. Avoid parsing thousands of
   // LaunchBox rows during rapid navigation. Reparse when FTP replaces the
   // metadata, when a sandbox mount appears, or on empty-index retries.
   const auto current_stamps=index_stamps();
   if(!index_loaded || current_stamps!=loaded_stamps ||
      (index.empty() && task.attempt>indexed_attempt)){
     index=read_index();
     loaded_stamps=current_stamps;
     index_loaded=true;
     indexed_attempt=task.attempt;
     s.indexed.store(static_cast<unsigned>(index.size()));
   }
   if(index.empty()){queue_retry(s,std::move(task));continue;}
   const auto found=index.find(task.id);
   if(found==index.end()){++s.unmatched;continue;}
   const int field=side_index(task.side);
   if(field<0)continue;
   const auto &candidates=found->second[std::size_t(field)];
   if(candidates.empty()){++s.unmatched;continue;}
   const std::string target=cache_path(task);
   // The fallback image can remain usable offline, but must not permanently
   // mask a newly available higher-priority PS5/PS4 Box - Back. Upgrade it
   // when possible, only trying entries BEFORE its cached source.
   std::size_t reusable_rank=candidates.size();
   for(std::size_t i=0;i<candidates.size();++i)
     if(existing(target,candidates[i])){reusable_rank=i;break;}
   if(reusable_rank==0){
     if(task.side=="front")official_front_ready=true;
     if(task.side=="back")official_back_ready=true;
     continue;
   }
   // Region/server variation: a missing FR image can fall back to EU or
   // another validated image, without ever trusting an arbitrary URL.
   // Up to three CDN candidates per side, ordered by the LaunchBox index:
   // PS5 -> PS4 -> PC for backs, hero, gameplay, game title and logos.
   // Fronts remain native console retail scans only.
   const unsigned candidate_limit=3u;
   unsigned examined=0;
   bool transient_failure=false,downloaded=false;
   for(const std::string &source:candidates) {
     {
       std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(s.mutex);
       if(task.generation!=s.generation || task.id!=s.selected)break;
     }
     if(examined>=candidate_limit || examined>=reusable_rank)break;
     ++examined;
     // No lifetime cap: seven sides with at most three passes each.
     ++s.requests;
     std::vector<std::uint8_t> bytes;
     int error=0,stage=0;
     const bool fetched=niak_fetch_launchbox_asset_ex(
         source.c_str(),bytes,&error,&stage,&s.generation,task.generation);
     // A request may finish after the player has moved to another game.
     // Never attribute its HTTP failure or decode result to the new focus.
     {
       std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(s.mutex);
       if(task.generation!=s.generation || task.id!=s.selected)break;
       if(!fetched){
         s.last_network_error.store(error);
         s.last_network_stage.store(stage);
         transient_failure|=transient_network_failure(error);
         ++s.network_failed;
       }
     }
     if(!fetched)continue;
     // Keep the latest CDN failure visible until another game is selected.
     // A successful front must not hide an HTTPS failure on the back.
     std::vector<unsigned char> webp;
     const bool converted=convert_webp(bytes,source,task.side,webp);
     {
       std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(s.mutex);
       if(task.generation!=s.generation || task.id!=s.selected)break;
       if(!converted)++s.decode_failed;
     }
     if(!converted)continue;
     const bool saved=save(task,source,webp);
     {
       std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(s.mutex);
       if(task.generation!=s.generation || task.id!=s.selected)break;
       if(saved){
         ++s.side_completed[static_cast<std::size_t>(field)];
         ++s.completed;
         downloaded=true;
         if(task.side=="front")official_front_ready=true;
         if(task.side=="back")official_back_ready=true;
       }else{
         ++s.write_failed;
       }
     }
     if(saved)break;
     std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(150));
   }
   // Retain a valid lower-priority back while online promotion fails.
   // Never discard an existing PC/PS4 fallback just because the PS5 CDN
   // cannot be reached. Reattempt transient failures with bounded backoff.
   if(!downloaded && reusable_rank<candidates.size()){
     if(task.side=="front")official_front_ready=true;
     if(task.side=="back")official_back_ready=true;
   }
   // Retry temporary HTTP failures without changing selection. Navigation
   // cancels both pending and delayed work for the previous title.
   if(!downloaded && transient_failure)
     queue_retry(s,std::move(task));
 }
}
} // namespace
#endif
void niak_queue_auto_case_art(const char *title_id,const char *side){
#if defined(__PROSPERO__)
 if(!valid_id(title_id) || !side || side_index(side)<0)return;
 State &s=state();
 const std::string name=std::string(title_id)+"-"+side;
 {
   std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(s.mutex);
   if(s.selected!=title_id ||
      s.seen.size()>=kMaxQueued || !s.seen.insert(name).second)return;
   // Scan the entire library without starving all remaining box fronts:
   // missing official front/back scans outrank extra logo/screenshots. New
   // titles also get a chance when the user navigates a long game shelf.
   if(std::strcmp(side,"front")==0||std::strcmp(side,"back")==0)
     s.tasks.push_front({title_id,side,s.generation});
   else s.tasks.push_back({title_id,side,s.generation});
   s.queued.store(static_cast<unsigned>(s.tasks.size()+s.retries.size()));
   if(!s.started){
     s.started=true;
     std::thread(work).detach();
   }
 }
 s.cv.notify_one();
#else
 (void)title_id;(void)side;
#endif
}

void niak_select_case_art(const char *title_id) {
#if defined(__PROSPERO__)
 State &s=state();
 const bool valid=valid_id(title_id);
 {
   std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(s.mutex);
   if(s.selected==(valid?std::string(title_id):std::string{}))return;
   s.selected=valid?title_id:"";
   ++s.generation;
   s.last_network_error.store(0);
   s.last_network_stage.store(0);
   // Only ONE game's CDN requests belong in the queue. A request already
   // in flight can finish; no next title ever waits behind the whole shelf.
   s.tasks.clear();
   s.retries.clear();
   s.queued.store(0);
   s.seen.clear();
 }
 s.cv.notify_one();
 if(!valid)return;
 // Eden Encore: originals first; scenery only for reconstruction. push_front
 // for front/back means both actual faces precede the optional resources.
 // No redundant clear logo is printed on the case or above the title.
 // Avoid its CDN request, decode, and GPU allocation.
 for(const char *side:{"spine","hero","shot1","shot2","back","front"})
   niak_queue_auto_case_art(title_id,side);
#else
 (void)title_id;
#endif
}

NiakArtDownloadStatus niak_case_art_download_status(){
#if defined(__PROSPERO__)
 const State &s=state();
 NiakArtDownloadStatus result{
     s.indexed.load(),s.queued.load(),s.completed.load(),
     s.network_failed.load(),s.decode_failed.load(),
     s.write_failed.load(),s.unmatched.load(),
     s.last_network_error.load(),s.requests.load(),s.exhausted.load(),
     s.last_network_stage.load()};
 for(std::size_t i=0;i<result.sides_completed.size();++i)
     result.sides_completed[i]=s.side_completed[i].load();
 return result;
#else
 return {};
#endif
}
```

```hpp
#pragma once
#include <array>
// Asynchronously fetch matching public LaunchBox artwork to NiakPS5's
// private sandbox. Never block the render thread or send the title ID.
// Only a change of focused game may request remote assets. Null or an

 int last_network_error;
 unsigned requests,exhausted;
 int last_network_stage;
 // Per-side completion epochs let the renderer replace ONLY textures that
 // have changed, including promotion from cached PC/PS4 to a PS5 box back.
 std::array<unsigned,7> sides_completed{};
};
```

`native/title/case_back_media.hpp`:

```hpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>
#include <initializer_list>
// Back-media selection has no rendering side effects. An absent second
// image remains ABSENT; callers must use a single full-width image or opaque
// paper, never repeat the hero/artwork to fill a second slot.
struct NiakBackArt {
    std::uint32_t texture=0;
    float aspect=1.f;
};
struct NiakBackSelection {
    NiakBackArt first{};
    NiakBackArt second{};
};
inline NiakBackSelection niak_select_back_media(
    std::initializer_list<NiakBackArt> candidates) {
    NiakBackSelection result{};
    for(const auto candidate:candidates) {
        if(!candidate.texture || !(candidate.aspect>0.f))continue;
        if(!result.first.texture) {
            result.first=candidate;
        } else if(candidate.texture!=result.first.texture) {
            result.second=candidate;
            break;
        }
    }
    return result;
}
```

`native/title/case_fallback_layout.hpp`:

```hpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#pragma once
// Source-agnostic physical case layout for missing faces ONLY.
// A genuine scanned front/back/spine bypasses all of these overlays.
// Ratios use the face's normalized coordinate system (height == 1).
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

struct NiakCaseFallbackLayout {
    float front_header;   // PS4/PS5 platform masthead, locked to top.
    float back_footer;    // legal footer starts here, locked to bottom.
    float back_text_top;  // editorial copy wholly above the fixed footer.
    float back_art_top;   // 2-up screen/art region, no overlap with text.
    float back_art_bottom;
};
constexpr NiakCaseFallbackLayout niak_case_fallback_layout(bool ps4) {
    // Original owner-supplied banners are ~7:1, so on a 0.76 width/height
    // box the header occupies ~10.8% of its height, NOT a thick 20% stripe.
    // Footer: PS4 647x362, PS5 1000x411 with front face aspect ~0.76.
    return {0.108f, ps4?0.576f:0.688f, 0.025f,
            ps4?0.265f:0.315f, ps4?0.555f:0.666f};
}
struct NiakCaseUvRegion {
    float left=0.0f,right=1.0f,top=0.0f,bottom=1.0f;
};
inline NiakCaseUvRegion niak_case_cover_crop(float source_aspect,
                                              float target_aspect) {
    NiakCaseUvRegion out{};
    if(!(std::isfinite(source_aspect)&&std::isfinite(target_aspect)) ||
       source_aspect<=0.f || target_aspect<=0.f)return out;
    // Never deform a square icon or landscape pic1 to fit portrait plastic.
    if(source_aspect>target_aspect) {
        const float span=std::clamp(target_aspect/source_aspect,0.01f,1.0f);
        out.left=(1.f-span)*0.5f;
        out.right=out.left+span;
    } else {
        const float span=std::clamp(source_aspect/target_aspect,0.01f,1.0f);
        out.top=(1.f-span)*0.5f;
        out.bottom=out.top+span;
    }
    return out;
}
```

`native/title/case_footer_alpha.hpp`:

```hpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#pragma once
// Preserve the owner's lower-back fixed graphic, but remove its embedded
// background so all text/icons are ink over one continuous PS4/PS5 paper.
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <vector>
inline bool niak_footer_paper_to_alpha(std::vector<unsigned char>& rgba,
                                        unsigned width,unsigned height,
                                        bool ps4) {
    if(!width || !height || width>2048 || height>1536 ||
       std::size_t(width)*height>2500000u ||
       rgba.size()!=std::size_t(width)*height*4u)return false;
    const std::size_t pixels=std::size_t(width)*height;
    std::size_t existing_clear=0;
    for(std::size_t i=3;i<rgba.size();i+=4)
        existing_clear+=rgba[i]<240;
    // Already properly extracted: do not damage existing alpha and edges.
    if(existing_clear*100>=pixels*2)return true;
    const int paper_r=ps4?24:255,paper_g=ps4?27:255,paper_b=ps4?24:255;
    const int transparent_until=ps4?10:12,opaque_from=ps4?48:58;
    std::size_t transparent=0;
    for(std::size_t i=0;i<rgba.size();i+=4) {
        const int delta=std::max({std::abs(int(rgba[i])-paper_r),
                                  std::abs(int(rgba[i+1])-paper_g),
                                  std::abs(int(rgba[i+2])-paper_b)});
        const int a=delta<=transparent_until?0:
                    delta>=opaque_from?255:
                    (delta-transparent_until)*255/
                         (opaque_from-transparent_until);
        rgba[i+3]=static_cast<unsigned char>(
            std::min<int>(rgba[i+3],a));
        transparent+=rgba[i+3]<32;
    }
    // An unrelated fully opaque photo must not replace the base sheet.
    return transparent*100>=pixels*4;
}
```

`native/title/case_renderer.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// NiakPS5 closed retail case: three independent covers, correct hidden surfaces.
// Projected exterior geometry only: no opening, tray, loader, or duplicated shell.
#include "niak/case_renderer.hpp"
#include "demo/catalog.hpp"
#include "niak/case_fallback_layout.hpp"
#include "niak/case_back_media.hpp"
#include "ui/fonts.hpp"
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
#include <utility>

namespace {
using hui::gfx::Color;
using hui::gfx::DrawList;
using hui::gfx::Rect;
struct Pt { float x,y; };
struct Vec { float x,y,z; };
constexpr float PI=3.14159265358979323846f;
float smooth(float t) {
    t=std::clamp(t,0.f,1.f);
    return t*t*(3.f-2.f*t);
}
float yaw_at(float seconds) {
    // A closed case rotating along its vertical axis: front -> spine -> back.
    constexpr float front_hold=2.7f,turn=1.35f,back_hold=3.0f;
    constexpr float period=front_hold+turn+back_hold+turn;
    const float t=std::fmod(std::max(0.f,seconds),period);
    if(t<front_hold)return 0.13f;
    if(t<front_hold+turn)
        return 0.13f+(PI-0.26f)*smooth((t-front_hold)/turn);
    if(t<front_hold+turn+back_hold)return PI-0.13f;
    return PI-0.13f+(PI+0.26f)*smooth(
        (t-front_hold-turn-back_hold)/turn);
}
struct Camera {
    Rect rect;
    float cs,sn,distance;
    Pt operator()(Vec p) const {
        const float nx=p.x*cs+p.z*sn;
        const float nz=p.z*cs-p.x*sn;
        const float k=distance/(distance-nz);
        return {rect.cx()+nx*k,rect.cy()+(p.y-0.060f*p.z)*k};
    }
};
void polygon4(DrawList &list,Pt a,Pt b,Pt c,Pt d,Color color) {
    const float xy[]={a.x,a.y,b.x,b.y,c.x,c.y,d.x,d.y};
    list.polygon(xy,4,color);
}
template<class Project>
void printed(DrawList &list,std::uint32_t texture,Project project,
             int columns,int rows,bool flip_v=false,
             float uv_min=0.0f,float uv_max=1.0f,
             NiakCaseUvRegion crop={},float opacity=1.0f) {
    if(!texture)return;
    // DrawList only supports rectangular texture instances. Tessellate BOTH
    // directions to approximate a projected plane, never stretch a full image
    // over unrelated side geometry. UV orientation stays stable on both covers.
    for(int r=0;r<rows;++r)for(int col=0;col<columns;++col) {
        const float u0=float(col)/columns,u1=float(col+1)/columns;
        const float v0=float(r)/rows,v1=float(r+1)/rows;
        const float sample0=crop.top+(crop.bottom-crop.top)*
            (uv_min+(uv_max-uv_min)*v0);
        const float sample1=crop.top+(crop.bottom-crop.top)*
            (uv_min+(uv_max-uv_min)*v1);
        const float cu0=crop.left+(crop.right-crop.left)*u0;
        const float cu1=crop.left+(crop.right-crop.left)*u1;
        const Pt p0=project(u0,v0),p1=project(u1,v0);
        const Pt p2=project(u1,v1),p3=project(u0,v1);
        const float x0=std::min({p0.x,p1.x,p2.x,p3.x});
        const float x1=std::max({p0.x,p1.x,p2.x,p3.x});
        const float y0=std::min({p0.y,p1.y,p2.y,p3.y});
        const float y1=std::max({p0.y,p1.y,p2.y,p3.y});
        if(x1-x0<0.10f||y1-y0<0.10f)continue;
        const bool reverse=(p1.x+p2.x)<(p0.x+p3.x);
        // UVs are 0..1 from real portrait covers and real narrow spine scans.
        // Very small overlap covers subpixel seams without widening the sleeve.
        list.image(texture,{x0-0.12f,y0-0.10f,x1-x0+0.24f,y1-y0+0.20f},
                   {reverse?cu1:cu0,flip_v?1.0f-sample0:sample0,
                    reverse?cu0-cu1:cu1-cu0,
                    flip_v?sample0-sample1:sample1-sample0},
                   Color::rgb(0xffffff,std::clamp(opacity,0.f,1.f)));
    }
}
template<class Project>
void molded_panel(DrawList &list,Project project,
                  float left,float right,float top,float bottom,
                  float rounding,Color color) {
    const float centers[4][2] = {
        {right-rounding,top+rounding},
        {right-rounding,bottom-rounding},
        {left+rounding,bottom-rounding},
        {left+rounding,top+rounding}};
    const float starts[4]={-PI*0.5f,0.f,PI*0.5f,PI};
    float xy[2*28];int n=0;
    for(int c=0;c<4;++c)for(int i=0;i<=6;++i) {
        const float angle=starts[c]+PI*i/12.f;
        const auto v=project(centers[c][0]+rounding*std::cos(angle),
                             centers[c][1]+rounding*std::sin(angle));
        xy[2*n]=v.x;xy[2*n+1]=v.y;++n;
    }
    list.polygon(xy,n,color);
}
void outer_face(DrawList &list,const Camera &camera,
                const hui::demo::Item &item,const hui::ui::Fonts &fonts,
                float L,float R,float T,float B,float z,float width,bool back) {
    const float b=width*0.020f;
    auto at=[&](float x,float y){return camera({x,y,z});};
    // A single molded case: thin translucent rim enclosing the printed sleeve.
    molded_panel(list,at,L,R,T,B,width*0.036f,Color::rgb(0x165dba,0.82f));
    const float pLeft=L;                  // Print reaches the LEFT spine fold.
    const float pRight=R-width*0.018f;   // Only the RIGHT closing edge is exposed.
    const float pTop=T+b,pBottom=B-b;
    auto paper=[&](float u,float v) {
        return at(back?pRight+(pLeft-pRight)*u:pLeft+(pRight-pLeft)*u,
                  pTop+(pBottom-pTop)*v);
    };
    // Near the stationary front/back holds the perspective is almost
    // rectangular. Reduce per-frame texture quads by ~75%, but retain full
    // tessellation as soon as the case rotates toward the edge.
    const bool near_frontal=std::fabs(camera.cs)>0.985f;
    const int face_columns=near_frontal?12:32;
    const int face_rows=near_frontal?6:9;
    const auto texture=back?item.case_back:item.case_front;
    if(texture) {
        printed(list,texture,paper,face_columns,face_rows);
    } else {
        // Recompose ONLY this missing face. Official scans use the early
        // texture branch and bypass EVERY fixed platform overlay below.
        const bool ps4=item.title_id[0]=='C';
        const auto layout=niak_case_fallback_layout(ps4);
        auto block=[&](float x0,float y0,float x1,float y1,Color color) {
            polygon4(list,paper(x0,y0),paper(x1,y0),
                     paper(x1,y1),paper(x0,y1),color);
        };
        // Real normalized sleeve width:height is ~0.76:1.
        constexpr float case_aspect=0.76f;
        const auto panel=[&](std::uint32_t image,float aspect,
                             float x0,float y0,float x1,float y1,
                             float opacity=1.f) {
            if(!image)return;
            const auto region=niak_case_cover_crop(
                aspect,case_aspect*(x1-x0)/(y1-y0));
            const auto coords=[&](float u,float v) {
                return paper(x0+(x1-x0)*u,y0+(y1-y0)*v);
            };
            printed(list,image,coords,near_frontal?12:24,
                    near_frontal?8:15,false,0.f,1.f,region,opacity);
        };
        // ONE uninterrupted opaque printable sheet lives between plastic
        // and ALL front/back elements. The design never gives screenshots,
        // captions or blank areas their own separate background cards.
        block(0.f,0.f,1.f,1.f,back?
              Color::rgb(ps4?0x161a19:0xffffff):
              Color::rgb(0x0c1727));
        if(!back) {
            // Artwork covers the entire PRINT below the PS4/PS5 masthead.
            // Background-size: cover uses cropped UVs, not width stretching.
            const auto art=item.case_poster?item.case_poster:
                item.case_scene?item.case_scene:
                item.case_hero?item.case_hero:
                (item.cover_is_image?item.cover:0);
            const float art_aspect=item.case_poster?item.poster_aspect:
                item.case_scene?item.case_scene_aspect:
                item.case_hero?item.case_hero_aspect:1.0f;
            const bool icon_fallback=art && art==item.cover &&
                !item.case_poster && !item.case_scene && !item.case_hero;
            if(icon_fallback) {
                // One fallback illustration, not the same app/game icon
                // twice. Cover-crop the source into the whole printable
                // front below the console masthead without stretching width.
                panel(art,art_aspect,0.f,layout.front_header,1.f,1.f);
            } else {
                // Poster/fanart also uses cover UVs, respecting source aspect.
                panel(art,art_aspect,0.f,layout.front_header,1.f,1.f);
            }
            if(item.case_template_front) {
                // The masthead is invariant and occupies only the top ~10.8%.
                const auto banner=[&](float u,float v){
                    return paper(u,layout.front_header*v);
                };
                printed(list,item.case_template_front,banner,
                        near_frontal?12:24,near_frontal?3:5);
            } else {
                block(0.f,0.f,1.f,layout.front_header,
                      Color::rgb(ps4?0x04499c:0xeef6ff));
                block(0.f,layout.front_header-0.004f,1.f,
                      layout.front_header,Color::rgb(0x2884e7));
            }
            // Never stamp an additional clear logo onto existing artwork.
            // Posters and game icons may already contain the game's wordmark.
        } else {
            // Fanart - Background is the soft full-page illustration IN THE
            // paper, not a separate card behind screenshots or text.
            // The uninterrupted PS4/PS5 base colour remains visible below
            // this semi-transparent cover image. Actual gameplay and title
            // screenshots are then placed over it as distinct assets.
            if(item.case_hero)
                panel(item.case_hero,item.case_hero_aspect,
                      0.f,0.f,1.f,1.f,ps4?0.16f:0.11f);
            const float gutter=0.018f;
            // Only two genuinely different gameplay screenshots can form
            // two columns. With zero/one screenshot, select ONE existing
            // scene/fanart/icon in priority order and print it full width.
            // In particular, never tile pic1 and hero side by side: they
            // might be visually identical despite having different handles.
            auto chosen=niak_select_back_media({
                {item.case_shot1,item.case_shot1_aspect},
                {item.case_shot2,item.case_shot2_aspect}
            });
            // Only dedicated LaunchBox back media belongs on a recreated
            // reverse cover. The installed icon/pic1 can match the main
            // library art: NEVER repeat it on the back as fake gameplay.
            if(!chosen.first.texture && item.case_hero)
                chosen.first={item.case_hero,item.case_hero_aspect};
            if(chosen.first.texture) {
                if(chosen.second.texture) {
                    panel(chosen.first.texture,chosen.first.aspect,
                          gutter,layout.back_art_top,
                          0.5f-gutter*0.5f,layout.back_art_bottom);
                    panel(chosen.second.texture,chosen.second.aspect,
                          0.5f+gutter*0.5f,layout.back_art_top,
                          1.f-gutter,layout.back_art_bottom);
                } else {
                    // With ONE source, use one full-width print: NO duplicate.
                    // With ZERO sources the opaque background stays visible.
                    panel(chosen.first.texture,chosen.first.aspect,
                          gutter,layout.back_art_top,
                          1.f-gutter,layout.back_art_bottom);
                }
            }
            // The naturally exposed gap shows the SAME underlying paper;
            // no extra rectangle over the print and no seams between pieces.
            if(item.case_template_back) {
                const auto footer=[&](float u,float v) {
                    return paper(u,layout.back_footer+
                                    (1.0f-layout.back_footer)*v);
                };
                printed(list,item.case_template_back,footer,
                        near_frontal?12:24,near_frontal?6:9);
            }
            // Without a footer image, leave the SAME opaque paper visible;
            // do not attach a separately coloured rectangle to the bottom.
        }
        // Draw description at the START of the back-cover approach and
        // fade into place, rather than suddenly popping at 90% rotation.
        // Keep text invisible edge-on so it never crosses the case spine.
        const float copy_opacity=std::clamp(
            (std::fabs(camera.cs)-0.35f)/0.40f,0.f,1.f);
        if(copy_opacity>0.01f) {
            list.push_opacity(copy_opacity);
            const auto text_bounds=[&](float left,float right,float line){
                const auto aa=paper(left,line),bb=paper(right,line);
                return std::pair<float,float>{std::min(aa.x,bb.x),
                                              std::fabs(bb.x-aa.x)};
            };
            if(!back) {
                // No duplicate game title on front; the icon is sufficient.
                if(!item.case_template_front) {
                    const auto top=text_bounds(0.08f,0.92f,0.047f);
                    const auto pos=paper(0.5f,0.047f);
                    hui::ui::text(list,fonts.semibold,ps4?"PS4":"PS5",
                                  top.first+top.second*0.5f,pos.y,
                                  std::clamp(top.second*0.095f,12.f,25.f),
                                  Color::rgb(ps4?0xffffff:0x164b84),
                                  hui::gfx::Align::center);
                }
            } else {
                // Editorial copy sits entirely ABOVE the two-shot gallery.
                // An original back never reaches this branch.
                const float ty=layout.back_text_top+0.014f;
                const auto area=text_bounds(0.042f,0.958f,ty);
                const auto pos=paper(0.042f,ty);
                if(area.second>65.f) {
                    const char *description=item.blurb&&item.blurb[0]?
                        item.blurb:item.title;
                    hui::ui::paragraph(list,fonts.regular,description,
                        area.first,pos.y,
                        std::clamp(area.second*0.046f,9.f,14.f),
                        area.second,ps4?14.f:16.f,
                        Color::rgb(ps4?0xf3f7ff:0x161a19),ps4?6:8);
                }
                // If the owner lacks the invariant footer, show a neutral
                // disclaimer instead of another game's classification/SKU.
                if(!item.case_template_back) {
                    const auto foot=text_bounds(0.055f,0.945f,0.95f);
                    const auto pos=paper(0.055f,0.95f);
                    hui::ui::paragraph(list,fonts.regular,
                        "APERÇU RECONSTITUÉ — NON OFFICIEL",
                        foot.first,pos.y,10.f,foot.second,15.f,
                        Color::rgb(ps4?0xf3f7ff:0x18394f),2);
                }
            }
            list.pop_opacity();
        }
    }
    const auto topL=at(L,T),topR=at(R,T),botL=at(L,B),botR=at(R,B);
    list.line(topL.x,topL.y,topR.x,topR.y,1.5f,Color::rgb(0x8bcfff,0.76f));
    list.line(botL.x,botL.y,botR.x,botR.y,1.5f,Color::rgb(0x217bde,0.82f));
    // The seal stays on the right, but never becomes a wide blue bar.
    list.line(topR.x,topR.y,botR.x,botR.y,1.3f,Color::rgb(0x0d45ab,0.79f));
}
void left_spine(DrawList &list,const Camera &camera,const hui::demo::Item &item,
                const hui::ui::Fonts &fonts,
                float L,float T,float B,float K,float F,float width) {
    const auto at=[&](float z,float y){return camera({L,y,z});};
    polygon4(list,at(K,T),at(F,T),at(F,B),at(K,B),
             Color::rgb(0x1c6cd0,0.88f));
    const float b=width*0.020f;
    const auto paper=[&](float u,float v){
        return at(K+(F-K)*u,T+b+(B-T-2*b)*v);
    };
    if(item.case_spine)printed(list,item.case_spine,paper,10,9);
    else if(item.case_template_spine) {
        // Preserve the real vertical PS4/PS5 masthead. Its lower 12% contains
        // an ID belonging to the example box, so mask that area; never show a
        // different game's SKU on the current case.
        auto upper=[&](float u,float v) {
            return paper(u,v*0.88f);
        };
        printed(list,item.case_template_spine,upper,8,15,false,0.f,0.88f);
        polygon4(list,paper(0,0.88f),paper(1,0.88f),
                 paper(1,1.f),paper(0,1.f),
                 Color::rgb(item.title_id[0]=='C'?0x081019:0xe8eef6));
    } else {
        // Standard PS4/PS5 blue plastic spine when LaunchBox has no scan.
        // It is a physical case side, not a fabricated game illustration.
        const auto left=paper(0.f,0.06f),right=paper(1.f,0.06f);
        if(std::fabs(right.x-left.x)>10.f) {
            const char *generation=item.title_id[0]=='C'?"PS4":"PS5";
            for(int i=0;i<3;++i) {
                const auto pos=paper(0.5f,0.08f+0.067f*i);
                const char glyph[2]={generation[i],0};
                hui::ui::text(list,fonts.semibold,glyph,pos.x,pos.y,14.f,
                   Color::rgb(0xf5faff),hui::gfx::Align::center);
            }
        }
    }
    // Small molded seam detail (NOT a thick series of projecting blocks).
    for(float rel:{0.08f,0.86f}) {
        const float y=T+(B-T)*rel;
        const auto a=at(K,y),b0=at(F,y);
        list.line(a.x,a.y,b0.x,b0.y,1.1f,Color::rgb(0xc0ebff,0.55f));
    }
}
void right_seal(DrawList &list,const Camera &camera,
                float R,float T,float B,float K,float F,float width) {
    auto at=[&](float z,float y){return camera({R,y,z});};
    polygon4(list,at(K,T),at(F,T),at(F,B),at(K,B),
             Color::rgb(0x1366c5,0.86f));
    const auto upper=at(K+0.30f*(F-K),T+width*0.060f);
    const auto lower=at(K+0.30f*(F-K),B-width*0.060f);
    list.line(upper.x,upper.y,lower.x,lower.y,1.0f,
              Color::rgb(0x0c397a,0.69f));
}
} // namespace

void niak_draw_rotating_case(hui::gfx::DrawList &list,const hui::demo::Item &item,
                             const hui::gfx::Rect &bounds,float seconds,
                             const hui::ui::Fonts &fonts) {
    // Homebrew games can have genuine privately supplied front/back scans.
    // If none exists, use the installed app icon rather than invent box art.
    if(!item.title_id[0] || item.application) {
        list.rounded_rect(bounds,26,Color::rgb(0x0f2231));
        if(item.cover)list.image(item.cover,bounds,
                   item.cover_is_image?hui::gfx::kFullUv:hui::gfx::kCanvasUv,
                   Color::rgb(0xffffff),26);
        return;
    }
    const float yaw=yaw_at(seconds);
    const float width=std::min(bounds.w*0.78f,bounds.h*0.76f);
    const float height=std::min(bounds.h*0.88f,width/0.76f);
    const float thickness=width*(item.title_id[0]=='C'?0.080f:0.084f);
    const float L=-width*0.5f,R=width*0.5f,T=-height*0.5f,B=height*0.5f;
    const float F=thickness*0.5f,K=-thickness*0.5f;
    const Camera camera{bounds,std::cos(yaw),std::sin(yaw),width*4.8f};

    // Alpha blending is painter-ordered: never draw occluded side pieces on top.
    // In the coordinate model depth=z*cos(yaw)-x*sin(yaw). Positive sin means
    // LEFT spine is visible; negative sin means the RIGHT closing seal is visible.
    const bool back=std::cos(yaw)<0.f;
    const bool show_spine=std::sin(yaw)>0.055f;
    const bool show_seal=std::sin(yaw)<-0.055f;
    const bool show_face=std::fabs(std::cos(yaw))>0.075f;
    list.shadow({bounds.cx()-width*0.48f,bounds.cy()-height*0.47f,
                 width*0.96f,height*0.94f},
                width*0.035f,16.f,Color::rgb(0x000917,0.36f));

    // Top and bottom are a THIN cap of the same closed body, not second covers.
    polygon4(list,camera({L,T,K}),camera({R,T,K}),
             camera({R,T,F}),camera({L,T,F}),
             Color::rgb(0x3296ea,0.69f));
    polygon4(list,camera({L,B,K}),camera({R,B,K}),
             camera({R,B,F}),camera({L,B,F}),
             Color::rgb(0x125abb,0.70f));

    // Back view: the near side edges overlay the far edge of the printed back.
    // Front view: the near-facing print covers the far side edges.
    if(back&&show_face)
        outer_face(list,camera,item,fonts,L,R,T,B,K,width,true);
    if(show_spine)
        left_spine(list,camera,item,fonts,L,T,B,K,F,width);
    if(show_seal)
        right_seal(list,camera,R,T,B,K,F,width);
    if(!back&&show_face)
        outer_face(list,camera,item,fonts,L,R,T,B,F,width,false);
}
```

`native/title/case_texture_scale.hpp`:

```hpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#pragma once
// Reduce permanent GPU footprint of per-game PS4/PS5 case print textures.
// Never upscale scans or deform their aspect ratios; bilinear sampling keeps
// small publisher typography readable in the projected 3D sleeve.
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <vector>

inline bool niak_scale_case_rgba(std::vector<unsigned char>& pixels,
                                 unsigned &w,unsigned &h,
                                 unsigned max_w,unsigned max_h) {
    if(!w||!h||!max_w||!max_h||
       pixels.size()!=std::size_t(w)*h*4u)return false;
    if(w<=max_w&&h<=max_h)return true;
    const float scale=std::min(float(max_w)/float(w),
                               float(max_h)/float(h));
    const unsigned nw=std::max(1u,std::min(max_w,
        static_cast<unsigned>(std::floor(w*scale+0.5f))));
    const unsigned nh=std::max(1u,std::min(max_h,
        static_cast<unsigned>(std::floor(h*scale+0.5f))));
    std::vector<unsigned char> reduced(std::size_t(nw)*nh*4u);
    for(unsigned y=0;y<nh;++y) {
        const float sy=std::max(0.0f,(float(y)+0.5f)*float(h)/float(nh)-0.5f);
        const unsigned y0=std::min(h-1u,static_cast<unsigned>(sy));
        const unsigned y1=std::min(h-1u,y0+1u);
        const float fy=std::min(1.0f,sy-float(y0));
        for(unsigned x=0;x<nw;++x) {
            const float sx=std::max(0.0f,(float(x)+0.5f)*float(w)/float(nw)-0.5f);
            const unsigned x0=std::min(w-1u,static_cast<unsigned>(sx));
            const unsigned x1=std::min(w-1u,x0+1u);
            const float fx=std::min(1.0f,sx-float(x0));
            for(unsigned c=0;c<4;++c) {
                const float a=pixels[(std::size_t(y0)*w+x0)*4u+c];
                const float b=pixels[(std::size_t(y0)*w+x1)*4u+c];
                const float d=pixels[(std::size_t(y1)*w+x0)*4u+c];
                const float e=pixels[(std::size_t(y1)*w+x1)*4u+c];
                const float value=(a+(b-a)*fx)*(1.f-fy)+(d+(e-d)*fx)*fy;
                reduced[(std::size_t(y)*nw+x)*4u+c]=static_cast<unsigned char>(
                    std::max(0.f,std::min(255.f,value+0.5f)));
            }
        }
    }
    pixels.swap(reduced);
    w=nw;h=nh;
    return true;
}
```

`native/title/compose_music.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""NiakPS5 original, reproducible ambient soundtrack.

The music is synthesized mathematically. No upstream recordings, melodies,
AI-generated audio files, samples, external accounts or copyrighted loops.
Requires ffmpeg solely to encode generated PCM to Ogg Vorbis for the PS5 mixer.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import array
import math
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import wave

SAMPLE_RATE=24000
SECONDS=36
SONGS=(
    ("niak-dawn",44,(0,3,7),((0,3,7),(5,8,12),(3,7,10),(7,10,14))),
    ("niak-orbit",40,(0,4,7),((0,4,7),(7,11,14),(9,12,16),(5,9,12))),
    ("niak-twilight",47,(0,3,7),((0,3,7),(8,12,15),(5,8,12),(10,14,17))),
)
def frequency(midi: float) -> float:
    return 440.0 * 2 ** ((midi-69.0)/12.0)

def render_song(out: Path, base: int, chords) -> None:
    # Slow four-chord progression, small pentatonic motif, no sampled sounds.
    # Stereo is deliberately subtle to keep console menus relaxing.
    with wave.open(str(out),"wb") as wav:
        wav.setnchannels(2)
        wav.setsampwidth(2)
        wav.setframerate(SAMPLE_RATE)
        frames_per_chord=SAMPLE_RATE*9
        block=array.array("h")
        phase=[0.0]*4
        lead_phase=[0.0,0.0]
        for index in range(SAMPLE_RATE*SECONDS):
            t=index/SAMPLE_RATE
            chord_idx=min(index//frames_per_chord,3)
            chord=chords[chord_idx]
            chord_t=(index%frames_per_chord)/SAMPLE_RATE
            # Slow pad attack/release and broad fade before playlist transition.
            envelope=min(1.0,chord_t/1.8,(9.0-chord_t)/2.2)
            envelope=max(0.0,envelope)
            overall=min(1.0,t/2.5,(SECONDS-t)/3.5)
            notes=(base+chord[0]-12,base+chord[0],base+chord[1],base+chord[2])
            pad=0.0
            for k,note in enumerate(notes):
                phase[k]+=2.0*math.pi*frequency(note)/SAMPLE_RATE
                if phase[k]>2.0*math.pi:phase[k]-=2.0*math.pi
                pad+=math.sin(phase[k])*(0.38 if k==0 else 0.17)
            beat=int(chord_t*1.3)
            motif=(0,2,1,3,2,1,0,1,2,3,1)
            note=base+chord[motif[beat%len(motif)]%3]+12
            lead_t=(chord_t*1.3)%1.0
            bell=(1.0-lead_t)**3
            lead_phase[0]+=2*math.pi*frequency(note)/SAMPLE_RATE
            lead_phase[1]+=2*math.pi*frequency(note)*2/SAMPLE_RATE
            if lead_phase[0]>2*math.pi:lead_phase[0]-=2*math.pi
            if lead_phase[1]>2*math.pi:lead_phase[1]-=2*math.pi
            line=(math.sin(lead_phase[0])+0.18*math.sin(lead_phase[1]))*bell*0.13
            signal=(pad*0.24*envelope+line)*max(0.0,overall)
            drift=math.sin(t*0.44)*0.10
            left=max(-1.0,min(1.0,signal*(1.0-drift)))
            right=max(-1.0,min(1.0,signal*(1.0+drift)))
            block.extend((int(left*26000),int(right*26000)))
            if len(block)>=SAMPLE_RATE*2:
                if sys.byteorder!="little":block.byteswap()
                wav.writeframesraw(block.tobytes())
                block=array.array("h")
        if block:
            if sys.byteorder!="little":block.byteswap()
            wav.writeframesraw(block.tobytes())

def main() -> None:
    if len(sys.argv)!=2:raise SystemExit("Usage: compose_music.py OUTDIR")
    ffmpeg=shutil.which("ffmpeg")
    if not ffmpeg:raise SystemExit("ffmpeg required to encode original NiakPS5 music")
    output=Path(sys.argv[1])
    output.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    # Remove the template project's pre-existing recorded music, so only
    # tracks uniquely composed for NiakPS5 can enter the retail title package.
    for original in output.glob("*.ogg"):original.unlink()
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="niak-music-") as work:
        for title,root,_,progression in SONGS:
            raw=Path(work)/(title+".wav")
            render_song(raw,root,progression)
            subprocess.run([ffmpeg,"-hide_banner","-loglevel","error","-y",
                            "-i",str(raw),"-ar","48000","-ac","2",
                            "-c:a","libvorbis","-q:a","4",
                            str(output/(title+".ogg"))],check=True)
            if (output/(title+".ogg")).stat().st_size<2000:
                raise RuntimeError("Empty encoded soundtrack "+title)
            print("Original NiakPS5 soundtrack:",title)
if __name__=="__main__":main()
```

`native/title/cover_sources.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Private, opt-in PS4/PS5 cover providers for NiakPS5 FTP installation.

TheGamesDB: platform-verified physical front/back box art.
SteamGridDB: community portrait artwork FRONT ONLY, never labelled retail.
Never bundle downloaded artwork or API credentials in a public application.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
import unicodedata
import urllib.parse
import urllib.request
from urllib.parse import urlsplit

MAX_JSON=1024*1024
IMAGE_HOSTS={"cdn.thegamesdb.net","cdn.steamgriddb.com","cdn2.steamgriddb.com"}
PLATFORM_NAMES={
    "ps5":{"sony playstation 5","playstation 5","ps5","sony ps5"},
    "ps4":{"sony playstation 4","playstation 4","ps4","sony ps4"},
}
IGNORABLE_SUFFIXES=(" console edition"," playstation 5 edition",
                    " playstation 4 edition"," ps5 edition"," ps4 edition")


def normalize(name):
    plain=unicodedata.normalize("NFKD",str(name)).encode("ascii","ignore").decode()
    return " ".join(re.findall(r"[a-z0-9]+",plain.lower()))


def name_variants(name):
    exact=normalize(name)
    variants=[exact] if exact else []
    for ending in IGNORABLE_SUFFIXES:
        if exact.endswith(ending) and len(exact)>len(ending)+4:
            variants.append(exact[:-len(ending)])
    return tuple(dict.fromkeys(variants))


def trusted_image_url(url):
    """Reject arbitrary hostnames and redirects from untrusted API metadata."""
    if not isinstance(url,str) or len(url)>600:
        return False
    p=urlsplit(url)
    return (p.scheme=="https" and p.hostname in IMAGE_HOSTS
            and p.username is None and p.password is None
            and not p.fragment and p.port in (None,443))


def get_json(url, headers=None):
    p=urlsplit(url)
    if p.scheme!="https" or p.hostname not in (
        "api.thegamesdb.net","www.steamgriddb.com"):
        raise ValueError("Unexpected API host")
    req=urllib.request.Request(url,headers=headers or {"User-Agent":"NiakPS5-private-art/1.1"})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=12) as response:
        resolved=getattr(response,"geturl",lambda:url)()
        if urlsplit(resolved).hostname!=p.hostname:
            raise ValueError("Unexpected API redirect")
        body=response.read(MAX_JSON+1)
    if len(body)>MAX_JSON:
        raise ValueError("Oversize API response")
    return json.loads(body)


def tgdb_cover_urls(title,platform,key):
    """Strict title + returned platform match; never guess across PS4/PS5."""
    if not key or platform not in PLATFORM_NAMES or not title.strip():
        return {}
    query=urllib.parse.urlencode({
        "apikey":key,"name":title[:120],"fields":"platform",
        "include":"boxart,platform"})
    data=get_json("https://api.thegamesdb.net/v1.1/Games/ByGameName?"+query)
    games=data.get("data",{}).get("games",[])
    platform_data=data.get("include",{}).get("platform",{}).get("data",{})
    boxart=data.get("include",{}).get("boxart",{}).get("data",{})
    if not isinstance(games,list) or not isinstance(platform_data,dict) or not isinstance(boxart,dict):
        return {}
    names=set(name_variants(title))
    matched=[]
    for game in games[:60]:
        if not isinstance(game,dict):continue
        # Both sources can have homonymous games: require exact names.
        if not set(name_variants(str(game.get("game_title") or game.get("name") or ""))) & names:
            continue
        pid=str(game.get("platform",""))
        item=platform_data.get(pid)
        if not isinstance(item,dict):continue
        label=normalize(item.get("name",""))
        if label not in PLATFORM_NAMES[platform]:continue
        matched.append(game)
    if len(matched)!=1:
        return {}
    gid=str(matched[0].get("id",""))
    images=boxart.get(gid,[])
    if not isinstance(images,list):return {}
    result={}
    for item in images:
        if not isinstance(item,dict):continue
        side=item.get("side")
        filename=item.get("filename")
        if side not in ("front","back") or side in result or not isinstance(filename,str):
            continue
        # Trust only the official fixed image CDN and a side-specific path.
        if not re.fullmatch(r"boxart/"+side+r"/[A-Za-z0-9_/-]{1,150}\.(?:jpg|jpeg|png|webp)",filename):
            continue
        url="https://cdn.thegamesdb.net/images/original/"+filename
        if trusted_image_url(url):result[side]=url
    return result


def steamgriddb_portrait_url(title,key):
    """Community vertical grid only. Not PS5 retail packaging or a back/spine."""
    if not key or not title.strip():return {}
    headers={"Authorization":"Bearer "+key,"User-Agent":"NiakPS5-private-art/1.1"}
    url="https://www.steamgriddb.com/api/v2/search/autocomplete/"+urllib.parse.quote(title[:120],safe="")
    data=get_json(url,headers)
    entries=data.get("data",[])
    if not isinstance(entries,list):return {}
    norm=normalize(title)
    matches=[x for x in entries if isinstance(x,dict) and
             normalize(x.get("name",""))==norm and
             "software" not in x.get("types",[])]
    if len(matches)!=1:return {}
    gid=matches[0].get("id")
    if not isinstance(gid,int) or gid<=0:return {}
    grids=get_json(
        "https://www.steamgriddb.com/api/v2/grids/game/"+str(gid)+
        "?dimensions=600x900,342x482,660x930&types=static&nsfw=false&humor=false&epilepsy=false&limit=25",
        headers).get("data",[])
    if not isinstance(grids,list):return {}
    for grid in sorted((x for x in grids if isinstance(x,dict)),
                       key=lambda x:x.get("score",0) if isinstance(x.get("score"),(int,float)) else 0,
                       reverse=True):
        candidate=grid.get("url")
        if trusted_image_url(candidate):
            return {"front":candidate}
    return {}
```

`native/title/cover_stream_state.hpp`:

```hpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#pragma once
// Pure scheduling: render-thread texture uploads remain elsewhere.
#include <cstddef>
#include <vector>
namespace niak {
class CoverStreamState {
public:
 static constexpr std::size_t invalid=static_cast<std::size_t>(-1);
 void reset(std::size_t count) {done_.assign(count,0); next_=0;remaining_=count;}
 std::size_t remaining() const {return remaining_;}
 std::size_t take(std::size_t preferred=invalid) {
   if(!remaining_)return invalid;
   if(preferred<done_.size()&&!done_[preferred]) {
     done_[preferred]=1;--remaining_;return preferred;
   }
   while(next_<done_.size()&&done_[next_])++next_;
   if(next_>=done_.size())return invalid;
   const auto current=next_++;
   done_[current]=1;--remaining_;return current;
 }
private:
 std::vector<unsigned char> done_;
 std::size_t next_=0,remaining_=0;
};
}
```

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// Native PS5 wallpaper: a real PS5 feed queried once per calendar day.
// The OpenGL UI never waits for HTTP; last packaged art remains available.
#include "niak/daily_backdrop.hpp"
#include "niak/daily_runtime.hpp"
#include "niak/lodepng.h"
#if defined(__PROSPERO__)
#include <webp/decode.h>
#endif
#include "gfx/renderer.hpp"
#include "platform/ps5/system.hpp"
#include <array>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <ctime>
#include <mutex>
#include <string>
#include <thread>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>

namespace {
constexpr std::size_t MAX_BYTES=7u*1024u*1024u;
// Each decoded 1280x720 RGBA wallpaper uses 3.52 MiB on the GPU.
// Keep ONE packaged texture, rather than preloading fourteen (~49.2 MiB).
std::array<std::string,14> packaged_paths{};
std::array<std::string,14> wallpaper_labels{};
std::array<bool,14> packaged_failed{};
std::uint32_t packaged_texture=0;
int packaged_index=-1;
int count=0;
int override_offset=0;
int override_day=-1;
// Today's manual wallpaper choice survives closing/reopening NiakPS5.
// A different local date ALWAYS resets to the automatic daily selection.
void restore_day_choice(int day) {
    if(override_day==day)return;
    override_day=day;
    override_offset=0;
    FILE *file=std::fopen("/download0/niak-wallpaper-choice.txt","rb");
    if(!file)return;
    int cached_day=-1,cached_offset=0;
    if(std::fscanf(file,"%d %d",&cached_day,&cached_offset)==2 &&
       cached_day==day && cached_offset>=0 && cached_offset<count)
        override_offset=cached_offset;
    std::fclose(file);
}
void save_day_choice(int day) {
    const char *tmp="/download0/niak-wallpaper-choice.txt.tmp";
    FILE *file=std::fopen(tmp,"wb");
    if(!file)return;
    const int wrote=std::fprintf(file,"%d %d\n",day,override_offset);
    const int flushed=std::fflush(file);
    const int closed=std::fclose(file);
    if(wrote<0 || flushed!=0 || closed!=0 ||
       std::rename(tmp,"/download0/niak-wallpaper-choice.txt")!=0)
        std::remove(tmp);
}
struct Runtime {
    std::mutex mutex;
    int started_day=-1, ready_day=-1, live_day=-1;
    bool pending=false;
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> bytes;
    std::uint32_t texture=0;
    hui::gfx::Renderer *renderer=nullptr;
};
Runtime &state() {
    // Intentionally process-lifetime: detached HTTP reader cannot reference
    // an object destroyed during title teardown. Memory stays bounded.
    static Runtime *runtime=new Runtime;
    return *runtime;
}
bool decode_png(const std::vector<std::uint8_t> &raw,
                unsigned &w,unsigned &h,
                std::vector<std::uint8_t> &rgba) {
    // Package media uses WebP 80; older caches and live downloads remain PNG.
    if(raw.size()>=24 && std::memcmp(raw.data(),"RIFF",4)==0 &&
       std::memcmp(raw.data()+8,"WEBP",4)==0) {
#if defined(__PROSPERO__)
        int iw=0,ih=0;
        if(!WebPGetInfo(raw.data(),raw.size(),&iw,&ih)||
           iw<320||ih<320||iw>4096||ih>4096||
           std::uint64_t(iw)*ih>10'000'000)return false;
        w=unsigned(iw);h=unsigned(ih);
        rgba.resize(std::size_t(w)*h*4u);
        return WebPDecodeRGBAInto(raw.data(),raw.size(),rgba.data(),
                                  rgba.size(),int(w*4u))!=nullptr;
#else
        return false;
#endif
    }
    static const std::uint8_t sig[]={137,80,78,71,13,10,26,10};
    if(raw.size()<33||raw.size()>MAX_BYTES ||
       std::memcmp(raw.data(),sig,8)!=0)return false;
    w=(unsigned(raw[16])<<24)|(unsigned(raw[17])<<16)|
      (unsigned(raw[18])<<8)|unsigned(raw[19]);
    h=(unsigned(raw[20])<<24)|(unsigned(raw[21])<<16)|
      (unsigned(raw[22])<<8)|unsigned(raw[23]);
    if(w<320||h<320||w>4096||h>4096||
       std::uint64_t(w)*h>10'000'000)return false;
    unsigned dw=0,dh=0;
    if(lodepng::decode(rgba,dw,dh,raw)!=0||dw!=w||dh!=h ||
       rgba.size()!=std::size_t(w)*h*4)return false;
    return true;
}
bool load_packaged(const char *path,std::vector<std::uint8_t> &rgba) {
    std::FILE *file=std::fopen(path,"rb");if(!file)return false;
    if(std::fseek(file,0,SEEK_END)!=0){std::fclose(file);return false;}
    const long len=std::ftell(file);
    if(len<32||len>long(MAX_BYTES)||std::fseek(file,0,SEEK_SET)!=0) {
        std::fclose(file);return false;
    }
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> buffer(std::size_t(len),0);
    const bool ok=std::fread(buffer.data(),1,buffer.size(),file)==buffer.size();
    std::fclose(file);if(!ok)return false;
    unsigned w=0,h=0;
    return decode_png(buffer,w,h,rgba) && w==1280 && h==720;
}
// Catalog only small image headers. Full PNG/WebP decoding happens when the
// wallpaper becomes visible, on the GL-owning thread, and never for all 14.
bool packaged_header_ok(const char *path) {
    std::FILE *file=std::fopen(path,"rb");if(!file)return false;
    if(std::fseek(file,0,SEEK_END)!=0){std::fclose(file);return false;}
    const long size=std::ftell(file);
    if(size<33 || size>long(MAX_BYTES) || std::fseek(file,0,SEEK_SET)!=0) {
        std::fclose(file);return false;
    }
    std::uint8_t header[32]{};
    const auto n=std::fread(header,1,sizeof(header),file);
    std::fclose(file);
    if(n!=sizeof(header))return false;
    static constexpr std::uint8_t png_sig[]={137,80,78,71,13,10,26,10};
    return (std::memcmp(header,"RIFF",4)==0 &&
            std::memcmp(header+8,"WEBP",4)==0) ||
           std::memcmp(header,png_sig,8)==0;
}
std::uint32_t packaged_backdrop(int index) {
    if(index<0 || index>=count)return 0;
    const auto slot=std::size_t(index);
    if(packaged_index==index)return packaged_texture;
    if(packaged_failed[slot])return 0;
    Runtime &runtime=state();
    if(!runtime.renderer)return 0;
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> rgba;
    if(!load_packaged(packaged_paths[slot].c_str(),rgba)) {
        packaged_failed[slot]=true;
        return 0;
    }
    const auto new_texture=runtime.renderer->create_texture(1280,720,rgba.data());
    if(!new_texture){packaged_failed[slot]=true;return 0;}
    const auto previous=packaged_texture;
    packaged_texture=new_texture;
    packaged_index=index;
    if(previous)runtime.renderer->destroy_texture(previous);
    return packaged_texture;
}
bool read_cache(const char *day,std::vector<std::uint8_t> &bytes) {
    FILE *id=std::fopen("/download0/niak-wallpaper-date.txt","rb");
    if(!id)return false;
    char stored[16]{};
    const bool valid=std::fgets(stored,sizeof(stored),id)!=nullptr;
    std::fclose(id);
    if(!valid || std::strncmp(stored,day,10)!=0)return false;
    FILE *file=std::fopen("/download0/niak-wallpaper.png","rb");
    if(!file)return false;
    if(std::fseek(file,0,SEEK_END)!=0){std::fclose(file);return false;}
    long size=std::ftell(file);
    if(size<33||size>long(MAX_BYTES)||std::fseek(file,0,SEEK_SET)!=0){
        std::fclose(file);return false;
    }
    bytes.resize(std::size_t(size));
    const bool ok=std::fread(bytes.data(),1,bytes.size(),file)==bytes.size();
    std::fclose(file);
    return ok;
}
void save_cache(const char *day,const std::vector<std::uint8_t> &bytes) {
    FILE *image=std::fopen("/download0/niak-wallpaper.png.tmp","wb");
    if(!image)return;
    const bool written=std::fwrite(bytes.data(),1,bytes.size(),image)==bytes.size();
    const int flushed=std::fflush(image);
    const int closed=std::fclose(image);
    if(!written||flushed||closed||
       std::rename("/download0/niak-wallpaper.png.tmp",
                   "/download0/niak-wallpaper.png")!=0) {
        std::remove("/download0/niak-wallpaper.png.tmp");return;
    }
    FILE *stamp=std::fopen("/download0/niak-wallpaper-date.txt.tmp","wb");
    if(!stamp)return;
    const bool stamped=std::fwrite(day,1,10,stamp)==10;
    const int result=std::fclose(stamp);
    if(!stamped||result||
       std::rename("/download0/niak-wallpaper-date.txt.tmp",
                   "/download0/niak-wallpaper-date.txt")!=0)
        std::remove("/download0/niak-wallpaper-date.txt.tmp");
}
void worker(int day,std::string date) {
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> png;
    bool cached=read_cache(date.c_str(),png);
    if(!cached) {
        // No user account, game library, IP address or other console data
        // is included in the public PlayStation HTTPS requests.
        if(!niak_fetch_latest_ps5_wallpaper(date.c_str(),unsigned(day),png))
            return;
        save_cache(date.c_str(),png);
    }
    unsigned w=0,h=0;std::vector<std::uint8_t> rgba;
    if(!decode_png(png,w,h,rgba))return;
    Runtime &s=state();
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(s.mutex);
    s.bytes=std::move(png);
    s.ready_day=day;
    s.pending=true;
}
std::vector<std::uint8_t> fit_wallpaper(const std::vector<std::uint8_t> &input,
                                        unsigned w,unsigned h) {
    constexpr unsigned W=1280,H=720;
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> dest(std::size_t(W)*H*4);
    // A full-bleed crop for landscapes. For portrait cover art, preserve its
    // aspect ratio over a dark tinted soft backdrop (no stretched jacket).
    const bool portrait=float(w)/float(h)<1.42f;
    const float scale=std::max(float(W)/w,float(H)/h);
    const float scaled_w=w*scale,scaled_h=h*scale;
    for(unsigned y=0;y<H;++y)for(unsigned x=0;x<W;++x) {
        const auto xx=std::min(w-1,unsigned(std::max(0.f,
               (float(x)+(scaled_w-W)*.5f)/scale)));
        const auto yy=std::min(h-1,unsigned(std::max(0.f,
               (float(y)+(scaled_h-H)*.5f)/scale)));
        const auto src=(std::size_t(yy)*w+xx)*4,dst=(std::size_t(y)*W+x)*4;
        for(int c=0;c<3;++c)dest[dst+c]=portrait?std::uint8_t(input[src+c]/3):input[src+c];
        dest[dst+3]=255;
    }
    if(portrait) {
        const float front_scale=std::min(540.f/w,660.f/h);
        const unsigned fw=std::max(1u,unsigned(w*front_scale));
        const unsigned fh=std::max(1u,unsigned(h*front_scale));
        const unsigned ox=(W-fw)/2,oy=(H-fh)/2;
        for(unsigned y=0;y<fh;++y)for(unsigned x=0;x<fw;++x) {
            const unsigned xx=std::min(w-1,unsigned(float(x)/front_scale));
            const unsigned yy=std::min(h-1,unsigned(float(y)/front_scale));
            const auto a=(std::size_t(yy)*w+xx)*4;
            const auto b=(std::size_t(oy+y)*W+ox+x)*4;
            const unsigned alpha=input[a+3];
            for(int c=0;c<3;++c)
                dest[b+c]=std::uint8_t((unsigned(input[a+c])*alpha+
                                       unsigned(dest[b+c])*(255-alpha))/255);
        }
    }
    return dest;
}
int day_now(char (&date)[11]) {
    const auto now=std::time(nullptr);const auto *tm=std::localtime(&now);
    if(!tm)return -1;
    std::strftime(date,sizeof(date),"%Y-%m-%d",tm);
    return (tm->tm_year+1900)*372+tm->tm_mon*31+tm->tm_mday;
}
}
void niak_load_daily_backdrops(hui::gfx::Renderer &renderer,const char *directory) {
    Runtime &runtime=state();
    if(packaged_texture && runtime.renderer)
        runtime.renderer->destroy_texture(packaged_texture);
    runtime.renderer=&renderer;
    packaged_texture=0;
    packaged_index=-1;
    packaged_failed.fill(false);
    packaged_paths.fill({});
    wallpaper_labels.fill({});
    count=0;
    override_day=-1;
    std::array<std::string,14> by_file{};
    char manifest[256];
    if(std::snprintf(manifest,sizeof(manifest),"%s/labels.tsv",directory)>0) {
        FILE *labels=std::fopen(manifest,"rb");
        if(labels) {
            char line[320];
            while(std::fgets(line,sizeof(line),labels)) {
                int idx=-1;char title[140]{},date[24]{};
                if((std::sscanf(line,"wall-%02d.webp\t%139[^\t]\t%23[^\r\n]",
                                &idx,title,date)==3 ||
                    std::sscanf(line,"wall-%02d.png\t%139[^\t]\t%23[^\r\n]",
                                &idx,title,date)==3) &&
                   idx>=0 && idx<14 && std::strlen(date)==10 &&
                   date[4]=='-' && date[7]=='-') {
                    by_file[std::size_t(idx)]=std::string("Fond · ")+title+
                        " · "+std::string(date+8,2)+"/"+
                        std::string(date+5,2)+"/"+std::string(date,4);
                }
            }
            std::fclose(labels);
        }
    }
    for(int i=0;i<14;++i) {
        char path[256];
        int n=std::snprintf(path,sizeof(path),"%s/wall-%02d.webp",directory,i);
        if(n<=0 || n>=int(sizeof(path)) || !packaged_header_ok(path)) {
            n=std::snprintf(path,sizeof(path),"%s/wall-%02d.png",directory,i);
            if(n<=0 || n>=int(sizeof(path)) || !packaged_header_ok(path))
                continue;
        }
        packaged_paths[std::size_t(count)]=path;
        wallpaper_labels[std::size_t(count)]=std::move(by_file[std::size_t(i)]);
        ++count;
    }
    hui::sys::log("[NiakPS5] packaged PS5 wallpaper files=%d; GPU loads on demand",count);
}
std::uint32_t niak_daily_backdrop() {
    Runtime &s=state();char today[11]={};const int day=day_now(today);
    if(day<0)return packaged_backdrop(0);
    restore_day_choice(day);
    // Do not retain yesterday's unused online RGBA GPU allocation.
    if(s.texture && s.live_day!=day && s.renderer) {
        s.renderer->destroy_texture(s.texture);
        s.texture=0;
        s.live_day=-1;
    }
#if defined(__PROSPERO__)
    if(s.started_day!=day) {
        s.started_day=day;
        // Network and JSON parsing stay off the render thread.
        std::thread([day,date=std::string(today)] {worker(day,date);}).detach();
    }
#endif
    {
        std::vector<std::uint8_t> bytes;
        {
            // The worker publishes only under this mutex. Never read the
            // completion flag without locking (would be a C++ data race).
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(s.mutex);
            if(s.pending&&s.ready_day==day) {
                bytes=std::move(s.bytes);
                s.pending=false;
            }
        }
        if(!bytes.empty()&&s.renderer) {
            unsigned w=0,h=0;std::vector<std::uint8_t> rgba;
            if(decode_png(bytes,w,h,rgba)) {
                auto image=fit_wallpaper(rgba,w,h);
                auto handle=s.renderer->create_texture(1280,720,image.data());
                if(handle) {
                    if(s.texture)s.renderer->destroy_texture(s.texture);
                    s.texture=handle;s.live_day=day;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    if(override_offset==0 && s.texture&&s.live_day==day)return s.texture;
    return count?packaged_backdrop(((day+override_offset)%count+count)%count):0;
}

const char *niak_daily_backdrop_caption() {
    static constexpr const char *kUnknown="Fond · Sélection PS5";
    static constexpr const char *kLive="Fond du jour · Sélection PS5 en ligne";
    char today[11]{};const int day=day_now(today);
    if(day<0)return kUnknown;
    restore_day_choice(day);
    Runtime &s=state();
    if(override_offset==0 && s.texture && s.live_day==day)return kLive;
    if(count==0)return kUnknown;
    const int idx=((day+override_offset)%count+count)%count;
    if(packaged_index!=idx || !packaged_texture)return kUnknown;
    const std::string &label=wallpaper_labels[std::size_t(idx)];
    return label.empty()?kUnknown:label.c_str();
}
void niak_next_daily_backdrop() {
    char date[11]{};
    const int day=day_now(date);
    if(count<2 || day<0)return;
    restore_day_choice(day);
    override_offset=(override_offset+1)%count;
    save_day_choice(day);
}
```
