```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// Fetches public released-PS5 media: GitHub JSON index + official PlayStation PNG.
// Network failure is never fatal; packaged wallpapers remain available.
#include "niak/daily_runtime.hpp"
// The PS5 title toolchain disables exceptions. Every field is type-checked
// before get<T>(); a failed internal assertion remains fail-closed.
#if !defined(__EXCEPTIONS) && !defined(_CPPUNWIND)
#define PICOJSON_ASSERT(x) do { if (!(x)) std::abort(); } while (0)
#endif
#include "niak/picojson.h"
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <utility>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#if defined(__PROSPERO__)
#include "platform/ps5/console_curl.h"
#include "niak/one_shot_install.hpp"
#include <mutex>
#include <chrono>
extern "C" {
int sceNetInit();
int sceNetPoolCreate(const char*,int,int);
int sceSslInit(std::size_t);
int sceHttpInit(int,int,std::size_t);
int sceHttpCreateTemplate(int,const char*,int,int);
int sceHttpDeleteTemplate(int);
int sceHttpCreateConnectionWithURL(int,const char*,int);
int sceHttpDeleteConnection(int);
int sceHttpCreateRequestWithURL(int,int,const char*,std::uint64_t);
int sceHttpDeleteRequest(int);
int sceHttpSendRequest(int,const void*,std::size_t);
int sceHttpGetStatusCode(int,int*);
int sceHttpReadData(int,void*,std::size_t);
int sceHttpSetAutoRedirect(int,int);
int sceHttpSetResolveTimeOut(int,unsigned);
int sceHttpSetConnectTimeOut(int,unsigned);
int sceHttpSetSendTimeOut(int,unsigned);
int sceHttpSetRecvTimeOut(int,unsigned);
}
namespace {
constexpr const char *FEED="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sharpemu/sharpemu-site/main/src/data/games.json";
constexpr const char *MEDIA="https://image.api.playstation.com/";
constexpr const char *LAUNCHBOX="https://images.launchbox-app.com/";
constexpr std::size_t MAX_FEED=5u*1024u*1024u, MAX_PNG=7u*1024u*1024u;
// The bundled GPLv3 console_curl shim uses OpenSSL and the console CA list.
// PS5 sceSsl may refuse public certificates once the GUI is elevated.
struct CurlBuffer {
 std::vector<std::uint8_t> bytes;
 std::size_t cap=0;
 bool oversized=false;
};
std::size_t curl_write(char *ptr,std::size_t size,std::size_t nmemb,void *context){
 auto &buffer=*static_cast<CurlBuffer*>(context);
 if(size && nmemb>SIZE_MAX/size){buffer.oversized=true;return 0;}
 const std::size_t n=size*nmemb;
 if(n>buffer.cap-buffer.bytes.size()){buffer.oversized=true;return 0;}
 buffer.bytes.insert(buffer.bytes.end(),
     reinterpret_cast<std::uint8_t*>(ptr),
     reinterpret_cast<std::uint8_t*>(ptr)+n);
 return n;
}
struct CurlEpoch {
 const std::atomic<unsigned> *value=nullptr;
 unsigned expected=0;
};
int curl_cancel_stale(void *context,curl_off_t,curl_off_t,
                      curl_off_t,curl_off_t) {
 const auto &epoch=*static_cast<CurlEpoch*>(context);
 return epoch.value && epoch.value->load(std::memory_order_relaxed)!=
        epoch.expected ? 1 : 0;
}
bool get_curl(const std::string &url,std::size_t limit,
              std::vector<std::uint8_t> &result,int *failure,int *stage,
              const std::atomic<unsigned> *selection_epoch=nullptr,
              unsigned expected_epoch=0){
 static std::once_flag started;
 static CURLcode initialized=CURLE_FAILED_INIT;
 std::call_once(started,[]{initialized=curl_global_init(CURL_GLOBAL_DEFAULT);});
 if(initialized!=CURLE_OK){
   if(failure)*failure=-10000-static_cast<int>(initialized);
   if(stage)*stage=10;
   return false;
 }
 CURL *easy=curl_easy_init();
 if(!easy){if(failure)*failure=-10002;if(stage)*stage=10;return false;}
 CurlBuffer body{};
 body.cap=limit;
 body.bytes.reserve(std::min(limit,std::size_t(1u<<20)));
 console_curl_setup(easy); // verified CA; socket nonblocking; no signals
 curl_easy_setopt(easy,CURLOPT_URL,url.c_str());
 curl_easy_setopt(easy,CURLOPT_PROTOCOLS_STR,"https");
 curl_easy_setopt(easy,CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION,0L);
 curl_easy_setopt(easy,CURLOPT_HTTP_VERSION,CURL_HTTP_VERSION_1_1);
 curl_easy_setopt(easy,CURLOPT_IPRESOLVE,CURL_IPRESOLVE_V4);
 curl_easy_setopt(easy,CURLOPT_CONNECTTIMEOUT_MS,5000L);
 curl_easy_setopt(easy,CURLOPT_TIMEOUT_MS,15000L);
 curl_easy_setopt(easy,CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER,1L);
 curl_easy_setopt(easy,CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYHOST,2L);
 curl_easy_setopt(easy,CURLOPT_USERAGENT,"NiakPS5-public-media/1.0");
 curl_easy_setopt(easy,CURLOPT_WRITEFUNCTION,curl_write);
 curl_easy_setopt(easy,CURLOPT_WRITEDATA,&body);
 curl_easy_setopt(easy,CURLOPT_MAXFILESIZE_LARGE,static_cast<curl_off_t>(limit));
 // Stop superseded artwork requests during slow connects or transfers.
 // This callback only reads an atomic epoch, never UI or GPU objects.
 CurlEpoch epoch{selection_epoch,expected_epoch};
 if(selection_epoch) {
   curl_easy_setopt(easy,CURLOPT_XFERINFOFUNCTION,curl_cancel_stale);
   curl_easy_setopt(easy,CURLOPT_XFERINFODATA,&epoch);
   curl_easy_setopt(easy,CURLOPT_NOPROGRESS,0L);
 }
 const CURLcode rc=curl_easy_perform(easy);
 long status=0;
 if(rc==CURLE_OK)curl_easy_getinfo(easy,CURLINFO_RESPONSE_CODE,&status);
 curl_easy_cleanup(easy);
 if(rc!=CURLE_OK){
   if(failure)*failure=body.oversized?-103:-10000-static_cast<int>(rc);
   if(stage)*stage=body.oversized?8:10;
   return false;
 }
 if(status!=200){if(failure)*failure=static_cast<int>(status);if(stage)*stage=6;return false;}
 if(body.bytes.empty()){if(failure)*failure=-101;if(stage)*stage=7;return false;}
 result=std::move(body.bytes);
 return true;
}
int context() {
  // Never permanently poison the only public-media transport if an early
  // boot, offline network or temporary PS5 sandbox error breaks sceHttpInit.
  // Retry the FAILED stage after a bounded delay on the HTTP worker only.
  // Successful pool/SSL objects are reused; no extra pools are created.
  static std::mutex init_mutex;
  static int pool=-1,ssl=-1,result=-1;
  static std::chrono::steady_clock::time_point next_attempt{};
  std::lock_guard<std::mutex> guard(init_mutex);
  if(result>=0)return result;
  const auto now=std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
  if(now<next_attempt)return result;
  next_attempt=now+std::chrono::seconds(30);
  if(pool<0) {
    (void)sceNetInit();
    pool=sceNetPoolCreate("NiakPS5 public art",4<<20,0);
  }
  if(pool<0)return result=pool;
  if(ssl<0)ssl=sceSslInit(2<<20);
  if(ssl<0)return result=ssl;
  result=sceHttpInit(pool,ssl,4<<20);
  return result;
}
bool launchbox_filename(const std::string &name) {
  const std::size_t start=name.rfind("r2_",0)==0?3u:0u;
  if(name.size()<start+40 || name.size()>start+41)return false;
  for(std::size_t i=start;i<start+36;++i) {
    const char c=name[i];
    if(!((c>='0'&&c<='9')||(c>='a'&&c<='f')||
         (c>='A'&&c<='F')||c=='-'))return false;
  }
  const auto ext=name.substr(start+36);
  return ext==".png" || ext==".jpg" || ext==".jpeg";
}
bool get(const std::string &url,std::size_t limit,std::vector<std::uint8_t> &result,
         int *failure=nullptr,int *stage=nullptr,
         const std::atomic<unsigned> *selection_epoch=nullptr,
         unsigned expected_epoch=0) {
  if(failure)*failure=0;
  if(stage)*stage=0;
  if(selection_epoch &&
     selection_epoch->load(std::memory_order_relaxed)!=expected_epoch)
     return false;
  // Host list is exact, not a substring. Refuse custom ports, parameters,
  // path traversal and redirects. No arbitrary user-supplied URLs.
  const bool feed=url==FEED;
  const bool art=url.rfind(MEDIA,0)==0 &&
      url.find("?",std::strlen(MEDIA))==std::string::npos &&
      url.find("..",std::strlen(MEDIA))==std::string::npos &&
      url.rfind(".png")==url.size()-4;
  const bool cases=url.rfind(LAUNCHBOX,0)==0 &&
      launchbox_filename(url.substr(std::strlen(LAUNCHBOX)));
  if(!feed&&!art&&!cases){if(failure)*failure=-100;if(stage)*stage=9;return false;}
  // The one-shot payload installer grants this GUI a privileged filesystem
  // identity. sceSsl can then reject public TLS with 0x8095F00C. libcurl
  // with OpenSSL retains peer/hostname verification under this identity.
  if(niak::payload_process_elevated)
     return get_curl(url,limit,result,failure,stage,
                     selection_epoch,expected_epoch);
  const int ctx=context();
  if(ctx<0){if(failure)*failure=ctx;if(stage)*stage=1;return false;}
  int tmpl=sceHttpCreateTemplate(ctx,"NiakPS5-public-media/1.0",2,1);
  if(tmpl<0){if(failure)*failure=tmpl;if(stage)*stage=2;return false;}
  (void)sceHttpSetAutoRedirect(tmpl,0);
  // Some PS5 HTTP versions honor deadlines only at the actual connection
  // or request handle. Apply bounded DNS/connect/send/read timeouts at all
  // levels; no CDN call may stall the title's background queue indefinitely.
  const auto bounded_timeout=[](int id){
    (void)sceHttpSetResolveTimeOut(id,5000000);
    (void)sceHttpSetConnectTimeOut(id,5000000);
    (void)sceHttpSetSendTimeOut(id,5000000);
    (void)sceHttpSetRecvTimeOut(id,8000000);
  };
  bounded_timeout(tmpl);
  int conn=sceHttpCreateConnectionWithURL(tmpl,url.c_str(),0);
  if(conn<0){if(failure)*failure=conn;if(stage)*stage=3;
    sceHttpDeleteTemplate(tmpl);return false;}
  bounded_timeout(conn);
  int req=sceHttpCreateRequestWithURL(conn,0,url.c_str(),0);
  if(req>=0)bounded_timeout(req);
  bool ok=req>=0;
  if(!ok){if(failure)*failure=req;if(stage)*stage=4;}
  int status=0;
  if(ok) {
    const int sent=sceHttpSendRequest(req,nullptr,0);
    if(sent<0){ok=false;if(failure)*failure=sent;if(stage)*stage=5;}
    else {
      const int rc=sceHttpGetStatusCode(req,&status);
      if(rc<0){ok=false;if(failure)*failure=rc;if(stage)*stage=6;}
      else if(status!=200){ok=false;if(failure)*failure=status;if(stage)*stage=6;}
    }
  }
  std::vector<std::uint8_t> bytes;bytes.reserve(std::min(limit,std::size_t(1u<<20)));
  if(ok) {
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> chunk(32768);
    int n=0;
    while((n=sceHttpReadData(req,chunk.data(),chunk.size()))>0) {
      if(selection_epoch &&
         selection_epoch->load(std::memory_order_relaxed)!=expected_epoch) {
        ok=false;break; // old focus, cleanly close HTTP handles below
      }
      if(bytes.size()+std::size_t(n)>limit){
        ok=false;if(failure)*failure=-103;if(stage)*stage=8;break;
      }
      bytes.insert(bytes.end(),chunk.begin(),chunk.begin()+n);
    }
    if(n<0||bytes.empty()) {
      ok=false;
      if(failure)*failure=n<0?n:-101;
      if(stage)*stage=7;
    }
  }
  if(req>=0)(void)sceHttpDeleteRequest(req);
  (void)sceHttpDeleteConnection(conn);
  (void)sceHttpDeleteTemplate(tmpl);
  if(ok){result=std::move(bytes);return true;}
  return false;
}
std::string value_string(const picojson::object &row,const char *key) {
  const auto it=row.find(key);
  return it!=row.end()&&it->second.is<std::string>() ?
      it->second.get<std::string>() : std::string{};
}
}
#endif

bool niak_fetch_latest_ps5_wallpaper(const char *today_yyyy_mm_dd,
                                    std::uint32_t selection_seed,
                                    std::vector<std::uint8_t> &png) {
#if defined(__PROSPERO__)
  if(!today_yyyy_mm_dd||std::strlen(today_yyyy_mm_dd)!=10)return false;
  std::vector<std::uint8_t> body;
  if(!get(FEED,MAX_FEED,body))return false;
  picojson::value parsed;
  const std::string json(body.begin(),body.end());
  if(!picojson::parse(parsed,json).empty() ||
     !parsed.is<picojson::array>())return false;
  const std::string today(today_yyyy_mm_dd);
  // Prefer genuinely released games within two calendar years, not preorders.
  const std::string floor=std::to_string(std::max(2000,std::atoi(today.substr(0,4).c_str())-2))+"-";
  struct Candidate {std::string date,url,name;};
  std::vector<Candidate> items;
  for(const picojson::value &v:parsed.get<picojson::array>()) {
    if(!v.is<picojson::object>())continue;
    const auto &row=v.get<picojson::object>();
    const std::string id=value_string(row,"titleId");
    const std::string date=value_string(row,"releaseDate");
    const std::string url=value_string(row,"cover");
    const std::string name=value_string(row,"name");
    if(id.rfind("PPSA",0)!=0||date.size()<10 ||name.empty()||
       date.substr(0,10)>today||date<floor||name.size()>140 ||
       url.rfind(MEDIA,0)!=0||url.size()<5 ||
       url.substr(url.size()-4)!=".png"||url.find('?')!=std::string::npos)
       continue;
    const std::string lower=name; // no console personal data is inspected.
    if(lower.find("Hentai")!=std::string::npos||
       lower.find("Porn")!=std::string::npos ||
       lower.find("Casino")!=std::string::npos)continue;
    items.push_back({date.substr(0,10),url,name});
  }
  if(items.empty())return false;
  std::sort(items.begin(),items.end(),[](const Candidate &a,const Candidate &b) {
    if(a.date!=b.date)return a.date>b.date;
    return a.name<b.name;
  });
  if(items.size()>70)items.resize(70);
  // Try a few nearby games if an image host is unavailable, never make the
  // initial GUI depend on a successful connection.
  const std::size_t first=selection_seed%items.size();
  for(std::size_t i=0;i<3 && i<items.size();++i) {
    png.clear();
    if(get(items[(first+i)%items.size()].url,MAX_PNG,png) &&
       png.size()>32 && png[0]==137 && png[1]==80 && png[2]==78 && png[3]==71)
       return true;
  }
#else
  (void)today_yyyy_mm_dd;(void)selection_seed;(void)png;
#endif
  return false;
}

bool niak_fetch_launchbox_asset_ex(const char *filename,
                               std::vector<std::uint8_t>& bytes,int *failure,
                               int *failure_stage,
                               const std::atomic<unsigned> *selection_epoch,
                               unsigned expected_epoch) {
#if defined(__PROSPERO__)
  if(!filename || !launchbox_filename(filename)){
      if(failure)*failure=-100;
      if(failure_stage)*failure_stage=9;
      return false;
  }
  // Public CDN name only. Never include a profile, console title ID, token
  // or user-supplied URL in the outbound request.
  // Eden Encore likewise allows full originals before decoding/downscaling.
  return get(std::string(LAUNCHBOX)+filename,16u*1024u*1024u,bytes,
             failure,failure_stage,selection_epoch,expected_epoch);
#else
  (void)filename;(void)bytes;
  (void)selection_epoch;(void)expected_epoch;
  if(failure)*failure=-200;
  if(failure_stage)*failure_stage=9;
  return false;
#endif
}
bool niak_fetch_launchbox_asset(const char *filename,
                               std::vector<std::uint8_t>& bytes) {
  return niak_fetch_launchbox_asset_ex(filename,bytes,nullptr);
}
```

`native/title/elevation/README.md`:

```md
# NiakPS5 one-shot filesystem access

Adapted from niakw/Prospero.Eden-Encore `headless/elevation`, originally
blackbearreloaded/ps5-native-app-boilerplate (GPL-3.0-or-later). This copy
changes the exact authorized title ID to `PPSA99386`.

Only a compatible, already running, local elfldr at 127.0.0.1:9021 can
execute the bundled helper. The helper validates its caller's PID/title ID,
cloned credentials, version and narrowly fixed filesystem capability.
Without it the GUI continues sandboxed. It never installs a resident
privilege service or grants access to another title. Any self-installation
must be restricted to NiakPS5's own PLDmgr payload files. As in Encore,
a rollback failure or failed elevation that changes the caller's UID/GID
causes immediate termination instead of continuing in an ambiguous state.

The FTP installer must stage the two verified payload assets into
`/data/homebrew/PPSA99386/tools/niakps5/` for the GUI's `/app0/tools/`
source path to exist. It does this only with `--autoload` or
`--preserve-autoload`; `--no-autoload` leaves this opt-in step disabled.
No installer Python script is uploaded to the console title.
The in-app one-shot helper copies ONLY the app's own PLDmgr ELF/JSON.
It checks the existing autoload entry read-only; the application NEVER
edits autoload.txt itself. A missing entry requires the explicit FTP
installer --autoload operation (or the owner's own PLDmgr setup).
Firmware 13.60 behavior requires real console qualification.

```

`native/title/elevation/elevation.cpp`:

```cpp
/*
 * ps5-native-app-boilerplate - elfldr elevation client.
 * Copyright (C) 2026 BlackBearReloaded
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
 */
#include "elevation.hpp"
#if defined(__PROSPERO__)
#include "platform/ps5/system.hpp"
#include <array>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>

namespace
{
struct NetSockaddrIn
{
    std::uint8_t length;
    std::uint8_t family;
    std::uint16_t port;
    std::uint32_t address;
    std::uint16_t virtual_port;
    std::uint8_t zero[6];
};

extern "C"
{
    int sceKernelOpen(const char *path, int flags, mode_t mode);
    int sceKernelClose(int descriptor);
    std::int64_t sceKernelRead(int descriptor, void *buffer, std::size_t length);
    int sceNetConnect(int socket, const void *address, std::uint32_t address_length);
    int sceNetSend(int socket, const void *data, std::size_t length, int flags);
    int sceNetRecv(int socket, void *data, std::size_t length, int flags);
    int sceNetSetsockopt(int socket, int level, int option, const void *value, std::uint32_t size);
    int sceNetSocket(const char *name, int domain, int type, int protocol);
    int sceNetSocketClose(int socket);
}

bool send_all(int socket, const void *data, std::size_t size) noexcept
{
    return elevation::wire::transfer(static_cast<const std::uint8_t *>(data), size,
                                     [socket](const auto *bytes, std::size_t remaining)
                                     { return sceNetSend(socket, bytes, remaining, 0); });
}

bool receive(int socket, elevation::wire::Message &message) noexcept
{
    return elevation::wire::transfer(reinterpret_cast<std::uint8_t *>(&message), sizeof(message),
                                     [socket](auto *bytes, std::size_t remaining)
                                     { return sceNetRecv(socket, bytes, remaining, 0); });
}

elevation::Status exchange(int socket, const elevation::wire::Message &request) noexcept
{
    using namespace elevation;
    using wire::Kind;
    hui::sys::log("elevation: send request");
    if (!send_all(socket, &request, sizeof(request))) {
        hui::sys::log("elevation: request send failed");
        return Status::transport_error;
    }
    wire::Message reply{};
    if (!receive(socket, reply)) {
        hui::sys::log("elevation: first response receive failed");
        return Status::transport_error;
    }
    if (wire::matches(reply, request, Kind::response) && reply.status != Status::ok) {
        hui::sys::log("elevation: helper rejected request status=%u",
                              static_cast<unsigned>(reply.status));
        return reply.status;
    }
    if (!wire::matches(reply, request, Kind::prepare) || reply.status != Status::ok) {
        hui::sys::log("elevation: unexpected first response kind=%u status=%u",
                              static_cast<unsigned>(reply.kind), static_cast<unsigned>(reply.status));
        return Status::protocol_error;
    }
    hui::sys::log("elevation: prepare received");

    // The native same-UID syscall clones credentials before the helper edits them.
    // The helper independently verifies that p_ucred actually changed.
    wire::Message prepared = request;
    prepared.kind = Kind::prepared;
    hui::sys::log("elevation: clone credentials");
    if (seteuid(geteuid()) != 0)
        prepared.status = Status::prepare_failed;
    if (!send_all(socket, &prepared, sizeof(prepared)) || !receive(socket, reply)) {
        hui::sys::log("elevation: prepared/final exchange failed");
        return Status::transport_error;
    }
    if (!wire::matches(reply, request, Kind::response)) {
        hui::sys::log("elevation: invalid final response");
        return Status::protocol_error;
    }
    hui::sys::log("elevation: final response status=%u", static_cast<unsigned>(reply.status));
    if (prepared.status != Status::ok)
        return Status::prepare_failed;
    return reply.status;
}

elevation::Status submit(int socket, int helper, const elevation::wire::Message &request) noexcept
{
    using elevation::Status;
    // SceNet uses integer microseconds and its own timeout options, not BSD timeval.
    hui::sys::log("elevation: configure socket");
    constexpr int socket_level = 0xffff;
    constexpr int timeout_us = elevation::wire::io_timeout_us;
    for (const int option : {0x1105, 0x1106, 0x1109}) // send, receive, connect
    {
        if (sceNetSetsockopt(socket, socket_level, option, &timeout_us, sizeof(timeout_us)) < 0) {
            hui::sys::log("elevation: socket option 0x%x failed", option);
            return Status::transport_error;
        }
    }
    constexpr std::uint16_t port = 9021;
    const NetSockaddrIn address{sizeof(NetSockaddrIn),
                                2,
                                static_cast<std::uint16_t>((port << 8) | (port >> 8)),
                                0x0100007f,
                                0,
                                {0}};
    hui::sys::log("elevation: connect 127.0.0.1:9021");
    if (sceNetConnect(socket, &address, sizeof(address)) < 0) {
        hui::sys::log("elevation: connect failed");
        return Status::transport_error;
    }
    hui::sys::log("elevation: connected; stream helper");

    std::array<std::uint8_t, 4096> buffer{};
    std::size_t streamed = 0;
    for (;;)
    {
        const auto count = sceKernelRead(helper, buffer.data(), buffer.size());
        if (count == 0)
            break;
        if (count < 0 || !send_all(socket, buffer.data(), static_cast<std::size_t>(count))) {
            hui::sys::log("elevation: helper stream failed after %zu bytes", streamed);
            return Status::transport_error;
        }
        streamed += static_cast<std::size_t>(count);
    }
    hui::sys::log("elevation: helper stream complete bytes=%zu", streamed);
    // elfldr consumes the ELF's section extent, then hands this same connection
    // to the helper as stdin/stdout. Keep it open for the protocol exchange.
    return exchange(socket, request);
}
} // namespace

elevation::Status elevation::request(Capability capability, const char *helper_path) noexcept
{
    hui::sys::log("elevation: request begin");
    wire::Message message{};
    message.pid = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(getpid());
    message.capability = capability;
    if (const auto error = wire::validate(message); error != Status::ok)
        return error;
    if (helper_path == nullptr)
        return Status::invalid_request;
    const int helper = sceKernelOpen(helper_path, O_RDONLY, 0);
    if (helper < 0) {
        hui::sys::log("elevation: helper open failed path=%s", helper_path);
        return Status::unavailable;
    }
    hui::sys::log("elevation: helper opened");
    const int socket = sceNetSocket("sandbox_elevator", 2, 1, 6);
    if (socket < 0)
        hui::sys::log("elevation: socket create failed");
    else
        hui::sys::log("elevation: socket created");
    const auto result = socket < 0 ? Status::transport_error : submit(socket, helper, message);
    if (socket >= 0)
        (void)sceNetSocketClose(socket);
    (void)sceKernelClose(helper);
    hui::sys::log("elevation: request end status=%u", static_cast<unsigned>(result));
    return result;
}

#else
elevation::Status elevation::request(Capability,const char*) noexcept {return Status::unavailable;}
#endif
```

`native/title/elevation/helper/main.cpp`:

```cpp
/*
 * ps5-native-app-boilerplate - One-request elevation helper.
 * Copyright (C) 2026 BlackBearReloaded
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
 */
#include "../protocol.hpp"

#include <array>
#include <cstring>

extern "C"
{
#include <ps5/kernel.h>
#include <ps5/klog.h>
#include <ps5/payload.h>
#include <sys/socket.h>
#include <sys/time.h>
#include <unistd.h>
}

namespace
{
using elevation::Capability;
using elevation::Status;
using elevation::wire::Kind;
using elevation::wire::Message;

constexpr char target_title_id[] = "PPSA99386";
constexpr std::uint64_t system_auth_id = UINT64_C(0x4801000000000013);

struct AppInfo
{
    std::uint32_t app_id;
    std::uint64_t unknown1;
    char title_id[14];
    char unknown2[0x3c];
};
extern "C" int sceKernelGetAppInfo(pid_t pid, AppInfo *info);

struct Target
{
    std::intptr_t process = 0;
    std::intptr_t ucred = 0;
    std::intptr_t filedesc = 0;
};

struct State
{
    // uid, ruid, svuid, ngroups, rgid, svgid; the SDK's supported ucred layout.
    std::array<std::uint32_t, 6> identity{};
    std::uint64_t authority = 0;
    std::array<std::uint8_t, 16> caps{};
    std::array<std::uint8_t, 32> attrs{};
    std::intptr_t root = 0;
    std::intptr_t jail = 0;
    bool operator==(const State &) const = default;
};

bool kernel_pointer(std::intptr_t pointer) noexcept
{
    return (static_cast<std::uint64_t>(pointer) >> 48) == 0xffff;
}

bool find_target(std::uint32_t pid, Target &target) noexcept
{
    AppInfo info{};
    if (sceKernelGetAppInfo(static_cast<pid_t>(pid), &info) != 0 ||
        std::memcmp(info.title_id, target_title_id, sizeof(target_title_id)) != 0)
        return false;

    // Walk afresh instead of reusing the SDK's PID cache after the handshake.
    std::intptr_t process = 0;
    if (kernel_copyout(KERNEL_ADDRESS_ALLPROC, &process, sizeof(process)) != 0)
        return false;
    for (unsigned guard = 0; process != 0 && guard < 4096; ++guard)
    {
        std::uint32_t candidate = 0;
        if (!kernel_pointer(process) ||
            kernel_copyout(process + KERNEL_OFFSET_PROC_P_PID, &candidate, sizeof(candidate)) != 0)
            return false;
        if (candidate == pid)
        {
            target.process = process;
            return kernel_copyout(process + KERNEL_OFFSET_PROC_P_UCRED, &target.ucred,
                                  sizeof(target.ucred)) == 0 &&
                   kernel_copyout(process + KERNEL_OFFSET_PROC_P_FD, &target.filedesc,
                                  sizeof(target.filedesc)) == 0 &&
                   kernel_pointer(target.ucred) && kernel_pointer(target.filedesc);
        }
        if (kernel_copyout(process, &process, sizeof(process)) != 0)
            return false;
    }
    return false;
}

bool read_state(const Target &target, State &state) noexcept
{
    return kernel_copyout(target.ucred + KERNEL_OFFSET_UCRED_CR_UID, state.identity.data(),
                          sizeof(state.identity)) == 0 &&
           kernel_copyout(target.ucred + KERNEL_OFFSET_UCRED_CR_SCEAUTHID, &state.authority,
                          sizeof(state.authority)) == 0 &&
           kernel_copyout(target.ucred + KERNEL_OFFSET_UCRED_CR_SCECAPS, state.caps.data(),
                          state.caps.size()) == 0 &&
           kernel_copyout(target.ucred + KERNEL_OFFSET_UCRED_CR_SCEATTRS, state.attrs.data(),
                          state.attrs.size()) == 0 &&
           kernel_copyout(target.filedesc + KERNEL_OFFSET_FILEDESC_FD_RDIR, &state.root,
                          sizeof(state.root)) == 0 &&
           kernel_copyout(target.filedesc + KERNEL_OFFSET_FILEDESC_FD_JDIR, &state.jail,
                          sizeof(state.jail)) == 0;
}

bool write_state(const Target &target, const State &state) noexcept
{
    // Attempt every field, including during rollback after a partial write.
    int failures = 0;
    failures += kernel_copyin(state.identity.data(), target.ucred + KERNEL_OFFSET_UCRED_CR_UID,
                              sizeof(state.identity)) != 0;
    failures += kernel_copyin(&state.authority, target.ucred + KERNEL_OFFSET_UCRED_CR_SCEAUTHID,
                              sizeof(state.authority)) != 0;
    failures += kernel_copyin(state.caps.data(), target.ucred + KERNEL_OFFSET_UCRED_CR_SCECAPS,
                              state.caps.size()) != 0;
    failures += kernel_copyin(state.attrs.data(), target.ucred + KERNEL_OFFSET_UCRED_CR_SCEATTRS,
                              state.attrs.size()) != 0;
    failures += kernel_copyin(&state.root, target.filedesc + KERNEL_OFFSET_FILEDESC_FD_RDIR,
                              sizeof(state.root)) != 0;
    failures += kernel_copyin(&state.jail, target.filedesc + KERNEL_OFFSET_FILEDESC_FD_JDIR,
                              sizeof(state.jail)) != 0;
    return failures == 0;
}

Status grant_filesystem(const Target &target, const State &original) noexcept
{
    State desired = original;
    desired.root = kernel_get_root_vnode();
    if (!kernel_pointer(desired.root))
        return Status::unavailable;
    desired.jail = desired.root;
    desired.identity.fill(0);
    desired.authority = system_auth_id;
    desired.caps.fill(0xff);
    desired.attrs[3] |= 0x80;

    State verified{};
    if (write_state(target, desired) && read_state(target, verified) && verified == desired)
        return Status::ok;
    if (write_state(target, original) && read_state(target, verified) && verified == original)
        return Status::apply_failed;
    return Status::rollback_failed;
}

bool send_message(const Message &message) noexcept
{
    return elevation::wire::transfer(reinterpret_cast<const std::uint8_t *>(&message),
                                     sizeof(message), [](const auto *bytes, std::size_t size)
                                     { return write(STDOUT_FILENO, bytes, size); });
}

bool receive_message(Message &message) noexcept
{
    return elevation::wire::transfer(reinterpret_cast<std::uint8_t *>(&message), sizeof(message),
                                     [](auto *bytes, std::size_t size)
                                     { return read(STDIN_FILENO, bytes, size); });
}

Status handle_request(const Message &request) noexcept
{
    if (const auto error = elevation::wire::validate(request); error != Status::ok)
        return error;
    if (request.kind != Kind::request || request.status != Status::ok)
        return Status::invalid_request;
    const auto *args = payload_get_args();
    if (args == nullptr || args->kdata_base_addr == 0)
        return Status::unavailable;

    Target before{};
    State original{};
    if (!find_target(request.pid, before))
        return Status::target_mismatch;
    if (!read_state(before, original))
        return Status::unavailable;
    Message prepare = request;
    prepare.kind = Kind::prepare;
    Message prepared{};
    if (!send_message(prepare) || !receive_message(prepared))
        return Status::transport_error;
    if (!elevation::wire::matches(prepared, request, Kind::prepared))
        return Status::invalid_request;
    if (prepared.status != Status::ok)
        return Status::prepare_failed;

    Target target{};
    State cloned{};
    if (!find_target(request.pid, target) || target.process != before.process ||
        target.filedesc != before.filedesc)
        return Status::target_mismatch;
    // Never write into the preexisting, potentially shared credential. Do not
    // copy cr_prison or swap credential pointers ourselves.
    if (target.ucred == before.ucred || !read_state(target, cloned) || cloned != original)
        return Status::prepare_failed;

    switch (request.capability)
    {
    case Capability::filesystem:
        return grant_filesystem(target, original);
    default:
        return Status::unsupported_capability;
    }
}
} // namespace

int main()
{
    const timeval timeout{elevation::wire::io_timeout_us / 1'000'000,
                          elevation::wire::io_timeout_us % 1'000'000};
    if (setsockopt(STDIN_FILENO, SOL_SOCKET, SO_RCVTIMEO, &timeout, sizeof(timeout)) != 0 ||
        setsockopt(STDOUT_FILENO, SOL_SOCKET, SO_SNDTIMEO, &timeout, sizeof(timeout)) != 0)
        return 1;
    Message request{};
    if (!receive_message(request))
        return 1;
    const auto result = handle_request(request);
    Message response{};
    response.kind = Kind::response;
    response.capability = request.capability;
    response.pid = request.pid;
    response.status = result;
    klog_printf("[sandbox-elevator] fw=%08x pid=%u capability=%u result=%u\n",
                kernel_get_fw_version(), request.pid, static_cast<unsigned>(request.capability),
                static_cast<unsigned>(result));
    return send_message(response) && result == Status::ok ? 0 : 1;
}
```

`native/title/elevation/one_shot_install.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// Bounded one-shot self-install of NiakPS5's OWN bundled PLDmgr ELF.
// The GUI remains sandboxed if the existing local elfldr cannot elevate it.
#include "one_shot_install.hpp"
#include "elevation.hpp"
#include <cerrno>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <cstdint>
#include <string>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>

#if defined(__PROSPERO__)
namespace {
constexpr const char *kSlot="/data/pldmgr/payloads/niakps5";
constexpr const char *kSource="/app0/tools/niakps5/niakps5.elf";
constexpr const char *kSourceJson="/app0/tools/niakps5/niakps5.elf.json";
constexpr const char *kDestination="/data/pldmgr/payloads/niakps5/niakps5.elf";
constexpr const char *kDestinationJson="/data/pldmgr/payloads/niakps5/niakps5.elf.json";
constexpr const char *kAutoload="/data/pldmgr/autoload.txt";

bool regular(const char *path,std::size_t cap,std::size_t *size=nullptr) {
    struct stat st{};
    if(lstat(path,&st)!=0 || !S_ISREG(st.st_mode) ||
       st.st_size<=0 || std::uint64_t(st.st_size)>cap)return false;
    if(size)*size=static_cast<std::size_t>(st.st_size);
    return true;
}
bool same_file(const char *source,const char *target) {
    std::size_t a=0,b=0;
    if(!regular(source,20u*1024u*1024u,&a) ||
       !regular(target,20u*1024u*1024u,&b) || a!=b)return false;
    FILE *left=std::fopen(source,"rb"),*right=std::fopen(target,"rb");
    if(!left||!right) {
        if(left)std::fclose(left);
        if(right)std::fclose(right);
        return false;
    }
    char x[8192],y[8192];bool equal=true;
    std::size_t remaining=a;
    while(remaining) {
        const std::size_t n=remaining<sizeof(x)?remaining:sizeof(x);
        if(std::fread(x,1,n,left)!=n || std::fread(y,1,n,right)!=n ||
           std::memcmp(x,y,n)!=0){equal=false;break;}
        remaining-=n;
    }
    std::fclose(left);std::fclose(right);
    return equal;
}
bool atomic_copy(const char *source,const char *target,int mode) {
    std::size_t size=0;
    if(!regular(source,20u*1024u*1024u,&size))return false;
    FILE *in=std::fopen(source,"rb");
    if(!in)return false;
    char temp[192];
    const int n=std::snprintf(temp,sizeof(temp),"%s/.niak-install-XXXXXX",kSlot);
    if(n<1 || n>=int(sizeof(temp))){std::fclose(in);return false;}
    const int fd=mkstemp(temp);
    if(fd<0){std::fclose(in);return false;}
    bool ok=true;char buffer[8192];std::size_t left=size;
    while(ok&&left) {
        const std::size_t bytes=left<sizeof(buffer)?left:sizeof(buffer);
        if(std::fread(buffer,1,bytes,in)!=bytes){ok=false;break;}
        std::size_t offset=0;
        while(offset<bytes) {
            const ssize_t wrote=write(fd,buffer+offset,bytes-offset);
            if(wrote<0&&errno==EINTR)continue;
            if(wrote<=0){ok=false;break;}
            offset+=static_cast<std::size_t>(wrote);
        }
        left-=bytes;
    }
    if(std::fclose(in)!=0)ok=false;
    if(ok && (fchmod(fd,mode)!=0 || fsync(fd)!=0))ok=false;
    if(close(fd)!=0)ok=false;
    if(ok)ok=rename(temp,target)==0;
    if(!ok)unlink(temp);
    return ok;
}
bool validate_bundle() {
    std::size_t size=0;
    if(!regular(kSource,20u*1024u*1024u,&size) || size<1024 ||
       !regular(kSourceJson,32768))return false;
    FILE *elf=std::fopen(kSource,"rb");
    if(!elf)return false;
    unsigned char magic[5]={};
    const bool correct=std::fread(magic,1,sizeof(magic),elf)==sizeof(magic) &&
        magic[0]==0x7f && magic[1]=='E' && magic[2]=='L' &&
        magic[3]=='F' && magic[4]==2;
    std::fclose(elf);
    return correct;
}
bool has_autoload_entry(const std::string &text) {
    std::size_t start=0;
    while(start<text.size()) {
        const auto end=text.find('\n',start);
        const auto size=(end==std::string::npos?text.size():end)-start;
        std::string line=text.substr(start,size);
        while(!line.empty()&&(line.back()=='\r'||line.back()==' '))line.pop_back();
        const auto first=line.find_first_not_of(" \t");
        if(first!=std::string::npos)line.erase(0,first);
        if(line=="niakps5.elf" || line==kDestination)return true;
        if(end==std::string::npos)break;
        start=end+1;
    }
    return false;
}
// Strict read-only check: the FTP installer owns PLDmgr configuration.
// A GUI launch, including one with temporary filesystem privilege, must
// NEVER rewrite the user's existing autoload list or silently append itself.
bool configure_autoload() {
    struct stat st{};
    if(lstat(kAutoload,&st)!=0 || !S_ISREG(st.st_mode) ||
       st.st_size<0 || st.st_size>3500)return false;
    FILE *in=std::fopen(kAutoload,"rb");
    if(!in)return false;
    std::string config;
    char buffer[1024];std::size_t n=0;
    while((n=std::fread(buffer,1,sizeof(buffer),in))>0)
        config.append(buffer,n);
    const int read_error=std::ferror(in);
    std::fclose(in);
    // No fallback creation: report pending PLDmgr setup and keep UI alive.
    return !read_error && config.find('\0')==std::string::npos &&
           has_autoload_entry(config);
}

} // namespace
#endif

int niak::bootstrap_own_payload() noexcept {
#if defined(__PROSPERO__)
    if(!validate_bundle())return -2;
    // Mirror Encore's one-shot safety contract: a failed helper must never
    // leave this long-lived graphical process with partly changed credentials.
    // On an ambiguous rollback, terminating is safer than continuing in UI.
    const uid_t uid_before=getuid(),euid_before=geteuid();
    const gid_t gid_before=getgid(),egid_before=getegid();
    const elevation::Status granted=
        elevation::request(elevation::Capability::filesystem);
    // The helper grants its capability to this graphical process; it does
    // not automatically restore the original PS5 sandbox credentials.
    // Expose the fact to the CDN diagnostic without logging user identity.
    niak::payload_process_elevated=(granted==elevation::Status::ok);
    const bool changed_on_failure=granted!=elevation::Status::ok &&
        (getuid()!=uid_before || geteuid()!=euid_before ||
         getgid()!=gid_before || getegid()!=egid_before);
    if(granted==elevation::Status::rollback_failed || changed_on_failure)
        std::_Exit(125);
    if(granted!=elevation::Status::ok)return -1;
    // Grant is not enough: prove that the specific managed destination exists
    // and perform only fixed-path own-slot atomic writes. No arbitrary paths.
    struct stat st{};
    if(lstat("/data/pldmgr/payloads",&st)!=0 || !S_ISDIR(st.st_mode))
        return -2;
    if(mkdir(kSlot,0755)!=0 && errno!=EEXIST)return -2;
    if(lstat(kSlot,&st)!=0 || !S_ISDIR(st.st_mode))return -2;
    const bool elf_current=same_file(kSource,kDestination);
    const bool json_current=same_file(kSourceJson,kDestinationJson);
    if(!elf_current && !atomic_copy(kSource,kDestination,0755))return -2;
    if(!json_current && !atomic_copy(kSourceJson,kDestinationJson,0644))return -2;
    if(!configure_autoload())return -2;
    return (elf_current && json_current)?0:1;
#else
    return -1;  // Host preview cannot elevate or modify host folders.
#endif
}
```

```hpp
// Status of the one-shot install attempt in this running GUI process.
```

`native/title/elevation/protocol.hpp`:

```hpp
/*
 * ps5-native-app-boilerplate - Versioned elfldr elevation messages.
 * Copyright (C) 2026 BlackBearReloaded
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
 */
#pragma once

#include <bit>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>

namespace elevation
{
enum class Capability : std::uint32_t
{
    filesystem = 1,
};

enum class Status : std::uint32_t
{
    ok = 0,
    invalid_request = 1,
    unsupported_version = 2,
    unsupported_capability = 3,
    target_mismatch = 4,
    unavailable = 5,
    prepare_failed = 6,
    apply_failed = 7,
    rollback_failed = 8,
    transport_error = 9,
    protocol_error = 10,
};

namespace wire
{
// Build-time tuning for slower consoles; both endpoints use the same timeout.
inline constexpr int io_timeout_us = 5'000'000;

enum class Kind : std::uint32_t
{
    request = 1,
    prepare = 2,
    prepared = 3,
    response = 4,
};

// Fixed-width little-endian ABI. No pointers, offsets, or privilege masks cross the socket.
struct Message
{
    std::uint32_t magic = 0x31564c45; // "ELV1"
    std::uint16_t version = 1;
    std::uint16_t size = 24;
    Kind kind = Kind::request;
    Capability capability = Capability::filesystem;
    std::uint32_t pid = 0;
    Status status = Status::ok;
};
static_assert(sizeof(Message) == 24);
static_assert(std::endian::native == std::endian::little);

constexpr Status validate(const Message &message) noexcept
{
    if (message.magic != Message{}.magic || message.size != sizeof(Message))
        return Status::invalid_request;
    if (message.version != Message{}.version)
        return Status::unsupported_version;
    if (message.kind < Kind::request || message.kind > Kind::response || message.pid == 0 ||
        message.pid > INT32_MAX || message.status > Status::protocol_error)
        return Status::invalid_request;
    if (message.capability != Capability::filesystem)
        return Status::unsupported_capability;
    return Status::ok;
}

constexpr bool matches(const Message &message, const Message &request, Kind kind) noexcept
{
    return validate(message) == Status::ok && message.kind == kind && message.pid == request.pid &&
           message.capability == request.capability;
}

// Both transports use this loop: TCP can split even a 24-byte frame. A timeout,
// interruption, EOF, or failed operation ends this attempt; there is no retry loop.
template <typename Byte, typename Operation>
bool transfer(Byte *bytes, std::size_t size, Operation operation) noexcept
{
    while (size != 0)
    {
        const auto count = operation(bytes, size);
        if (count <= 0 || static_cast<std::size_t>(count) > size)
            return false;
        bytes += count;
        size -= static_cast<std::size_t>(count);
    }
    return true;
}
} // namespace wire
} // namespace elevation
```

`native/title/fetch_daily_games.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""PS5-only daily wallpaper *build snapshot* from public PS Store title data.

The package rotates the results by local day without contacting an external
service from the console. New PlayStation media is fetched on CI rebuilds only.
Images are resized and stored as native-decodable WebP at quality 80.
"""
from datetime import date,datetime,timedelta
from io import BytesIO
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urlparse
from urllib.request import Request,urlopen
import argparse,json,sys

SOURCE="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sharpemu/sharpemu-site/main/src/data/games.json"
ALLOWED_IMAGE_HOST="image.api.playstation.com"
MAX_FEED=5*1024*1024
MAX_IMAGE=7*1024*1024
MAX_WALLS=14
def get(url,limit,hosts):
    parsed=urlparse(url)
    if parsed.scheme!="https" or parsed.hostname not in hosts:
        raise ValueError("Image/data host is not allowlisted")
    req=Request(url,headers={"User-Agent":"NiakPS5-PS5-Daily-Wallpaper/1.0"})
    with urlopen(req,timeout=18) as resp:
        result=resp.read(limit+1)
    if not result or len(result)>limit:raise ValueError("Resource too large")
    return result

def released(value,today):
    try:
        when=datetime.fromisoformat(value.replace("Z","+00:00")).date()
    except (TypeError,AttributeError,ValueError):
        return None
    if not today-timedelta(days=455)<=when<=today:return None
    return when

def candidates(feed,today):
    # PlayStation PS5 dataset only. Filter preorders, duplicates, missing art,
    # adult-themed names and non-game services. Source isn't a rating provider.
    deny=("hentai","porn","sex ", "erotic","casino","gambling","adult only")
    seen=set()
    hits=[]
    for item in feed:
        name=str(item.get("name") or "")
        ident=item.get("conceptId")
        cover=str(item.get("cover") or "")
        day=released(item.get("releaseDate"),today)
        if not name or not day or not cover or ident in seen:continue
        if any(word in name.casefold() for word in deny):continue
        if urlparse(cover).hostname != ALLOWED_IMAGE_HOST:continue
        if not str(item.get("titleId","")).startswith("PPSA"):continue
        if not item.get("enriched"):continue
        genres=item.get("genres") or []
        if "Adult" in genres:continue
        seen.add(ident)
        hits.append((day,name,ident,cover))
    hits.sort(key=lambda e:(-e[0].toordinal(),e[1].casefold()))
    return hits

def build(folder,now=None,limit=MAX_WALLS):
    from PIL import Image,ImageFilter,ImageOps
    folder.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    today=now or date.today()
    feed=json.loads(get(SOURCE,MAX_FEED,{"raw.githubusercontent.com"}))
    records=[]
    for day,name,ident,cover in candidates(feed,today)[:85]:
        if len(records)>=limit:break
        try:
            raw=get(cover,MAX_IMAGE,{ALLOWED_IMAGE_HOST})
            with Image.open(BytesIO(raw)) as im:
                im.load()
                if im.width<300 or im.height<250 or im.width*im.height>12_000_000:
                    continue
                rgb=im.convert("RGB")
                if rgb.width/rgb.height>=1.6:
                    visual=ImageOps.fit(rgb,(1280,720),method=Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
                else:
                    # Square cover art is not stretched: blurred page-wide
                    # backdrop plus accurately proportioned central art.
                    visual=ImageOps.fit(rgb,(1280,720),method=Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
                    visual=visual.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(radius=27))
                    foreground=rgb.copy()
                    foreground.thumbnail((510,670),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
                    visual.paste(foreground,((1280-foreground.width)//2,
                                              (720-foreground.height)//2))
                # Native PS5 build now links libwebp. Keep colours in RGB.
                output=folder/f"wall-{len(records):02d}.webp"
                visual.save(output,format="WEBP",quality=80,method=6)
            records.append({"game":name,"date":day.isoformat(),"conceptId":ident,
                            "source":cover,"file":output.name,
                            "bytes":output.stat().st_size})
        except (OSError,ValueError,TimeoutError,KeyError) as exc:
            print("Skipped artwork:",name,type(exc).__name__,file=sys.stderr)
    # Remove previous unused files so art count can't lag after a rebuild.
    keep={item["file"] for item in records}
    for pattern in ("wall-*.png","wall-*.webp"):
        for path in folder.glob(pattern):
            if path.name not in keep:path.unlink()
    manifest={"source":"PlayStation 5 media, sharpemu public title catalogue",
              "generated":today.isoformat(),"games":records}
    (folder/"index.json").write_text(json.dumps(manifest,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),"utf8")
    # The native PS5 app uses a compact local text manifest for provenance;
    # no live JSON parsing or network request on the rendering thread.
    (folder/"labels.tsv").write_text(
        "".join(f"{r['file']}\t{r['game'].replace(chr(9),' ').replace(chr(10),' ')[:110]}\t{r['date']}\n"
                for r in records),"utf8")
    print("PS5 backgrounds",len(records),"quality-80 WebP files",
          sum(x["bytes"] for x in records),"bytes")
    return len(records)

if __name__=="__main__":
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--output",type=Path,required=True)
    args=parser.parse_args()
    try:
        build(args.output)
    except Exception as error:
        # Preserve the animated smoke if network fetching is unavailable.
        print("PlayStation images unavailable; preserve smoke:",error,file=sys.stderr)
        args.output.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
        (args.output/"index.json").write_text('{"source":"offline","games":[]}')
        (args.output/"labels.tsv").write_text("")
```
