```cpp
namespace {
constexpr std::size_t kMaximumPng = 4U * 1024U * 1024U;
// Library tiles are ~200 px wide. 256 px icon textures save 75% of the
// RGBA8 GPU memory per installed title compared with the old 512 px cache.
constexpr int kTarget = 256;
NiakIconEndpointPolicy icon_endpoint;
std::uint64_t endpoint_now_ms() {
    using namespace std::chrono;
    return static_cast<std::uint64_t>(
        duration_cast<milliseconds>(steady_clock::now().time_since_epoch()).count());
}
bool download(const std::string &uri, std::vector<unsigned char> &out)
{
    if(!icon_endpoint.allowed(endpoint_now_ms()))return false;
    // Whole-operation deadline: a slow local HTTP response must not hold
    // the renderer thread indefinitely by trickling one fragment at a time.
    const auto deadline=std::chrono::steady_clock::now()+
                        std::chrono::milliseconds(220);
    int sock = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_STREAM, 0);
    if (sock < 0) {
        icon_endpoint.transport_failed(endpoint_now_ms());
        return false;
    }
    // ShadowMountPlus may close its HTTP socket while assets are loading;
    // do not let SIGPIPE kill the entire native title.
    niak_socket_guard(sock);
    // Socket timeouts are individual limits, not the overall deadline.
    timeval timeout{0, 100000};
    setsockopt(sock, SOL_SOCKET, SO_RCVTIMEO, &timeout, sizeof(timeout));
    setsockopt(sock, SOL_SOCKET, SO_SNDTIMEO, &timeout, sizeof(timeout));
    sockaddr_in address{};
    address.sin_family = AF_INET;
    address.sin_port = htons(10101);
    address.sin_addr.s_addr = htonl(0x7f000001u);
    if (niak_connect_bounded(sock, reinterpret_cast<sockaddr *>(&address), sizeof(address), 75) < 0)
    {
        close(sock);
        icon_endpoint.transport_failed(endpoint_now_ms());
        return false;
    }
    const std::string request =
        "GET " + uri + " HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: 127.0.0.1\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n";
    std::size_t sent = 0;
    while (sent < request.size())
    {
        if(std::chrono::steady_clock::now()>=deadline) {
            close(sock);icon_endpoint.transport_failed(endpoint_now_ms());return false;
        }
        const ssize_t n = niak_socket_send(sock, request.data() + sent, request.size() - sent);
        if (n <= 0) { close(sock); icon_endpoint.transport_failed(endpoint_now_ms()); return false; }
        sent += static_cast<std::size_t>(n);
    }
    std::vector<unsigned char> response;
    response.reserve(256*1024);
    // The framing parser rechecks buffered bytes as fragments arrive.
    // Read in 64 KiB slabs rather than 8 KiB to reduce repeated scans
    // and receive syscalls for multi-megabyte PNGs (same bounded total size).
    std::array<unsigned char,65536> buffer{};
    // Complete Content-Length and chunked bodies without waiting for EOF:
    // the local API may legitimately keep its HTTP connection open.
    while(response.size()<kMaximumPng+8192+256*1024) {
        const auto remaining=std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::microseconds>(
            deadline-std::chrono::steady_clock::now()).count();
        if(remaining<=0) {icon_endpoint.transport_failed(endpoint_now_ms());break;}
        const auto wait_us=std::min<std::int64_t>(remaining,100000);
        timeval recv_timeout{0,static_cast<suseconds_t>(std::max<std::int64_t>(wait_us,1000))};
        (void)setsockopt(sock,SOL_SOCKET,SO_RCVTIMEO,&recv_timeout,sizeof(recv_timeout));
        const ssize_t count=recv(sock,buffer.data(),buffer.size(),0);
        if(count>0) {
            response.insert(response.end(),buffer.begin(),buffer.begin()+count);
            // 404 is a complete and valid refusal for THIS icon, not an
            // endpoint failure. A 200 header alone is not enough: a server
            // can stall before delivering any body data.
            const auto reply=niak_icon_reply(response.data(),response.size());
            if(reply==NiakIconReply::OtherStatus) {
                icon_endpoint.responded();
                close(sock);
                return false;
            }
            if(reply==NiakIconReply::Invalid)break;
            const auto state=niak_http_icon_body(response,false,kMaximumPng,out);
            if(state==NiakHttpState::Complete) {
                icon_endpoint.responded();
                close(sock);
                return out.size()>=24 && out.size()<=kMaximumPng;
            }
            if(state==NiakHttpState::Invalid)break;
            continue;
        }
        if(count==0) {
            const auto state=niak_http_icon_body(response,true,kMaximumPng,out);
            if(state==NiakHttpState::Complete)icon_endpoint.responded();
            else icon_endpoint.transport_failed(endpoint_now_ms());
            close(sock);
            return state==NiakHttpState::Complete &&
                   out.size()>=24 && out.size()<=kMaximumPng;
        }
        icon_endpoint.transport_failed(endpoint_now_ms());
        break;
    }
    close(sock);
    return false;
}
unsigned size32(const unsigned char *bytes)
{
    return (static_cast<unsigned>(bytes[0])<<24) |
           (static_cast<unsigned>(bytes[1])<<16) |
           (static_cast<unsigned>(bytes[2])<<8) |
           static_cast<unsigned>(bytes[3]);
}
bool read_local_png(const char *path,std::vector<unsigned char> &png) {
    std::FILE *fp=std::fopen(path,"rb");
    if(!fp)return false;
    if(std::fseek(fp,0,SEEK_END)!=0){std::fclose(fp);return false;}
    const long length=std::ftell(fp);
    if(length<33||length>long(kMaximumPng)||std::fseek(fp,0,SEEK_SET)!=0) {
        std::fclose(fp);return false;
    }
    png.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(length));
    const bool ok=std::fread(png.data(),1,png.size(),fp)==png.size();
    std::fclose(fp);return ok;
}
// Verified installed PNG and modern quality-80 WebP, bounded before allocation.
// Inspect scene geometry before decoding potentially large source images.
// An icon, portrait or square cover must not consume 16 MiB of RGBA
// allocation only to be rejected as a background after decompression.
bool valid_scene_dimensions(unsigned width,unsigned height) {
    return width>=512 && height>=256 &&
           width<=2048 && height<=1536 &&
           std::uint64_t(width)*10u>=std::uint64_t(height)*13u &&
           std::uint64_t(width)*2u<=std::uint64_t(height)*5u;
}
bool decode_installed_art(const std::vector<unsigned char> &bytes,
                          std::vector<unsigned char> &rgba,
                          unsigned &w,unsigned &h,
                          bool landscape_scene=false)
{
    if(bytes.size()<24||bytes.size()>kMaximumPng)return false;
    const bool webp=std::memcmp(bytes.data(),"RIFF",4)==0 &&
                    std::memcmp(bytes.data()+8,"WEBP",4)==0;
    if(webp) {
#if defined(__PROSPERO__)
        int iw=0,ih=0;
        if(!WebPGetInfo(bytes.data(),bytes.size(),&iw,&ih)||
           iw<32||ih<32||iw>2048||ih>2048)return false;
        w=unsigned(iw);h=unsigned(ih);
        if(landscape_scene && !valid_scene_dimensions(w,h))return false;
        rgba.resize(std::size_t(w)*h*4u);
        return WebPDecodeRGBAInto(bytes.data(),bytes.size(),rgba.data(),
                                  rgba.size(),int(w*4u))!=nullptr;
#else
        return false;
#endif
    }
    static const unsigned char signature[8]={137,80,78,71,13,10,26,10};
    if(std::memcmp(bytes.data(),signature,8)!=0)return false;
    const unsigned iw=size32(bytes.data()+16),ih=size32(bytes.data()+20);
    if(iw<32||ih<32||iw>2048||ih>2048)return false;
    if(landscape_scene && !valid_scene_dimensions(iw,ih))return false;
    if(lodepng::decode(rgba,w,h,bytes)!=0||w!=iw||h!=ih)return false;
    return rgba.size()==std::size_t(w)*h*4u;
}
// CPU-only and reentrant: usable by the HTTP worker or by the local-art
// reader. Network completions carry only 256x256 RGBA, never compressed
// multi-megabyte input or large decoded 2048x2048 image buffers.
bool decode_icon_thumbnail(const std::vector<unsigned char> &image,
                           std::vector<unsigned char> &scaled)
{
    std::vector<unsigned char> rgba;
    unsigned w=0,h=0;
    if(!decode_installed_art(image,rgba,w,h))return false;
    if(w==kTarget && h==kTarget) {
        scaled=std::move(rgba);
        return true;
    }
    scaled.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(kTarget)*kTarget*4u);
    for(int y=0;y<kTarget;++y) {
        const unsigned sy=std::min(h-1,static_cast<unsigned>(
            (static_cast<std::uint64_t>(y)*h)/kTarget));
        for(int x=0;x<kTarget;++x) {
            const unsigned sx=std::min(w-1,static_cast<unsigned>(
                (static_cast<std::uint64_t>(x)*w)/kTarget));
            const std::size_t a=(static_cast<std::size_t>(sy)*w+sx)*4u;
            const std::size_t b=(static_cast<std::size_t>(y)*kTarget+x)*4u;
            for(int c=0;c<4;++c)scaled[b+c]=rgba[a+c];
        }
    }
    return true;
}
std::uint32_t decode_upload(hui::gfx::Renderer &renderer,
                             const std::vector<unsigned char> &image)
{
    // Locally installed artwork still uses this synchronous path; only
    // network icons are decoded and resized by the dedicated HTTP worker.
    std::vector<unsigned char> pixels;
    if(!decode_icon_thumbnail(image,pixels))return 0;
    return renderer.create_texture(kTarget,kTarget,pixels.data());
}
// Preserve installed-art priority on BOTH PS5 and host. Only the worker
// opens local files on PS5; the host preview retains its existing eager path.
constexpr const char *kInstalledIconPaths[] = {
        "/app0/assets/niak-installed/%s-icon.webp",
        "/data/homebrew/PPSA99386/assets/niak-installed/%s-icon.webp",
        "/app0/assets/niak-installed/%s-icon.png",
        "/data/homebrew/PPSA99386/assets/niak-installed/%s-icon.png",
        "/data/homebrew/%s/sce_sys/icon0.png",
        "/user/app/%s/sce_sys/icon0.png",
        "/user/appmeta/%s/icon0.png",
        "/system_ex/app/%s/sce_sys/icon0.png",
        "/mnt/ext0/user/app/%s/sce_sys/icon0.png",
        "/mnt/ext1/user/app/%s/sce_sys/icon0.png",
        "/mnt/ext0/user/appmeta/%s/icon0.png",
        "/mnt/ext1/user/appmeta/%s/icon0.png"};
bool load_installed_icon_pixels(const char *id,
                                std::vector<unsigned char> &pixels) {
    for(const char *format : kInstalledIconPaths) {
        char path[160]{};
        const int n=std::snprintf(path,sizeof(path),format,id);
        if(n<=0 || n>=int(sizeof(path)))continue;
        std::vector<unsigned char> encoded;
        if(read_local_png(path,encoded) &&
           decode_icon_thumbnail(encoded,pixels))return true;
    }
    return false;
}
// One background reader for missing installed icons. The GPU renderer never
// calls a socket API: it only consumes a completed byte vector. One completion
// slot applies backpressure (one 256x256 RGBA buffer: 256 KiB).
// This process-lifetime object is intentional: the detached reader must not
// reference destroyed static mutexes or catalogue-owned Item pointers.
#if defined(__PROSPERO__)
struct AsyncIconDownloads {
    std::mutex mutex;
    std::condition_variable wake;
    std::deque<std::string> queue;
    std::unordered_set<std::string> seen;
    std::string completed_title;
    std::vector<unsigned char> completed_pixels;
    bool completed=false;
    bool started=false;
};
AsyncIconDownloads &async_icons() {
    static auto *state=new AsyncIconDownloads;
    return *state;
}
void icon_reader_worker() {
    auto &state=async_icons();
    for(;;) {
        std::string id;
        {
            std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lock(state.mutex);
            state.wake.wait(lock,[&] {
                return !state.completed && !state.queue.empty();
            });
            id=std::move(state.queue.front());
            state.queue.pop_front();
        }
        // Installed art is authoritative. Reading, PNG/WebP decoding and
        // downsampling all happen here, never on the PS5 render thread.
        std::vector<unsigned char> pixels;
        if(!load_installed_icon_pixels(id.c_str(),pixels)) {
            std::vector<unsigned char> bytes;
            const std::string url="/api/v1/games/icon?title_id="+id;
            bool complete=download(url,bytes);
            // A 404 applies only to the full-size image. Do not repeat a
            // failed transport request for its thumbnail.
            if(!complete && !icon_endpoint.consecutive_failures) {
                bytes.clear();
                complete=download(url+"&size=thumb",bytes);
            }
            if(!complete || !decode_icon_thumbnail(bytes,pixels)) {
                // Temporary outage, denied media or corrupt response:
                // allow the throttled idle retry to revisit this title.
                std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(state.mutex);
                state.seen.erase(id);
                continue;
            }
        }
        {
            std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(state.mutex);
            state.completed_title=std::move(id);
            state.completed_pixels=std::move(pixels);
            state.completed=true;
        }
        // The reader cannot get ahead of the renderer and accumulate raw
        // HTTP responses. The next tick consumes this one on the GL thread.
    }
}
void request_missing_icon(const char *id) {
    auto &state=async_icons();
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(state.mutex);
    // "seen" tracks QUEUED/in-flight/unconsumed responses, not permanent
    // success or failure. Cleared at worker failure or renderer consumption.
    if(state.seen.size()>=4096 || !state.seen.emplace(id).second)return;
    state.queue.emplace_back(id);
    if(!state.started) {
        state.started=true;
        std::thread([] {icon_reader_worker();}).detach();
    }
    state.wake.notify_one();
}
// This SECOND bounded CPU worker is dedicated to installed pic1 / scene art.
// It never touches OpenGL, remote services or catalogue-owned Item pointers.
// Results are one 768x320..560 RGBA buffer (~1.7 MiB maximum) pending upload.
struct AsyncCaseBackground {
    std::mutex mutex;
    std::condition_variable wake;
    std::deque<std::string> queue;
    std::unordered_set<std::string> queued;
    // Every focus change supersedes ALL earlier scene work, including an
    // in-flight decode. No stale artwork may monopolize the next GPU upload.
    std::uint64_t generation=0;
    std::string latest_title;
    std::string completed_title;
    std::vector<unsigned char> completed_pixels;
    unsigned completed_width=0,completed_height=0;
    bool completed=false,started=false;
};
AsyncCaseBackground &case_background_state() {
    static auto *state=new AsyncCaseBackground;
    return *state;
}
void case_background_worker() {
    auto &state=case_background_state();
    for(;;) {
        std::string id;
        std::uint64_t generation=0;
        {
            std::unique_lock<std::mutex> lock(state.mutex);
            state.wake.wait(lock,[&] {
                return !state.completed && !state.queue.empty();
            });
            id=std::move(state.queue.front());
            state.queue.pop_front();
            generation=state.generation;
        }
        std::vector<unsigned char> pixels;
        unsigned target_w=0,target_h=0;
        // Priority matches the production path: WebP cache, installed
        // scene, then pic1.png on internal and external storage.
        for(const char *format : {
            "/app0/assets/niak-installed/%s-scene.webp",
            "/data/homebrew/PPSA99386/assets/niak-installed/%s-scene.webp",
            "/app0/assets/niak-installed/%s-scene.png",
            "/data/homebrew/PPSA99386/assets/niak-installed/%s-scene.png",
            "/data/homebrew/%s/sce_sys/pic1.png",
            "/user/app/%s/sce_sys/pic1.png",
            "/user/appmeta/%s/pic1.png",
            "/system_ex/app/%s/sce_sys/pic1.png",
            "/mnt/ext0/user/app/%s/sce_sys/pic1.png",
            "/mnt/ext1/user/app/%s/sce_sys/pic1.png"
        }) {
            char path[200]{};
            const int n=std::snprintf(path,sizeof(path),format,id.c_str());
            if(n<=0 || n>=int(sizeof(path)))continue;
            std::vector<unsigned char> image,rgba;
            unsigned width=0,height=0;
            if(!read_local_png(path,image))continue;
            if(!decode_installed_art(image,rgba,width,height,true))continue;
            target_w=768;
            target_h=std::max(320u,std::min(560u,
                unsigned((std::uint64_t(target_w)*height)/width)));
            pixels.resize(std::size_t(target_w)*target_h*4u);
            for(unsigned y=0;y<target_h;++y) {
                const unsigned sy=std::min(height-1,unsigned(
                    (std::uint64_t(y)*height)/target_h));
                for(unsigned x=0;x<target_w;++x) {
                    const unsigned sx=std::min(width-1,unsigned(
                        (std::uint64_t(x)*width)/target_w));
                    const auto src=(std::size_t(sy)*width+sx)*4u;
                    const auto dst=(std::size_t(y)*target_w+x)*4u;
                    for(int k=0;k<4;++k)pixels[dst+k]=rgba[src+k];
                }
            }
            break;
        }
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(state.mutex);
        // A user can select many games while one big PNG is decoding.
        // Discard superseded results without modifying queued work for the
        // latest selection, even if the old and new title IDs are equal.
        if(generation!=state.generation || id!=state.latest_title)
            continue;
        if(pixels.empty()) {
            state.queued.erase(id);
            continue;
        }
        state.completed_title=std::move(id);
        state.completed_width=target_w;
        state.completed_height=target_h;
        state.completed_pixels=std::move(pixels);
        state.completed=true;
    }
}
void enqueue_missing_scene(const char *id) {
    auto &state=case_background_state();
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(state.mutex);
    // There is only one selected 3D case. Older queued requests are not
    // useful; clear them and invalidate a previous completed buffer.
    if(state.latest_title!=id) {
        state.latest_title=id;
        ++state.generation;
        state.queue.clear();
        state.queued.clear();
        state.completed=false;
        state.completed_title.clear();
        state.completed_pixels.clear();
    }
    // Deduplicate a pending/in-flight/completed request for this title.
    if(state.queued.size()>=1 || !state.queued.emplace(id).second)return;
    state.queue.emplace_back(id);
    if(!state.started) {
        state.started=true;
        std::thread([] {case_background_worker();}).detach();
    }
    state.wake.notify_one();
}
#endif
} // namespace

std::uint32_t niak_load_game_icon(hui::gfx::Renderer &renderer, const char *id)
{
    // Media applications may use NPXSxxxxx, unlike regular PPSA/CUSA games.
    bool media=id && std::strlen(id)==9 &&
               std::strncmp(id,"NPXS",4)==0;
    if(media)for(int i=4;i<9;++i)
        if(id[i]<'0'||id[i]>'9')media=false;
    if(!niak_valid_title_id(id) && !media)return 0;
#if defined(__PROSPERO__)
    // No local disk access, decompression, HTTP or GPU upload during initial
    // shelf streaming. The sole CPU worker tries installed art before HTTP.
    request_missing_icon(id);
    return 0;
#else
    std::vector<unsigned char> png;
#if defined(__linux__)
    // Host-only art is original QA artwork; not packaged or consulted on PS5.
    if(const char *fixtures=std::getenv("NIAK_CASE_PREVIEW_MEDIA")) {
        if(fixtures[0]) {
            char path[480]{};
            std::snprintf(path,sizeof(path),"%s/%s-icon.png",fixtures,id);
            if(read_local_png(path,png))
                if(const auto handle=decode_upload(renderer,png))return handle;
        }
    }
#endif
    // Try the actual installed icon first. This also works for homebrews
    // when ShadowMountPlus does not expose their icon endpoint.
    for(const char *format : kInstalledIconPaths) {
        char path[160]{};
        std::snprintf(path,sizeof(path),format,id);
        png.clear();
        if(read_local_png(path,png))
            if(const auto handle=decode_upload(renderer,png)) return handle;
    }
    png.clear();
    const std::string url=std::string("/api/v1/games/icon?title_id=")+id;
    if(download(url,png)) {
        if(const auto texture=decode_upload(renderer,png))return texture;
    }
    if(!icon_endpoint.consecutive_failures) {
        png.clear();
        if(download(url+"&size=thumb",png))
            return decode_upload(renderer,png);
    }
#endif
    return 0;
}

void niak_request_missing_game_icon(const char *id) {
#if defined(__PROSPERO__)
    if(!id || !*id || std::strlen(id)>=16)return;
    bool media=std::strlen(id)==9 && std::strncmp(id,"NPXS",4)==0;
    if(media)for(int i=4;i<9;++i)
        if(id[i]<'0'||id[i]>'9')media=false;
    if(!niak_valid_title_id(id) && !media)return;
    // Pure queue management; no filesystem read, socket call or GPU upload.
    request_missing_icon(id);
#else
    (void)id;
#endif
}

std::uint32_t niak_take_downloaded_game_icon(hui::gfx::Renderer &renderer,
                                             char (&title_id)[16]) {
    title_id[0]=0;
#if defined(__PROSPERO__)
    auto &state=async_icons();
    std::string id;
    std::vector<unsigned char> bytes;
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(state.mutex);
        if(!state.completed)return 0;
        id=std::move(state.completed_title);
        bytes=std::move(state.completed_pixels);
        state.completed=false;
        // A future catalogue rebuild may need the same title again; no
        // permanent "already downloaded" blacklist is permitted.
        state.seen.erase(id);
    }
    state.wake.notify_one();
    if(id.size()>=sizeof(title_id))return 0;
    std::memcpy(title_id,id.data(),id.size());
    title_id[id.size()]=0;
    // The worker already decoded/resampled this image; only the GPU texture
    // allocation remains on its owning thread. Never decode here.
    if(bytes.size()!=std::size_t(kTarget)*kTarget*4u)return 0;
    return renderer.create_texture(kTarget,kTarget,bytes.data());
#else
    (void)renderer;
    return 0;
#endif
}

std::uint32_t niak_load_game_background(hui::gfx::Renderer &renderer,const char *id,float *aspect) {
    bool media=id && std::strlen(id)==9 && std::strncmp(id,"NPXS",4)==0;
    if(media)for(int i=4;i<9;++i)
        if(id[i]<'0'||id[i]>'9')media=false;
    if(!niak_valid_title_id(id) && !media)return 0;
#if defined(__PROSPERO__)
    // Stage-4 loader now schedules CPU-only work and returns immediately.
    // Result is installed later by refresh_pending_case_background().
    enqueue_missing_scene(id);
    (void)renderer;(void)aspect;
    return 0;
#else
    std::vector<unsigned char> png;
    std::vector<std::string> locations;
#if defined(__linux__)
    if(const char *fixtures=std::getenv("NIAK_CASE_PREVIEW_MEDIA")) {
        if(fixtures[0])locations.emplace_back(
            std::string(fixtures)+"/"+id+"-scene.png");
    }
#endif
    for(const char *format : {
        "/app0/assets/niak-installed/%s-scene.webp",
        "/data/homebrew/PPSA99386/assets/niak-installed/%s-scene.webp",
        "/app0/assets/niak-installed/%s-scene.png",
        "/data/homebrew/PPSA99386/assets/niak-installed/%s-scene.png",
        "/data/homebrew/%s/sce_sys/pic1.png",
        "/user/app/%s/sce_sys/pic1.png",
        "/user/appmeta/%s/pic1.png",
        "/system_ex/app/%s/sce_sys/pic1.png",
        "/mnt/ext0/user/app/%s/sce_sys/pic1.png",
        "/mnt/ext1/user/app/%s/sce_sys/pic1.png"
    }) {
        char path[200]{};
        std::snprintf(path,sizeof(path),format,id);
        locations.emplace_back(path);
    }
    for(const std::string &path:locations) {
        png.clear();
        if(!read_local_png(path.c_str(),png))continue;
        std::vector<unsigned char> rgba;
        unsigned w=0,h=0;
        // Reject non-landscape art before a costly PNG/WebP pixel decode.
        if(!decode_installed_art(png,rgba,w,h,true))continue;
        const unsigned target_w=768;
        const unsigned target_h=std::max(320u,std::min(560u,
            static_cast<unsigned>((std::uint64_t(target_w)*h)/w)));
        std::vector<unsigned char> scaled(std::size_t(target_w)*target_h*4);
        for(unsigned y=0;y<target_h;++y) {
            const unsigned sy=std::min(h-1,static_cast<unsigned>(
                (std::uint64_t(y)*h)/target_h));
            for(unsigned x=0;x<target_w;++x) {
                const unsigned sx=std::min(w-1,static_cast<unsigned>(
                    (std::uint64_t(x)*w)/target_w));
                const std::size_t src=(std::size_t(sy)*w+sx)*4;
                const std::size_t dst=(std::size_t(y)*target_w+x)*4;
                for(int k=0;k<4;++k)scaled[dst+k]=rgba[src+k];
            }
        }
        const auto texture=renderer.create_texture(
            int(target_w),int(target_h),scaled.data());
        // A rejected GPU allocation must not suppress the next local image.
        if(!texture)continue;
        niak_track_case_texture(texture,target_w,target_h);
        if(aspect)*aspect=float(target_w)/float(target_h);
        return texture;
    }
    return 0;
#endif
}

std::uint32_t niak_take_downloaded_game_background(
        hui::gfx::Renderer &renderer,char (&title_id)[16],float *aspect) {
    title_id[0]=0;
#if defined(__PROSPERO__)
    auto &state=case_background_state();
    std::string id;
    std::vector<unsigned char> pixels;
    unsigned width=0,height=0;
    {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(state.mutex);
        if(!state.completed)return 0;
        id=std::move(state.completed_title);
        pixels=std::move(state.completed_pixels);
        width=state.completed_width;
        height=state.completed_height;
        state.completed=false;
        state.queued.erase(id);
    }
    state.wake.notify_one();
    if(id.size()>=sizeof(title_id)||width!=768u||height<320u ||
       height>560u||pixels.size()!=std::size_t(width)*height*4u)
        return 0;
    std::memcpy(title_id,id.c_str(),id.size()+1u);
    // Never upload GL textures on the CPU worker.
    const auto texture=renderer.create_texture(int(width),int(height),pixels.data());
    if(texture) {
        niak_track_case_texture(texture,width,height);
        if(aspect)*aspect=float(width)/float(height);
    }
    return texture;
#else
    (void)renderer;(void)aspect;
    return 0;
#endif
}

std::uint32_t niak_load_profile_cache_png(hui::gfx::Renderer &renderer,unsigned user) {
    char path[160];
    std::snprintf(path,sizeof(path),
        "/system_data/priv/cache/profile/0x%08X/avatar.png",user);
    std::vector<unsigned char> png;
    return read_local_png(path,png)?decode_upload(renderer,png):0;
}

std::uint32_t niak_load_local_png(hui::gfx::Renderer &renderer, const char *path)
{
    if(!path || (std::strcmp(path,"/app0/assets/niak-profile.png") != 0 &&
        std::strcmp(path,"/data/homebrew/PPSA99386/assets/niak-profile.png") != 0))
        return 0;
    std::FILE *f=std::fopen(path,"rb");
    if(!f)return 0;
    if(std::fseek(f,0,SEEK_END)!=0){std::fclose(f);return 0;}
    const long size=std::ftell(f);
    if(size<33 || size>2*1024*1024 || std::fseek(f,0,SEEK_SET)!=0)
    {std::fclose(f);return 0;}
    std::vector<unsigned char> data(static_cast<std::size_t>(size));
    const bool okay=std::fread(data.data(),1,data.size(),f)==data.size();
    std::fclose(f);
    return okay ? decode_upload(renderer,data) : 0;
}
```

```py
    data=path.read_text("utf8")

    term='"'+chr(36)+'{objects[@]}" -lEGL -lGL -lm -o'
    new='"'+chr(36)+'{objects[@]}" -lEGL -lGL -lsqlite3 -pthread -lm -o'
    if term not in contents:raise RuntimeError("Host linker args changed")
    host.write_text(contents.replace(term,new),"utf8")
if __name__=="__main__":
    cli=argparse.ArgumentParser()
    cli.add_argument("--kit",type=Path,required=True)
    patch(cli.parse_args().kit)
```

`native/title/http_icon_response.hpp`:

```hpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#pragma once
// Bounded HTTP body framing for locally served PS5 game icons.
// Handles Content-Length, chunked responses, and close-delimited HTTP/1.0.
// Do not wait for EOF after a complete frame on a persistent connection.
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstring>
#include <string>
#include <utility>
#include <vector>

enum class NiakHttpState { NeedMore, Complete, Invalid };

inline NiakHttpState niak_http_icon_body(
    const std::vector<unsigned char> &wire,bool eof,std::size_t maximum,
    std::vector<unsigned char> &out) {
    constexpr std::size_t kMaxHeader=8192;
    if(wire.size()>maximum+kMaxHeader+256*1024)return NiakHttpState::Invalid;
    std::size_t header_end=0;
    const unsigned char separator[4]={'\r','\n','\r','\n'};
    for(std::size_t p=0;p+4<=wire.size() && p<kMaxHeader;++p) {
        if(std::memcmp(wire.data()+p,separator,4)==0) {
            header_end=p+4;break;
        }
    }
    if(!header_end)return wire.size()>kMaxHeader||eof?
        NiakHttpState::Invalid:NiakHttpState::NeedMore;
    if(header_end<16 || (std::memcmp(wire.data(),"HTTP/1.1 200",12)!=0 &&
                         std::memcmp(wire.data(),"HTTP/1.0 200",12)!=0) ||
                         (wire[12]!=' ' && wire[12]!='\r'))
        return NiakHttpState::Invalid;
    std::string header(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(wire.data()),header_end);
    if(header.find('\0')!=std::string::npos)return NiakHttpState::Invalid;
    auto trim=[](std::string value) {
        const auto a=value.find_first_not_of(" \t");
        if(a==std::string::npos)return std::string();
        const auto b=value.find_last_not_of(" \t");
        return value.substr(a,b-a+1);
    };
    auto lower=[](std::string value) {
        for(char &c:value)if(c>='A'&&c<='Z')c=char(c-'A'+'a');
        return value;
    };
    bool has_length=false,chunked=false,other_encoding=false;
    std::size_t length=0;
    std::size_t line=header.find("\r\n");
    if(line==std::string::npos)return NiakHttpState::Invalid;
    line+=2;
    while(line<header_end-2) {
        const auto end=header.find("\r\n",line);
        if(end==std::string::npos)return NiakHttpState::Invalid;
        if(end==line)break;
        const auto colon=header.find(':',line);
        if(colon==std::string::npos || colon>=end)return NiakHttpState::Invalid;
        const std::string key=lower(trim(header.substr(line,colon-line)));
        const std::string value=lower(trim(header.substr(colon+1,end-colon-1)));
        if(key=="content-length") {
            if(value.empty())return NiakHttpState::Invalid;
            std::size_t n=0;
            for(const char digit:value) {
                if(digit<'0'||digit>'9')return NiakHttpState::Invalid;
                const auto d=std::size_t(digit-'0');
                // Check before multiplication; oversized decimal strings
                // must not wrap back into a seemingly valid image size.
                if(d>maximum || n>(maximum-d)/10u)
                    return NiakHttpState::Invalid;
                n=n*10u+d;
            }
            if(has_length && n!=length)return NiakHttpState::Invalid;
            length=n;has_length=true;
        } else if(key=="transfer-encoding") {
            if(value.find("chunked")!=std::string::npos)chunked=true;
            else other_encoding=true;
        }
        line=end+2;
    }
    if(other_encoding || (chunked && has_length))return NiakHttpState::Invalid;
    if(chunked) {
        // Collect only (offset,size) pairs while the frame is incomplete.
        // Do not allocate/copy decoded image bytes at every TCP fragment.
        std::vector<std::pair<std::size_t,std::size_t>> spans;
        std::size_t decoded_size=0;
        std::size_t pos=header_end;
        for(;;) {
            const auto end=std::search(wire.begin()+pos,wire.end(),
                                       separator,separator+2);
            if(end==wire.end())return (wire.size()-pos>100||eof)?
                NiakHttpState::Invalid:NiakHttpState::NeedMore;
            const std::size_t end_at=std::size_t(end-wire.begin());
            if(end_at-pos>100)return NiakHttpState::Invalid;
            const std::string size_line(
                reinterpret_cast<const char*>(wire.data()+pos),end_at-pos);
            std::size_t n=0,digits=0;
            for(char c:size_line) {
                if(c==';')break; // optional chunk extension
                unsigned d=0;
                if(c>='0'&&c<='9')d=unsigned(c-'0');
                else if(c>='a'&&c<='f')d=unsigned(c-'a'+10);
                else if(c>='A'&&c<='F')d=unsigned(c-'A'+10);
                else return NiakHttpState::Invalid;
                if(++digits>8)return NiakHttpState::Invalid;
                n=n*16u+d;
            }
            if(!digits || n>maximum-decoded_size)return NiakHttpState::Invalid;
            pos=end_at+2;
            if(n==0) {
                // Consume bounded optional trailers, until a blank line.
                for(;;) {
                    const auto e=std::search(wire.begin()+pos,wire.end(),
                                              separator,separator+2);
                    if(e==wire.end())return eof?NiakHttpState::Invalid:
                                                NiakHttpState::NeedMore;
                    const std::size_t off=std::size_t(e-wire.begin());
                    if(off-pos>kMaxHeader)return NiakHttpState::Invalid;
                    if(off==pos) {
                        out.resize(decoded_size);
                        std::size_t copied=0;
                        for(const auto &span:spans) {
                            std::memcpy(out.data()+copied,
                                        wire.data()+span.first,span.second);
                            copied+=span.second;
                        }
                        return NiakHttpState::Complete;
                    }
                    pos=off+2;
                }
            }
            if(wire.size()-pos<n+2)return eof?NiakHttpState::Invalid:
                                                    NiakHttpState::NeedMore;
            if(wire[pos+n]!='\r'||wire[pos+n+1]!='\n')
                return NiakHttpState::Invalid;
            // Limit pathological tiny-chunk responses; bounded wire size
            // alone would still allow hundreds of thousands of allocations.
            if(spans.size()>=8192)return NiakHttpState::Invalid;
            spans.emplace_back(pos,n);
            decoded_size+=n;
            pos+=n+2;
        }
    }
    if(has_length) {
        if(wire.size()-header_end<length)return eof?NiakHttpState::Invalid:
                                                   NiakHttpState::NeedMore;
        out.assign(wire.begin()+header_end,wire.begin()+header_end+length);
        return NiakHttpState::Complete;
    }
    if(wire.size()-header_end>maximum)return NiakHttpState::Invalid;
    if(!eof)return NiakHttpState::NeedMore;
    out.assign(wire.begin()+header_end,wire.end());
    return NiakHttpState::Complete;
}
```

`native/title/icon_endpoint_policy.hpp`:

```hpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#pragma once
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstring>

// Classify a complete HTTP response header WITHOUT reading the body.
// Receiving just "HTTP/1.1 200 OK" is not proof that a stalled server
// can actually deliver an icon, but a complete 404 is a valid reply.
enum class NiakIconReply { NeedMore, Success, OtherStatus, Invalid };
inline NiakIconReply niak_icon_reply(const unsigned char *data,
                                    std::size_t size) {
    if(!data || size<16)return NiakIconReply::NeedMore;
    if(std::memcmp(data,"HTTP/1.1 ",9)!=0 &&
       std::memcmp(data,"HTTP/1.0 ",9)!=0)
        return NiakIconReply::Invalid;
    if(data[9]<'0'||data[9]>'9'||data[10]<'0'||data[10]>'9'||
       data[11]<'0'||data[11]>'9'||data[12]!=' ')
        return NiakIconReply::Invalid;
    const std::size_t cap=size<8192?size:8192;
    bool complete=false;
    for(std::size_t p=0;p+4<=cap;++p) {
        if(data[p]=='\r'&&data[p+1]=='\n'&&
           data[p+2]=='\r'&&data[p+3]=='\n') {
            complete=true;break;
        }
    }
    if(!complete)return size>8192?NiakIconReply::Invalid:
                                   NiakIconReply::NeedMore;
    return std::memcmp(data+9,"200",3)==0?NiakIconReply::Success:
                                            NiakIconReply::OtherStatus;
}

// Transport failures are endpoint-wide; HTTP 404 for one game's art is not.
// Back off only after two consecutive socket/timeouts, and retry on a
// monotonic clock without permanently blacklisting the local service.
struct NiakIconEndpointPolicy {
    unsigned consecutive_failures=0;
    std::uint64_t retry_after_ms=0;
    bool allowed(std::uint64_t now_ms) const {
        return now_ms >= retry_after_ms;
    }
    void responded() {
        consecutive_failures=0;
        retry_after_ms=0;
    }
    void transport_failed(std::uint64_t now_ms) {
        if(consecutive_failures<2)++consecutive_failures;
        if(consecutive_failures>=2) {
            // Saturating addition is unnecessary for a real monotonic clock,
            // but prevents wrap from re-enabling an endpoint on bad inputs.
            constexpr std::uint64_t limit=UINT64_MAX-10000u;
            retry_after_ms=now_ms>=limit?UINT64_MAX:now_ms+10000u;
        }
    }
};
```

`native/title/launch_bridge.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#define _POSIX_C_SOURCE 200809L
// Connect only to NiakPS5's opt-in PLDmgr local launch broker.
// A sandboxed title must not claim sceSystemServiceLaunchApp works here.
#include "niak/launch_bridge.hpp"
#include "niak/socket_guard.h"
#include "niak/loopback_connect.h"
#include "niak/broker_snapshot.h"
#include <arpa/inet.h>
#include <netinet/in.h>
#include <cerrno>
#include <cstdint>
#include <time.h>
#include <ctime>
#include <sys/select.h>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <sys/socket.h>
#include <sys/time.h>
#include <unistd.h>

namespace {
constexpr unsigned short kPort=19187;
bool valid(const char *id) {
    if(!id || std::strlen(id)!=9)return false;
    if(std::strncmp(id,"PPSA",4)&&std::strncmp(id,"CUSA",4)&&
       std::strncmp(id,"LAPY",4)&&std::strncmp(id,"FAKE",4)&&
       std::strncmp(id,"NPXS",4))return false;
    for(int i=4;i<9;++i)if(id[i]<'0'||id[i]>'9')return false;
    return true;
}
}
int niak_launch_registered_title(const char *title_id) {
    if(!valid(title_id))return -3;
    int fd=::socket(AF_INET,SOCK_STREAM,0);
    if(fd<0)return -2;
    niak_socket_guard(fd);
    timeval tv{2,0};
    ::setsockopt(fd,SOL_SOCKET,SO_RCVTIMEO,&tv,sizeof(tv));
    ::setsockopt(fd,SOL_SOCKET,SO_SNDTIMEO,&tv,sizeof(tv));
    sockaddr_in peer{};
    peer.sin_family=AF_INET;
    peer.sin_port=htons(kPort);
    peer.sin_addr.s_addr=htonl(0x7f000001u);
    // The user pressing Jouer must not wait for a missing broker to time out.
    if(niak_connect_bounded(fd,reinterpret_cast<sockaddr*>(&peer),sizeof(peer),100)<0) {
        ::close(fd);return -2;
    }
    char request[24]{};
    const int len=std::snprintf(request,sizeof(request),"LAUNCH %.9s\n",title_id);
    if(len<=0 || len>=int(sizeof(request))) {::close(fd);return -3;}
    int sent=0;
    while(sent<len) {
        const ssize_t n=niak_socket_send(fd,request+sent,std::size_t(len-sent));
        if(n<=0){::close(fd);return -2;}
        sent+=int(n);
    }
    // TCP is a byte stream. Reject partial or malformed RC messages.
    char response[12]{};
    std::size_t received=0;
    while(received<sizeof(response)) {
        const ssize_t n=::recv(fd,response+received,
                               sizeof(response)-received,0);
        if(n<=0){::close(fd);return -2;}
        received+=static_cast<std::size_t>(n);
    }
    ::close(fd);
    if(std::memcmp(response,"RC ",3)!=0 || response[11]!='\n')return -3;
    for(std::size_t i=3;i<11;++i) {
        const char c=response[i];
        if(!((c>='0'&&c<='9')||(c>='a'&&c<='f')||
             (c>='A'&&c<='F')))return -3;
    }
    unsigned code=0;
    if(std::sscanf(response+3,"%8x",&code)!=1)return -3;
    return static_cast<int>(code);
}

namespace {
int kProbeStage=0;
int kProbeError=0;
void mark_probe(int stage,int error) {
    kProbeStage=stage;
    kProbeError=error;
}
}

const char *niak_launch_broker_diagnostic() {
    static char message[196];
    const char *step="non testé";
    switch(kProbeStage) {
    case 1:step="socket";break;
    case 2:step="ioctl FIONBIO";break;
    case 3:step="connect";break;
    case 4:step="send";break;
    case 5:step="recv";break;
    case 6:step="PONG invalide";break;
    case 7:step="PONG confirme";break;
    default:break;
    }
    if(kProbeStage==7)return "PING confirme : service joignable";
    // Settings redraws every frame. Cache filesystem snapshot checks so
    // a denied /app0 or /data read cannot stall the GPU/dual-sense UI at 60 Hz.
    static bool catalogue_readable=false;
    static int snapshot_errors[3]{};
    static std::time_t snapshot_checked_at=0;
    const std::time_t now=std::time(nullptr);
    if(!snapshot_checked_at || now<snapshot_checked_at ||
       now-snapshot_checked_at>=3) {
        NiakGame probe{};
        const char *const sources[]={
            NIAK_SNAPSHOT_APP_FILE,NIAK_SNAPSHOT_APP_SOURCE,
            NIAK_SNAPSHOT_FILE};
        catalogue_readable=false;
        for(int i=0;i<3;++i) {
            errno=0;
            const int result=niak_snapshot_read(sources[i],&probe,1);
            snapshot_errors[i]=result>=0?-1:errno;
            catalogue_readable|=result>=0;
        }
        snapshot_checked_at=now;
    }
    if(catalogue_readable)
        std::snprintf(message,sizeof(message),
                      "PING %s (errno %d); catalogue local lisible",
                      step,kProbeError);
    else
        std::snprintf(message,sizeof(message),
                      "PING %s (errno %d); snapshots app0:%d source:%d data:%d",
                      step,kProbeError,snapshot_errors[0],
                      snapshot_errors[1],snapshot_errors[2]);
    // A readable catalogue does NOT imply that launching games over TCP works.
    return message;
}

bool niak_launch_broker_ready() {
    // A bounded probe only on a cached settings repaint. 30/40 ms was too
    // aggressive on a console busy mounting games: allow 120 ms for each
    // connect/read without waiting for OS TCP retries or blocking each frame.
    static std::uint64_t checked_at_ms=0;
    static bool previous=false,checked=false;
    struct timespec stamp{};
    const bool timed=clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC,&stamp)==0;
    const std::uint64_t now_ms=timed?
        static_cast<std::uint64_t>(stamp.tv_sec)*1000u+
        static_cast<std::uint64_t>(stamp.tv_nsec)/1000000u:0u;
    if(timed && checked && now_ms>=checked_at_ms &&
       now_ms-checked_at_ms<1000u)return previous;
    checked_at_ms=now_ms;
    checked=timed;
    previous=false; // Fail closed; never infer liveness from stale logs.
    int fd=::socket(AF_INET,SOCK_STREAM,0);
    if(fd<0){mark_probe(1,errno);return false;}
    niak_socket_guard(fd);
    sockaddr_in peer{};
    peer.sin_family=AF_INET;
    peer.sin_port=htons(kPort);
    peer.sin_addr.s_addr=htonl(0x7f000001u);
    int stage=2;
    if(niak_connect_bounded_ex(fd,reinterpret_cast<sockaddr*>(&peer),
                               sizeof(peer),120,&stage)<0) {
        const int issue=errno;
        ::close(fd);mark_probe(stage,issue);return false;
    }
    timeval io_timeout{0,120000};
    (void)::setsockopt(fd,SOL_SOCKET,SO_RCVTIMEO,&io_timeout,sizeof(io_timeout));
    (void)::setsockopt(fd,SOL_SOCKET,SO_SNDTIMEO,&io_timeout,sizeof(io_timeout));
    if(niak_socket_send(fd,"PING\n",5)!=5) {
        const int error=errno;
        ::close(fd);mark_probe(4,error);return false;
    }
    char answer[5]{};
    std::size_t received=0;
    while(received<sizeof(answer)) {
        const ssize_t n=::recv(fd,answer+received,
                               sizeof(answer)-received,0);
        if(n<=0) {
            const int error=n==0?ECONNRESET:errno;
            ::close(fd);mark_probe(5,error);return false;
        }
        received+=static_cast<std::size_t>(n);
    }
    ::close(fd);
    previous=std::memcmp(answer,"PONG\n",5)==0;
    mark_probe(previous?7:6,0);
    return previous;
}

unsigned niak_launch_broker_pid() {
    int fd=::socket(AF_INET,SOCK_STREAM,0);
    if(fd<0)return 0;
    niak_socket_guard(fd);
    sockaddr_in peer{};
    peer.sin_family=AF_INET;
    peer.sin_port=htons(kPort);
    peer.sin_addr.s_addr=htonl(0x7f000001u);
    if(niak_connect_bounded(fd,reinterpret_cast<sockaddr*>(&peer),
                            sizeof(peer),100)<0) {
        ::close(fd);return 0;
    }
    timeval tv{0,150000};
    (void)::setsockopt(fd,SOL_SOCKET,SO_RCVTIMEO,&tv,sizeof(tv));
    (void)::setsockopt(fd,SOL_SOCKET,SO_SNDTIMEO,&tv,sizeof(tv));
    if(niak_socket_send(fd,"STATUS\n",7)!=7){::close(fd);return 0;}
    char reply[13]{};
    std::size_t have=0;
    while(have<sizeof(reply)) {
        const ssize_t n=::recv(fd,reply+have,sizeof(reply)-have,0);
        if(n<=0)break;
        have+=static_cast<std::size_t>(n);
    }
    ::close(fd);
    if(have!=sizeof(reply)||std::memcmp(reply,"PID ",4)!=0||
       reply[12]!='\n')return 0;
    unsigned pid=0;
    for(unsigned i=4;i<12;++i) {
        const unsigned char c=static_cast<unsigned char>(reply[i]);
        if(c>='0'&&c<='9')pid=(pid<<4)|(c-'0');
        else if(c>='A'&&c<='F')pid=(pid<<4)|(c-'A'+10);
        else if(c>='a'&&c<='f')pid=(pid<<4)|(c-'a'+10);
        else return 0;
    }
    return pid;
}

static int niak_open_system_settings_broker() {
    int fd=::socket(AF_INET,SOCK_STREAM,0);
    if(fd<0)return -2;
    niak_socket_guard(fd);
    sockaddr_in address{};
    address.sin_family=AF_INET;
    address.sin_port=htons(kPort);
    address.sin_addr.s_addr=htonl(0x7f000001u);
    if(niak_connect_bounded(fd,reinterpret_cast<sockaddr*>(&address),
                            sizeof(address),100)<0) {
        ::close(fd);return -2;
    }
    timeval timeout{0,350000};
    (void)::setsockopt(fd,SOL_SOCKET,SO_RCVTIMEO,&timeout,sizeof(timeout));
    (void)::setsockopt(fd,SOL_SOCKET,SO_SNDTIMEO,&timeout,sizeof(timeout));
    if(niak_socket_send(fd,"SETTINGS\n",9)!=9){::close(fd);return -2;}
    char reply[12]{};
    std::size_t have=0;
    while(have<sizeof(reply)) {
        const auto n=::recv(fd,reply+have,sizeof(reply)-have,0);
        if(n<=0)break;
        have+=static_cast<std::size_t>(n);
    }
    ::close(fd);
    if(have!=sizeof(reply)||std::memcmp(reply,"RC ",3)!=0||
       reply[11]!='\n')return -2;
    for(int i=3;i<11;++i) {
        const char ch=reply[i];
        if(!((ch>='0'&&ch<='9')||(ch>='a'&&ch<='f')||
             (ch>='A'&&ch<='F')))return -2;
    }
    unsigned status=0;
    if(std::sscanf(reply+3,"%8x",&status)!=1)return -2;
    return static_cast<int>(status);
}
#if defined(__PROSPERO__)
extern "C" int sceKernelLoadStartModule(const char *path,std::size_t argc,
    const void *argv,std::uint32_t flags,std::uint32_t options,int *result);
extern "C" int sceKernelDlsym(int handle,const char *name,void **address);
extern "C" int sceUserServiceGetForegroundUser(int *user);
struct NiakShellUriArgs { std::uint32_t size,user; };
#endif
int niak_open_system_settings() {
    // First ask the existing, opt-in PLDmgr broker. Its system context
    // may launch ShellUI even where this application's sandbox is denied.
    const int broker_rc=niak_open_system_settings_broker();
    if(broker_rc!=-2)return broker_rc;
#if defined(__PROSPERO__)
    // A PlayStation URI is NOT an Internet URL. The WebBrowser service
    // rejects pssettings:, as confirmed on hardware. Itemzflow/etaHEN use
    // ShellUIUtilLaunchByUri instead; resolve dynamically to avoid assuming
    // the sandbox grants this private service.
    int module_result=0;
    const int module=sceKernelLoadStartModule(
        "/system_ex/common_ex/lib/libSceShellUIUtil.sprx",
        0,nullptr,0,0,&module_result);
    if(module<0)return module;
    using Initialize=int(*)();
    using Launch=int(*)(const char*,NiakShellUriArgs*);
    Initialize init=nullptr;
    Launch launch=nullptr;
    void *resolved=nullptr;
    if(sceKernelDlsym(module,"sceShellUIUtilInitialize",&resolved)<0 ||
       !resolved)return -10;
    init=reinterpret_cast<Initialize>(resolved);
    resolved=nullptr;
    if(sceKernelDlsym(module,"sceShellUIUtilLaunchByUri",&resolved)<0 ||
       !resolved)return -11;
    launch=reinterpret_cast<Launch>(resolved);
    int user=-1;
    if(sceUserServiceGetForegroundUser(&user)<0 || user<0)return -12;
    const int initialized=init();
    if(initialized<0)return initialized;
    NiakShellUriArgs args{sizeof(NiakShellUriArgs),
                           static_cast<std::uint32_t>(user)};
    // Fixed root settings URI, not debug settings or an editable URL.
    return launch("pssettings:play?mode=settings",&args);
#else
    return -2;
#endif
}
```

```hpp
// Return 0 only after PLDmgr's privileged local service accepted the launch.
```

`native/title/launch_log_status.h`:

```h
/* SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
 * Classifies the latest PS5 launch result in a bounded, read-only log buffer.
 * SystemService can be refused with 0x80940005 while LncUtil succeeds.
 * This helper never confuses that successful fallback with a failed launch.
 */
#ifndef NIAK_LAUNCH_LOG_STATUS_H
#define NIAK_LAUNCH_LOG_STATUS_H
#include <string.h>
#include <stdint.h>

typedef enum {
    NIAK_LAUNCH_LOG_NO_PAYLOAD=0,
    NIAK_LAUNCH_LOG_NO_ATTEMPT,
    NIAK_LAUNCH_LOG_SYSTEM_OK,
    NIAK_LAUNCH_LOG_LNC_OK,
    NIAK_LAUNCH_LOG_SYSTEM_FAILED,
    NIAK_LAUNCH_LOG_LNC_FAILED
} NiakLaunchLogStatus;

/* Classify the raw API return without assuming success must equal zero.
 * Require exactly eight hexadecimal digits to avoid accepting truncated
 * or malformed journal lines as evidence of an accepted call.
 */
static inline int niak_launch_log_nonnegative(const char *line) {
    static const char tag[]="sceSystemServiceLaunchApp rc=0x";
    const size_t prefix=sizeof(tag)-1;
    if(!line || strncmp(line,tag,prefix)!=0)return 0;
    uint32_t value=0;
    for(size_t i=0;i<8;++i) {
        const unsigned char c=(unsigned char)line[prefix+i];
        unsigned nibble;
        if(c>='0'&&c<='9')nibble=(unsigned)(c-'0');
        else if(c>='a'&&c<='f')nibble=(unsigned)(c-'a'+10);
        else if(c>='A'&&c<='F')nibble=(unsigned)(c-'A'+10);
        else return 0;
        value=(value<<4)|nibble;
    }
    return (line[prefix+8]=='\n' || line[prefix+8]=='\0') &&
           (value & 0x80000000u)==0;
}

static inline NiakLaunchLogStatus niak_last_launch_result(const char *buffer) {
    if(!buffer)return NIAK_LAUNCH_LOG_NO_PAYLOAD;
    const char *begin=0;
    for(const char *p=buffer;
        (p=strstr(p,"NiakPS5 optional autostart start"))!=0;++p)
        begin=p;
    if(!begin)return NIAK_LAUNCH_LOG_NO_PAYLOAD;
    const char *latest=0;
    for(const char *p=begin;
        (p=strstr(p,"sceSystemServiceLaunchApp rc="))!=0;++p)
        latest=p;
    if(!latest)return NIAK_LAUNCH_LOG_NO_ATTEMPT;
    if(niak_launch_log_nonnegative(latest))
        return NIAK_LAUNCH_LOG_SYSTEM_OK;
    const char *accepted=strstr(latest,"sceLncUtilLaunchApp accepted app id rc=");
    const char *refused=strstr(latest,"sceLncUtilLaunchApp refused rc=");
    const char *invalid=strstr(latest,"sceLncUtilLaunchApp returned invalid app id rc=");
    if(accepted && (!refused || accepted>refused) &&
       (!invalid || accepted>invalid))return NIAK_LAUNCH_LOG_LNC_OK;
    if(refused || invalid)return NIAK_LAUNCH_LOG_LNC_FAILED;
    return NIAK_LAUNCH_LOG_SYSTEM_FAILED;
}
#endif
```

`native/title/launch_policy.h`:

```h
/* SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
 * Restricted, owner-initiated PS5 title launch policy.
 * A copied homebrew title can be visible as a folder without being
 * registered with the console's title service. No kernel modification,
 * app installation, process kill or system-process impersonation here.
 */
#ifndef NIAK_PS5_LAUNCH_POLICY_H
#define NIAK_PS5_LAUNCH_POLICY_H
#include <stdint.h>

typedef struct {
    uint32_t structsize;
    uint32_t user_id;
    uint32_t app_opt;
    uint64_t crash_report;
    uint32_t check_flag;
} NiakLaunchContext;
_Static_assert(sizeof(NiakLaunchContext)==32,
               "PS5 launch context must match the LncAppParam ABI");

typedef int (*NiakLaunchFunction)(const char*,const char**,NiakLaunchContext*);
enum { NIAK_LAUNCH_NOT_TRIED = -3 };
typedef struct {
    int result;      /* zero: accepted, negative: raw error */
    int system_rc;   /* raw sceSystemServiceLaunchApp result */
    int lnc_rc;      /* raw sceLncUtilLaunchApp result if called */
    unsigned method; /* 0 failed, 1 system service, 2 LncUtil */
} NiakLaunchResult;

/* SystemService can return a NONNEGATIVE app/process identifier (as
 * observed on PS5 with 0x18 and 0x2018), not just zero. Negative values with
 * the high bit set represent errors. Normalize API acceptance to zero for
 * our existing wire protocol, but do not claim the app is fully running.
 * LncUtil also returns a positive app ID on acceptance.
 * The LncUtil fallback is intentionally limited to error 0x80940005.
 */
static inline NiakLaunchResult niak_launch_with_fallback(
    const char *title,int user,NiakLaunchFunction system_launch,
    NiakLaunchFunction lnc_launch) {
    NiakLaunchResult result={NIAK_LAUNCH_NOT_TRIED,
                              NIAK_LAUNCH_NOT_TRIED,
                              NIAK_LAUNCH_NOT_TRIED,0};
    if(!title || user<0 || !system_launch)return result;
    NiakLaunchContext ctx={0};
    ctx.structsize=(uint32_t)sizeof(ctx);
    ctx.user_id=(uint32_t)user;
    result.system_rc=system_launch(title,0,&ctx);
    result.result=result.system_rc;
    if(result.system_rc>=0) {
        result.method=1;
        result.result=0; // API accepted; physical launch still unverified.
        return result;
    }
    /* PS5 mounted/fake titles may be refused by SystemService with
     * 0x80940005. Existing PS5 launchers use LncUtil for precisely this
     * case, but the fallback can still fail without title registration.
     */
    if((uint32_t)result.system_rc==0x80940005u && lnc_launch) {
        result.lnc_rc=lnc_launch(title,0,&ctx);
        result.result=result.lnc_rc;
        // LncUtil's success value is an actual positive app ID, not
        // SystemService's zero-on-success convention. An app ID of zero
        // cannot identify a launched process, so fail closed.
        if(result.lnc_rc>0) {
            result.method=2;
            result.result=0;
        } else if(result.lnc_rc==0) {
            result.result=-1; // no valid app ID, do not report success
        }
    }
    return result;
}
#endif
```

`native/title/launchbox_index.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build a safe PS4/PS5 LaunchBox retail metadata index from Metadata.zip.
Adapted to the same regional-front/back/spine model as Eden Encore.
Only text, IDs and CDN image filenames are shipped, never retail scans.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse,html,re,unicodedata,urllib.request,zipfile
from pathlib import Path
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

SOURCE="https://gamesdb.launchbox-app.com/Metadata.zip"
IMAGE=re.compile(r"^(?:r2_)?[A-Fa-f0-9-]{36}\.(?:png|jpe?g)$")
KINDS={"Box - Front":"front","Box - Back":"back","Box - Spine":"spine",
       "Fanart - Box - Front":"front_fanart",
       "Fanart - Box - Back":"back_fanart",
       "Clear Logo":"logo", "Fanart - Background":"hero",
       "Screenshot - Gameplay":"gameplay",
       "Screenshot - Game Title":"game_title"}
PLATFORMS={"Sony Playstation 4":"ps4","Sony Playstation 5":"ps5",
           "Sony PlayStation 4":"ps4","Sony PlayStation 5":"ps5",
           "Windows":"windows","Windows PC":"windows"}
REGIONS={"france":"fr","europe":"eu","world":"world","united kingdom":"uk",
         "north america":"us","united states":"us","canada":"ca","germany":"de",
         "japan":"jp","spain":"es","italy":"it","portugal":"pt"}
# French first, then shared European editions, then English UK/US/CA,
# finally worldwide and other territories. All regions remain available.
ORDER=("fr","eu","uk","us","ca","world","de","es","it","pt","jp","other")

def normalize(name):
    name=unicodedata.normalize("NFKD",str(name)).encode("ascii","ignore").decode()
    return re.sub(r"\s+"," ",re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+"," ",name.lower())).strip()

# A PS5 physical edition can be catalogued under the base title in
# LaunchBox. Strip ONLY platform descriptors, never the year, numbered
# sequel, Deluxe/Ultimate suffix or substantive edition name.
IGNORABLE_SUFFIXES=(" console edition"," playstation 5 edition",
                    " playstation 4 edition"," ps5 edition"," ps4 edition")
def safe_titles(name):
    exact=normalize(name)
    variants=[exact] if exact else []
    for suffix in IGNORABLE_SUFFIXES:
        if exact.endswith(suffix):
            base=exact[:-len(suffix)]
            if len(base)>=5 and any(c.isalpha() for c in base):
                variants.append(base)
    return tuple(dict.fromkeys(variants))

def clean_overview(notes):
    """Only a short, sourced description, never the complete LaunchBox essay."""
    text=re.sub(r"\s+"," ",html.unescape(re.sub(r"<[^>]*>"," ",str(notes)))).strip()
    sentences=re.split(r"(?<=[.!?])\s+",text)
    return " ".join(sentences[:3])[:360].rstrip()
def targets(path):
    index={}
    with Path(path).open(encoding="utf8") as f:
        for line in f:
            columns=line.rstrip("\r\n").split("\t")
            if len(columns)<2:continue
            title, name=columns[:2]
            if len(title)!=9 or title[:4] not in ("PPSA","CUSA"):continue
            key=normalize(name)
            if key:index.setdefault((("ps5" if title.startswith("PPSA") else "ps4"),key),[]).append(title)
    return index

def region(value):return REGIONS.get(str(value).strip().lower(),"other")
def face_options(entries):
    first=[]
    alternates=[]
    for area in ORDER:
        group=list(dict.fromkeys(name for where,name in entries if where==area))
        if not group:continue
        first.append(area+":"+group[0])
        alternates.extend(area+":"+name for name in group[1:3])
    # With 3 bounded runtime CDN requests, first visit THREE regions before
    # trying the second FR variant. Otherwise two failed FR scans can mask
    # a perfectly valid English retail image at candidate index four.
    return ";".join((first+alternates)[:12]) or "-"

def layered_media(*groups):
    """Keep source-platform preference before regional alternatives.

    Every slot can contain a PS5 choice followed by PS4 and Windows
    alternatives. Back scans may fall through all three platforms; Box - Front
    remains a true scan from the installed console platform only.
    """
    best=[]
    extras=[]
    for group in groups:
        options=[part for part in face_options(group).split(";") if part!="-"]
        if options:
            best.append(options[0])  # one candidate per platform first
            extras.extend(options[1:])
    result=[]
    used=set()
    for item in (*best,*extras):
        filename=item.split(":",1)[1]
        if filename not in used:
            used.add(filename)
            result.append(item)
        if len(result)>=12:break
    return ";".join(result) or "-"

def parse(xml,installed,diagnostics=None):
    games,aliases,media={}, {}, {}
    # Metadata.zip can group GameImage/GameAlternateName independently of
    # Game entries. Never assume an image's game was already encountered.
    # Pass one collects names/aliases; pass two reads images ONLY for game
    # IDs that could match a title installed on this console.
    iterator=ET.iterparse(xml,events=("start","end"))
    _,root=next(iterator)
    for event,el in iterator:
        if event!="end":continue
        tag=el.tag.rsplit("}",1)[-1]
        if tag=="Game":
            platform=PLATFORMS.get(el.findtext("Platform",""))
            gid=el.findtext("DatabaseID","")
            if platform and gid.isdecimal():
                games[gid]=(platform,el.findtext("Name",""),
                            clean_overview(el.findtext("Overview","") or
                                           el.findtext("Notes","")))
        elif tag=="GameAlternateName":
            gid=el.findtext("DatabaseID","")
            if gid.isdecimal():
                aliases.setdefault(gid,[]).append(el.findtext("AlternateName",""))
        if tag in ("Game","GameAlternateName","GameImage"):
            el.clear();root.clear()

    exact_matches={}
    edition_matches={}
    for gid,(platform,name,notes) in games.items():
        for alias in (name,*aliases.get(gid,[])):
            variants=safe_titles(alias)
            if not variants:continue
            exact_matches.setdefault((platform,variants[0]),set()).add(gid)
            for key in variants[1:]:
                edition_matches.setdefault((platform,key),set()).add(gid)
    # Collect tightly matched PS5/PS4/Windows editions separately. A PC
    # screenshot can enrich a PS5 back, but cannot replace a PS5 box front.
    def related(key,platform):
        names=safe_titles(key[1])
        matches=set()
        for name in names:
            matches.update(exact_matches.get((platform,name),()))
            matches.update(edition_matches.get((platform,name),()))
        return matches
    wanted=set()
    for key in installed:
        for platform in (key[0],"ps4","ps5","windows"):
            wanted.update(related(key,platform))
    if wanted:
        xml.seek(0)  # ZipExtFile and BytesIO support rewinding.
        iterator=ET.iterparse(xml,events=("start","end"))
        _,root=next(iterator)
        for event,el in iterator:
            if event!="end":continue
            tag=el.tag.rsplit("}",1)[-1]
            if tag=="GameImage":
                gid=el.findtext("DatabaseID","")
                if gid in wanted:
                    kind=KINDS.get(el.findtext("Type",""))
                    filename=el.findtext("FileName","")
                    if kind and IMAGE.fullmatch(filename):
                        media.setdefault(gid,{}).setdefault(kind,[]).append(
                            (region(el.findtext("Region","")),filename))
            if tag in ("Game","GameAlternateName","GameImage"):
                el.clear();root.clear()
    rows=[]
    for key,ids in sorted(installed.items()):
        matched=exact_matches.get(key,set())
        # Prefer a unique, platform-exact LaunchBox record. An alternative
        # edition scan is allowed only when exact has no FRONT artwork.
        candidates=matched if len(matched)==1 else set()
        if not any(media.get(g,{}).get("front") or
                   media.get(g,{}).get("front_fanart") for g in candidates):
            alternative=set(edition_matches.get(key,set()))
            # Symmetric lookup: Anno 1800 Console Edition on the console may
            # have a PS5 LaunchBox image filed under "Anno 1800" itself.
            for base in safe_titles(key[1])[1:]:
                alternative.update(exact_matches.get((key[0],base),set()))
            fronts={g for g in alternative if media.get(g,{}).get("front") or
                    media.get(g,{}).get("front_fanart")}
            if len(fronts)==1:candidates=fronts
        # A console entry may be absent from LaunchBox while the same game
        # has excellent PC fanart/gameplay/screenshots. Do NOT discard it:
        # create a scenery-only record and leave its physical FRONT empty.
        # Exact console IDs must never become an unrelated Windows box scan.
        ps5_ids=related(key,"ps5")
        ps4_ids=related(key,"ps4")
        pc_ids=related(key,"windows")
        ps5_gid=next(iter(ps5_ids)) if len(ps5_ids)==1 else None
        ps4_gid=next(iter(ps4_ids)) if len(ps4_ids)==1 else None
        pc_gid=next(iter(pc_ids)) if len(pc_ids)==1 else None
        ps5=media.get(ps5_gid,{}) if ps5_gid else {}
        ps4=media.get(ps4_gid,{}) if ps4_gid else {}
        pc=media.get(pc_gid,{}) if pc_gid else {}
        other_gid=ps4_gid if key[0]=="ps5" else ps5_gid
        if len(candidates)==1:
            gid=next(iter(candidates))
            images=media.get(gid,{})
            # The chosen native edition is authoritative even when the
            # broader alias lookup finds several editions on this platform.
            if key[0]=="ps5":
                ps5,ps5_gid=images,gid
            else:
                ps4,ps4_gid=images,gid
        else:
            # Ambiguous native matches/editions are not assigned at random.
            # A unique secondary record can still supply non-box media.
            if len(matched)>1 or (not other_gid and not pc_gid):
                continue
            gid=other_gid or pc_gid
            images={}
        info=games[gid]
        faces=[face_options(images.get("front",[]) or
                            images.get("front_fanart",[])),
               face_options(images.get("back",[]) or
                            images.get("back_fanart",[])),
               face_options(images.get("spine",[])),
               face_options(images.get("logo",[]))]
        # Box - Front MUST be the installed platform's real retail cover.
        # Box - Back may fall back PS5 -> PS4 -> PC, in that exact order,
        # even when an earlier source has a broken CDN file. Never substitute
        # a PC front as a retail front for a PlayStation game.
        def box_back(group):
            return group.get("back",[]) or group.get("back_fanart",[])
        faces[1]=layered_media(box_back(ps5),box_back(ps4),box_back(pc))
        # Supplementary media also follows PS5 -> PS4 -> PC.
        faces[3]=layered_media(ps5.get("logo",[]),ps4.get("logo",[]),
                               pc.get("logo",[]))
        hero=layered_media(ps5.get("hero",[]),ps4.get("hero",[]),
                           pc.get("hero",[]))
        used={part.split(":",1)[1] for part in hero.split(";") if ":" in part}
        # Two intentionally DIFFERENT screenshot classes:
        # Gameplay is the first image; a Game Title screenshot is preferred
        # for the second. This guarantees both kinds can appear on a
        # reconstructed back even if gameplay has many regional images.
        # The Fanart Background remains an independent HERO slot.
        shots=[]
        shot_kinds=[]
        def add_first(kind):
            for group in (ps5,ps4,pc):
                for area in ORDER:
                    for where,filename in group.get(kind,[]):
                        if where!=area or filename in used:continue
                        used.add(filename)
                        shots.append(area+":"+filename)
                        shot_kinds.append(kind)
                        return True
            return False
        add_first("gameplay")
        add_first("game_title")
        # Missing a separate title image? Use a SECOND distinct gameplay
        # image, then other title screens, never a duplicate of the hero.
        for kind in ("gameplay","game_title"):
            if len(shots)>=2:break
            add_first(kind)
        # Each of the TWO distinct screenshot slots may fall back to its
        # matching PC image when a console CDN candidate is unavailable.
        # Never use the same primary frame as another slot or any hero image.
        def screenshot_sources(slot):
            if slot>=len(shots):return "-"
            primary=shots[slot]
            primary_name=primary.split(":",1)[1]
            forbidden={x.split(":",1)[1] for x in hero.split(";") if ":" in x}
            forbidden.update(x.split(":",1)[1] for i,x in enumerate(shots)
                             if i!=slot)
            options=layered_media(*(
                [(area,filename) for area,filename in group.get(shot_kinds[slot],[])
                 if filename not in forbidden]
                for group in (ps5,ps4,pc)
            ))
            result=[primary]
            seen={primary_name}
            for choice in options.split(";"):
                if ":" not in choice:continue
                filename=choice.split(":",1)[1]
                if filename not in seen:
                    seen.add(filename)
                    result.append(choice)
                if len(result)>=4:break
            return ";".join(result)
        shot1,shot2=screenshot_sources(0),screenshot_sources(1)
        overview=info[2] or (
            games[ps5_gid][2] if ps5_gid else "") or (
            games[ps4_gid][2] if ps4_gid else "") or (
            games[pc_gid][2] if pc_gid else "") or "-"
        for title in sorted(set(ids)):
            rows.append((title,overview,*faces,hero,shot1,shot2,gid))
    rows.sort()
    if diagnostics is not None:
        # The public Metadata.zip must really contain all three media types.
        # Only aggregate counts are printed; no private PS5 IDs/names.
        diagnostics.update({
            kind:sum(len(group.get(kind,())) for group in media.values())
            for kind in ("hero","gameplay","game_title")
        })
    return rows

def build(archive,ids_file,out):
    installed=targets(ids_file)
    with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as bundle:
        xml=[p for p in bundle.infolist() if Path(p.filename).name.lower()=="metadata.xml"]
        if len(xml)!=1 or xml[0].file_size>2*1024**3:
            raise ValueError("LaunchBox archive is malformed")
        with bundle.open(xml[0]) as source:
            stats={}
            rows=parse(source,installed,stats)
    back_types=[stats.get(k,0) for k in ("hero","gameplay","game_title")]
    print("LaunchBox real media [fanart, gameplay, game title]:",back_types)
    if len(rows)>1000 and min(back_types)<100:
        raise ValueError("LaunchBox back image category missing from live metadata")
    output=Path(out)
    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    output.write_text("# title\tOverview\tFront\tBack\tSpine\tLogo\tHero\tShot1\tShot2\tLaunchBoxID\n"+
                      "".join("\t".join(parts)+"\n" for parts in rows),"utf8")
    fronts=sum(row[2]!="-" for row in rows)
    backs=sum(row[3]!="-" for row in rows)
    spines=sum(row[4]!="-" for row in rows)
    print("PS4/PS5 LaunchBox verified-platform matches:",len(rows),
          "fronts:",fronts,"backs:",backs,"spines:",spines)

def download(path):
    req=urllib.request.Request(SOURCE,headers={"User-Agent":"NiakPS5/1.0"})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=50) as resp,Path(path).open("wb") as out:
        size=0
        while True:
            chunk=resp.read(1024*1024)
            if not chunk:break
            size+=len(chunk)
            if size>220*1024*1024:raise ValueError("Oversize metadata archive")
            out.write(chunk)
def main():
    p=argparse.ArgumentParser()
    p.add_argument("--zip",type=Path)
    p.add_argument("--download",action="store_true")
    p.add_argument("--titles",type=Path,required=True)
    p.add_argument("--output",type=Path,required=True)
    args=p.parse_args()
    archive=args.zip or Path("/tmp/niak-launchbox-metadata.zip")
    if args.download:download(archive)
    build(archive,args.titles,args.output)
if __name__=="__main__":
    main()
```

`native/title/local_inventory.h`:

```h
/* SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
 * Read-only copy of a previous owner's FTP-installed title inventory.
 * Used ONLY when live catalogue sources all fail. No assertion that these
 * titles are currently installed/launchable; never executes or opens titles.
 */
#ifndef NIAK_LOCAL_INVENTORY_H
#define NIAK_LOCAL_INVENTORY_H
#include "catalog.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>
static inline int niak_scan_local_inventory(const char *path,
                                            NiakGame *games,size_t capacity) {
    if(!path||!games||!capacity)return -1;
    FILE *input=fopen(path,"rb");
    if(!input)return -1;
    if(fseek(input,0,SEEK_END)!=0){fclose(input);return -1;}
    const long length=ftell(input);
    if(length<0||length>512*1024L||fseek(input,0,SEEK_SET)!=0){
        fclose(input);return -1;
    }
    char line[512];
    size_t count=0;
    while(count<capacity && fgets(line,sizeof(line),input)) {
        const char *first=strchr(line,'\t');
        if(!first || (size_t)(first-line)!=9)continue;
        char id[10]={0};
        memcpy(id,line,9);
        const int media=strncmp(id,"NPXS",4)==0;
        if(!media && strncmp(id,"PPSA",4)!=0 &&
           strncmp(id,"CUSA",4)!=0 && strncmp(id,"LAPY",4)!=0 &&
           strncmp(id,"FAKE",4)!=0)continue;
        int valid=1;
        for(int i=4;i<9;++i)if(id[i]<'0'||id[i]>'9')valid=0;
        if(!valid||strcmp(id,"PPSA99386")==0)continue;
        const char *name=first+1;
        const char *second=strchr(name,'\t');
        if(!second||second-name<1||second-name>=192)continue;
        for(const char *p=name;p<second;++p)
            if((unsigned char)*p<32 || (unsigned char)*p==127)valid=0;
        if(!valid)continue;
        const char *category=second+1;
        const char *end=strchr(category,'\t');
        if(!end)continue;
        const size_t type_len=(size_t)(end-category);
        int type=0;
        if(type_len==3 && memcmp(category,"Jeu",3)==0)type=1;
        else if(type_len==11 && memcmp(category,"Application",11)==0)type=2;
        else if(type_len!=0)continue;
        /* NPXS system services cannot be shown without verified app type. */
        if(media&&type!=2)continue;
        int duplicate=0;
        for(size_t n=0;n<count;++n)
            if(strcmp(games[n].id,id)==0){duplicate=1;break;}
        if(duplicate)continue;
        NiakGame *out=&games[count++];
        memset(out,0,sizeof(*out));
        memcpy(out->id,id,10);
        memcpy(out->title,name,(size_t)(second-name));
        out->application_category=(unsigned char)type;
        out->discovered_from_homebrew=3; /* last-known FTP snapshot */
    }
    const int failed=ferror(input);
    fclose(input);
    return failed?-1:(int)count;
}
#endif
```

`native/title/localized_name.h`:

```h
/* SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
 * Source-backed names: use the actual installed PS5 param.json, not a
 * game-name translation service or guessed mappings.
 */
#ifndef NIAK_LOCALIZED_NAME_H
#define NIAK_LOCALIZED_NAME_H
#include <stddef.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "title_category.h"
/* Return a DIRECT key's value; never accidentally enter a nested description
 * or select a string inside an unrelated JSON object. */
static inline const char *niak_json_direct(const char *json,const char *key) {
 if(!json||!key)return NULL;
 const char *p=niak_json_space(json);
 if(*p++!='{')return NULL;
 const size_t wanted=strlen(key);
 for(unsigned count=0;count<512;++count) {
  p=niak_json_space(p);
  if(*p=='}')return NULL;
  const char *end=niak_json_string_end(p);
  if(!end)return NULL;
  const int found=(size_t)(end-p-2)==wanted &&
      memcmp(p+1,key,wanted)==0;
  p=niak_json_space(end);
  if(*p++!=':')return NULL;
  const char *value=niak_json_space(p);
  if(found)return value;
  p=niak_json_skip_value(value);
  if(!p)return NULL;
  p=niak_json_space(p);
  if(*p=='}')return NULL;
  if(*p++!=',')return NULL;
 }
 return NULL;
}
static inline int niak_json_title_value(const char *value,
                                         char *out,size_t cap) {
 if(!value||!out||cap<2||*value!='"')return 0;
 const char *end=niak_json_string_end(value);
 if(!end)return 0;
 size_t n=0;
 for(const char *p=value+1;p<end-1;++p) {
  unsigned cp=(unsigned char)*p;
  if(cp=='\\') {
   if(++p>=end-1)return 0;
   if(*p=='u') {
    cp=0;
    for(int i=0;i<4;++i) {
     if(++p>=end-1)return 0;
     unsigned digit=(*p>='0'&&*p<='9')?(unsigned)(*p-'0'):
       (*p>='a'&&*p<='f')?(unsigned)(*p-'a'+10):
       (*p>='A'&&*p<='F')?(unsigned)(*p-'A'+10):16u;
     if(digit>15)return 0;
     cp=(cp<<4u)|digit;
    }
    if(cp>=0xD800u && cp<=0xDFFFu)return 0;
   } else {
    switch(*p) {
     case '"':cp='"';break;
     case '\\':cp='\\';break;
     case '/':cp='/';break;
     case 'n':case 'r':case 't':cp=' ';break;
     default:return 0;
    }
   }
  }
  if(cp<32u||cp==127u)return 0;
  if(cp<0x80u) {
   if(n+1>=cap)return 0;
   out[n++]=(char)cp;
  } else if(cp<0x800u) {
   if(n+2>=cap)return 0;
   out[n++]=(char)(0xC0u|(cp>>6u));
   out[n++]=(char)(0x80u|(cp&63u));
  } else if(cp<0x10000u) {
   if(n+3>=cap)return 0;
   out[n++]=(char)(0xE0u|(cp>>12u));
   out[n++]=(char)(0x80u|((cp>>6u)&63u));
   out[n++]=(char)(0x80u|(cp&63u));
  } else return 0;
 }
 out[n]=0;
 return n>0;
}
/* FR official manifest display name, EN fallback, never a fake translation. */
static inline int niak_manifest_localized_title(const char *json,
                                                char *out,size_t cap) {
 const char *langs=niak_json_direct(json,"localizedParameters");
 if(!langs)return 0;
 static const char *const codes[]={"fr-FR","fr-CA","fr",
                                    "en-US","en-GB",NULL};
 for(unsigned i=0;codes[i];++i) {
  const char *localized=niak_json_direct(langs,codes[i]);
  const char *title=niak_json_direct(localized,"titleName");
  if(niak_json_title_value(title,out,cap))return 1;
 }
 return 0;
}
#endif
```
