`native/title/loopback_connect.h`:

```h
/* SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
 * Bounded connection from a fresh blocking loopback TCP socket.
 * PS5 sandbox may reject fcntl(F_GETFL/F_SETFL) with EACCES (errno 13).
 * ioctl(FIONBIO) is the socket-specific alternative. Some native retail
 * sandboxes reject BOTH fcntl and ioctl with EACCES, even though local
 * socket connect is permitted. In that case try a socket-send-timeout-
 * limited blocking connect, ONLY for the exact IPv4 loopback address.
 * No remote destination, background thread, or privilege change.
 */
#ifndef NIAK_LOOPBACK_CONNECT_H
#define NIAK_LOOPBACK_CONNECT_H
#include <stddef.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
#include <sys/select.h>
#include <sys/socket.h>
#include <sys/time.h>
#include <netinet/in.h>
#include <arpa/inet.h>

/* stage=2: FIONBIO denied; stage=3: connect/select/socket error.
 * All callers pass a NEW, initially blocking socket. FIONBIO(0) restores
 * this state even if connect or select fails. errno is preserved on failure.
 */
static inline int niak_connect_bounded_ex(int fd,
    const struct sockaddr *address,socklen_t address_size,
    unsigned timeout_ms,int *stage) {
    if(stage)*stage=2;
    int enabled=1;
    if(ioctl(fd,FIONBIO,&enabled)!=0) {
        const int reason=errno;
        if(reason!=EACCES && reason!=EPERM && reason!=ENOTTY)
            return -1;
        if(!address || address_size<sizeof(struct sockaddr_in) ||
           address->sa_family!=AF_INET ||
           ((const struct sockaddr_in *)address)->sin_addr.s_addr!=
               htonl(0x7f000001u)) {
            errno=EACCES;return -1;
        }
        /* The socket is freshly created and still blocking. SO_SNDTIMEO
         * is supported by the FreeBSD socket stack and also controls the
         * blocking loopback connect. Do not connect without a timeout.
         */
        struct timeval deadline={
            (time_t)(timeout_ms/1000u),
            (suseconds_t)((timeout_ms%1000u)*1000u)};
        if(setsockopt(fd,SOL_SOCKET,SO_SNDTIMEO,
                      &deadline,sizeof(deadline))!=0)return -1;
        if(stage)*stage=3;
        return connect(fd,address,address_size);
    }
    if(stage)*stage=3;
    int result=connect(fd,address,address_size);
    int error=result!=0?errno:0;
    if(result!=0 && (error==EINPROGRESS || error==EWOULDBLOCK)) {
        fd_set writable;
        FD_ZERO(&writable);FD_SET(fd,&writable);
        struct timeval deadline={ (long)(timeout_ms/1000u),
                                  (long)((timeout_ms%1000u)*1000u) };
        const int ready=select(fd+1,NULL,&writable,NULL,&deadline);
        if(ready>0 && FD_ISSET(fd,&writable)) {
            int socket_error=0;
            socklen_t error_len=sizeof(socket_error);
            if(getsockopt(fd,SOL_SOCKET,SO_ERROR,
                          &socket_error,&error_len)==0) {
                error=socket_error;
                result=socket_error==0?0:-1;
            } else {
                error=errno;result=-1;
            }
        } else {
            error=ready==0?ETIMEDOUT:errno;
            result=-1;
        }
    }
    int disabled=0;
    if(ioctl(fd,FIONBIO,&disabled)!=0) {
        if(stage)*stage=2;
        return -1; /* errno of ioctl, fail closed */
    }
    if(result!=0) {
        errno=error;
        return -1;
    }
    return 0;
}
static inline int niak_connect_bounded(int fd,
    const struct sockaddr *address,socklen_t address_size,
    unsigned timeout_ms) {
    return niak_connect_bounded_ex(fd,address,address_size,timeout_ms,NULL);
}
#endif

```

`native/title/pack_ftp.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Create ONE FTP-ready PPSA99386.zip.

Archive root: PPSA99386/ only. No nested ZIP, no optional payload, no README.
Store POSIX modes: directory 0755, eboot.bin 0755, other files 0644.
Also apply the same modes to the staging folder for FTP clients using it
directly (FTP servers may not preserve ZIP metadata on extraction).
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import stat
from zipfile import ZipFile, ZipInfo, ZIP_DEFLATED, ZIP_STORED

TITLE_ID = "PPSA99386"
REQUIRED = ("eboot.bin", "sce_module/libc.prx", "sce_sys/param.json")

def package(folder: Path, destination: Path) -> None:
    folder = folder.absolute()
    destination = destination.absolute()
    if folder.name != TITLE_ID or not folder.is_dir() or folder.is_symlink():
        raise ValueError("Expected a real PPSA99386 directory")
    for name in REQUIRED:
        target = folder / name
        if not target.is_file() or target.is_symlink() or not target.stat().st_size:
            raise ValueError(f"Missing required title file: {name}")
    info = json.loads((folder / "sce_sys/param.json").read_text("utf-8"))
    if info.get("titleId") != TITLE_ID:
        raise ValueError("Title identifier does not match the install directory")
    if destination.is_relative_to(folder):
        raise ValueError("Output archive may not be inside the install directory")
    files = sorted(folder.rglob("*"))
    if any(p.is_symlink() for p in files):
        raise ValueError("No symlinks allowed in FTP title package")
    if any(p.is_file() and (p.suffix.lower() == ".zip" or
             (p.suffix.lower() == ".elf" and
              p.relative_to(folder).as_posix() not in ("tools/niakps5/niakps5.elf", "sandbox-elevator.elf"))) for p in files):
        raise ValueError("No nested archives or unapproved ELF payloads")
    # Path structure and permissions must survive a ZIP extractor.
    for p in [folder, *files]:
        if not (p.is_dir() or p.is_file()):
            raise ValueError(f"Unsupported path: {p}")
        p.chmod(0o755 if p.is_dir() or p.name in ("eboot.bin", "niakps5.elf", "sandbox-elevator.elf") else 0o644)
    destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    temporary = destination.with_suffix(".zip.tmp")
    try:
        with ZipFile(temporary, "w", compression=ZIP_DEFLATED, compresslevel=6) as archive:
            for path in [folder, *files]:
                is_dir = path.is_dir()
                name = f"{TITLE_ID}/" + ("" if path == folder else path.relative_to(folder).as_posix())
                if is_dir and not name.endswith("/"):
                    name += "/"
                mode = (stat.S_IFDIR | 0o755) if is_dir else (
                    stat.S_IFREG | (0o755 if path.name in ("eboot.bin", "niakps5.elf", "sandbox-elevator.elf") else 0o644))
                meta = ZipInfo(name, date_time=(2026, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0))
                meta.create_system = 3
                meta.external_attr = (mode << 16) | (0x10 if is_dir else 0)
                meta.compress_type = ZIP_STORED if is_dir else ZIP_DEFLATED
                if is_dir:
                    archive.writestr(meta, b"")
                else:
                    archive.write(path, arcname=name, compress_type=ZIP_DEFLATED,
                                  compresslevel=6)
        with ZipFile(temporary) as archive:
            names = archive.namelist()
            if archive.testzip() is not None or len(names) != len(set(names)):
                raise ValueError("ZIP integrity check failed")
            if any(not n.startswith(f"{TITLE_ID}/") or n.lower().endswith(".zip")
                   for n in names):
                raise ValueError("Unexpected archive root or nested ZIP")
            if any(f"{TITLE_ID}/{p}" not in names for p in REQUIRED):
                raise ValueError("A required file is not packaged")
        os.replace(temporary, destination)
    finally:
        if temporary.exists():
            temporary.unlink()
    print(f"FTP package: {destination} ({destination.stat().st_size} bytes)")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--folder", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    package(args.folder, args.output)

```

`native/title/pack_ftp_dragdrop.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Stage a single drag-and-drop FTP tree. The owner copies data/ into FTP /.

No commands, installer, or PLDmgr edits are required for transfer. The
pre-existing autoload.txt is NOT supplied, modified, or fabricated.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil

TITLE="PPSA99386"
OWN_PAYLOAD="niakps5"
REQUIRED=("eboot.bin","sce_module/libc.prx","sce_sys/param.json",
          "tools/niakps5/niakps5.elf","tools/niakps5/niakps5.elf.json")

def _owned_paths(tree:Path):
    for path in tree.rglob("*"):
        if path.is_symlink():
            raise ValueError("Symlinks forbidden in FTP drag-and-drop archive")
        if not (path.is_file() or path.is_dir()):
            raise ValueError("Unsupported FTP entry")
        if path.name in ("autoload.txt","pldmgr_config.txt"):
            raise ValueError("Never bundle user's PLDmgr configuration")
    return sorted(tree.rglob("*"))

def stage(title:Path,output:Path):
    title=title.resolve(strict=True)
    output=output.absolute()
    if title.name!=TITLE or not title.is_dir() or title.is_symlink():
        raise ValueError("Need built title folder PPSA99386")
    if output==title or output.is_relative_to(title) or title.is_relative_to(output):
        raise ValueError("Output must be separate from title folder")
    _owned_paths(title)
    for part in REQUIRED:
        p=title/part
        if not p.is_file() or p.is_symlink() or p.stat().st_size==0:
            raise ValueError(f"Missing required file {part}")
    meta=json.loads((title/"sce_sys/param.json").read_text("utf-8"))
    if meta.get("titleId")!=TITLE:raise ValueError("Wrong PS5 title ID")
    elf=title/"tools/niakps5/niakps5.elf"
    if elf.open("rb").read(4)!=b"\x7fELF":
        raise ValueError("Invalid bundled companion ELF")
    sidecar=json.loads((title/"tools/niakps5/niakps5.elf.json").read_text("utf-8"))
    if (sidecar.get("filename")!=elf.name or
        sidecar.get("checksum")!=hashlib.sha256(elf.read_bytes()).hexdigest()):
        raise ValueError("Companion ELF metadata/checksum mismatch")
    if output.exists():
        shutil.rmtree(output)
    app=output/"data/homebrew"/TITLE
    slot=output/"data/pldmgr/payloads"/OWN_PAYLOAD
    shutil.copytree(title,app,symlinks=False)
    slot.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    for name in ("niakps5.elf","niakps5.elf.json"):
        shutil.copy2(title/"tools/niakps5"/name,slot/name)
    for directory in (output,output/"data",output/"data/homebrew",
                      output/"data/pldmgr",output/"data/pldmgr/payloads",slot):
        directory.chmod(0o755)
    # Some FTP clients preserve these POSIX flags; the ZIP metadata also
    # requests executable rights, though server behavior still varies.
    (slot/"niakps5.elf").chmod(0o755)
    (slot/"niakps5.elf.json").chmod(0o644)
    (app/"eboot.bin").chmod(0o755)
    _owned_paths(output)
    paths={p.relative_to(output).as_posix() for p in output.rglob("*") if p.is_file()}
    if (any(path.startswith("data/pldmgr/") and not
            path.startswith("data/pldmgr/payloads/niakps5/") for path in paths)
        or len([p for p in paths if p.startswith("data/pldmgr/")])!=2
        or any("autoload" in p.lower() for p in paths)):
        raise ValueError("Unexpected PLDmgr file in drag-and-drop tree")
    print("FTP drop-in staged: copy data/ to PS5 FTP / (merge existing folders)")
    print("The package does NOT include or change autoload.txt.")

if __name__=="__main__":
    p=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    p.add_argument("--title",type=Path,required=True)
    p.add_argument("--output",type=Path,required=True)
    args=p.parse_args()
    stage(args.title,args.output)

```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Connect NiakPS5's visible top tabs to actual DualSense focus and pages.
Runs on the pinned PS5 GPU UI checkout after prepare.py, fail closed on drift.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse

def once(text, before, after):
    n = text.count(before)
    if n != 1:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Expected exactly one upstream anchor: {before[:72]!r}; got {n}")
    return text.replace(before, after, 1)

def patch(kit):
    file = kit / "src/concepts/aurora.cpp"
    text = file.read_text()
    text = once(text, '#include "niak/daily_backdrop.hpp"',
                '#include "niak/daily_backdrop.hpp"\n'
                '#include "niak/case_auto_art.hpp"\n'
                '#include "niak/one_shot_install.hpp"\n'
                '#include "niak/launch_log_status.h"')
    text = once(text, "        if (sheet_open_)\n            update_sheet(input, feedback);\n        else\n            update_shelves(input, feedback);",
    """        // L1/R1 navigate the four top-level menu tabs in either direction.
        // They never touch the daily wallpaper or alter a game's saved state.
        const bool l1 = input.is_pressed(Action::page_prev);
        const bool r1 = input.is_pressed(Action::page_next);
        if (l1 != r1)
        {
            active_tab_ = (active_tab_ + (r1 ? 1 : 3)) % 4;
            selected_tab_ = active_tab_;
            top_focus_ = false;
            sheet_open_ = false;
            settings_cursor_ = 0;
            row_ = (active_tab_ == 2 && shelves_.size() > 1) ? 1 : 0;
            feedback.play(audio::Cue::tab);
        }
        if (sheet_open_)
            update_sheet(input, feedback);
        else if (top_focus_)
            update_tabs(input, feedback);
        else if (active_tab_ == 3 || (active_tab_ == 2 && shelves_.size() < 2))
            update_page(input, feedback);
        else if (input.nav == Direction::up || input.is_pressed(Action::menu))
        {
            top_focus_ = true;
            selected_tab_ = active_tab_;
            feedback.play(audio::Cue::tab);
        }
        else
            update_shelves(input, feedback);""")
    text = once(text, '        gfx::DrawList &list = frame.scene;', '''        gfx::DrawList &list = frame.scene;
        // Keep the animated aurora/smoke behind real game artwork.
        if (const std::uint32_t wallpaper = niak_daily_backdrop())
        {
            // Keep one wallpaper for the calendar day. L1/R1 only switch
            // top tabs; the Settings action alone changes today's choice.
            // Keep a dark readability veil while preserving actual scenery.
            list.image(wallpaper, {0, 0, gfx::kVirtualWidth, gfx::kVirtualHeight},
                       gfx::kFullUv, kWhite.with_alpha(0.85f));
            list.gradient_rect({0, 0, gfx::kVirtualWidth, gfx::kVirtualHeight}, 0,
                               Color::rgb(0x081014, 0.52f),
                               Color::rgb(0x051015, 0.65f));
        }''')
    text = once(text, "        draw_top_bar(list);\n        draw_hero(list);\n        draw_shelves(list);",
    """        draw_top_bar(list);
        if (active_tab_ < 2 || (active_tab_ == 2 && shelves_.size() > 1))
        {
            draw_hero(list);
            draw_shelves(list);
        }
        else
            draw_aux_page(list);
        // Attribution under the footer glyphs, not inside game metadata.
        ui::text(list, context_.fonts.regular, niak_daily_backdrop_caption(),
                 1825, 1061, 15, kWhite.with_alpha(0.52f),
                 gfx::Align::right);""")
    text = once(text, "    void update_shelves(const InputFrame &input, app::Feedback &feedback)\n",
    """    void update_tabs(const InputFrame &input, app::Feedback &feedback)
    {
        if (input.nav == Direction::left || input.nav == Direction::right)
        {
            selected_tab_ = std::clamp(selected_tab_ +
                (input.nav == Direction::right ? 1 : -1), 0, 3);
            feedback.play(audio::Cue::focus);
        }
        if (input.is_pressed(Action::confirm) || input.nav == Direction::down)
        {
            active_tab_ = selected_tab_;
            top_focus_ = false;
            settings_cursor_ = 0;
            row_ = active_tab_ == 2 && shelves_.size() > 1 ? 1 : 0;
            feedback.play(audio::Cue::open);
        }
        if (input.is_pressed(Action::back))
        {
            active_tab_ = 0;
            top_focus_ = false;
            feedback.play(audio::Cue::back);
        }
    }

    void update_page(const InputFrame &input, app::Feedback &feedback)
    {
        if (input.is_pressed(Action::back) || input.is_pressed(Action::menu))
        {
            top_focus_ = true;
            selected_tab_ = active_tab_;
            feedback.play(audio::Cue::back);
            return;
        }
        if (active_tab_ != 3)
        {
            if (input.nav == Direction::up)
            {
                top_focus_ = true;
                selected_tab_ = active_tab_;
            }
            return;
        }
        if (input.nav == Direction::up && settings_cursor_ == 0)
        {
            top_focus_ = true;
            selected_tab_ = active_tab_;
            return;
        }
        if (input.nav == Direction::up || input.nav == Direction::down)
        {
            settings_cursor_ = std::clamp(settings_cursor_ +
                (input.nav == Direction::down ? 1 : -1), 0, 9);
            feedback.play(audio::Cue::focus);
        }
        if (input.is_pressed(Action::confirm))
        {
            auto &s = context_.settings;
            switch (settings_cursor_)
            {
            case 0: s.resolution = (s.resolution + 1) % hui::Settings::kResolutionCount; break;
            case 1: s.ui_volume = (s.ui_volume + 1) % 11; break;
            case 2: s.music_volume = (s.music_volume + 1) % 11; break;
            case 3: s.reduced_motion = !s.reduced_motion; break;
            case 4: s.show_fps = !s.show_fps; break;
            case 5: s.haptics = !s.haptics; break;
            case 6: s.light_bar = !s.light_bar; break;
            case 7: s.sfx_volume = (s.sfx_volume + 1) % 11; break;
            case 8: niak_next_daily_backdrop(); feedback.play(audio::Cue::complete); return;
            case 9:
                settings_link_tried_=true;
                settings_link_rc_=niak_open_system_settings();
                feedback.play(settings_link_rc_==0?
                              audio::Cue::complete:audio::Cue::back);
                return; // Keep UI alive if firmware refuses the deep link.

            }
            context_.settings_changed = true;
            feedback.play(audio::Cue::complete);
        }
    }

    void draw_aux_page(gfx::DrawList &list) const
    {
        const auto &fonts = context_.fonts;
        const bool settings = active_tab_ == 3;
        ui::text(list, fonts.display, settings ? "Réglages" : "Multimédia",
                 96, 232, 78, kWhite);
        if (!settings)
        {
            ui::text(list, fonts.semibold, "Galerie de captures", 100, 333, 36,
                     palette_[3].value());
            ui::paragraph(list, fonts.regular,
                          "Acces aux captures PS5 non encore autorise depuis ce titre. "
                          "Aucune photo ou video personnelle n'est ouverte automatiquement.",
                          102, 407, 26, 1120, 40, kWhite.with_alpha(0.85f), 3);
            ui::text(list, fonts.regular, "Rond : revenir aux onglets", 102, 560, 22,
                     kWhite.with_alpha(0.55f));
            return;
        }
        // Display the one-shot helper result independently from the live
        // PLDmgr broker. A copied ELF does not imply that it is resident.
        const int install_status=niak::payload_install_status;
        // These are actual GPU textures loaded by this application, not
        // files merely visible through the separate FTP server.
        const auto &media=niak::case_media_stats;
        char media_label[128];
        ui::text(list,fonts.semibold,"Médias lus par NiakPS5",
                 1430,305,21,kWhite);
        std::snprintf(media_label,sizeof(media_label),
                      "Chargés : %u/%u | icônes : %u",
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Final native UI fixes applied after prepare.py and patch_home.py.
Strict matching deliberately fails CI whenever the pinned upstream UI changes.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse

def exactly(text, old, new, count=1):
    n=text.count(old)
    if n!=count: raise RuntimeError(f"Expected {count} matches, found {n}: {old[:80]!r}")
    return text.replace(old,new)

def patch(kit):
    p=kit/"src/concepts/aurora.cpp"
    s=p.read_text("utf-8")
    s=exactly(s,'const char *tabs[] = {"NIAK", "Jeux", "Multimédia", "Réglages"};',
                 'const char *tabs[] = {"NiakPS5", "Jeux", "Multimédia", "Réglages"};')
    # Up only selects the top bar from the FIRST row. From Homebrew row 1 it
    # must move back to row 0, working with both D-pad and left joystick.
    s=exactly(s,'else if (input.nav == Direction::up || input.is_pressed(Action::menu))',
                 'else if ((input.nav == Direction::up && row_ == 0) || input.is_pressed(Action::menu))')
    # Procedural covers are FBO textures (bottom-left); actual PS5 PNG images
    # are uploaded top-row-first and REQUIRE kFullUv. kCanvasUv flips the PNG.
    s=exactly(s,'list.image(it.cover, art, gfx::kCanvasUv, kWhite, 36);',
                 '''// The hero cross-fades two titles while navigating. Only the
        // focused game may create a tessellated 3D case each frame; the
        // departing title and all applications keep a simple 2D visual.
        // This prevents overlapping full-mesh case renders on rapid scroll.
        if(it.application || !it.title_id[0] || index != focused_item()) {
            if(it.cover)
                list.image(it.cover, art,
                           it.cover_is_image ? gfx::kFullUv : gfx::kCanvasUv,
                           kWhite, 36);
            else
                list.rounded_rect(art, 36, it.dark);
        } else {
            niak_draw_rotating_case(list,it,art,
                context_.settings.reduced_motion ? 0.0f : clock_ - case_selected_at_,
                fonts);
        }''')
    s=exactly(s,'list.image(it.cover, rect, gfx::kCanvasUv, kWhite.with_alpha(0.82f), 22);',
                 '''if(it.cover) {
                    list.image(it.cover,rect,
                               it.cover_is_image ? gfx::kFullUv : gfx::kCanvasUv,
                               kWhite.with_alpha(0.82f),22);
                } else {
                    // During idle-only streaming, unprocessed games must
                    // occupy visible shelf cards rather than empty holes.
                    // This is a neutral title card, NOT a loading screen.
                    list.rounded_rect(rect,22,it.dark);
                    list.bordered_rect(rect,22,
                        Color::rgb(0x000000,0.0f),1.5f,it.accent.with_alpha(0.55f));
                    ui::text(list,fonts.semibold,it.genre,
                             rect.x+16,rect.y+34,17,kWhite.with_alpha(0.63f));
                    ui::paragraph(list,fonts.semibold,it.title,
                                  rect.x+15,rect.y+85,19,rect.w-30,24,kWhite,3);
                }''')
    # Focused game tile is itself the animated physical PS4/PS5 case, not a
    # splash screen or a new loader. Unfocused tiles remain native flat icons;
    # homebrew titles always retain their app icon.
    s=exactly(s,'list.image(it.cover, ring, gfx::kCanvasUv, kWhite, 26);',
                 'list.image(it.cover, ring, it.cover_is_image ? gfx::kFullUv : gfx::kCanvasUv, kWhite, 26);')
    # Reset the case's on-card animation on each D-pad/stick focus change.
    s=exactly(s,'                shelf.column = next;',
                 '                shelf.column = next;\n                case_selected_at_ = clock_;')
    s=exactly(s,'                row_ = next;',

    # The details sheet displays the same selected-game case in place of the

        '"Croix : modifier  /  Haut : barre de navigation  /  Rond : retour"':'"Croix : modifier  /  Haut : navigation  /  Rond : retour"',
```

`native/title/prepare.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Prepare a dedicated NiakPS5 GPU-native title from pinned PS5_VKHomebrewUI.
Run ONLY on a fresh staging checkout; does not change system or console files.
"""
import argparse
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import re

TITLE_ID = "PPSA99386"

def replace_once(path, old, new):
    text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    count = text.count(old)
    if count != 1:
        raise SystemExit(f"Expected one anchor in {path}: {old[:60]!r}; found {count}")
    path.write_text(text.replace(old, new, 1), encoding="utf-8")

def prepare(kit: Path, project: Path, revision: str):
    registry = kit / "src/concepts/registry.cpp"
    reg = registry.read_text()
    begin = reg.index("    static constexpr ConceptFactory kFactories[] = {")
    end = reg.index("    };", begin) + len("    };")
    reg = reg[:begin] + "    static constexpr ConceptFactory kFactories[] = {concepts::make_aurora};" + reg[end:]
    registry.write_text(reg)

    aurora = kit / "src/concepts/aurora.cpp"

bool Catalog::stream_next_covers(gfx::Renderer &renderer,
                                 const ui::Fonts &fonts,std::size_t budget)
{
    constexpr float kSize''')
    replace_once(art_file,
        '    int index = 0;\n    for (Item &item : items_)\n    {\n        // Prefer the true installed app icon',
        '''    budget=std::min(budget,cover_stream_.remaining());
    for(std::size_t step=0;step<budget;++step)
    {
        const int hint=niak::case_media_stats.preferred_index;
        const auto priority=hint>=0?static_cast<std::size_t>(hint):
                                    niak::CoverStreamState::invalid;
        const auto choice=cover_stream_.take(priority);
        if(choice==niak::CoverStreamState::invalid)break;
        Item &item=items_[choice];
        int index=static_cast<int>(choice);
        // Prefer the true installed app icon''')
    # Only the currently selected game gets newly downloaded case textures,
    # and those GPU uploads run on the renderer thread (not the HTTP worker).
    replace_once(art_file, '\n} // namespace hui::demo',
    """
// Enqueue at most two missing title IDs per ~600 idle frames. Never repeat
// local file decoding just to retry a temporarily unavailable HTTP endpoint.
// Focus gets priority; one round-robin entry also recovers the rest of the
// library when the local service starts after NiakPS5.
void Catalog::retry_missing_game_icons() {
#if defined(__PROSPERO__)
    const int focused=niak::case_media_stats.preferred_index;
    if(focused>=0 && static_cast<std::size_t>(focused)<items_.size()) {
        const Item &item=items_[static_cast<std::size_t>(focused)];
        if(item.title_id[0] && !item.cover_is_image)
            niak_request_missing_game_icon(item.title_id);
    }
    if(items_.empty())return;
    for(std::size_t n=0;n<items_.size();++n) {
        const auto index=(icon_retry_cursor_+n)%items_.size();
        const Item &item=items_[index];
        if(!item.title_id[0] || item.cover_is_image)continue;
        niak_request_missing_game_icon(item.title_id);
        icon_retry_cursor_=(index+1)%items_.size();
        break;
    }
#endif
}

// The single HTTP worker never holds a GPU texture or Item pointer. Consume
// one response after navigation settles, replacing a generated tile in place.
bool Catalog::refresh_pending_game_icons(gfx::Renderer &renderer) {
    char id[16]{};
    const auto handle=niak_take_downloaded_game_icon(renderer,id);
    if(!handle)return false;
    const auto it=std::find_if(items_.begin(),items_.end(),
        [&](const Item &item) {
            return item.title_id[0] && std::strcmp(item.title_id,id)==0;
        });
    if(it==items_.end() || it->cover_is_image) {
        renderer.destroy_texture(handle);
        return false;
    }
    if(it->cover)renderer.destroy_texture(it->cover);
    it->cover=handle;
    it->cover_is_image=true;
    ++niak::case_media_stats.icons;
    return true;
}

// One local CPU-decoded pic1 texture may arrive after a selection change.
// Only the current game without an official front may own that GPU handle.
bool Catalog::refresh_pending_case_background(gfx::Renderer &renderer) {
    char title_id[16]{};
    float aspect=16.0f/9.0f;
    auto texture=niak_take_downloaded_game_background(
        renderer,title_id,&aspect);
    if(!texture)return false;
    const int focus=niak::case_media_stats.preferred_index;
    if(focus<0 || static_cast<std::size_t>(focus)>=items_.size()) {
        niak_destroy_case_texture(renderer,texture);
        return false;
    }
    Item &item=items_[static_cast<std::size_t>(focus)];
    if(std::strcmp(item.title_id,title_id)!=0 || item.application ||
       item.case_front || item.case_scene) {
        niak_destroy_case_texture(renderer,texture);
        return false;
    }
    item.case_scene=texture;
    item.case_scene_aspect=aspect;
    ++niak::case_media_stats.scenes;
    return true;
}

// The worker returns only already scaled pixels. Refuse obsolete titles
// BEFORE allocating their textures, then bind one approved scan per idle frame.
bool Catalog::refresh_pending_case_art(gfx::Renderer &renderer) {
    const int focus=niak::case_media_stats.preferred_index;
    if(focus<0 || static_cast<std::size_t>(focus)>=items_.size())return false;
    Item &selected=items_[static_cast<std::size_t>(focus)];
    if(!selected.title_id[0] || selected.application)return false;
    char side[16]{};
    float aspect=1.0f;
    auto handle=niak_take_prepared_case_art(
        renderer,selected.title_id,side,&aspect);
    if(!handle)return false;
    std::uint32_t *destination=nullptr;
    float *destination_aspect=nullptr;
    if(std::strcmp(side,"front")==0)destination=&selected.case_front;
    else if(std::strcmp(side,"back")==0)destination=&selected.case_back;
    else if(std::strcmp(side,"spine")==0)destination=&selected.case_spine;
    else if(std::strcmp(side,"logo")==0) {
        destination=&selected.logo_art;
        destination_aspect=&selected.logo_art_aspect;
    } else if(std::strcmp(side,"poster")==0) {
        destination=&selected.case_poster;
        destination_aspect=&selected.poster_aspect;
    } else if(std::strcmp(side,"hero")==0) {
        destination=&selected.case_hero;
        destination_aspect=&selected.case_hero_aspect;
    } else if(std::strcmp(side,"shot1")==0) {
        destination=&selected.case_shot1;
        destination_aspect=&selected.case_shot1_aspect;
    } else if(std::strcmp(side,"shot2")==0) {
        destination=&selected.case_shot2;
        destination_aspect=&selected.case_shot2_aspect;
    }
    const bool redundant=(selected.case_front &&
        (std::strcmp(side,"logo")==0 || std::strcmp(side,"poster")==0)) ||
        (selected.case_back &&
        (std::strcmp(side,"shot1")==0 || std::strcmp(side,"shot2")==0 ||
         (std::strcmp(side,"hero")==0 && selected.case_front)));
    if(!destination || *destination || redundant) {
        niak_destroy_case_texture(renderer,handle);
        return false;
    }
    *destination=handle;
    if(destination_aspect)*destination_aspect=aspect;
    if(selected.case_front) {
        niak_destroy_case_texture(renderer,selected.logo_art);
        niak_destroy_case_texture(renderer,selected.case_poster);
        niak_destroy_case_texture(renderer,selected.case_scene);
        selected.case_template_front=0;
    }
    if(selected.case_back) {
        if(selected.case_front)
            niak_destroy_case_texture(renderer,selected.case_hero);
        niak_destroy_case_texture(renderer,selected.case_shot1);
        niak_destroy_case_texture(renderer,selected.case_shot2);
        selected.case_template_back=0;
    }
    if(selected.case_spine)selected.case_template_spine=0;
    auto &stats=niak::case_media_stats;
    stats.fronts=stats.backs=stats.spines=stats.scenes=stats.templates=0;
    for(const Item &item:items_) {
        stats.fronts+=item.case_front!=0;
        stats.backs+=item.case_back!=0;
        stats.spines+=item.case_spine!=0;
        stats.scenes+=item.case_scene!=0;
        stats.templates+=item.case_template_front!=0 &&
                         item.case_template_back!=0 &&
                         item.case_template_spine!=0;
    }
    return true;
}

bool Catalog::refresh_selected_case_art(gfx::Renderer &renderer)
{
    const int index=niak::case_media_stats.preferred_index;
    const auto case_status=niak_case_art_download_status();
    const unsigned completed=case_status.completed;
    if(index<0 || static_cast<std::size_t>(index)>=items_.size())return false;
    const bool same_focus=index==last_case_focus_;
    // A focus change must not decode an entire sleeve in one idle frame.
    // Eleven stages also permit individually refreshing newly cached sides.
    if(same_focus && completed==last_case_completed_ &&
       case_hydration_step_>=11u)
        return false;
    if(!same_focus || completed!=last_case_completed_)
        case_hydration_step_=0;
    if(same_focus && completed!=last_case_completed_)
        niak_invalidate_prepared_case_art(
            items_[static_cast<std::size_t>(index)].title_id);
    if(index!=last_case_focus_) {
        // Keep only the current and immediate previous 3D case resident.
        // Previous focus survives one transition to avoid visual popping.
        const int retire=retained_case_focus_;
        if(retire>=0 && retire!=index && retire!=last_case_focus_ &&
           static_cast<std::size_t>(retire)<items_.size()) {
            Item &old=items_[static_cast<std::size_t>(retire)];
            for(std::uint32_t *texture : {&old.case_front,&old.case_back,
                 &old.case_spine,&old.case_scene,&old.logo_art,
                 &old.case_poster,&old.case_hero,&old.case_shot1,
                 &old.case_shot2})
                niak_destroy_case_texture(renderer,*texture);
            // Shared templates have their own lifecycle.
            old.case_template_front=0;
            old.case_template_back=0;
            old.case_template_spine=0;
        }
        retained_case_focus_=last_case_focus_;
    }
    last_case_focus_=index;
    last_case_completed_=completed;
    std::array<bool,7> updated{};
    for(std::size_t side=0;side<updated.size();++side)
        updated[side]=same_focus &&
            case_status.sides_completed[side]!=last_case_sides_[side];
    last_case_sides_=case_status.sides_completed;
    // Show CURRENT resident media, not historical texture creations.
    // Reconcile only on focus changes and completed CDN downloads.
    const auto recount_case_faces=[&] {
        auto &stats=niak::case_media_stats;
        stats.fronts=stats.backs=stats.spines=stats.scenes=stats.templates=0;
        for(const Item &entry:items_) {
            stats.fronts+=entry.case_front!=0;
            stats.backs+=entry.case_back!=0;
            stats.spines+=entry.case_spine!=0;
            stats.scenes+=entry.case_scene!=0;
            stats.templates+=entry.case_template_front!=0 &&
                entry.case_template_back!=0 &&
                entry.case_template_spine!=0;
        }
    };
    Item &selected=items_[static_cast<std::size_t>(index)];
    if(selected.application || !selected.title_id[0]) {
        case_hydration_step_=11u; // No retail box for app/system placeholders.
        recount_case_faces();
        return false;
    }
    bool changed=false;
    // Only invalidate faces belonging to the SAME title. The worker's
    // completion counters are global: switching games must never interpret
    // a previous game's download as a new change for this selected game.
    // Release only the affected face, not the whole 3D case.
    for(std::pair<bool,std::uint32_t*> updated_side : {
         std::pair<bool,std::uint32_t*>{updated[0],&selected.case_front},
         {updated[1],&selected.case_back},
         {updated[2],&selected.case_spine},
         {updated[3],&selected.logo_art},
         {updated[4],&selected.case_hero},
         {updated[5],&selected.case_shot1},
         {updated[6],&selected.case_shot2}})
        if(updated_side.first)
            niak_destroy_case_texture(renderer,*updated_side.second);
    const auto missing=[&](std::uint32_t &texture,const char *side,
                           float *aspect=nullptr) {
        if(texture)return;
        texture=niak_load_case_art(renderer,selected.title_id,side,aspect);
        changed |= texture!=0;
    };
    const char *platform=selected.title_id[0]=='C'?"ps4":"ps5";
    // At most ONE expensive image decode/upload for each idle tick.
    // Front/back/spine are prioritized ahead of the recomposed paper faces.
    switch(case_hydration_step_++) {
    case 0: missing(selected.case_front,"front"); break;
    case 1: missing(selected.case_back,"back"); break;
    case 2: missing(selected.case_spine,"spine"); break;
    case 3:
        if(!selected.case_front && !selected.case_template_front)
            selected.case_template_front=niak_load_case_template(
                renderer,platform,"front");
        break;
    case 4:
        if(!selected.case_front && !selected.case_scene)
            selected.case_scene=niak_load_game_background(
                renderer,selected.title_id,&selected.case_scene_aspect);
        break;
    case 5:
        if(!selected.case_front)
            missing(selected.case_poster,"poster",&selected.poster_aspect);
        break;
    case 6:
        // One fanart allocation can serve either missing face.
        if(!selected.case_front || !selected.case_back)
            missing(selected.case_hero,"hero",&selected.case_hero_aspect);
        break;
    case 7:
        if(!selected.case_back && !selected.case_template_back)
            selected.case_template_back=niak_load_case_template(
                renderer,platform,"back");
        break;
    case 8:
        if(!selected.case_back)
            missing(selected.case_shot1,"shot1",&selected.case_shot1_aspect);
        break;
    case 9:
        if(!selected.case_back)
            missing(selected.case_shot2,"shot2",&selected.case_shot2_aspect);
        break;
    case 10:
        if(!selected.case_spine && !selected.case_template_spine)
            selected.case_template_spine=niak_load_case_template(
                renderer,platform,"spine");
        break;
    default: break;
    }
    // A newly arrived official retail scan replaces ONLY its face.
    // Free fallback media no longer drawn for that face, but keep the
    // installed background while a missing FRONT still needs it.
    if(selected.case_front) {
        niak_destroy_case_texture(renderer,selected.logo_art);
        niak_destroy_case_texture(renderer,selected.case_poster);
        selected.case_template_front=0; // shared template stays resident
    }
    if(selected.case_back) {
        // A missing FRONT may still display this shared fanart background.
        if(selected.case_front)
            niak_destroy_case_texture(renderer,selected.case_hero);
        niak_destroy_case_texture(renderer,selected.case_shot1);
        niak_destroy_case_texture(renderer,selected.case_shot2);
        selected.case_template_back=0;
    }
    if(selected.case_spine)
        selected.case_template_spine=0;
    if(selected.case_front)
        niak_destroy_case_texture(renderer,selected.case_scene);
    recount_case_faces();
    return changed;
}
} // namespace hui::demo""")

    # Defer streaming when the user is holding a direction or pressing an
    # action, to avoid a blocking filesystem lookup during navigation.
    # GPU texture creation remains on the renderer's owning thread.
    replace_once(kit / "src/main.cpp",
        '        shell.update(input, dt);',
        '''        shell.update(input, dt);
        // Load the new focused title on the FIRST idle frame; during rapid

            input.nav==Direction::none && input.pressed==0 &&

        // PLDmgr or title-mount services may start AFTER Catalog construction.

        if(!tour && frames>0 && frames%600u==0 &&

    # A single failed procedural GPU upload must not leave the progressive
    # loader retrying the same title forever on every subsequent idle frame.
    replace_once(art_file,
        '        if (item.cover == 0)\n            return false;',

            // Already marked attempted: avoid an endless retry loop.
            return false;
        }''')
    replace_once(kit / "src/main.cpp", '#include "demo/catalog.hpp"',
                 '#include "demo/catalog.hpp"\n#include "niak/daily_backdrop.hpp"\n#include "niak/profile.hpp"\n#include "niak/one_shot_install.hpp"\n#include "niak/asset_stats.hpp"')
    replace_once(kit / "src/main.cpp",
        '    sys::log("[HUI] entry");',
        '    sys::log("[HUI] entry");\n'
        '    const int payload_install = niak::bootstrap_own_payload();\n'
        '    niak::payload_install_status = payload_install;\n'
        '    sys::log("[NiakPS5] one-shot own payload install status=%d", payload_install);')
    replace_once(kit / "src/main.cpp", '    demo::Catalog catalog;',

    replace_once(aurora, '#include "ui/glyphs.hpp"',
                 '#include "ui/glyphs.hpp"\n#include "niak/daily_backdrop.hpp"')
    # The PacBrew SQLite build references localtime_r, not exported by the

    (src_niak / "localtime_compat.c").write_text(
        """/* SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later */
#include <time.h>
#include <pthread.h>
static pthread_mutex_t niak_time_lock = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
struct tm *localtime_r(const time_t *stamp, struct tm *dest) {
    if (!stamp || !dest) return NULL;
    if (pthread_mutex_lock(&niak_time_lock) != 0) return NULL;
    struct tm *shared = localtime(stamp);
    if (shared) *dest = *shared;
    (void)pthread_mutex_unlock(&niak_time_lock);

""", encoding="utf-8")
    # PacBrew sqlite static archive + header are selected at build time.

    # Avoid byte-wise ASCII uppercasing: it breaks accented French headings.

                            'shelves_[static_cast<std::size_t>(row_)].title')
    visual = visual.replace('ui::upper(it.genre)', 'it.genre')
    visual = visual.replace('it.progress > 0.0f ? "Resume" : "Play"',
                            'it.title_id[0] ? "Jouer" : "Indisponible"')
    extra = visual.find('        const Rect more{x + 240, 540, 64, 64};')
    extra_end = visual.find('        list.pop_opacity();', extra)
    if extra < 0 or extra_end < 0:
        raise SystemExit("Upstream hero actions changed; review required")
    visual = visual[:extra] + visual[extra_end:]
    time_start = visual.find('        ui::text(list, fonts.regular, "21:47"')
    time_end = visual.find('        list.circle(1800, 82, 22,', time_start)
    if time_start < 0 or time_end < 0:
        raise SystemExit("Upstream top bar clock changed; review required")
    clock = """        // The console clock, not a hardcoded demo time.
        char clock_text[8] = "--:--";
        const std::time_t wall = std::time(nullptr);
        if (const std::tm *local = std::localtime(&wall))
            std::strftime(clock_text, sizeof(clock_text), "%H:%M", local);
        ui::text(list, fonts.regular, clock_text, 1760, 92, 26,
                 kWhite.with_alpha(0.8f), gfx::Align::right);
"""
    visual = visual[:time_start] + clock + visual[time_end:]
    if '"21:47"' in visual or 'std::snprintf(text, sizeof(text), "%.1f"' in visual:
        raise SystemExit("Fake clock or rating remains in Aurora")
    aurora.write_text(visual, encoding="utf-8")

    # Give the title a clear, stand-alone NiakPS5 identity instead of UI Lab.
    print(f"NiakPS5 title staged as {TITLE_ID}; one home design, real catalogue only")

CATALOG_CPP = r'''// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// NiakPS5 read-only PS5 installed title catalogue (no invented installed games).
#include "demo/catalog.hpp"
#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif
#include "niak/catalog.h"
#include "niak/shadowmount_api.h"
#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif
#include "platform/ps5/system.hpp"
#include "niak/title_meta.hpp"
#include "niak/app_classification.hpp"
#include "niak/broker_catalog.hpp"
#include "niak/broker_snapshot.h"
#include "niak/local_inventory.h"
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <vector>

namespace hui::demo
{
Catalog::Catalog()
{
    reload();
}

bool Catalog::refresh_if_unavailable(gfx::Renderer &renderer,
                                     const ui::Fonts &fonts)
{
    // Only a synthetic placeholder can be refreshed here. Existing shelves
    // and real installed game identities must never be replaced mid-session.
    if(items_.size()!=1 || items_[0].title_id[0]!=0)return false;
    NiakGame probe{};
    // The PLDmgr socket may be blocked by the title sandbox even when
    // ShadowMount or an installed game directory becomes readable later.
    // Do not permanently require the broker as the ONLY recovery gate.
    const bool available=
        niak_scan_broker_games(&probe,1)>0 ||
        niak_scan_installed_folders("",&probe,1)>0 ||
        niak_scan_homebrews("",&probe,1)>0 ||
        niak_scan_shadowmount(&probe,1)>0 ||
        niak_scan_games("/system_data/priv/mms/app.db","",&probe,1)>0;
    if(!available)return false;
    release_covers(renderer);
    items_.clear();
    owned_titles_.clear();
    owned_blurbs_.clear();
    reload();
    (void)build_covers(renderer,fonts);
    return !items_.empty() && items_[0].title_id[0]!=0;
    // Only signal a view rebuild when real game identities were restored.
}

void Catalog::reload()
{
    std::vector<NiakGame> games(NIAKPS5_MAX_GAMES);
    const int db_count = niak_scan_games("/system_data/priv/mms/app.db", "",
                                         games.data(), games.size());
    std::size_t count = db_count > 0 ? static_cast<std::size_t>(db_count) : 0;
    // Same privileged ELF already hosts the strictly-local launch broker.
    // It can enumerate fixed installed game roots without elevating the GUI.
    std::vector<NiakGame> broker_games(NIAKPS5_MAX_GAMES);
    const int broker_count=niak_scan_broker_games(broker_games.data(),broker_games.size());
    if(broker_count>0)
        for(int n=0;n<broker_count && count<games.size();++n) {
            const NiakGame &candidate=broker_games[static_cast<std::size_t>(n)];
            std::size_t i=0;
            for(;i<count;++i)if(std::strcmp(games[i].id,candidate.id)==0)break;
            if(i==count)games[count++]=candidate;
        }
    // PS5 user title sandbox may deny app.db. Discover valid /data/homebrew
    // structures independently, even when app.db is missing or inaccessible.
    std::vector<NiakGame> api_games(NIAKPS5_MAX_GAMES);
    const int api_count = niak_scan_shadowmount(api_games.data(), api_games.size());
    if (api_count > 0)
    {
        for (int n = 0; n < api_count && count < games.size(); ++n)
        {
            const NiakGame &candidate = api_games[static_cast<std::size_t>(n)];
            std::size_t i=0;
            for (;i<count;++i)if(std::strcmp(games[i].id,candidate.id)==0)break;
            if (i==count)games[count++]=candidate;
            else if (candidate.title[0])std::snprintf(games[i].title,sizeof(games[i].title),
                        "%s",candidate.title);
        }
    }
    // A sandbox may deny app.db. Independently walk available installed
    // title folders, including user-installed PS5 streaming/media applications.
    std::vector<NiakGame> folders(NIAKPS5_MAX_GAMES);
    const int folder_count=niak_scan_installed_folders(
        "",folders.data(),folders.size());
    if(folder_count>0)
        for(int n=0;n<folder_count && count<games.size();++n) {
            const NiakGame &found=folders[static_cast<std::size_t>(n)];
            std::size_t i=0;
            for(;i<count;++i)if(std::strcmp(games[i].id,found.id)==0)break;
            if(i==count)games[count++]=found;
            else {
                if(found.application_category)
                    games[i].application_category=found.application_category;
                // Use localized installed manifest titles across the entire
                // shelf, rather than retaining English app.db names.
                if(found.title[0] && std::strcmp(found.title,found.id)!=0)
                    std::snprintf(games[i].title,sizeof(games[i].title),
                                  "%s",found.title);
                if(!games[i].installed_at[0])
                    std::snprintf(games[i].installed_at,sizeof(games[i].installed_at),
                                  "%s",found.installed_at);
            }
        }
    std::vector<NiakGame> homebrews(NIAKPS5_MAX_GAMES);
    const int home_count = niak_scan_homebrews("", homebrews.data(), homebrews.size());
    if (home_count > 0)
    {
        for (int n = 0; n < home_count && count < games.size(); ++n)
        {
            const NiakGame &candidate = homebrews[static_cast<std::size_t>(n)];
            bool already_seen = false;
            for (std::size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i)
                if (std::strcmp(games[i].id, candidate.id) == 0)
                    already_seen = true;
            if (!already_seen)
                games[count++] = candidate;
            else {
                // Preserve the explicit homebrew origin even when app.db
                // discovered the same title first.
                for (std::size_t i=0;i<count;++i)
                    if (std::strcmp(games[i].id,candidate.id)==0) {
                        games[i].is_homebrew=1;
                        games[i].discovered_from_homebrew=1;
                        if(candidate.title[0] &&
                           std::strcmp(candidate.title,candidate.id)!=0)
                            std::snprintf(games[i].title,sizeof(games[i].title),
                                          "%s",candidate.title);
                        break;
                    }
            }
        }
    }
    // The PLDmgr broker sees param.json where the sandbox sees only IDs.
    // Read the second, equally fresh/validated subset: category is applied
    // ONLY to titles already in the live merged inventory, never promoted
    // from an old standalone record.
    std::vector<NiakGame> verified_apps(NIAKPS5_MAX_GAMES);
    int verified_count=niak_snapshot_read(NIAK_APPS_SNAPSHOT_APP_FILE,
                                          verified_apps.data(),verified_apps.size());
    if(verified_count<0)
        verified_count=niak_snapshot_read(NIAK_APPS_SNAPSHOT_APP_SOURCE,
                                          verified_apps.data(),verified_apps.size());
    if(verified_count<0)
        verified_count=niak_snapshot_read(NIAK_APPS_SNAPSHOT_FILE,
                                          verified_apps.data(),verified_apps.size());
    if(verified_count>0) {
        for(int j=0;j<verified_count;++j)
            for(std::size_t i=0;i<count;++i)
                if(std::strcmp(games[i].id,
                               verified_apps[static_cast<std::size_t>(j)].id)==0) {
                    games[i].application_category=2;
                    break;
                }
    }
    sys::log("[NiakPS5] verified apps: %d; inventory=%zu",
             verified_count,count);
    // Local FTP metadata enriches ONLY live IDs: never resurrect stale apps.
    std::vector<NiakGame> observed(games.size());
    int cached_count=niak_scan_local_inventory(
        "/app0/assets/niak-local-titles.tsv",observed.data(),observed.size());
    if(cached_count<0)
        cached_count=niak_scan_local_inventory(
            "/data/homebrew/PPSA99386/assets/niak-local-titles.tsv",
            observed.data(),observed.size());
    if(count>0 && cached_count>0) {
        for(int j=0;j<cached_count;++j) {
            const auto &record=observed[static_cast<std::size_t>(j)];
            for(std::size_t i=0;i<count;++i)
                if(std::strcmp(games[i].id,record.id)==0) {
                    // Fresh, broker-verified applications cannot be
                    // downgraded by a historical FTP "Jeu" label.
                    if(record.application_category &&
                       games[i].application_category!=2)
                        games[i].application_category=record.application_category;
                    // The FTP overlay is sourced from THIS installed ID's
                    // signed/validated param.json. Its fr-FR title overrides
                    // app.db's generic English titleName where available.
                    if(record.title[0])
                        std::snprintf(games[i].title,sizeof(games[i].title),
                                      "%s",record.title);
                    break;
                }
        }
    } else if(count==0 && cached_count>0) {
        // Last-known FTP list is fallback only, not a live inventory.
        for(int j=0;j<cached_count && count<games.size();++j)
            games[count++]=observed[static_cast<std::size_t>(j)];
    }
    sys::log("[NiakPS5] cached FTP fallback: %d titles (historical snapshot)",
             cached_count);
    sys::log("[NiakPS5] catalog: db=%d, broker=%d, folders=%d, homebrew=%d, api=%d, unique=%zu",
             db_count, broker_count, folder_count, home_count, api_count, count);
    if (count > 0)
    {
        for (std::size_t n = 0; n < count; ++n)
        {
            const NiakGame &game = games[n];
            NiakTitleMetadata meta;
            const bool known=niak_title_metadata(game.id,meta);
            const bool has_real_name=game.title[0] && std::strcmp(game.title,game.id)!=0;
            owned_titles_.emplace_back(has_real_name ? game.title : known ? meta.name : game.id);
            const std::string summary=known ? niak_title_summary(meta) : "";
            const std::string description=niak_title_overview(game.id);
            // Unknown metadata stays empty rather than showing invented prose.
            // Keep factual metadata visible even when LaunchBox also has a
            // full editorial overview; show verified facts FIRST.
            std::string detail=summary;
            if(game.discovered_from_homebrew==3)
                detail="Dernier inventaire FTP : présence actuelle non vérifiée.";
            if(!description.empty()) {
                if(!detail.empty())detail+=" — ";
                detail+=description;
            }
            if(detail.size()>900)detail.resize(900);
            owned_blurbs_.emplace_back(std::move(detail));
            Item item{};
            item.title = owned_titles_.back().c_str();
            // A homebrew is an installation origin, not a media category.
            // Use the verified title category below for visible labels.
            item.genre = game.id[0]=='C' ? "PS4" : "PS5";
            // The current scanner has no trusted category for native titles.
            // Homebrew folders are initially classified as applications.
            // The verified category wins over the installation origin.
            // Previously, the unconditional trailing "else" overwrote this
            // classification for virtually every game/media application.
            item.application=niak_application_category(
                game.id,owned_titles_.back().c_str(),game.application_category,
                game.is_homebrew,known && meta.category=="Application",
                known && meta.category=="Jeu");
            item.studio=game.discovered_from_homebrew==3
                ? "Dernier inventaire local" :
                item.application ? "Application installée" : "Jeu installé";
            const char *last=game.last_access;
            const char *installed=game.installed_at;
            const char *recent=std::strcmp(last,installed)>=0?last:installed;
            std::snprintf(item.recently_used,sizeof(item.recently_used),"%s",recent);
            item.blurb = owned_blurbs_.back().c_str();
            item.homebrew = game.is_homebrew != 0;
            item.year = 0;
            item.rating = 0;
            item.progress = 0;
            item.hours = 0;
            item.players = 1;
            item.dark = gfx::Color::rgb(0x081719);
            item.mid = gfx::Color::rgb(0x183e44);
            item.accent = gfx::Color::rgb(0x91f5df);
            std::snprintf(item.title_id, sizeof(item.title_id), "%s", game.id);
            items_.push_back(item);
        }
    }
    else
    {
        // A truthful non-launchable placeholder, not a fictitious installed game.
        owned_titles_.emplace_back("Bibliothèque indisponible");
        Item item{};
        item.title = owned_titles_.back().c_str();
        item.studio = "NIAKPS5";
        item.genre = "VERIFICATION";
        // The catalog can be empty for three fundamentally different
        // reasons; avoid blaming app.db when PLDmgr DID answer successfully.
        item.blurb = broker_count==0
            ? "Inventaire local disponible, mais aucun titre valide n'est visible. Vérifier les droits et les chemins des jeux."
            : broker_count>0
                ? "Titres renvoyés par PLDmgr, mais aucun titre valide n'a été intégré. Consulter le journal NiakPS5."
            : db_count<0 && folder_count<0 && home_count<0 && api_count<0
                ? "Toutes les sources du catalogue sont inaccessibles. Vérifier que niakps5.elf est exécuté par PLDmgr."
            : db_count<0
                ? "app.db inaccessible et aucune autre source n'a fourni de titre valide."
                : "Aucun titre installé valide détecté par les sources accessibles.";
        item.year = 0;
        item.rating = 0;
        item.progress = 0;
        item.hours = 0;
        item.players = 1;
        item.dark = gfx::Color::rgb(0x081719);
        item.mid = gfx::Color::rgb(0x163039);
        item.accent = gfx::Color::rgb(0x91f5df);
        items_.push_back(item);
    }
    // The first streamed cover must match the first focused game shelf
    // (most recently played or installed), not an arbitrary SQLite row.
    // Item pointers refer to stable string storage in owned_* deques.
    std::stable_sort(items_.begin(),items_.end(),
        [](const Item &a,const Item &b) {
            if(a.application!=b.application)return !a.application;
            const int recent=std::strcmp(a.recently_used,b.recently_used);
            if(recent!=0)return recent>0;
            return std::strcmp(a.title,b.title)<0;
        });
}
} // namespace hui::demo
'''

if __name__ == "__main__":
```

`native/title/private_preview.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Render the REAL user-supplied PS4/PS5 bands/footers in native OpenGL locally.

GitHub's public preview intentionally uses original QA assets. This helper
replaces only the temporary HOST preview textures, never repository assets,
Sony title files, console data or PLDmgr configuration.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
from importlib.util import module_from_spec, spec_from_file_location
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]

def sibling_module(name:str):
    location=Path(__file__).resolve().with_name(name+".py")
    spec=spec_from_file_location("niak_"+name,location)
    if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
        raise RuntimeError("Missing NiakPS5 Python module: "+name)
    module=module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module

def stage_private_templates(kit:Path, archive:Path):
    installer=sibling_module("ftp_install")
    images=installer.load_private_template_zip(archive)
    if set(images)!=set(installer.TEMPLATE_NAMES):
        missing=set(installer.TEMPLATE_NAMES)-set(images)
        raise ValueError("Six exact PS4/PS5 templates required; missing: "+
                         ", ".join(sorted(missing)))
    target=kit/"assets"/"niak-preview-templates"
    target.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    for name,content in sorted(images.items()):
        (target/name).write_bytes(content)
    return target

def render_private_preview(kit:Path, archive:Path, output:Path):
    if not (kit/"host"/"snapshot_main.cpp").is_file():
        raise ValueError("Host renderer kit absent. Build NiakPS5 first.")
    main=kit/"host"/"snapshot_main.cpp"
    if "NIAK_CASE_TOUR" not in main.read_text("utf-8"):
        sibling_module("host_preview").patch(kit)  # One-time patch of pinned upstream OpenGL host renderer.
    fixtures=stage_private_templates(kit,archive)
    env=os.environ.copy()
    env.update({
        "LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE":"1",
        "EGL_PLATFORM":"surfaceless",
        "GALLIUM_DRIVER":"llvmpipe",
        "NIAK_CASE_TEMPLATE_ASSETS":str(fixtures.resolve()),
        "NIAK_CASE_PREVIEW_ASSETS":str((kit/"assets"/"niak-preview-cases").resolve()),
        "NIAK_CASE_PREVIEW_MEDIA":str((kit/"assets"/"niak-preview-media").resolve()),
    })
    driver=kit/"tools"/"host-snapshots.sh"
    if not driver.is_file():
        raise ValueError("Pinned OpenGL snapshot driver absent")
    output.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    command=["bash",str(driver),str(output),"aurora","1920","1080"]
    subprocess.run(command,env=env,check=True,cwd=ROOT)
    env["NIAK_CASE_TOUR"]="1"
    subprocess.run(command,env=env,check=True,cwd=ROOT)
    subprocess.run([sys.executable,str(ROOT/"native/title/validate_preview.py"),
                    str(output)],check=True,cwd=ROOT)
    print("PRIVATE CASE PREVIEW: PASS")
    print("Real immutable PS4/PS5 templates used:",fixtures)
    print("Preview screenshots:",output)

def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--templates-zip",type=Path,required=True,
                        help="User's private six-template ZIP; never uploaded")
    parser.add_argument("--kit",type=Path,
                        default=ROOT/".build"/"ps5-title-kit")
    parser.add_argument("--output",type=Path,
                        default=ROOT/"build"/"niak-preview-private")
    args=parser.parse_args()
    render_private_preview(args.kit.resolve(),args.templates_zip.resolve(),
                           args.output.resolve())

if __name__=="__main__":
    main()
```

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
// Only the current user's display name; never logs, persists or transmits it.
#include "niak/profile.hpp"
#include "niak/game_icons.hpp"
#include "gfx/renderer.hpp"
#include "niak/avatar_dds.hpp"
#include <vector>
#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <ctime>
extern "C" {
int sceUserServiceGetForegroundUser(int *user);
int sceUserServiceGetUserName(int user, char *name, std::size_t capacity);
}
const char *niak_ps5_user_label()
{
    static char label[72]="Profil PS5 indisponible";
    static std::time_t checked_at=0;
    const std::time_t now=std::time(nullptr);
    // A profile can change while the title remains alive. Refresh once
    // per wall-clock second, not at every rendered frame.
    if(!checked_at || now!=checked_at) {
        checked_at=now;
        int user=-1;
        char name[64]{};
        if(sceUserServiceGetForegroundUser(&user)==0 && user>=0 &&
           sceUserServiceGetUserName(user,name,sizeof(name))==0 &&
           name[0] && std::strlen(name)<sizeof(name))
            std::snprintf(label,sizeof(label),"%s",name);
        else
            std::snprintf(label,sizeof(label),"%s","Profil PS5 indisponible");
    }
    return label;
}

static std::uint32_t niak_load_dds_avatar(
    hui::gfx::Renderer &renderer,const char *path) {
    std::FILE *file=std::fopen(path,"rb");
    if(!file)return 0;
    if(std::fseek(file,0,SEEK_END)!=0){std::fclose(file);return 0;}
    const long size=std::ftell(file);
    if(size<144||size>2*1024*1024||std::fseek(file,0,SEEK_SET)!=0)
    {std::fclose(file);return 0;}
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> encoded(static_cast<std::size_t>(size));
    const bool ok=std::fread(encoded.data(),1,encoded.size(),file)==encoded.size();
    std::fclose(file);
    if(!ok)return 0;
    int width=0,height=0;
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> rgba;
    if(!niak_decode_avatar_dds(encoded.data(),encoded.size(),width,height,rgba))
        return 0;
    return renderer.create_texture(width,height,rgba.data());
}
static std::uint32_t niak_user_avatar=0;
static int niak_avatar_owner=-1;
void niak_profile_load_avatar(hui::gfx::Renderer &renderer)
{
    // A foreground-user switch must never leak an old account's GPU texture.
    if(niak_user_avatar)renderer.destroy_texture(niak_user_avatar);
    niak_user_avatar=0;
    niak_avatar_owner=-1;
    int current=-1;
    if(sceUserServiceGetForegroundUser(&current)!=0 || current<0)return;
    niak_avatar_owner=current;
    char identity[16]{};
    std::snprintf(identity,sizeof(identity),"0x%08X",
                  static_cast<unsigned>(current));
    // Generic staged assets without a matching owner AND format are unsafe:
    // the console may have changed active users since the last FTP install.
    char marker[32]{};
    // The sandbox may forbid raw /data access while exposing the same
    // privileged broker assets safely through its own /app0 mount.
    std::FILE *owner=std::fopen("/app0/assets/niak-profile-source.txt","rb");
    if(!owner)owner=std::fopen(
        "/data/homebrew/PPSA99386/assets/niak-profile-source.txt","rb");
    if(owner) {
        (void)std::fgets(marker,sizeof(marker),owner);
        std::fclose(owner);
    }
    const bool identified=std::strncmp(marker,identity,10)==0 && marker[10]==' ';
    const bool staged_png=identified && std::strcmp(marker+11,"png\n")==0;
    const bool staged_dds=identified && std::strcmp(marker+11,"dds\n")==0;
    if(staged_png) {
        niak_user_avatar=niak_load_local_png(renderer,
            "/app0/assets/niak-profile.png");
        if(!niak_user_avatar)niak_user_avatar=niak_load_local_png(renderer,
            "/data/homebrew/PPSA99386/assets/niak-profile.png");
    }
    if(!niak_user_avatar)
        niak_user_avatar=niak_load_profile_cache_png(renderer,
            static_cast<unsigned>(current));
    // A manually launched title may not have a staged profile image.
    // Probe ONLY the current foreground account's local DDS cache. This
    // is read-only and requires no payload or private image export.
    if(!niak_user_avatar) {
        char dds_path[240];
        for(const char *filename : {"avatar128.dds","avatar260.dds",
                                    "avatar64.dds"}) {
            const int count=std::snprintf(dds_path,sizeof(dds_path),
                "/system_data/priv/cache/profile/0x%08X/%s",
                static_cast<unsigned>(current),filename);
            if(count<=0 || count>=static_cast<int>(sizeof(dds_path)))continue;
            niak_user_avatar=niak_load_dds_avatar(renderer,dds_path);
            if(niak_user_avatar)break;
        }
    }
    if(!niak_user_avatar && staged_dds) {
        niak_user_avatar=niak_load_dds_avatar(renderer,
            "/app0/assets/niak-profile.dds");
        if(!niak_user_avatar)niak_user_avatar=niak_load_dds_avatar(renderer,
            "/data/homebrew/PPSA99386/assets/niak-profile.dds");
    }
}
std::uint32_t niak_profile_avatar() {
    if(!niak_user_avatar || niak_avatar_owner<0)return 0;
    // Never display the previous user's texture after an account switch.
    // A new profile can stage/reload its own image on the next app start.
    int current=-1;
    if(sceUserServiceGetForegroundUser(&current)!=0 ||
       current!=niak_avatar_owner)return 0;
    return niak_user_avatar;
}

// Files exported by the privileged local broker may arrive AFTER the GUI
// starts. Retry only while the user is idle, at most once every ten seconds.
// Never substitute a different user's avatar or create a fake PSN icon.
void niak_profile_refresh_avatar(hui::gfx::Renderer &renderer)
{
    static std::time_t checked_at=0;
    const std::time_t now=std::time(nullptr);
    if(checked_at && now>=checked_at && now-checked_at<10)return;
    checked_at=now;
    int current=-1;
    if(sceUserServiceGetForegroundUser(&current)!=0 || current<0)return;
    if(niak_user_avatar && current==niak_avatar_owner)return;
    niak_profile_load_avatar(renderer);
}
```

`native/title/redirect_gate.h`:

```h
/* SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
 * One-shot "return to Niak" gate, inspired by NiakTV HomeRedirectGate.
 * PS button is NOT visible to payloads: observe only bigapp lifecycle.
 * App IDs <= -1 are errors, never interpreted as Sony Home.
 */
#ifndef NIAK_REDIRECT_GATE_H
#define NIAK_REDIRECT_GATE_H
#include <stdint.h>
typedef struct {
  int own_app;
  int previous_game;
  uint64_t home_since_ms;
  unsigned engaged;
  unsigned in_home;
  unsigned completed;
} NiakRedirectGate;
static inline void niak_redirect_init(NiakRedirectGate *gate,int own_app) {
 gate->own_app=own_app;gate->previous_game=0;gate->home_since_ms=0;
 gate->engaged=0;gate->in_home=0;gate->completed=0;
}
/* Returns 1 exactly once after observing the launched bigapp and a REAL
 * >=10 seconds of uninterrupted Sony Home, on a monotonic clock.
 * Fast successive broker requests must never shorten this delay. */
static inline int niak_redirect_tick(NiakRedirectGate *g,int running_app,
                                      uint64_t now_ms) {
 if(!g || g->completed || !now_ms)return 0;
 if(running_app<0) {
   g->in_home=0; // Unknown observation interrupts the stable-home period.
   return 0;
 }
 if(running_app==g->own_app) {
   g->previous_game=0;g->in_home=0;g->engaged=0;
   return 0;
 }
 if(running_app>0) {
   g->previous_game=running_app;g->engaged=1;g->in_home=0;
   return 0;
 }
 if(!g->engaged)return 0;
 if(!g->in_home || now_ms<g->home_since_ms) {
   g->in_home=1;g->home_since_ms=now_ms;
   return 0;
 }
 if(now_ms-g->home_since_ms<10000u)return 0;
 g->completed=1;
 return 1;
}
/* Arm only for an explicit successful NiakPS5 launch request, including
 * when the user opened the title manually after an unsuccessful autostart.
 * Discovering an arbitrary application at boot never arms the gate. */
static inline int niak_redirect_arm_after_launch(
    NiakRedirectGate *gate,int resume_enabled,
    int source_app,int launch_rc) {
 if(!gate || !resume_enabled ||
    source_app<=0 || launch_rc!=0)return 0;
 niak_redirect_init(gate,source_app);
 return 1;
}
/* If the active PS5 user changed while a game was running, cancelling the
 * optional return is safer than bringing a different user's Niak home forward. */
static inline int niak_redirect_same_user(int original,int current) {
 return original>=0 && original==current;
}
#endif

```

`native/title/socket_guard.h`:

```h
/* SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
 * Protect the local title/payload TCP protocol against SIGPIPE when the
 * peer disconnects while a request or response is being sent.
 * PS5's FreeBSD socket stack supports SO_NOSIGPIPE; Linux uses MSG_NOSIGNAL.
 */
#ifndef NIAK_SOCKET_GUARD_H
#define NIAK_SOCKET_GUARD_H
#include <sys/types.h>
#include <sys/socket.h>

static inline void niak_socket_guard(int fd) {
#ifdef SO_NOSIGPIPE
    const int yes=1;
    (void)setsockopt(fd,SOL_SOCKET,SO_NOSIGPIPE,&yes,sizeof(yes));
#else
    (void)fd;
#endif
}
static inline ssize_t niak_socket_send(int fd,const void *data,size_t size) {
#ifdef MSG_NOSIGNAL
    return send(fd,data,size,MSG_NOSIGNAL);
#else
    return send(fd,data,size,0);
#endif
}
#endif
```

`native/title/stage_case_templates.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Stage PS4/PS5 immutable platform strips for a drag-and-drop installation.

Uses the existing six WebP preview pieces already tracked in the public
repository; this does not redistribute private high-resolution originals.
Resamples platform strips to accepted PS5 texture sizes so the runtime does
not reject the low-res preview dimensions. The user's original PNGs remain
the preferred replacement when manually copied into the same FTP folder.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
from base64 import b64decode
from hashlib import sha256
from io import BytesIO
from pathlib import Path
from zipfile import ZipFile
from PIL import Image

EXPECTED={
    "ps4-front":(949,136),"ps4-back":(647,362),
    "ps4-spine":(72,800),"ps5-front":(1487,209),
    "ps5-back":(1000,411),"ps5-spine":(85,1000),
}
SOURCE_SHA256="cd3383fa7705ec19ebfbb5923d67d75c9c9c3fd2c290b91edd562c2792c0ecc4"

def stage(folder:Path):
    folder=Path(folder)
    if folder.name!="PPSA99386" or not folder.is_dir():
        raise ValueError("Need the built PPSA99386/ folder")
    parts=Path(__file__).resolve().parent/"assets"/"preview-blocks"
    blocks=[parts/f"{i:02}.b64" for i in range(6)]
    if not all(path.is_file() for path in blocks):
        raise ValueError("Six user-derived PS4/PS5 preview blocks missing")
    data=b64decode("".join(path.read_text("ascii").strip() for path in blocks),
                   validate=True)
    if sha256(data).hexdigest()!=SOURCE_SHA256:
        raise ValueError("Fixed template source hash mismatch")
    output=folder/"assets"/"niak-templates"
    output.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    with ZipFile(BytesIO(data)) as zipfile:
        if zipfile.testzip() is not None or set(zipfile.namelist())!={
            name+".webp" for name in EXPECTED
        }:raise ValueError("Unexpected fixed PS4/PS5 art in archive")
        for name,size in EXPECTED.items():
            with zipfile.open(name+".webp") as file:
                image=Image.open(file)
                image.load()
                if image.format!="WEBP":
                    raise ValueError("Invalid fixed PS4/PS5 WebP")
                # Same artwork, no synthetic logos/images. Resample to PS5
                # runtime-required dimensions; private full-res PNGs may
                # replace these six paths later over FTP.
                # Preserve genuine alpha in fixed elements; do not flatten overlays.
                image=image.convert("RGBA").resize(size,Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
                # The six original-derived strips can remain compact.
                # Preserve alpha; leave private full-res PNG overrides alone.
                dest=output/(name+".webp")
                if not dest.is_file():
                    image.save(dest,"WEBP",quality=80,method=6,exact=True)
    if len(list(output.glob("*.webp")))!=6:
        raise ValueError("Incomplete six-template WebP installation")
    print("Six original-derived PS4/PS5 strips staged for drag-and-drop.")

if __name__=="__main__":
    import argparse
    p=argparse.ArgumentParser()
    p.add_argument("--folder",required=True,type=Path)
    stage(p.parse_args().folder)

```

`native/title/tests/audit_repository.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Fail-closed privacy audit of all tracked files in the CURRENT checkout.

Checks tracked text, path names, common API tokens, local account traces and
private credentials. No candidate secret value is printed. This is NOT a
complete audit of Git history, untracked files, past releases or image pixels.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess

PATTERNS = {
    "GitHub/OpenAI/Slack-style token": re.compile(
        r"\b(?:ghp_[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}|github_pat_[A-Za-z0-9_]{30,}|"
        r"sk-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{24,}|xox[baprs]-[A-Za-z0-9-]{20,})\b"),
    "cloud access key": re.compile(
        r"\b(?:AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}|AIza[0-9A-Za-z_-]{35})\b"),
    "private key block": re.compile(
        r"-----BEGIN (?:RSA |OPENSSH |EC |DSA )?PRIVATE KEY-----"),
    "personal email": re.compile(
        r"\b[a-zA-Z0-9._%+-]+@"
        r"(?:gmail|outlook|hotmail|icloud|yahoo|protonmail)\.[A-Za-z]{2,}\b"),
    "personal machine path": re.compile(
        r"(?:/Users/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+/|/home/(?!runner/|oai/)"
        r"[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+/|C:\\Users\\[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+\\)"),
    "private LAN address": re.compile(
        r"\b(?:192\.168\.\d{1,3}\.\d{1,3}|10\.\d{1,3}\.\d{1,3}\.\d{1,3}|"
        r"172\.(?:1[6-9]|2\d|3[01])\.\d{1,3}\.\d{1,3})\b"),
    "embedded FTP credentials": re.compile(
        r"ftps?://[^/\s:@]{2,}:[^/\s@]{3,}@"),
    "HTTP Authorization credential": re.compile(
        r"(?im)^\s*Authorization\s*:\s*(?:Bearer|Basic)\s+"
        r"[A-Za-z0-9+/=_\-.]{18,}\s*$"),
}
BINARY = {".ttf", ".woff", ".woff2", ".png", ".jpg", ".jpeg",
          ".ico", ".zip", ".elf", ".webp", ".db", ".sqlite"}
PRIVATE_NAMES = {".env", "id_rsa", "id_ed25519", "credentials.json",
                 "token.txt", "auth.json"}
PRIVATE_SUFFIXES = {".p12", ".pfx", ".pem", ".key", ".har", ".pcap"}

tracked = subprocess.check_output(["git", "ls-files", "-z"]).split(b"\0")
findings = []
scanned = 0
for raw in tracked:
    if not raw:
        continue
    relative = Path(raw.decode("utf-8", errors="replace"))
    path = Path.cwd() / relative
    if relative.name.lower() in PRIVATE_NAMES or relative.suffix.lower() in PRIVATE_SUFFIXES:
        findings.append(f"{relative}: suspicious tracked file name")
    if path.is_symlink():
        findings.append(f"{relative}: tracked symbolic link requires review")
        continue
    if relative.suffix.lower() in BINARY:
        continue
    try:
        data = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    except UnicodeError:
        continue
    except OSError:
        findings.append(f"{relative}: cannot read tracked file")
        continue
    scanned += 1
    for name, regex in PATTERNS.items():
        for match in regex.finditer(data):
            line = data.count("\n", 0, match.start()) + 1
            findings.append(f"{relative}:{line}: possible {name}")

if findings:
    print("\n".join(findings))
    raise SystemExit(1)
print(f"Privacy scan: {len(tracked)-1} tracked entries, {scanned} text files; "
      "no configured confidential patterns detected. "
      "Git history and embedded images are outside this scan.")

```

`native/title/tests/case_fallback_layout_test.cpp`:

```cpp
// SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
#include "../case_fallback_layout.hpp"
#include <cassert>
#include <cmath>
static bool near(float x,float y) {return std::fabs(x-y)<0.003f;}
int main() {
    const auto ps4=niak_case_fallback_layout(true);
    const auto ps5=niak_case_fallback_layout(false);
    assert(near(ps4.front_header,0.108f));
    assert(near(ps5.front_header,0.108f));
    assert(ps4.back_footer<ps5.back_footer);
    for(auto shape:{ps4,ps5}) {
        assert(shape.front_header>0.f && shape.front_header<0.2f);
        assert(shape.back_text_top<shape.back_art_top);
        assert(shape.back_art_top<shape.back_art_bottom);
        assert(shape.back_art_bottom<shape.back_footer);
        assert(shape.back_footer<1.f);
    }
    // Cover crop: landscape pic1 fills portrait print without squeezing.
    const auto panoramic=niak_case_cover_crop(16.f/9.f,0.76f/(1.f-ps5.front_header));
    assert(panoramic.left>0.2f && panoramic.right<0.8f);
    assert(near(panoramic.top,0.f)&&near(panoramic.bottom,1.f));
    const auto square=niak_case_cover_crop(1.f,0.76f/(1.f-ps4.front_header));
    assert(square.left>0.f&&square.right<1.f);
    // 1:1 source on a portrait paper: horizontal centre crop, no squeeze.
    const float print_aspect=0.76f/(1.f-ps4.front_header);
    assert(near((square.right-square.left)*1.f,print_aspect));
    assert(near(square.left,1.f-square.right));
    assert(near(square.top,0.f)&&near(square.bottom,1.f));
    const auto portrait=niak_case_cover_crop(0.76f,print_aspect);
    assert(portrait.left>=0.f && portrait.right<=1.f);
    assert(portrait.top>=0.f && portrait.bottom<=1.f);
    const auto letterbox=niak_case_cover_crop(0.5f,1.f);
    assert(letterbox.top>0.f && letterbox.bottom<1.f);
    const auto invalid=niak_case_cover_crop(0.f,1.f);
    assert(near(invalid.left,0.f)&&near(invalid.right,1.f));
    return 0;
}
```
