```cpp
    unsigned spine_w=200,spine_h=1400;
    std::vector<unsigned char> spine(std::size_t(spine_w)*spine_h*4u,180);
    assert(niak_scale_case_rgba(spine,spine_w,spine_h,96,768));
    assert(spine_w<=96&&spine_h<=768);
    assert(spine_w==96&&spine_h==672); // original 1:7 aspect preserved
    unsigned bad_w=0,bad_h=768;
    std::vector<unsigned char> bad;
    assert(!niak_scale_case_rgba(bad,bad_w,bad_h,512,768));
    return 0;
}
```

`native/title/tests/http_icon_response_test.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "../http_icon_response.hpp"
#include <cassert>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
static std::vector<unsigned char> wire(const std::string &s) {
    return {s.begin(),s.end()};
}
int main() {
    constexpr std::size_t limit=4096;
    std::vector<unsigned char> out;
    const std::string fixed="HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Length: 6\r\n"
                            "Connection: keep-alive\r\n\r\nABCDEF";
    auto bytes=wire(fixed);
    assert(niak_http_icon_body(bytes,false,limit,out)==NiakHttpState::Complete);
    assert(std::string(out.begin(),out.end())=="ABCDEF");
    bytes=wire(fixed.substr(0,fixed.size()-2));
    assert(niak_http_icon_body(bytes,false,limit,out)==NiakHttpState::NeedMore);
    assert(niak_http_icon_body(bytes,true,limit,out)==NiakHttpState::Invalid);
    bytes=wire("HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nTransfer-Encoding: chunked\r\n\r\n"
               "3\r\nABC\r\n3\r\nDEF\r\n0\r\n\r\n");
    assert(niak_http_icon_body(bytes,false,limit,out)==NiakHttpState::Complete);
    assert(std::string(out.begin(),out.end())=="ABCDEF");
    // Reassembly across many received fragments must never publish an
    // incomplete PNG body, and reconstruct each byte exactly once.
    std::string chunks="HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nTransfer-Encoding: chunked\r\n\r\n";
    std::string picture;
    for(unsigned block=0;block<64;++block) {
        const std::string piece(16384,char('A'+block%26));
        picture+=piece;
        chunks+="4000\r\n"+piece+"\r\n";
    }
    chunks+="0\r\n\r\n";
    std::vector<unsigned char> assembled;
    for(std::size_t cap=4096;cap<chunks.size();cap+=32768) {
        const auto incomplete=wire(chunks.substr(0,cap));
        assert(niak_http_icon_body(incomplete,false,2*1024*1024,assembled)
               ==NiakHttpState::NeedMore);
        assert(assembled.empty());
    }
    auto complete=wire(chunks);
    assert(niak_http_icon_body(complete,false,2*1024*1024,assembled)
           ==NiakHttpState::Complete);
    assert(std::string(assembled.begin(),assembled.end())==picture);
    bytes=wire("HTTP/1.0 200 OK\r\nContent-Type: image/png\r\n\r\nABCDEF");
    assert(niak_http_icon_body(bytes,false,limit,out)==NiakHttpState::NeedMore);
    assert(niak_http_icon_body(bytes,true,limit,out)==NiakHttpState::Complete);
    bytes=wire("HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found\r\nContent-Length: 0\r\n\r\n");
    assert(niak_http_icon_body(bytes,true,limit,out)==NiakHttpState::Invalid);
    bytes=wire("HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Length: 999999\r\n\r\n");
    assert(niak_http_icon_body(bytes,false,limit,out)==NiakHttpState::Invalid);
    bytes=wire("HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Length: 99999999999999999999999999999999\r\n\r\n");
    assert(niak_http_icon_body(bytes,false,limit,out)==NiakHttpState::Invalid);
    bytes=wire("HTTP/1.1 200X\r\nContent-Length: 2\r\n\r\nAB");
    assert(niak_http_icon_body(bytes,false,limit,out)==NiakHttpState::Invalid);
    bytes=wire("HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Length: 2\r\n"
               "Content-Length: 3\r\n\r\nABC");
    assert(niak_http_icon_body(bytes,false,limit,out)==NiakHttpState::Invalid);
    bytes=wire("HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nTransfer-Encoding: chunked\r\n"
               "Content-Length: 6\r\n\r\n6\r\nABCDEF\r\n0\r\n\r\n");
    assert(niak_http_icon_body(bytes,false,limit,out)==NiakHttpState::Invalid);
    return 0;
}
```

`native/title/tests/icon_endpoint_policy_test.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "../icon_endpoint_policy.hpp"
#include <cassert>
int main() {
    const char *incomplete="HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Length: 99\r\n";
    assert(niak_icon_reply(
        reinterpret_cast<const unsigned char*>(incomplete),
        std::strlen(incomplete))==NiakIconReply::NeedMore);
    const char *okay="HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Length: 10\r\n\r\n";
    assert(niak_icon_reply(reinterpret_cast<const unsigned char*>(okay),
        std::strlen(okay))==NiakIconReply::Success);
    const char *missing="HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found\r\nContent-Length: 0\r\n\r\n";
    assert(niak_icon_reply(reinterpret_cast<const unsigned char*>(missing),
        std::strlen(missing))==NiakIconReply::OtherStatus);
    const char *bad="HTTP/1.1 20X OK\r\n\r\n";
    assert(niak_icon_reply(reinterpret_cast<const unsigned char*>(bad),
        std::strlen(bad))==NiakIconReply::Invalid);
    NiakIconEndpointPolicy policy;
    assert(policy.allowed(1));
    policy.transport_failed(100);
    assert(policy.allowed(100)); // One isolated error is not a circuit break.
    policy.responded();           // A legitimate 404 still proves API alive.
    policy.transport_failed(101);
    assert(policy.allowed(101));
    policy.transport_failed(102);
    assert(!policy.allowed(103));
    assert(!policy.allowed(10101));
    assert(policy.allowed(10102));
    policy.responded();
    assert(policy.allowed(105));
    policy.transport_failed(UINT64_MAX);
    policy.transport_failed(UINT64_MAX);
    assert(!policy.allowed(102));
    assert(policy.allowed(UINT64_MAX));
    return 0;
}
```

`native/title/tests/launch_policy_test.c`:

```c
#include "../launch_policy.h"
#include <assert.h>
#include <string.h>
static unsigned system_calls=0,lnc_calls=0;
static int system_value=0,lnc_value=0;
static int expected_user=0x1234;
static int call_system(const char *title,const char **args,NiakLaunchContext *ctx) {
    ++system_calls;
    assert(title && strcmp(title,"PPSA99386")==0 && args==0);
    assert(ctx && ctx->structsize==sizeof(*ctx));
    assert(ctx->user_id==(unsigned)expected_user);
    assert(ctx->app_opt==0 && ctx->crash_report==0 && ctx->check_flag==0);
    return system_value;
}
static int call_lnc(const char *title,const char **args,NiakLaunchContext *ctx) {
    ++lnc_calls;
    assert(title && strcmp(title,"PPSA99386")==0 && args==0);
    assert(ctx && ctx->structsize==sizeof(*ctx));
    assert(ctx->user_id==(unsigned)expected_user);
    return lnc_value;
}
int main(void) {
    NiakLaunchResult r=niak_launch_with_fallback(
        "PPSA99386",expected_user,call_system,call_lnc);
    assert(r.result==0 && r.method==1 && system_calls==1 && lnc_calls==0);
    // 0x18 and 0x2018 were real console returns. They are NONNEGATIVE:
    // accepted API calls, not refusal/errors, and must not invoke fallback.
    for(int positive=0;positive<2;++positive) {
        system_value=positive==0?0x18:0x2018;
        const unsigned lnc_before=lnc_calls;
        r=niak_launch_with_fallback("PPSA99386",expected_user,
                                    call_system,call_lnc);
        assert(r.method==1 && r.result==0 && r.system_rc==system_value);
        assert(lnc_calls==lnc_before);
    }
    system_value=(int)0x80940005u;lnc_value=0x60010001;
    r=niak_launch_with_fallback("PPSA99386",expected_user,
                                call_system,call_lnc);
    assert(r.result==0 && r.method==2 && r.lnc_rc==lnc_value);
    assert(system_calls==4 && lnc_calls==1);
    lnc_value=0;
    r=niak_launch_with_fallback("PPSA99386",expected_user,
                                call_system,call_lnc);
    assert(r.method==0 && r.result<0 && r.lnc_rc==0);
    lnc_value=(int)0x80940031u;
    r=niak_launch_with_fallback("PPSA99386",expected_user,
                                call_system,call_lnc);
    assert((unsigned)r.result==0x80940031u && r.method==0);
    assert(lnc_calls==3);
    system_value=(int)0x80940031u;
    r=niak_launch_with_fallback("PPSA99386",expected_user,
                                call_system,call_lnc);
    assert((unsigned)r.result==0x80940031u && r.method==0);
    assert(lnc_calls==3); /* never retry 'not installed' with LncUtil */
    unsigned before=system_calls;
    r=niak_launch_with_fallback("PPSA99386",-1,call_system,call_lnc);
    assert(r.method==0 && system_calls==before);
    r=niak_launch_with_fallback(0,expected_user,call_system,call_lnc);
    assert(r.method==0 && system_calls==before);
    return 0;
}
```

`native/title/tests/loopback_connect_test.c`:

```c
#define _POSIX_C_SOURCE 200809L
#include "../loopback_connect.h"
#include <assert.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <arpa/inet.h>
#include <netinet/in.h>
#include <unistd.h>

int main(void) {
    int listener=socket(AF_INET,SOCK_STREAM,0);
    assert(listener>=0);
    struct sockaddr_in address={0};
    address.sin_family=AF_INET;
    address.sin_addr.s_addr=htonl(INADDR_LOOPBACK);
    address.sin_port=0;
    assert(bind(listener,(struct sockaddr *)&address,sizeof(address))==0);
    assert(listen(listener,1)==0);
    socklen_t size=sizeof(address);
    assert(getsockname(listener,(struct sockaddr *)&address,&size)==0);
    int client=socket(AF_INET,SOCK_STREAM,0);
    assert(client>=0);
    assert(niak_connect_bounded(client,
           (const struct sockaddr *)&address,sizeof(address),100)==0);
    assert((fcntl(client,F_GETFL,0)&O_NONBLOCK)==0);
    int accepted=accept(listener,NULL,NULL);
    assert(accepted>=0);
    close(accepted);close(client);close(listener);
    // Closed listener: fail promptly and restore descriptor flags.
    client=socket(AF_INET,SOCK_STREAM,0);
    assert(client>=0);
    assert(niak_connect_bounded(client,
           (const struct sockaddr *)&address,sizeof(address),100)==-1);
    assert((fcntl(client,F_GETFL,0)&O_NONBLOCK)==0);
    close(client);
    return 0;
}
```

`native/title/tests/redirect_gate_test.c`:

```c
#include "../redirect_gate.h"
#include <assert.h>
int main(void){
 NiakRedirectGate g;
 // Manual opening is sufficient for return after a successful PLAY.
 // No separate bootstrap success flag is needed.
 assert(!niak_redirect_arm_after_launch(&g,0,314,0));
 assert(!niak_redirect_arm_after_launch(&g,0,314,0));
 assert(!niak_redirect_arm_after_launch(&g,1,-1,0));
 assert(!niak_redirect_arm_after_launch(&g,1,314,-2));
 assert(niak_redirect_same_user(100,100));
 assert(!niak_redirect_same_user(100,200));
 assert(!niak_redirect_same_user(-1,100));
 assert(niak_redirect_arm_after_launch(&g,1,314,0));
 // Running own UI and Sony Home with no intervening game never returns.
 for(unsigned i=0;i<50;++i)
     assert(!niak_redirect_tick(&g,0,1000u+i));
 assert(!niak_redirect_tick(&g,314,2000));
 // A real game engages the gate.
 for(unsigned i=0;i<100;++i)
     assert(!niak_redirect_tick(&g,21,3000u+i));
 // Empty observations 200ms apart must NOT count as ten seconds.
 for(unsigned i=0;i<100;++i)
     assert(!niak_redirect_tick(&g,0,3200u+i*2));
 assert(!niak_redirect_tick(&g,0,13199));
 assert(niak_redirect_tick(&g,0,13200));
 for(unsigned i=0;i<30;++i)
     assert(!niak_redirect_tick(&g,0,16000u+i));
 // Disconnected/unknown observations reset the stable-home timer.
 assert(niak_redirect_arm_after_launch(&g,1,314,0));
 assert(!niak_redirect_tick(&g,18,20000));
 assert(!niak_redirect_tick(&g,0,21000));
 assert(!niak_redirect_tick(&g,-1,30000));
 assert(!niak_redirect_tick(&g,0,31000));
 assert(!niak_redirect_tick(&g,0,40000));
 assert(niak_redirect_tick(&g,0,41000));
 // Another title resumes before grace period; the countdown restarts.
 assert(niak_redirect_arm_after_launch(&g,1,314,0));
 assert(!niak_redirect_tick(&g,18,50000));
 assert(!niak_redirect_tick(&g,0,51000));
 assert(!niak_redirect_tick(&g,0,60999));
 assert(!niak_redirect_tick(&g,18,61000));
 assert(!niak_redirect_tick(&g,0,62000));
 assert(!niak_redirect_tick(&g,0,71999));
 assert(niak_redirect_tick(&g,0,72000));
 // Clock failures and resets cannot trigger an early redirect.
 assert(niak_redirect_arm_after_launch(&g,1,314,0));
 assert(!niak_redirect_tick(&g,18,80000));
 assert(!niak_redirect_tick(&g,0,82000));
 assert(!niak_redirect_tick(&g,0,0));
 assert(!niak_redirect_tick(&g,0,1000));
 assert(!niak_redirect_tick(&g,0,10999));
 assert(niak_redirect_tick(&g,0,11000));
 // Returning to our own title cancels a pending game-exit redirect.
 niak_redirect_init(&g,314);
 niak_redirect_tick(&g,20,30000);
 niak_redirect_tick(&g,314,31000);
 for(unsigned i=0;i<20;++i)
     assert(!niak_redirect_tick(&g,0,42000u+i*1000));
 return 0;
}
```

`native/title/tests/socket_guard_test.c`:

```c
#include "../socket_guard.h"
#include <assert.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <unistd.h>
int main(void) {
    int fds[2]={-1,-1};
    assert(socketpair(AF_UNIX,SOCK_STREAM,0,fds)==0);
    niak_socket_guard(fds[0]);
    close(fds[1]);
    // If SIGPIPE is not suppressed, the child process dies here instead of
    // reaching the assertion (SIGPIPE default disposition is termination).
    assert(niak_socket_send(fds[0],"PING\n",5)==-1);
    assert(errno==EPIPE || errno==ECONNRESET);
    close(fds[0]);
    return 0;
}
```

```py
"""PS5 case backgrounds decode without filesystem or WebP work on GL thread."""
from pathlib import Path
import unittest

SOURCE=(ROOT/"game_icons.cpp").read_text()

HEADER=(ROOT/"game_icons.hpp").read_text()

class AsyncCaseSceneTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_only_one_bounded_case_scene_worker(self):
        block=SOURCE[SOURCE.index("struct AsyncCaseBackground {"):
                     SOURCE.index("std::uint32_t niak_load_game_icon(")]
        self.assertIn("state.wake.wait(",block)
        self.assertIn("!state.completed && !state.queue.empty()",block)
        self.assertIn("state.queued.size()>=1",block)
        self.assertIn("state.queue.clear();",block)
        self.assertIn("state.completed_pixels.clear();",block)
        self.assertIn("generation=state.generation;",block)
        self.assertIn("if(generation!=state.generation || id!=state.latest_title)",block)

        self.assertIn("state.completed_pixels=std::move(pixels);",block)
        self.assertNotIn("renderer.",block)

                       SOURCE.index("#endif\n} // namespace",SOURCE.index("void enqueue_missing_scene("))]
        self.assertIn("if(state.latest_title!=id)",enqueue)
        self.assertIn("++state.generation;",enqueue)

        self.assertIn("state.queued.clear();",enqueue)
        self.assertIn("state.completed=false;",enqueue)
        self.assertIn("state.completed_pixels.clear();",enqueue)
        worker=SOURCE[SOURCE.index("void case_background_worker() {"):
                      SOURCE.index("void enqueue_missing_scene(")]
        self.assertLess(worker.index("if(generation!=state.generation || id!=state.latest_title)"),
                        worker.index("state.completed_title=std::move(id);"))
        # Discarding an old completion must not erase a newly re-queued ID.
        discard=worker[worker.index("if(generation!=state.generation || id!=state.latest_title)"):
                       worker.index("if(pixels.empty())")]
        self.assertNotIn("state.queued.erase(",discard)

        body=SOURCE[SOURCE.index("std::uint32_t niak_load_game_background("):
                    SOURCE.index("std::uint32_t niak_take_downloaded_game_background(")]

        self.assertNotIn("read_local_png",ps5)
        self.assertNotIn("decode_installed_art",ps5)
        self.assertIn("return 0;",ps5)

                    SOURCE.index("std::uint32_t niak_load_profile_cache_png(")]

        # Host preview must retain its fallback to the next valid local file.
        self.assertIn("if(!texture)continue;",SOURCE)
```

`native/title/tests/test_broker_catalog.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""End-to-end host test: sandboxed client reads only local title IDs."""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile
import unittest

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
SOURCE=r'''
#include "niak/broker_catalog.hpp"
#include <arpa/inet.h>
#include <netinet/in.h>
#include <sys/socket.h>
#include <cassert>
#include <chrono>
#include <cstring>
#include <thread>
#include <unistd.h>
int main() {
    int server=socket(AF_INET,SOCK_STREAM,0);
    assert(server>=0);
    int yes=1;
    setsockopt(server,SOL_SOCKET,SO_REUSEADDR,&yes,sizeof(yes));
    sockaddr_in addr{};
    addr.sin_family=AF_INET;
    addr.sin_port=htons(19187);
    addr.sin_addr.s_addr=htonl(INADDR_LOOPBACK);
    assert(bind(server,reinterpret_cast<sockaddr*>(&addr),sizeof(addr))==0);
    assert(listen(server,2)==0);
    std::thread backend([&] {
        for(int round=0;round<5;++round) {
            int client=accept(server,nullptr,nullptr);
            assert(client>=0);
            char request[16]{};
            ssize_t n=recv(client,request,sizeof(request),0);
            assert(n==6 && std::memcmp(request,"GAMES\n",6)==0);
            if(round==0) {
                assert(send(client,"GAM",3,0)==3);
                std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(10));
                const char *rest="ES\nPPSA12345\nCUSA54321\nEND\n";
                assert(send(client,rest,std::strlen(rest),0)==ssize_t(std::strlen(rest)));
            } else {
                const char *reply=round==1?
                    "GAMES\nPPSA12345\nPPSA12345\nEND\n":
                    round==2?"GAMES\nPPSA99386\nEND\n":
                    round==3?"GAMES\nCUSA54321\nEND\nEXTRA":
                             "DENIED\n";
                assert(send(client,reply,std::strlen(reply),0)==
                       ssize_t(std::strlen(reply)));
            }
            close(client);
        }
    });
    NiakGame items[4]{};
    assert(niak_scan_broker_games(items,4)==2);
    assert(std::strcmp(items[0].id,"PPSA12345")==0);
    assert(std::strcmp(items[1].id,"CUSA54321")==0);
    assert(std::strcmp(items[0].title,"PPSA12345")==0);
    assert(niak_scan_broker_games(items,4)==-1); // duplicate
    assert(niak_scan_broker_games(items,4)==-1); // own title
    assert(niak_scan_broker_games(items,4)==-1); // trailing bytes
    assert(niak_scan_broker_games(items,4)==-1); // broker denied
    backend.join();
    close(server);
    assert(niak_scan_broker_games(items,4)==-1);
    return 0;
}
'''

class BrokerTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_real_fragmented_catalogue_socket(self):
        compiler=shutil.which("g++")
        if not compiler:
            self.skipTest("host C++ compiler unavailable")

            built=subprocess.run(
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Host contract: PLDmgr snapshot works without TCP, rejects stale/symlinks."""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile
import unittest

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
SOURCE=r'''
#define _POSIX_C_SOURCE 200809L
#include "niak/broker_snapshot.h"
#include <assert.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <unistd.h>
int main(int argc,char **argv) {
  assert(argc==2);
  const char *path=argv[1];
  NiakGame games[4]; memset(games,0,sizeof(games));
  const long long now=(long long)time(NULL);
  assert(niak_snapshot_write(path,"PPSA12345\nCUSA54321\n",2,now)==0);
  assert(niak_snapshot_read(path,games,4)==2);
  assert(strcmp(games[0].id,"PPSA12345")==0);
  assert(strcmp(games[1].id,"CUSA54321")==0);
  assert(niak_snapshot_read(path,games,1)==1);
  /* A crashed older writer may have left its PID-named temp behind. */
  char old_temp[512];
  snprintf(old_temp,sizeof(old_temp),"%s.tmp.%ld",path,(long)getpid());
  FILE *orphan=fopen(old_temp,"wb");assert(orphan);
  fputs("stale",orphan);fclose(orphan);
  assert(niak_snapshot_write(path,"PPSA12345\n",1,now)==0);
  assert(niak_snapshot_read(path,games,1)==1);
  assert(niak_snapshot_write(path,"NPXS54321\n",1,now)==0);
  assert(niak_snapshot_read(path,games,4)==1);
  assert(strcmp(games[0].id,"NPXS54321")==0);
  unlink(old_temp);
  /* Even a cap=1 reader must reject duplicates elsewhere in the file. */
  FILE *duplicate=fopen(path,"wb");assert(duplicate);
  fprintf(duplicate,"NIAKPS5-GAMES-1 %lld 2\nPPSA12345\nPPSA12345\nEND\n",now);
  fclose(duplicate);
  assert(niak_snapshot_read(path,games,1)==-1);
  FILE *suffix=fopen(path,"wb");assert(suffix);
  fprintf(suffix,"NIAKPS5-GAMES-1 %lld 1 EXTRA\nPPSA12345\nEND\n",now);
  fclose(suffix);
  assert(niak_snapshot_read(path,games,1)==-1);
  assert(niak_snapshot_write(path,"PPSA12345\n",1,now-2000)==0);
  assert(niak_snapshot_read(path,games,4)==-1);
  assert(niak_snapshot_write(path,"PPSA12345\n",1,now+2000)==0);
  assert(niak_snapshot_read(path,games,4)==-1);
  assert(niak_snapshot_write(path,"../../etc/passwd\n",1,now)==-1);
  assert(niak_snapshot_write(path,"PPSA12345\n",1,now)==0);
  FILE *out=fopen(path,"wb");assert(out);
  fputs("NIAKPS5-GAMES-1 12345 1\nINVALID999\nEND\n",out);fclose(out);
  assert(niak_snapshot_read(path,games,4)==-1);
  unlink(path);
  assert(symlink("/dev/null",path)==0);
  assert(niak_snapshot_read(path,games,4)==-1);
  return 0;
}
'''
class SnapshotTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_fresh_sandbox_file_catalogue_and_security(self):
        cc=shutil.which("cc")
        if not cc:self.skipTest("C compiler unavailable")
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            root=Path(directory)
            (root/"niak").mkdir()
            for p in ("broker_snapshot.h",):
                shutil.copyfile(ROOT/p,root/"niak"/p)
            shutil.copyfile(ROOT.parent/"catalog.h",root/"niak"/"catalog.h")
            (root/"test.c").write_text(SOURCE,encoding="utf-8")
            binary=root/"test"
            compiled=subprocess.run([cc,"-std=c11","-Wall","-Wextra","-Werror",
                                     "-I",str(root),str(root/"test.c"),
                                     "-o",str(binary)],capture_output=True,text=True)
            self.assertEqual(compiled.returncode,0,compiled.stderr)
            subprocess.run([str(binary),str(root/"snapshot.txt")],
                           check=True,capture_output=True,text=True)
if __name__=="__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compile fixed PS4/PS5 fallback geometries independently of SDK."""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile
import unittest
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]

class CaseFallbackTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_geometry_and_unstretched_full_bleed(self):

        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
            binary=Path(td)/"fallback"
            subprocess.run([cc,"-std=c++20","-O1","-Wall","-Wextra","-Werror",
                            "-I",str(ROOT),str(ROOT/"tests/case_fallback_layout_test.cpp"),
                            "-o",str(binary)],check=True,capture_output=True,text=True)
            subprocess.run([str(binary)],check=True,capture_output=True,text=True)

    def test_reconstructed_case_uses_one_full_sheet_below_every_element(self):

        assert "if(!item.case_spine)" in staged

        assert 'item.case_template_back=niak_load_case_template' in staged
        assert "niak_case_cover_crop(" in source
        assert "item.logo_art" not in source
        assert "layout.front_header" in source
        assert "layout.back_footer" in source
        assert "item.case_scene_aspect" in source
        assert "item.logo_art_aspect" not in source
        assert "if(!back)" in source
        assert "if(item.case_template_back)" in source
        assert "if(item.case_template_front)" in source
        assert "0.18f+v*0.59f" not in source
        assert "block(0,0.90f,1,1" not in source
```

```py
import importlib.util
import io
import json
from urllib.parse import urlsplit
import os
from pathlib import Path
import tempfile
import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("niak_cover_sources",ROOT/"cover_sources.py")
provider=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(provider)
spec2=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("niak_ftp_for_providers",ROOT/"ftp_install.py")
ftp=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec2)
spec2.loader.exec_module(ftp)


class FakeFTP:
    def __init__(self,files=None):self.files=dict(files or {})
    def nlst(self,path):
        prefix=path.rstrip("/")+"/"
        return sorted({prefix+k[len(prefix):].split("/",1)[0]
                       for k in self.files if k.startswith(prefix)})
    def mkd(self,path):return None
    def sendcmd(self,command):return "200 OK"
    def storbinary(self,command,source):self.files[command[5:]]=source.read()
    def retrbinary(self,command,callback):
        path=command[5:]
        if path not in self.files:
            from ftplib import error_perm
            raise error_perm("550 not found")
        callback(self.files[path])


TGDB_URL="https://cdn.thegamesdb.net/images/original/"
def tgdb_response(second=False,wrong_platform=False):
    game={"id":421,"game_title":"Anno 1800 Console Edition",
          "platform":2 if wrong_platform else 1}
    matches=[game]
    if second:matches.append({"id":422,"game_title":game["game_title"],"platform":1})
    return {
        "data":{"games":matches},
        "include":{
            "platform":{"data":{"1":{"name":"Sony PlayStation 5"},
                                "2":{"name":"Sony PlayStation 4"}}},
            "boxart":{"data":{"421":[
                {"side":"front","filename":"boxart/front/421-1.jpg"},
                {"side":"back","filename":"boxart/back/421-1.jpg"}],
                "422":[{"side":"front","filename":"boxart/front/422-1.jpg"}]}}
        }
    }


class SourceTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_platform_title_and_edition_are_required(self):
        with patch.object(provider,"get_json",return_value=tgdb_response()):
            result=provider.tgdb_cover_urls("Anno 1800 Console Edition","ps5","test-key")
        self.assertEqual(result,{"front":TGDB_URL+"boxart/front/421-1.jpg",
                                 "back":TGDB_URL+"boxart/back/421-1.jpg"})
        with patch.object(provider,"get_json",return_value=tgdb_response(wrong_platform=True)):
            self.assertEqual(provider.tgdb_cover_urls("Anno 1800 Console Edition","ps5","test-key"),{})
        with patch.object(provider,"get_json",return_value=tgdb_response(second=True)):
            self.assertEqual(provider.tgdb_cover_urls("Anno 1800 Console Edition","ps5","test-key"),{})
        self.assertEqual(provider.name_variants("EA SPORTS FC 27"),("ea sports fc 27",))
        self.assertEqual(provider.name_variants("Elden Ring Ultimate Edition"),
                         ("elden ring ultimate edition",))

    def test_image_host_and_side_are_restricted(self):
        self.assertFalse(provider.trusted_image_url("http://cdn.thegamesdb.net/img.png"))
        self.assertFalse(provider.trusted_image_url("https://cdn.thegamesdb.net.evil.org/img.png"))
        self.assertFalse(provider.trusted_image_url("https://evil.org/x.jpg"))
        with patch.object(provider,"get_json",return_value={
            **tgdb_response(),
            "include":{
                **tgdb_response()["include"],
                "boxart":{"data":{"421":[
                    {"side":"front","filename":"../admin.png"},
                    {"side":"back","filename":"boxart/front/wrong.jpg"},
                    {"side":"front","filename":"boxart/front/421.png"}]}}
            }
        }):
            self.assertEqual(provider.tgdb_cover_urls("Anno 1800 Console Edition","ps5","key"),
                             {"front":TGDB_URL+"boxart/front/421.png"})

    def test_steamgriddb_is_front_only_and_unique_title(self):
        def fake(url,headers=None):
            if "/search/" in url:return {"data":[{"id":123,"name":"EA SPORTS FC 27","types":["game"]}]}
            return {"data":[
                {"url":"https://evil.test/p.jpg","score":999},
                {"url":"https://cdn2.steamgriddb.com/grid/a.png","score":8}]}
        with patch.object(provider,"get_json",side_effect=fake):
            self.assertEqual(
                provider.steamgriddb_portrait_url("EA SPORTS FC 27","private"),
                {"front":"https://cdn2.steamgriddb.com/grid/a.png"})
        with patch.object(provider,"get_json",return_value={"data":[
            {"id":123,"name":"EA SPORTS FC 27","types":["game"]},
            {"id":124,"name":"EA SPORTS FC 27","types":["game"]}]}):
            self.assertEqual(provider.steamgriddb_portrait_url("EA SPORTS FC 27","private"),{})

    def test_ftp_fallback_downloads_only_missing_sides(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            folder=Path(tmp)/ftp.TITLE
            (folder/"assets").mkdir(parents=True)
            (folder/"assets/niak-ps-titles.tsv").write_text(
                "PPSA04716\tAnno 1800 Console Edition\t\t\t\n",encoding="utf8")
            fake=FakeFTP({"/user/app/PPSA04716/eboot.bin":b"game"})
            class Response:
                def __init__(self,url,body):self.url,self.body=url,body
                def __enter__(self):return self
                def __exit__(self,*args):pass
                def geturl(self):return self.url
                def read(self,n):return self.body
            def query(request,timeout=12):
                url=request.full_url
                parsed=urlsplit(url)
                if parsed.scheme=="https" and parsed.hostname=="api.thegamesdb.net":
                    return Response(url,json.dumps(tgdb_response()).encode())
                if (parsed.scheme=="https" and
                    parsed.hostname=="cdn.thegamesdb.net" and
                    parsed.path.startswith("/images/original/")):
                    return Response(url,b"fake JPG")
                raise AssertionError("Unexpected URL: "+url.split("?")[0])
            with (patch.dict(os.environ,{"NIAK_THEGAMESDB_KEY":"secret-test",
                                        "NIAK_STEAMGRIDDB_KEY":"configured-too"}),
                  patch("urllib.request.urlopen",side_effect=query),
                  patch.object(ftp,"_decode_retail_image",return_value=b"valid fixture")):
                count=ftp.fetch_alternative_covers(fake,folder)
            self.assertEqual(count,2)
            base=f"/data/homebrew/{ftp.TITLE}/assets/niak-cases/PPSA04716-"
            self.assertEqual(fake.files[base+"front.png"],b"valid fixture")
            self.assertEqual(fake.files[base+"back.png"],b"valid fixture")
            self.assertNotIn(base+"spine.png",fake.files)

    def test_community_grid_is_poster_not_retail_front(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            folder=Path(tmp)/ftp.TITLE
            (folder/"assets").mkdir(parents=True)
            (folder/"assets/niak-ps-titles.tsv").write_text(
                "PPSA04716\tAnno 1800 Console Edition\t\t\t\n",encoding="utf8")
            fake=FakeFTP({"/user/app/PPSA04716/eboot.bin":b"installed"})
            class Response:
                def __init__(self,url,payload):self.url,self.payload=url,payload
                def __enter__(self):return self
                def __exit__(self,*args):pass
                def geturl(self):return self.url
                def read(self,n):return self.payload
            def api(request,timeout=12):
                url=request.full_url
                if "/search/autocomplete/" in url:
                    data={"data":[{"id":170,"name":"Anno 1800 Console Edition",
                                   "types":["game"]}]}
                    return Response(url,json.dumps(data).encode())
                if "/grids/game/170" in url:
                    data={"data":[{"url":"https://cdn2.steamgriddb.com/grid/170.png",
                                   "score":10}]}
                    return Response(url,json.dumps(data).encode())
                if url=="https://cdn2.steamgriddb.com/grid/170.png":
                    return Response(url,b"PNG sample")
                raise AssertionError("Unexpected provider URL")
            with (patch.dict(os.environ,{"NIAK_THEGAMESDB_KEY":"",
                                        "NIAK_STEAMGRIDDB_KEY":"private"}),
                  patch("urllib.request.urlopen",side_effect=api),
                  patch.object(ftp,"_decode_retail_image",return_value=b"portrait")):
                self.assertEqual(ftp.fetch_alternative_covers(fake,folder),1)
            root=f"/data/homebrew/{ftp.TITLE}/assets/niak-cases/PPSA04716-"
            self.assertEqual(fake.files[root+"poster.png"],b"portrait")
            self.assertNotIn(root+"front.png",fake.files)
            self.assertNotIn(root+"back.png",fake.files)

    def test_no_keys_does_not_call_network_or_touch_console(self):

                  patch("urllib.request.urlopen") as network):
```

```py
"""PS5 FTP autoload must be idempotent, reversible and preserve payload ordering."""
import importlib.util
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

SCRIPT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]/"ftp_install.py"
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("niak_ftp_install",SCRIPT)
ftpmod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(ftpmod)

class FakeFTP:
    def __init__(self,files=None):
        self.files=dict(files or {})
    def nlst(self,path):
        prefix=path.rstrip("/")+"/"
        return sorted({prefix+key[len(prefix):].split("/",1)[0]
                       for key in self.files if key.startswith(prefix)})
    def mkd(self,path):pass
    def storbinary(self,command,buf):
        assert command.startswith("STOR ")
        self.files[command[5:]]=buf.read()
    def retrbinary(self,command,callback):
        assert command.startswith("RETR ")
        path=command[5:]
        if path not in self.files:
            from ftplib import error_perm
            raise error_perm("550 not found")
        callback(self.files[path])
    def sendcmd(self,command):
        assert command.startswith("SITE CHMOD ")
        return "200 okay"
    def delete(self,path):
        from ftplib import error_perm
        if path not in self.files:
            raise error_perm("550 not found")
        del self.files[path]
        return "250 removed"

class AutoloadTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_private_launchbox_index_uses_actual_installed_name(self):
        from zipfile import ZipFile
        from unittest.mock import patch
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            root=Path(tmp)
            tools=root/"tools"
            tools.mkdir()
            (tools/"launchbox_index.py").write_text(
                (SCRIPT.parent/"launchbox_index.py").read_text())
            archive=root/"Metadata.zip"
            xml=b"""<LaunchBox>
             <Game><DatabaseID>427261</DatabaseID>
               <Platform>Sony Playstation 5</Platform>
               <Name>A Plague Tale: Innocence</Name>
               <Notes>True game synopsis.</Notes></Game>
             <GameImage><DatabaseID>427261</DatabaseID>
               <Type>Box - Front</Type>
               <FileName>00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000427261.png</FileName>
             </GameImage></LaunchBox>"""
            with ZipFile(archive,"w") as z:z.writestr("Metadata.xml",xml)
            f=FakeFTP({f"/data/homebrew/{ftpmod.TITLE}/assets/niak-local-titles.tsv":
                b"PPSA02387\tA Plague Tale: Innocence\tJeu\t\t\n",
                "/user/app/PPSA02387/sce_sys/param.json":b'{"titleId":"PPSA02387"}'})
            with patch.object(ftpmod,"__file__",str(tools/"ftp_install.py")):
                self.assertTrue(ftpmod.rebuild_installed_launchbox_index(
                    f,root,archive=archive))
            result=f.files[ftpmod.LAUNCHBOX_PRIVATE_INDEX]
            self.assertIn(b"True game synopsis",result)
            self.assertIn(b"PPSA02387",result)


    def setUp(self):
        self.tmp=tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.root=Path(self.tmp.name)/"PPSA99386"
        (self.root/"sce_sys").mkdir(parents=True)
        (self.root/"sce_sys/param.json").write_bytes(b'{"titleId":"PPSA99386"}')
        (self.root/"eboot.bin").write_bytes(b"title binary")
        (self.root/"sce_module").mkdir()
        (self.root/"sce_module/libc.prx").write_bytes(b"native runtime")
        (self.root/"tools/niakps5").mkdir(parents=True)
        payload=b"\x7fELFps5 test"
        (self.root/"tools/niakps5/niakps5.elf").write_bytes(payload)
        import hashlib
        import json
        (self.root/"tools/niakps5/niakps5.elf.json").write_text(
            json.dumps({"name":"NiakPS5","filename":"niakps5.elf",
                        "checksum":hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()}))
    def tearDown(self):
        self.tmp.cleanup()
    def test_private_zip_templates_install_without_autoload_rewrite(self):
        import struct
        from zipfile import ZipFile
        from unittest.mock import patch
        overlay=Path(self.tmp.name)/"owner-templates.zip"
        sizes={"ps4-front.png":(949,136),"ps4-back.png":(647,362),
               "ps4-spine.png":(72,800),"ps5-front.png":(1487,209),
               "ps5-back.png":(1000,411),"ps5-spine.png":(85,1000)}
        with ZipFile(overlay,"w") as archive:
            archive.writestr("HOW_TO_INSTALL.txt","Private assets")
            for name,(w,h) in sizes.items():
                header=b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n"+b"\0"*8+struct.pack(">II",w,h)+b"\0"*14
                archive.writestr("PPSA99386/assets/niak-templates/"+name,header)
        imgs=ftpmod.load_private_template_zip(overlay)
        self.assertEqual(set(imgs),set(sizes))
        original=b"ftpsrv.elf\nniakps5.elf\n"
        f=FakeFTP({ftpmod.AUTOLOAD:original})
        with patch.object(ftpmod,"fetch_retail_covers",return_value=0), \
             patch.object(ftpmod,"fetch_alternative_covers",return_value=0):
            ftpmod.install(f,self.root,False,preserve_autoload=True,
                           case_templates=overlay)
        self.assertEqual(f.files[ftpmod.AUTOLOAD],original)
        for name in sizes:
            remote=f"/data/homebrew/PPSA99386/assets/niak-templates/{name}"
            self.assertEqual(f.files[remote],imgs[name])
        with ZipFile(overlay,"a") as archive:
            archive.writestr("PPSA99386/../../untrusted.png",b"bad")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            ftpmod.load_private_template_zip(overlay)

    def test_user_supplied_case_templates_are_private_and_checked(self):
        import struct
        import io
        from contextlib import redirect_stdout
        folder=self.root/"assets/niak-templates"
        folder.mkdir(parents=True)
        examples={"ps4-front":(949,136),"ps4-back":(647,362),
                  "ps4-spine":(72,800),"ps5-front":(1487,209),
                  "ps5-back":(1000,411),"ps5-spine":(85,1000)}
        for name,(width,height) in examples.items():
            # Enough PNG header bytes for the bounded transfer validator.
            (folder/(name+".png")).write_bytes(
                b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n"+b"\x00"*8+
                struct.pack(">II",width,height)+b"\x00"*16)
        console=FakeFTP()
        with redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
            self.assertEqual(ftpmod.upload_case_templates(console,self.root),6)
        private="/data/homebrew/PPSA99386/assets/niak-templates/"
        self.assertEqual(sum(p.startswith(private) for p in console.files),6)
        self.assertNotIn(ftpmod.PAYLOAD,console.files)
        (folder/"ps5-spine.png").write_bytes(b"BAD")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            ftpmod.upload_case_templates(FakeFTP(),self.root)


    def test_installed_publisher_artwork_is_staged_privately_once(self):
        import io
        import struct
        import zlib
        from contextlib import redirect_stdout
        def png(w,h):
            def chunk(tag,data):
                return (struct.pack(">I",len(data))+tag+data+
                        struct.pack(">I",zlib.crc32(tag+data)&0xffffffff))
            pixels=b"".join(b"\0"+b"\x18\x28\x38\xff"*w for _ in range(h))
            return (b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n"+
                    chunk(b"IHDR",struct.pack(">IIBBBBB",w,h,8,6,0,0,0))+
                    chunk(b"IDAT",zlib.compress(pixels))+
                    chunk(b"IEND",b""))
        title="PPSA01234"
        root=f"/user/app/{title}/sce_sys"
        console=FakeFTP({root+"/icon0.png":png(512,512),
                         root+"/pic1.png":png(640,360),
                         "/user/av_contents/photo/private.png":png(512,512)})
        with redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
            self.assertEqual(ftpmod.stage_installed_artwork(console,2),2)
            self.assertEqual(ftpmod.stage_installed_artwork(console,2),0)
        cached="/data/homebrew/PPSA99386/assets/niak-installed/"
        self.assertEqual(len([p for p in console.files if p.startswith(cached)]),2)
        for side in ("icon","scene"):
            candidates=[cached+title+"-"+side+ext for ext in (".webp",".png")]
            present=[path for path in candidates if path in console.files]
            self.assertEqual(len(present),1)
            payload=console.files[present[0]]
            self.assertTrue(payload.startswith(b"RIFF") and payload[8:12]==b"WEBP"
                            or payload.startswith(b"\x89PNG"))
        native=(SCRIPT.parent/"game_icons.cpp").read_text()
        self.assertIn('"/app0/assets/niak-installed/%s-icon.png"',native)
        self.assertIn('"/app0/assets/niak-installed/%s-scene.png"',native)
        self.assertIn('"/app0/assets/niak-installed/%s-icon.webp"',native)
        self.assertIn('"/app0/assets/niak-installed/%s-scene.webp"',native)
        self.assertIn("decode_installed_art(",native)


    def test_only_verified_npxs_media_is_staged(self):
        import io
        from contextlib import redirect_stdout
        good="NPXS12345"
        bad="NPXS99999"
        # The cache discovery itself must be restricted to verified media
        # metadata, not just any directory matching an NPXS identifier.
        overlay=f"/data/homebrew/PPSA99386/assets/niak-local-titles.tsv"
        ftp=FakeFTP({overlay:(good+"\tLecteur vidéo\tApplication\t\t\n"+
                              bad+"\tService système\tAutre\t\t\n").encode()})
        with redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
            self.assertEqual(ftpmod._verified_media_ids(ftp),[good])
        src=(SCRIPT.parent/"game_icons.cpp").read_text()
        self.assertIn('std::strncmp(id,"NPXS",4)==0',src)
        self.assertIn('if(!niak_valid_title_id(id) && !media)return 0;',src)

    def test_installed_artwork_rejects_malformed_and_oversized_png(self):
        self.assertIsNone(ftpmod._prepare_installed_png(b"NOTPNG",False))
        header=(b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n"+b"\x00"*8+
                (9000).to_bytes(4,"big")+(9000).to_bytes(4,"big")+b"\x00"*16)
        self.assertIsNone(ftpmod._prepare_installed_png(header,False))
        self.assertIsNone(ftpmod._prepare_installed_png(b"x"*(5*1024*1024+1),False))


    def test_diagnose_normalizes_basename_only_ftp_listings(self):
        from contextlib import redirect_stdout
        from io import StringIO
        class Basenames(FakeFTP):
            def nlst(self,path):
                return [value.rsplit("/",1)[-1] for value in super().nlst(path)]
        base="/data/homebrew/PPSA99386"
        files={base+"/eboot.bin":b"native",
               base+"/assets/niak-launchbox-cases.tsv":b"# index",
               base+"/assets/niak-local-titles.tsv":b"# local",
               base+"/assets/niak-profile.png":b"private avatar",
               ftpmod.PAYLOAD:b"payload",
               "/data/niakps5-autostart.enabled":b""}
        stream=StringIO()
        with redirect_stdout(stream):
            ftpmod.diagnose(Basenames(files))
        report=stream.getvalue()
        self.assertIn("Titre eboot.bin : True",report)
        self.assertIn("Index LaunchBox : True",report)
        self.assertIn("Métadonnées locales : True",report)
        self.assertIn("Avatar copié : True",report)
        self.assertIn("Payload ELF : True",report)
        self.assertIn("Marqueur activation : True",report)

    def test_denied_ftp_roots_preserve_last_verified_title_overlay(self):
        from ftplib import error_perm
        class InaccessibleTitles(FakeFTP):
            def nlst(self,path):
                if path in ("/data/homebrew","/user/app","/system_ex/app",
                            "/mnt/ext0/user/app","/mnt/ext1/user/app"):
                    raise error_perm("550 Permission denied")
                return super().nlst(path)
        private=f"/data/homebrew/{ftpmod.TITLE}/assets/niak-local-titles.tsv"
        old=b"PPSA00001\\tJeu deja connu\\tJeu\\t\\t\\n"
        console=InaccessibleTitles({private:old})
        self.assertEqual(ftpmod.upload_local_homebrew_names(console),0)
        self.assertEqual(console.files[private],old)

    def test_installed_metadata_rejects_inconsistent_title_identity(self):
        # The folder and an explicit titleId must represent the same title;
        # otherwise stale/copied param.json can mislabel a title in the UI.
        root="/user/app/PPSA12345/sce_sys/param.json"
        path=f"/data/homebrew/{ftpmod.TITLE}/assets/niak-local-titles.tsv"
        ftp=FakeFTP({root:b'{"titleId":"PPSA99999","titleName":"Wrong Game","applicationCategoryType":0}'})
        self.assertEqual(ftpmod.upload_local_homebrew_names(ftp),0)
        self.assertEqual(ftp.files[path],b"")

    def test_malformed_installed_metadata_cannot_abort_all_title_discovery(self):
        import json
        base="/user/app"
        valid="PPSA12345"
        malformed={
            "PPSA23456":{"titleId":"PPSA23456","titleName":"List params",
                         "localizedParameters":["not","an","object"],
                         "applicationCategoryType":0},
            "PPSA34567":{"titleId":{"spoofed":True},"titleName":"Wrong identity",
                         "applicationCategoryType":0},
            "PPSA45678":{"titleId":"PPSA45678",
                         "localizedParameters":True,
                         "applicationCategoryType":0},
        }
        files={f"{base}/{valid}/sce_sys/param.json":
               json.dumps({"titleId":valid,"titleName":"Jeu valide",
                           "applicationCategoryType":0}).encode()}
        for ident,meta in malformed.items():
            files[f"{base}/{ident}/sce_sys/param.json"]=json.dumps(meta).encode()
        ftp=FakeFTP(files)
        self.assertEqual(ftpmod.upload_local_homebrew_names(ftp),2)
        overlay=ftp.files[f"/data/homebrew/{ftpmod.TITLE}/assets/niak-local-titles.tsv"].decode()
        self.assertIn("PPSA12345\tJeu valide\tJeu",overlay)
        self.assertIn("PPSA23456\tList params\tJeu",overlay)
        self.assertNotIn("PPSA34567",overlay)

    def test_preserve_autoload_updates_payload_without_rewriting_configuration(self):
        class TrackingFTP(FakeFTP):
            def __init__(self,files):
                super().__init__(files)
                self.writes=[]
            def storbinary(self,command,buf):
                self.writes.append(command[5:])
                return super().storbinary(command,buf)
        autoload=b"ftpsrv.elf\nniakps5.elf\n"
        settings=b"AUTOLOAD_DELAY=10\nAUTOLOAD_ENABLED=1\n"
        f=TrackingFTP({ftpmod.AUTOLOAD:autoload,ftpmod.CONFIG:settings,
                       ftpmod.PAYLOAD:b"stale-payload"})
        ftpmod.install(f,self.root,False,preserve_autoload=True)
        self.assertEqual(f.files[ftpmod.PAYLOAD],
                         (self.root/"tools/niakps5/niakps5.elf").read_bytes())
        self.assertIn(ftpmod.PAYLOAD_META,f.writes)
        self.assertIn("/data/homebrew/PPSA99386/eboot.bin",f.writes)
        bundled="/data/homebrew/PPSA99386/tools/niakps5/niakps5.elf"
        self.assertEqual(f.files[bundled],
                         (self.root/"tools/niakps5/niakps5.elf").read_bytes())
        self.assertIn(bundled+".json",f.files)
        self.assertNotIn("/data/homebrew/PPSA99386/tools/ftp_install.py",f.files)
        for protected in (ftpmod.AUTOLOAD,ftpmod.CONFIG,
                          "/data/niakps5-autostart.enabled"):
            self.assertNotIn(protected,f.writes)
        self.assertEqual(f.files[ftpmod.AUTOLOAD],autoload)
        self.assertEqual(f.files[ftpmod.CONFIG],settings)

    def test_reinstall_preserves_existing_autoload_bytes_and_order(self):
        class TrackingFTP(FakeFTP):
            def __init__(self,files):
                super().__init__(files)
                self.writes=[]
            def storbinary(self,command,buf):
                self.writes.append(command[5:])
                return super().storbinary(command,buf)
        autoload=b"niakps5.elf\nother.elf\n"
        settings=b"AUTOLOAD_ENABLED=1\nAUTOLOAD_DELAY=7\n"
        f=TrackingFTP({ftpmod.AUTOLOAD:autoload,ftpmod.CONFIG:settings})
        ftpmod.install(f,self.root,True)
        self.assertEqual(f.files[ftpmod.AUTOLOAD],autoload)
        self.assertEqual(f.files[ftpmod.CONFIG],settings)
        self.assertNotIn(ftpmod.AUTOLOAD,f.writes)
        self.assertNotIn(ftpmod.CONFIG,f.writes)
        self.assertIn(ftpmod.PAYLOAD,f.writes)

    def test_order_backup_idempotence(self):
        initial=(b"nanoDNS_0.4.elf\nkstuff-lite_v1.11.elf\n"
                 b"ShadowMountPlus_1.7beta7.elf\nftpsrv_v0.21.1.elf\n"
                 b"BFpilot_v0.4.4.elf\n")
        config=b"AUTOLOAD_ENABLED=0\nAUTOLOAD_DELAY=5\n"
        f=FakeFTP({ftpmod.AUTOLOAD:initial,ftpmod.CONFIG:config})
        ftpmod.install(f,self.root,True,True)
        final=f.files[ftpmod.AUTOLOAD].decode()
        self.assertTrue(final.startswith(initial.decode()))
        self.assertTrue(final.endswith("BFpilot_v0.4.4.elf\nniakps5.elf\n"))
        self.assertEqual(final.count(ftpmod.AUTOLOAD_NAME),1)
        self.assertNotIn("!2000",final)
        self.assertIn(ftpmod.PAYLOAD_META,f.files)
        import hashlib
        import json
        sidecar=json.loads(f.files[ftpmod.PAYLOAD_META])
        self.assertEqual(sidecar["filename"],"niakps5.elf")
        self.assertEqual(sidecar["checksum"],hashlib.sha256(
            f.files[ftpmod.PAYLOAD]).hexdigest())
        self.assertEqual(f.files[ftpmod.AUTOLOAD+".niakps5.bak"],initial)
        self.assertEqual(f.files[ftpmod.CONFIG+".niakps5.bak"],config)
        self.assertIn("AUTOLOAD_DELAY=5",f.files[ftpmod.CONFIG].decode())
        self.assertIn("AUTOLOAD_ENABLED=1",f.files[ftpmod.CONFIG].decode())
        self.assertIn("/data/niakps5-autostart.enabled",f.files)
        self.assertIn("/data/niakps5-return-after-game.enabled",f.files)
        ftpmod.install(f,self.root,True,False)
        self.assertNotIn("/data/niakps5-return-after-game.enabled",f.files)
        self.assertIn("/data/niakps5-autostart.enabled",f.files)
        self.assertEqual(f.files[ftpmod.AUTOLOAD].decode().count(ftpmod.AUTOLOAD_NAME),1)
        # A repeat install must never replace the original pre-Niak backups.
        self.assertEqual(f.files[ftpmod.AUTOLOAD+".niakps5.bak"],initial)
        self.assertEqual(f.files[ftpmod.CONFIG+".niakps5.bak"],config)


    def test_invalid_pldmgr_config_never_partially_enables_autoload(self):
        existing=b"/data/pldmgr/payloads/shadow/shadow.elf\n"
        f=FakeFTP({ftpmod.AUTOLOAD:existing,
                   ftpmod.CONFIG:b"AUTOLOAD_ENABLED=0\0CORRUPT"})

            ftpmod.install(f,self.root,True)
        self.assertEqual(f.files[ftpmod.AUTOLOAD],existing)
        self.assertNotIn(ftpmod.PAYLOAD,f.files)
        self.assertNotIn(ftpmod.AUTOLOAD+".niakps5.bak",f.files)
        self.assertNotIn("/data/niakps5-autostart.enabled",f.files)

    def test_disabled_return_flag_remains_disabled_on_reinstall(self):
        f=FakeFTP()
        ftpmod.install(f,self.root,True,False)
        self.assertNotIn("/data/niakps5-return-after-game.enabled",f.files)
        ftpmod.install(f,self.root,True,True)
        self.assertIn("/data/niakps5-return-after-game.enabled",f.files)
        ftpmod.install(f,self.root,True,False)
        self.assertNotIn("/data/niakps5-return-after-game.enabled",f.files)

    def test_failed_return_flag_removal_cannot_silently_claim_opt_out(self):
        from ftplib import error_perm
        marker="/data/niakps5-return-after-game.enabled"
        class UndeletableFTP(FakeFTP):
            def delete(self,path):
                raise error_perm("550 permission denied")
        f=UndeletableFTP({marker:b""})
        with self.assertRaises(error_perm):
            ftpmod.install(f,self.root,True,False)
        self.assertIn(marker,f.files)
        self.assertNotIn(ftpmod.PAYLOAD,f.files)
        self.assertNotIn(ftpmod.AUTOLOAD,f.files)
        self.assertNotIn("/data/niakps5-autostart.enabled",f.files)

    def test_autoload_backup_is_never_replaced_if_it_preexists(self):
        initial=b"/data/pldmgr/payloads/shadow/shadow.elf\n"
        first_backup=b"ORIGINAL BEFORE NIAKPS5\n"
        first_config=b"AUTOLOAD_ENABLED=0\nAUTOLOAD_DELAY=3\n"
        current_config=b"AUTOLOAD_ENABLED=1\nAUTOLOAD_DELAY=5\n"
        f=FakeFTP({ftpmod.AUTOLOAD:initial,
                   ftpmod.CONFIG:current_config,
                   ftpmod.AUTOLOAD+".niakps5.bak":first_backup,
                   ftpmod.CONFIG+".niakps5.bak":first_config})
        ftpmod.install(f,self.root,True)
        self.assertEqual(f.files[ftpmod.AUTOLOAD+".niakps5.bak"],first_backup)
        self.assertEqual(f.files[ftpmod.CONFIG+".niakps5.bak"],first_config)

    def test_multiple_profiles_are_not_guessed(self):
        root="/system_data/priv/cache/profile/"
        sample=b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n"+bytes(200)
        f=FakeFTP({root+"0x11111111/avatar.png":sample,root+"0x22222222/avatar.png":sample})
        ftpmod.install(f,self.root,False)
        self.assertNotIn("/data/homebrew/PPSA99386/assets/niak-profile.png",f.files)
        ftpmod.install(f,self.root,False,avatar_user_id="0x22222222")
        self.assertEqual(f.files["/data/homebrew/PPSA99386/assets/niak-profile.png"],sample)
        self.assertEqual(f.files["/data/homebrew/PPSA99386/assets/niak-profile-source.txt"],
                         b"0x22222222 png\n")

    def test_avatar_upload_failure_clears_previous_owner_before_image_update(self):
        from ftplib import error_perm

        marker="/data/homebrew/PPSA99386/assets/niak-profile-source.txt"
        destination="/data/homebrew/PPSA99386/assets/niak-profile.png"
        class BrokenFTP(FakeFTP):
            def storbinary(self,command,buf):
                if command=="STOR "+destination:
                    raise error_perm("550 write refused")
                return super().storbinary(command,buf)
        f=BrokenFTP({
            source:b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n"+bytes(200),
            marker:b"0x87654321 png\n",
            destination:b"old-avatar",
        })
        with self.assertRaises(error_perm):
            ftpmod.copy_avatar_for_ftp(f)
        self.assertEqual(f.files[marker],b"")
        self.assertEqual(f.files[destination],b"old-avatar")

    def test_launchbox_reports_download_and_write_failures_without_secrets(self):
        from unittest.mock import patch
        from urllib.error import HTTPError
        from contextlib import redirect_stdout
        from io import StringIO
        import urllib.request
        ident="PPSA34015"
        artwork_id="00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001.jpg"
        (self.root/"assets").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        (self.root/"assets/niak-launchbox-cases.tsv").write_text(
            ident+"\tOverview\tfr:"+artwork_id+"\t-\t-\t-\t42\n")
        ftp=FakeFTP({f"/user/app/{ident}/eboot.bin":b"installed"})
        output=StringIO()
        source="https://images.launchbox-app.com/"+artwork_id
        with (patch.object(urllib.request,"urlopen",
                           side_effect=HTTPError(source,403,"denied",None,None)),
              redirect_stdout(output)):
            self.assertEqual(ftpmod.fetch_retail_covers(ftp,self.root),0)
        report=output.getvalue()
        self.assertIn("HTTP [403: 1]",report)
        self.assertNotIn(artwork_id,report)
        self.assertIn("source distante restreinte",report)
        class Reply:
            def __enter__(self): return self
            def __exit__(self,*args): pass
            def read(self,n): return b"not an image"
        output=StringIO()
        with (patch.object(urllib.request,"urlopen",return_value=Reply()),
              patch.object(ftpmod,"_decode_retail_image",
                           side_effect=ValueError("malformed")),
              redirect_stdout(output)):
            self.assertEqual(ftpmod.fetch_retail_covers(ftp,self.root),0)
        self.assertIn("images rejetées=1",output.getvalue())
        output=StringIO()
        with (patch.object(urllib.request,"urlopen",return_value=Reply()),
              patch.object(ftpmod,"_decode_retail_image",
                           return_value=b"valid png fixture"),
              patch.object(ftpmod,"upload",side_effect=OSError("FTP 550")),
              redirect_stdout(output)):
            self.assertEqual(ftpmod.fetch_retail_covers(ftp,self.root),0)
        self.assertIn("FTP refusé=1",output.getvalue())

    def test_read_only_app_db_registration_evidence(self):

        from io import StringIO
        from contextlib import redirect_stdout

                   (ftpmod.TITLE,"NiakPS5"))
        image=db.serialize()
        db.close()
        for blob,expected in [
            (image,"PPSA99386 trouvé"),
            (b"invalid","inconnu"),

            with self.subTest(expected=expected):
                ftp=FakeFTP({location:blob})
                previous=ftp.files.copy()
                output=StringIO()
                with redirect_stdout(output):
                    ftpmod.diagnose_appdb_registration(ftp)
                self.assertEqual(ftp.files,previous)
                self.assertIn(expected,output.getvalue())
        db=sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
        db.execute("CREATE TABLE tbl_contentinfo(titleId TEXT)")
        missing=db.serialize()
        db.close()
        ftp=FakeFTP({location:missing})
        output=StringIO()
        with redirect_stdout(output):
            ftpmod.diagnose_appdb_registration(ftp)
        self.assertIn("absent de la copie reçue",output.getvalue())
        self.assertEqual(ftp.files,{location:missing})

    def test_log_separates_lnc_success_from_stale_process(self):
        last="NiakPS5 optional autostart start rc=0x00000000\n"
        sys="sceSystemServiceLaunchApp rc=0x80940005\n"
        accepted="sceLncUtilLaunchApp accepted app id rc=0x0000ABCD\n"
        refused="sceLncUtilLaunchApp refused rc=0x80940031\n"
        from_lnc=last+sys+accepted
        observed,heartbeat=ftpmod.interpret_broker_log(from_lnc,clock=1000)
        self.assertIn("succès HISTORIQUE (LncUtil)",observed)
        self.assertIn("aucun horodatage",heartbeat)
        self.assertIn("échec historique",ftpmod.interpret_broker_log(
            last+sys+refused,clock=1000)[0])
        self.assertIn("échec historique",ftpmod.interpret_broker_log(
            last+sys,clock=1000)[0])
        recent=last+sys+accepted+"NiakPS5 broker heartbeat epoch=900 pid=12345\n"
        observed,heartbeat=ftpmod.interpret_broker_log(recent,clock=1000)
        self.assertIn("succès HISTORIQUE (LncUtil)",observed)
        self.assertIn("activité récente",heartbeat)
        self.assertIn("PID 12345",heartbeat)
        self.assertIn("dernier battement ancien",
                      ftpmod.interpret_broker_log(recent,clock=1900)[1])
        after=last+sys+accepted+sys+refused
        self.assertIn("échec historique",ftpmod.interpret_broker_log(
            after,clock=1000)[0])
        self.assertEqual("non confirmée",
                         ftpmod.interpret_broker_log("arbitrary text")[0])

    def test_art_cache_handles_absolute_and_basename_ftp_listings(self):
        from unittest.mock import patch
        import urllib.request
        for mode in ("absolute","basename","relative"):
            with self.subTest(mode=mode):
                ident="PPSA34015"
                stored=f"/data/homebrew/{ftpmod.TITLE}/assets/niak-cases/{ident}-front.png"
                ftp=FakeFTP({stored:b"cached",
                             f"/user/app/{ident}/eboot.bin":b"game",
                             ftpmod.CASE_CACHE_SOURCES:(
                        ident+"\tfront\t00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001.jpg\n").encode(),})
                (self.root/"assets").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
                (self.root/"assets/niak-launchbox-cases.tsv").write_text(
                    ident+"\\t-\\tfr:00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001.jpg"
                    +"\\t-\\t-\\t-\\t4\\n")
                original=ftp.nlst
                def alternate_listing(path):
                    returned=original(path)
                    if path.endswith("/niak-cases"):
                        if mode=="basename":
                            return [entry.rsplit("/",1)[-1] for entry in returned]
                        if mode=="relative":
                            return ["niak-cases/"+entry.rsplit("/",1)[-1]
                                    for entry in returned]
                    return returned
                with (patch.object(ftp,"nlst",side_effect=alternate_listing),
                      patch.object(ftpmod,"_cache_hit",return_value=True),
                      patch.object(urllib.request,"urlopen") as net):
                    self.assertEqual(ftpmod.fetch_retail_covers(ftp,self.root),0)
                    net.assert_not_called()
                self.assertEqual(ftp.files[stored],b"cached")
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Single-folder FTP installation must not require CLI on the user's PS5."""
import importlib.util
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import stat
import tempfile
import unittest

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
module=ROOT/"pack_ftp_dragdrop.py"
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("niak_ftp_dragdrop",module)
mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(mod)

class FTPDropinTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.tmp=tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.tmp.cleanup)
        self.home=Path(self.tmp.name)
        self.title=self.home/"PPSA99386"
        for filename,body in {
            "eboot.bin":b"ELF native title",
            "sce_module/libc.prx":b"runtime",
            "sce_sys/param.json":b'{"titleId":"PPSA99386"}',
            "tools/niakps5/niakps5.elf":b"\x7fELF" + b"payload",
            "assets/test.txt":b"visible",
        }.items():
            p=self.title/filename
            p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
            p.write_bytes(body)
        payload=(self.title/"tools/niakps5/niakps5.elf").read_bytes()
        (self.title/"tools/niakps5/niakps5.elf.json").write_text(json.dumps(
            {"filename":"niakps5.elf","checksum":hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()}))
    def test_one_data_folder_and_exact_two_payload_files(self):
        dest=self.home/"dropin"
        mod.stage(self.title,dest)
        app=dest/"data/homebrew/PPSA99386"
        slot=dest/"data/pldmgr/payloads/niakps5"
        self.assertEqual((app/"eboot.bin").read_bytes(),b"ELF native title")
        self.assertEqual((slot/"niakps5.elf").read_bytes(),
                         (app/"tools/niakps5/niakps5.elf").read_bytes())
        self.assertEqual((slot/"niakps5.elf.json").read_bytes(),
                         (app/"tools/niakps5/niakps5.elf.json").read_bytes())
        self.assertEqual([p.name for p in dest.iterdir()],["data"])
        self.assertFalse((dest/"data/pldmgr/autoload.txt").exists())
        self.assertFalse((dest/"data/pldmgr/pldmgr_config.txt").exists())
        self.assertEqual((slot/"niakps5.elf").stat().st_mode & 0o777,0o755)
    def test_no_nested_zips_in_transfer_folder(self):
        dest=self.home/"dropin"
        mod.stage(self.title,dest)
        self.assertEqual([p.name for p in dest.iterdir()],["data"])
        self.assertFalse(any(p.suffix.lower()==".zip" for p in dest.rglob("*")))
        self.assertFalse((dest/"data/pldmgr/autoload.txt").exists())

    def test_reject_corrupt_sidecar_before_copying(self):
        sidecar=self.title/"tools/niakps5/niakps5.elf.json"
        sidecar.write_text('{"filename":"niakps5.elf","checksum":"wrong"}')
        out=self.home/"dest"
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,"checksum"):
            mod.stage(self.title,out)
        self.assertFalse(out.exists())
    def test_never_copy_user_autoload(self):
        (self.title/"autoload.txt").write_text("overwrite")
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,"Never bundle"):
            mod.stage(self.title,self.home/"out")
    def test_never_accept_symlinked_console_assets(self):
        link=self.title/"assets/alias.png"
        link.symlink_to(self.title/"eboot.bin")
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,"Symlinks forbidden"):
            mod.stage(self.title,self.home/"out")
```

```py
"""The PS5 icon worker may perform HTTP; it must never upload GPU textures."""
from pathlib import Path
import unittest

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
SOURCE=(ROOT/"game_icons.cpp").read_text()
PATCH=(ROOT/"prepare.py").read_text()
HEADER=(ROOT/"game_icons.hpp").read_text()

class IconAsyncWorkerTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_ps5_loader_enqueues_without_network(self):
        loader=SOURCE[SOURCE.index("std::uint32_t niak_load_game_icon("):
                      SOURCE.index("std::uint32_t niak_take_downloaded_game_icon(")]
        ps5=loader[loader.index("#if defined(__PROSPERO__)"):
                    loader.index("#else")]
        self.assertIn("request_missing_icon(id)",ps5)
        self.assertNotIn("read_local_png(",ps5)
        self.assertNotIn("decode_icon_thumbnail(",ps5)
        self.assertNotIn("download(",ps5)
        self.assertNotIn("renderer.create_texture(",ps5)

    def test_only_reader_owns_http(self):
        worker=SOURCE[SOURCE.index("void icon_reader_worker() {"):
                      SOURCE.index("void request_missing_icon(")]
        self.assertIn("download(url,bytes)",worker)
        self.assertIn("if(!load_installed_icon_pixels(id.c_str(),pixels))",worker)
        self.assertLess(worker.index("load_installed_icon_pixels("),
                        worker.index("download(url,bytes)"))
        self.assertIn("state.wake.wait(",worker)
        self.assertIn("!state.completed && !state.queue.empty()",worker)
        self.assertIn("std::thread([] {icon_reader_worker();}).detach();",SOURCE)
        self.assertIn("state.seen.size()>=4096",SOURCE)
        self.assertNotIn("renderer.",worker)
        self.assertIn("decode_icon_thumbnail(bytes,pixels)",worker)
        self.assertIn("state.completed_pixels=std::move(pixels);",worker)
        self.assertIn("state.seen.erase(id);",worker)
        self.assertIn("state.seen.erase(id);",SOURCE[SOURCE.index("std::uint32_t niak_take_downloaded_game_icon("):])

    def test_installed_local_art_decodes_off_render_thread(self):
        helper=SOURCE[SOURCE.index("bool load_installed_icon_pixels("):
                      SOURCE.index("// One background reader for missing installed icons.")]
        self.assertIn("kInstalledIconPaths",helper)
        self.assertIn("read_local_png(path,encoded)",helper)
        self.assertIn("decode_icon_thumbnail(encoded,pixels)",helper)
        self.assertNotIn("renderer.",helper)
        loader=SOURCE[SOURCE.index("std::uint32_t niak_load_game_icon("):
                      SOURCE.index("void niak_request_missing_game_icon(")]
        ps5=loader[loader.index("#if defined(__PROSPERO__)"):
                    loader.index("#else")]
        self.assertNotIn("std::fopen",ps5)
        self.assertNotIn("read_local_png",ps5)
        self.assertIn("for(const char *format : kInstalledIconPaths)",loader)
        self.assertIn("state.completed_pixels=std::move(pixels);",SOURCE)

    def test_network_worker_releases_raw_images_before_gpu_upload(self):
        worker=SOURCE[SOURCE.index("void icon_reader_worker() {"):
                      SOURCE.index("void request_missing_icon(")]
        self.assertIn("std::vector<unsigned char> pixels;",worker)
        self.assertIn("if(!complete || !decode_icon_thumbnail(bytes,pixels))",worker)
        self.assertIn("state.completed_pixels=std::move(pixels);",worker)
        self.assertIn("one 256x256 RGBA buffer: 256 KiB",SOURCE)
        self.assertNotIn("completed_bytes",SOURCE)
        self.assertIn("return renderer.create_texture(kTarget,kTarget,pixels.data());",SOURCE)
        self.assertIn("return renderer.create_texture(kTarget,kTarget,bytes.data());",SOURCE)

    def test_renderer_consumes_and_replaces_fallback(self):
        self.assertIn("niak_take_downloaded_game_icon",HEADER)
        self.assertIn("return renderer.create_texture(kTarget,kTarget,bytes.data());",SOURCE)
        poll=SOURCE[SOURCE.index("std::uint32_t niak_take_downloaded_game_icon("):
                    SOURCE.index("std::uint32_t niak_load_game_background(")]

        self.assertNotIn("decode_icon_thumbnail(",poll)

        self.assertIn("scaled=std::move(rgba);",SOURCE)
        self.assertIn("if(!decode_icon_thumbnail(image,pixels))return 0;",SOURCE)
        self.assertIn("renderer.destroy_texture(handle);",PATCH)
        self.assertIn("if(it->cover)renderer.destroy_texture(it->cover);",PATCH)
        self.assertIn("it->cover_is_image=true;",PATCH)
        self.assertIn("catalog.refresh_pending_game_icons(renderer);",PATCH)
        self.assertIn("#include <cstring>",PATCH)
        self.assertIn("if(navigation_idle)",PATCH)
        self.assertIn("void niak_request_missing_game_icon(const char *title_id);",HEADER)
        self.assertIn("request_missing_icon(id);",SOURCE)
        self.assertIn("void Catalog::retry_missing_game_icons()",PATCH)
```

`native/title/tests/test_launch_bridge.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Exercise the real PS5 launch bridge protocol against a fragmented TCP server."""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile
import unittest

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
SERVER= r'''
#include <arpa/inet.h>
#include <cassert>
#include <chrono>
#include <cstring>
#include <sys/socket.h>
#include <thread>
#include <unistd.h>
#include "niak/launch_bridge.hpp"

static void send_parts(int fd,const char *first,const char *second) {
    assert(::send(fd,first,std::strlen(first),0)==ssize_t(std::strlen(first)));
    std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(10));
    assert(::send(fd,second,std::strlen(second),0)==ssize_t(std::strlen(second)));
}
int main() {
    const int server=::socket(AF_INET,SOCK_STREAM,0);
    assert(server>=0);
    int yes=1;::setsockopt(server,SOL_SOCKET,SO_REUSEADDR,&yes,sizeof(yes));
    sockaddr_in local{};
    local.sin_family=AF_INET;local.sin_port=htons(19187);
    local.sin_addr.s_addr=htonl(INADDR_LOOPBACK);
    assert(::bind(server,reinterpret_cast<sockaddr*>(&local),sizeof(local))==0);
    assert(::listen(server,4)==0);
    std::thread worker([&]() {
        for(int i=0;i<6;++i) {
            int client=::accept(server,nullptr,nullptr);
            assert(client>=0);
            char buffer[40]{};
            const ssize_t count=::recv(client,buffer,sizeof(buffer),0);
            assert(count>0);
            if(i==0) {
                assert(std::strncmp(buffer,"PING\n",5)==0);
                send_parts(client,"PO","NG\n");
            } else if(i==1) {
                assert(std::strncmp(buffer,"STATUS\n",7)==0);
                send_parts(client,"PID 0000","400A\n");
            } else if(i==4) {
                assert(std::strncmp(buffer,"PING\n",5)==0);
                // A dead broker accepted the socket but never replied.
                std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(300));
            } else if(i==5) {
                assert(std::strncmp(buffer,"SETTINGS\n",9)==0);
                send_parts(client,"RC 0000","0000\n");
            } else {
                assert(std::strncmp(buffer,"LAUNCH PPSA12345\n",17)==0);
                if(i==2)send_parts(client,"RC 0000","0000\n");
                else assert(::send(client,"RC 0",4,0)==4);
            }
            ::close(client);
        }
    });
    assert(niak_launch_registered_title("BAD")==-3);
    assert(niak_launch_broker_ready());
    assert(std::strstr(niak_launch_broker_diagnostic(),"PING confirme")!=nullptr);
    assert(niak_launch_broker_pid()==0x400Au);
    const auto cached_start=std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
    for(int i=0;i<40;++i)assert(niak_launch_broker_ready());
    const auto cached_ms=std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(
        std::chrono::steady_clock::now()-cached_start).count();
    assert(cached_ms<100); // No extra PING sockets while rendering Settings.
    assert(niak_launch_registered_title("PPSA12345")==0);
    assert(niak_launch_registered_title("PPSA12345")==-2);
    std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(1050));
    const auto before=std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
    assert(!niak_launch_broker_ready());
    assert(std::strstr(niak_launch_broker_diagnostic(),"PING recv")!=nullptr);
    assert(!niak_launch_broker_ready()); // cached failed health check
    const auto milliseconds=std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(
        std::chrono::steady_clock::now()-before).count();
    assert(milliseconds<220);
    assert(niak_open_system_settings()==0);
    worker.join();
    ::close(server);
    const auto offline=std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
    assert(niak_launch_registered_title("PPSA12345")==-2);
    const auto elapsed=std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(
        std::chrono::steady_clock::now()-offline).count();
    assert(elapsed<300);
    return 0;
}
'''

class LaunchBridgeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_real_fragmented_broker_messages(self):
        compiler=shutil.which("g++")
        if not compiler:
            self.skipTest("host g++ unavailable")
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            work=Path(tmp)
            (work/"niak").mkdir()
            shutil.copyfile(ROOT/"launch_bridge.hpp",work/"niak"/"launch_bridge.hpp")
            shutil.copyfile(ROOT/"socket_guard.h",work/"niak"/"socket_guard.h")
            shutil.copyfile(ROOT/"loopback_connect.h",work/"niak"/"loopback_connect.h")
            shutil.copyfile(ROOT/"broker_snapshot.h",work/"niak"/"broker_snapshot.h")
            shutil.copyfile(ROOT.parent/"catalog.h",work/"niak"/"catalog.h")
            (work/"server.cpp").write_text(SERVER,encoding="utf8")
            binary=work/"launch-bridge-test"
            compiled=subprocess.run([
                compiler,"-std=c++20","-pthread","-Wall","-Wextra","-Werror",
                "-I",str(work),str(ROOT/"launch_bridge.cpp"),
                str(work/"server.cpp"),"-o",str(binary)],
                capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=50)
            self.assertEqual(compiled.returncode,0,compiled.stderr)
            subprocess.run([str(binary)],check=True,capture_output=True,
                           text=True,timeout=15)

if __name__=="__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Host regression: an accepted LncUtil fallback is not a failed launch."""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile
import unittest

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
TEST=r"""
#include "niak/launch_log_status.h"
#include <assert.h>
int main(void) {
    const char *fail="NiakPS5 optional autostart start rc=0x00000000\n"
        "UserService initialize rc=0x00000000\n"
        "sceSystemServiceLaunchApp rc=0x80940005\n";
    assert(niak_last_launch_result(fail)==NIAK_LAUNCH_LOG_SYSTEM_FAILED);
    const char *ok="NiakPS5 optional autostart start rc=0x00000000\n"
        "sceSystemServiceLaunchApp rc=0x80940005\n"
        "sceLncUtilLaunchApp accepted app id rc=0x00007777\n";
    assert(niak_last_launch_result(ok)==NIAK_LAUNCH_LOG_LNC_OK);
    const char *still_fail="NiakPS5 optional autostart start rc=0x00000000\n"
        "sceSystemServiceLaunchApp rc=0x80940005\n"
        "sceLncUtilLaunchApp refused rc=0x80940031\n";
    assert(niak_last_launch_result(still_fail)==NIAK_LAUNCH_LOG_LNC_FAILED);
    const char *invalid="NiakPS5 optional autostart start rc=0x00000000\n"
        "sceSystemServiceLaunchApp rc=0x80940005\n"
        "sceLncUtilLaunchApp returned invalid app id rc=0x00000000\n";
    assert(niak_last_launch_result(invalid)==NIAK_LAUNCH_LOG_LNC_FAILED);
    const char *after="NiakPS5 optional autostart start rc=0x00000000\n"
        "sceSystemServiceLaunchApp rc=0x80940005\n"
        "sceLncUtilLaunchApp accepted app id rc=0x00007777\n"
        "sceSystemServiceLaunchApp rc=0x80940005\n";
    assert(niak_last_launch_result(after)==NIAK_LAUNCH_LOG_SYSTEM_FAILED);
    const char *system="NiakPS5 optional autostart start rc=0x00000000\n"
        "sceSystemServiceLaunchApp rc=0x00000000\n";
    assert(niak_last_launch_result(system)==NIAK_LAUNCH_LOG_SYSTEM_OK);
    const char *real_console="NiakPS5 optional autostart start rc=0x00000000\n"
        "sceSystemServiceLaunchApp rc=0x00000018\n"
        "sceSystemServiceLaunchApp rc=0x00002018\n";
    assert(niak_last_launch_result(real_console)==NIAK_LAUNCH_LOG_SYSTEM_OK);
    assert(niak_launch_log_nonnegative("sceSystemServiceLaunchApp rc=0x00002018\n"));
    assert(!niak_launch_log_nonnegative("sceSystemServiceLaunchApp rc=0x80940005\n"));
    assert(!niak_launch_log_nonnegative("sceSystemServiceLaunchApp rc=0x0000201G\n"));
    assert(!niak_launch_log_nonnegative("sceSystemServiceLaunchApp rc=0x00002018abcdef\n"));
    assert(niak_last_launch_result("abc")==NIAK_LAUNCH_LOG_NO_PAYLOAD);
    return 0;
}
"""
class LogTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_latest_attempt_and_fallback(self):
        cc=shutil.which("cc")
        if not cc:self.skipTest("No C compiler")
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            path=Path(tmp)
            (path/"niak").mkdir()
            shutil.copyfile(ROOT/"launch_log_status.h",path/"niak/launch_log_status.h")
            (path/"main.c").write_text(TEST,encoding="utf8")
            subprocess.run([cc,"-std=c11","-Wall","-Wextra","-Werror",
                            "-I",str(path),str(path/"main.c"),"-o",str(path/"run")],
                            check=True,capture_output=True,text=True)
            subprocess.run([str(path/"run")],check=True,capture_output=True,text=True)
if __name__=="__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

```py
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET
MODULE=Path(__file__).parents[1]/"launchbox_index.py"

class TestRetailCases(unittest.TestCase):
 def test_real_launchbox_overview_field_is_preferred(self):
  xml=b'''<LaunchBox>
    <Game><DatabaseID>427261</DatabaseID>
      <Platform>Sony Playstation 5</Platform>
      <Name>A Plague Tale: Innocence</Name>
      <Overview>Follow two siblings. Escape danger. Protect each other. Fourth is removed.</Overview>
      <Notes>Incorrect application-only field.</Notes>
```
