```py
  </LaunchBox>'''
  rows=mod.parse(io.BytesIO(xml),{("ps5","a plague tale innocence"):["PPSA02387"]})
  self.assertEqual(len(rows),1)
  self.assertEqual(rows[0][1],"Follow two siblings. Escape danger. Protect each other.")
  self.assertNotIn("Incorrect",rows[0][1])


 def test_overview_keeps_only_three_source_sentences(self):
  original="One. Two! Three? Four. Five."
  self.assertEqual(mod.clean_overview(original),"One. Two! Three?")
  self.assertLessEqual(len(mod.clean_overview("Sentence. "*200)),360)

 def test_front_prioritizes_french_europe_english_before_other(self):
  entries=[("world","00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000900.jpg"),
           ("us","00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000901.jpg"),
           ("fr","00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000902.jpg"),
           ("fr","00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000903.jpg"),
           ("uk","00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000904.jpg"),
           ("eu","00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000905.jpg")]
  faces=mod.face_options(entries).split(";")
  self.assertEqual([x.split(":")[0] for x in faces[:4]],
                   ["fr","eu","uk","us"])
  self.assertEqual(faces[0].split(":")[1][-7:],"902.jpg")
  self.assertIn("903.jpg",faces[-1])

 def test_language_platform_and_ambiguity(self):
  sources={("ps5","ea sports fc 27"):["PPSA34015"],
           ("ps4","ea sports fc 27"):["CUSA77777"]}
  xml=b'''<LaunchBox>
  <Game><DatabaseID>8</DatabaseID><Platform>Sony Playstation 5</Platform><Name>EA SPORTS FC 27</Name><Notes>Authentic &amp; real gameplay.</Notes></Game>
  <Game><DatabaseID>9</DatabaseID><Platform>Sony Playstation 4</Platform><Name>EA SPORTS FC 27</Name><Notes>PS4 edition</Notes></Game>
  <GameImage><DatabaseID>8</DatabaseID><Type>Box - Front</Type><Region>North America</Region><FileName>00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001.jpg</FileName></GameImage>
  <GameImage><DatabaseID>8</DatabaseID><Type>Box - Front</Type><Region>France</Region><FileName>00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002.jpg</FileName></GameImage>
  <GameImage><DatabaseID>8</DatabaseID><Type>Box - Back</Type><Region>Europe</Region><FileName>00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000003.png</FileName></GameImage>
  <GameImage><DatabaseID>9</DatabaseID><Type>Box - Front</Type><Region>World</Region><FileName>00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000004.jpg</FileName></GameImage>
  </LaunchBox>'''
  rows=mod.parse(io.BytesIO(xml),sources)
  self.assertEqual(len(rows),2)
  ps5=next(x for x in rows if x[0]=="PPSA34015")
  ps4=next(x for x in rows if x[0]=="CUSA77777")
  self.assertTrue(ps5[2].startswith("fr:00000000"))
  self.assertIn("Authentic & real",ps5[1])
  self.assertTrue(ps4[2].startswith("world:"))
  self.assertNotEqual(ps4[2],ps5[2])
  self.assertEqual(mod.normalize("EA SPORTS® FC 27"),"ea sports fc 27")

 def test_console_edition_matches_base_when_no_exact_front(self):

    <Game><DatabaseID>52</DatabaseID><Platform>Sony Playstation 4</Platform>
      <Name>Le Titre Local</Name></Game>

      <FileName>00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000053.png</FileName></GameImage>

  rows=mod.parse(io.BytesIO(xml),target)
```

`native/title/tests/test_local_inventory.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Cached FTP title manifest parser; no Sony DB access or writes."""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile
import unittest

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
SOURCE=r"""
#include "niak/local_inventory.h"
#include <assert.h>
#include <string.h>
int main(int argc,char **argv) {
    assert(argc==2);
    NiakGame games[8]={0};
    assert(niak_scan_local_inventory(argv[1],games,8)==3);
    assert(strcmp(games[0].id,"PPSA12345")==0);
    assert(strcmp(games[0].title,"Mon Jeu")==0);
    assert(games[0].application_category==1);
    assert(games[0].discovered_from_homebrew==3);
    assert(strcmp(games[1].id,"CUSA99999")==0);
    assert(strcmp(games[2].id,"NPXS12345")==0);
    assert(games[2].application_category==2);
    assert(niak_scan_local_inventory("/not-found/manifest.tsv",games,8)==-1);
    return 0;
}
"""

class LocalInventoryTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_rejects_invalid_and_builtin_titles(self):
        compiler=shutil.which("cc")
        if not compiler:
            self.skipTest("host C compiler unavailable")
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            root=Path(directory)
            (root/"niak").mkdir()
            shutil.copyfile(ROOT/"local_inventory.h",root/"niak/local_inventory.h")
            shutil.copyfile(ROOT.parent/"catalog.h",root/"niak/catalog.h")
            (root/"main.c").write_text(SOURCE)
            inventory=root/"titles.tsv"
            inventory.write_text(
                "PPSA12345\tMon Jeu\tJeu\t\t\n"
                "CUSA99999\tJeu PS4\tJeu\t\t\n"
                "NPXS98765\tService système\tJeu\t\t\n"
                "NPXS12345\tApplication média\tApplication\t\t\n"
                "PPSA99386\tNiakPS5\tApplication\t\t\n"
                "PPSA12345\tDoublon\tJeu\t\t\n"
                "BADID\tInvalide\tJeu\t\t\n",
                encoding="utf-8")
            binary=root/"test"
            subprocess.run([compiler,"-std=c11","-Wall","-Wextra","-Werror",
                            "-I",str(root),str(root/"main.c"),"-o",str(binary)],
                           check=True,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=20)
            subprocess.run([str(binary),str(inventory)],
                           check=True,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=10)

if __name__=="__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

`native/title/tests/test_loopback_denied.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Native sandbox regression: denied FIONBIO must not hide a live local broker."""
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile
import unittest

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
SOURCE=r"""
#define _POSIX_C_SOURCE 200809L
#include <errno.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>
/* Simulate the PS5's EPERM/EACCES on the network FIONBIO ioctl, leaving
 * the freshly allocated socket in its original blocking mode. */
static int niak_denied_ioctl(int fd,unsigned long request,...) {
    (void)fd;(void)request;errno=EACCES;return -1;
}
#define ioctl niak_denied_ioctl
#include "niak/loopback_connect.h"
#undef ioctl
#include <assert.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>

int main(void) {
    int listener=socket(AF_INET,SOCK_STREAM,0);
    assert(listener>=0);
    struct sockaddr_in address={0};
    address.sin_family=AF_INET;
    address.sin_addr.s_addr=htonl(INADDR_LOOPBACK);
    assert(bind(listener,(struct sockaddr *)&address,sizeof(address))==0);
    assert(listen(listener,1)==0);
    socklen_t size=sizeof(address);
    assert(getsockname(listener,(struct sockaddr *)&address,&size)==0);
    int client=socket(AF_INET,SOCK_STREAM,0);
    assert(client>=0);
    int stage=0;
    assert(niak_connect_bounded_ex(client,
            (const struct sockaddr *)&address,sizeof(address),150,&stage)==0);
    assert(stage==3);
    assert((fcntl(client,F_GETFL,0)&O_NONBLOCK)==0);
    int accepted=accept(listener,NULL,NULL);
    assert(accepted>=0);
    close(accepted);close(client);
    // No network access beyond 127.0.0.1 on the ioctl-denied path.
    struct sockaddr_in forbidden=address;
    forbidden.sin_addr.s_addr=htonl(0x08080808U);
    client=socket(AF_INET,SOCK_STREAM,0);
    assert(client>=0);
    assert(niak_connect_bounded_ex(client,
            (const struct sockaddr *)&forbidden,sizeof(forbidden),150,&stage)==-1);
    assert(errno==EACCES);
    assert(stage==2);
    close(client);
    close(listener);
    return 0;
}
"""

class DeniedIoctlTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_denied_nonblocking_ioctl_falls_back_only_for_loopback(self):
        cc=shutil.which("cc")
        if not cc:self.skipTest("C compiler unavailable")
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp:
            root=Path(temp)
            (root/"niak").mkdir()
            shutil.copy2(ROOT/"loopback_connect.h",root/"niak"/"loopback_connect.h")
            (root/"sandbox.c").write_text(SOURCE,encoding="utf-8")
            exe=root/"sandbox-test"
            result=subprocess.run(
                [cc,"-std=c11","-Wall","-Wextra","-Werror",
                 "-I",str(root),str(root/"sandbox.c"),"-o",str(exe)],
                capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=25)
            self.assertEqual(result.returncode,0,result.stderr)
            subprocess.run([str(exe)],check=True,capture_output=True,
                           text=True,timeout=10)

if __name__=="__main__":
    unittest.main()

```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Prove public preview contains six user-supplied console blocks, not QA art."""
from pathlib import Path
from io import BytesIO
import base64
import hashlib
import unittest
from zipfile import ZipFile

TITLE=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
ROOT=TITLE.parent.parent
EXPECTED_SHA="cd3383fa7705ec19ebfbb5923d67d75c9c9c3fd2c290b91edd562c2792c0ecc4"
EXPECTED={f"{family}-{part}.webp" for family in ("ps4","ps5")
          for part in ("front","back","spine")}

class PreviewBlocksTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_user_supplied_blocks_are_available_to_every_ci_run(self):
        src=TITLE/"assets"/"preview-blocks"
        self.assertEqual([p.name for p in sorted(src.glob("*.b64"))],
                         [f"{i:02}.b64" for i in range(6)])
        contents="".join((src/f"{i:02}.b64").read_text("ascii") for i in range(6))
        raw=base64.b64decode(contents,validate=True)
        self.assertEqual(hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),EXPECTED_SHA)
        with ZipFile(BytesIO(raw)) as archive:
            self.assertIsNone(archive.testzip())
            self.assertEqual(set(archive.namelist()),EXPECTED)
            for name in EXPECTED:
                content=archive.read(name)
                self.assertGreater(len(content),600)
                self.assertEqual(content[:4],b"RIFF")
                self.assertEqual(content[8:12],b"WEBP")

    def test_standard_artifact_requires_actual_blocks(self):
        host=(TITLE/"host_preview.py").read_text("utf-8")
        workflow=(ROOT/".github/workflows/native-title.yml").read_text("utf-8")
        validator=(TITLE/"validate_preview.py").read_text("utf-8")
        self.assertNotIn('family.upper()+"  /  QA HEADER"',host)
        self.assertNotIn('" / QA FOOTER"',host)
        self.assertIn("NIAK_CASE_ORIGINAL_BLOCKS",host)
        self.assertIn("00-fixed-elements-PS4-PS5.png",host)
        self.assertIn("Expected exactly 6 PNG captures",validator)
        self.assertNotIn("00-fixed-elements-PS4-PS5.png build/niak-preview/",workflow)
        self.assertIn("NIAK_CASE_TOUR=1",workflow)
        self.assertIn("NiakPS5-OpenGL-interface-preview",workflow)
        self.assertIn("NIAK_CASE_TEMPLATE_ASSETS",workflow)

if __name__=="__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

`native/title/tests/test_private_preview.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Private OpenGL preview uses the actual six templates, never synthetic QA."""
import importlib.util
from pathlib import Path
import struct
import tempfile
import unittest
from zipfile import ZipFile

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("niak_private_preview",
                                             ROOT/"private_preview.py")
module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(module)

class PrivatePreviewTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_original_six_templates_injected_into_local_kit_only(self):
        images={}
        sizes={
            "ps4-front.png":(949,136),"ps5-front.png":(1487,209),
            "ps4-back.png":(647,362),"ps5-back.png":(1000,411),
            "ps4-spine.png":(72,800),"ps5-spine.png":(85,1000),
        }
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
            temp=Path(td)
            archive=temp/"private.zip"
            with ZipFile(archive,"w") as output:
                for name,size in sizes.items():
                    width,height=size
                    images[name]=(b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n"+
                                  b"\0"*8+struct.pack(">II",width,height)+
                                  b"\0"*14)
                    output.writestr("PPSA99386/assets/niak-templates/"+name,
                                    images[name])
            kit=temp/"kit"
            target=module.stage_private_templates(kit,archive)
            self.assertEqual({p.name for p in target.glob("*.png")},set(images))
            for name,content in images.items():
                self.assertEqual((target/name).read_bytes(),content)
            self.assertFalse((temp/"PPSA99386").exists())
            with ZipFile(archive,"a") as output:
                output.writestr("PPSA99386/../../escape.png",b"invalid")
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                module.stage_private_templates(kit,archive)

    def test_refuses_partial_user_supplied_assets(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
            root=Path(td)
            png=(b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n"+b"\0"*8+
                 struct.pack(">II",949,136)+b"\0"*14)
            path=root/"partial.zip"
            with ZipFile(path,"w") as out:
                out.writestr("PPSA99386/assets/niak-templates/ps4-front.png",
                             png)
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError,"Six exact"):
                module.stage_private_templates(root/"kit",path)

    def test_host_only_and_no_github_asset_upload(self):
        source=(ROOT/"private_preview.py").read_text("utf-8")
        self.assertIn("NIAK_CASE_TEMPLATE_ASSETS",source)
        self.assertIn("niak-preview-private",source)
        self.assertIn("validate_preview.py",source)
        self.assertNotIn("git push",source)
        workflow=(ROOT.parent.parent/".github/workflows/native-title.yml").read_text("utf-8")
        self.assertIn("niak-preview-templates",workflow)
        self.assertNotIn("private_preview.py",workflow)

if __name__=="__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

```py
    def test_staged_native_manifest_locale_parser_headers(self):
        stage=(ROOT/"title"/"prepare.py").read_text()
        source=(ROOT.parent/"native/catalog.c").read_text()
        self.assertIn('"localized_name.h","title_category.h"',stage)

    def test_all_game_french_source_index_is_canonical_and_safe(self):
        import importlib.util
        import tempfile
        from pathlib import Path
        path=ROOT/"title"/"fr_source_index.py"
        spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("fr_source_index",path)
        module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
        spec.loader.exec_module(module)
        source=(ROOT/"title"/"fr_overviews.tsv").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        rows=module.normalized_rows(source)
        self.assertGreater(len(rows),0)
        self.assertTrue(all(len(row)==3 and row[0].startswith(("CUSA","PPSA"))
                            for row in rows))
        self.assertTrue(all(row[1].startswith(module.ALLOWED) for row in rows))
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
            destination=Path(folder)/"niak-overviews-fr-sourced.tsv"
            self.assertEqual(module.generate(ROOT/"title"/"fr_overviews.tsv",
                                             destination),len(rows))
            actual=destination.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
            self.assertNotIn("\\\\t",actual)
            self.assertEqual(len(actual.splitlines()),len(rows))
            self.assertTrue(all(len(line.split("\t"))==3 for line in actual.splitlines()))
        for bad in ("CUSA12345\\thttps://evil.example/fr\\tTexte",
                    "BADID\\thttps://www.jeuxvideo.com/jeu\\tTexte",
                    "CUSA12345\\thttps://www.jeuxvideo.com/jeu\\t"):
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                module.normalized_rows(bad)
        builder=(ROOT/"title"/"build.sh").read_text()
        native=(ROOT/"title"/"title_meta.cpp").read_text()

    def test_exact_ftp_package(self):
        import tempfile
        import json
        import sys
        import zipfile
        import subprocess
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temp:
            base = Path(temp) / "PPSA99386"
            for path in ("eboot.bin", "sce_module/libc.prx", "sce_sys/param.json"):
                target=base / path
                target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                target.write_text(json.dumps({"titleId":"PPSA99386"}) if
                                  path.endswith("param.json") else "nonempty")
            (base / "assets").mkdir()
            (base / "tools/niakps5").mkdir(parents=True)
            payload=bytes([127,69,76,70])
            (base / "tools/niakps5/niakps5.elf").write_bytes(payload)
            import hashlib
            (base / "tools/niakps5/niakps5.elf.json").write_text(
                json.dumps({"name":"NiakPS5","filename":"niakps5.elf",
                            "checksum":hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()}))
            package=Path(temp) / "PPSA99386.zip"
            subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(ROOT / "title" / "pack_ftp.py"),
                            "--folder", str(base), "--output", str(package)], check=True)
            with zipfile.ZipFile(package) as z:
                self.assertIsNone(z.testzip())
                self.assertEqual([n.split("/")[0] for n in z.namelist()],
                                 ["PPSA99386"] * len(z.namelist()))
                self.assertFalse(any(n.endswith(".zip") for n in z.namelist()))
                self.assertIn("PPSA99386/tools/niakps5/niakps5.elf", z.namelist())
                self.assertIn("PPSA99386/tools/niakps5/niakps5.elf.json",z.namelist())
                meta=json.loads(z.read("PPSA99386/tools/niakps5/niakps5.elf.json"))
                self.assertEqual(meta["checksum"],hashlib.sha256(
                    z.read("PPSA99386/tools/niakps5/niakps5.elf")).hexdigest())
                self.assertEqual((z.getinfo("PPSA99386/tools/niakps5/niakps5.elf").external_attr >> 16) & 0o777, 0o755)
                self.assertEqual((z.getinfo("PPSA99386/eboot.bin").external_attr >> 16) & 0o777, 0o755)
                self.assertEqual((z.getinfo("PPSA99386/sce_module/libc.prx").external_attr >> 16) & 0o777, 0o644)
            (base / "assets/inner.zip").write_text("forbidden")
            with self.assertRaises(subprocess.CalledProcessError):
                subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(ROOT / "title" / "pack_ftp.py"),
                                "--folder", str(base), "--output", str(package)],
                               check=True, capture_output=True)

    def test_generated_preview_cpp_diagnostic_has_literal_newline_escape(self):
        import ast
        host=(ROOT/"title"/"host_preview.py").read_text()
        tree=ast.parse(host)
        generated=[
            node.value for node in ast.walk(tree)
            if isinstance(node,ast.Constant) and isinstance(node.value,str)
            and "six-view fixtures invalid" in node.value
        ]
        self.assertEqual(len(generated),1)
        # Python must NOT interpret \\n into a physical newline inside a
        # generated C++ quoted string. Check the evaluated AST constant.
        self.assertIn(r"templates=%u\n",generated[0])
        self.assertNotIn("templates=%u\n",generated[0])
```

`native/title/tests/test_translate_overviews.py`:

```py
"""FR descriptions: never invent translation, send only public text, keep source."""
import importlib.util
import json
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

SCRIPT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]/"translate_overviews.py"
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("niak_translate",SCRIPT)
translation=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(translation)

class TranslationTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_only_short_sourced_excerpt_is_eligible(self):
        original="First. Second! Third? Fourth. Fifth."
        self.assertEqual(translation.safe_overview(original),"First. Second! Third?")
        self.assertLessEqual(len(translation.safe_overview("Long sentence. "*200)),360)

    def test_no_key_keeps_untranslated_launchbox_text(self):
        source=b"PPSA02387\tA richly imagined historical adventure.\tfront\n"
        self.assertIsNone(translation.translation_file(
            source,{"PPSA02387"},key=""))
        self.assertEqual(len(translation.eligible_rows(source,{"PPSA02387"})),1)

    def test_private_deepl_translation_does_not_submit_title_id(self):
        source=(b"PPSA02387\tA compelling story about two siblings.\tart\n"
                b"CUSA12345\tA missing game.\tart\n")
        queries=[]
        class Response:
            def __enter__(self):return self
            def __exit__(self,*args):pass
            def read(self,size):
                return json.dumps({"translations":[{"text":"Une histoire de famille."}]}).encode()
        def fetch(req,timeout):
            payload=json.loads(req.data)
            self.assertEqual(req.full_url,"https://api-free.deepl.com/v2/translate")
            self.assertEqual(payload["target_lang"],"FR")
            self.assertEqual(payload["text"],["A compelling story about two siblings."])
            self.assertNotIn("PPSA02387",str(payload))
            queries.append(req)
            return Response()
        output=translation.translation_file(
            source,{"PPSA02387"},key="secret:fx",fetch=fetch)
        self.assertIn(b"PPSA02387\t",output)
        self.assertIn("Une histoire de famille.".encode(),output)
        self.assertNotIn(b"secret",output)
        self.assertNotIn(b"CUSA12345",output)
        self.assertEqual(len(queries),1)

if __name__=="__main__":
    unittest.main()

```

```c
#include "../title_category.h"
#include <assert.h>

int main(void) {
    assert(niak_is_installed_media_category("{\"applicationCategoryType\":65536}"));
    assert(niak_is_installed_media_category("{\"applicationCategoryType\":\"65792\"}"));
    assert(niak_is_installed_media_category(
        "{ \"applicationCategoryType\" : \"66048\", \"titleName\": \"Media\" }"));
    assert(niak_is_installed_media_category(
        "{\"localizedParameters\":{\"en-US\":{\"applicationCategoryType\":0}},"
        "\"applicationCategoryType\":65536}"));
    assert(!niak_is_installed_media_category(
        "{\"localizedParameters\":{\"applicationCategoryType\":65536},"
        "\"applicationCategoryType\":0}"));
    assert(!niak_is_installed_media_category(
        "{\"localizedParameters\":{\"applicationCategoryType\":65536}}"));
    assert(!niak_is_installed_media_category(
        "{\"applicationCategoryType\":65536,\"applicationCategoryType\":0}"));
    assert(!niak_is_installed_media_category(
        "{\"applicationCategoryType\":0,\"applicationCategoryType\":65536}"));
    assert(!niak_is_installed_media_category("{\"applicationCategoryType\":0}"));
    assert(!niak_is_installed_media_category("{\"applicationCategoryType\":\"0\"}"));
    assert(!niak_is_installed_media_category("{\"applicationCategoryType\":\"65536x\"}"));
    assert(!niak_is_installed_media_category("{\"applicationCategoryType\":65536x}"));
    assert(!niak_is_installed_media_category("{\"applicationCategoryType\":655360}"));
    assert(!niak_is_installed_media_category("{\"applicationCategoryType\":-65536}"));
    assert(!niak_is_installed_media_category("{\"applicationCategoryType\":null}"));
    assert(!niak_is_installed_media_category("{\"otherCategoryType\":65536}"));
    assert(!niak_is_installed_media_category("{\"applicationCategoryType\":65536,}"));
    assert(!niak_is_installed_media_category("{\"applicationCategoryType\":65536}garbage"));
    assert(!niak_is_installed_media_category("{\"applicationCategoryType\":65536"));
    assert(!niak_is_installed_media_category(
        "{\"other\":{\"nested\":[]],\"applicationCategoryType\":65536}"));
    assert(niak_is_installed_media_category_for_title(
        "{\"titleId\":\"NPXS00001\",\"applicationCategoryType\":65536}",
        "NPXS00001"));
    assert(!niak_is_installed_media_category_for_title(
        "{\"titleId\":\"NPXS00002\",\"applicationCategoryType\":65536}",
        "NPXS00001"));
    assert(!niak_is_installed_media_category_for_title(
        "{\"titleId\":\"NPXS00001\",\"titleId\":\"NPXS00001\","
        "\"applicationCategoryType\":65536}", "NPXS00001"));
    assert(niak_is_installed_media_category_for_title(
        "{\"titleName\":\"Media\",\"applicationCategoryType\":65536}",
        "NPXS00001"));
    assert(!niak_is_installed_media_category(NULL));
    return 0;
}
```

`native/title/tests/title_permissions_test.c`:

```c
#define _POSIX_C_SOURCE 200809L
#include "../title_permissions.h"
#include <assert.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
static void file_at(const char *path,const char *body) {
    FILE *fp=fopen(path,"wb");
    assert(fp);
    assert(fwrite(body,1,strlen(body),fp)==strlen(body));
    assert(fclose(fp)==0);
}
int main(void) {
    char root[]="/tmp/niak-launch-perms-XXXXXX";
    assert(mkdtemp(root));
    char base[256],param[512],meta_dir[300];
    const char *roots[]={root};
    snprintf(base,sizeof(base),"%s/PPSA12345",root);
    assert(mkdir(base,0700)==0);
    assert(niak_title_is_launchable("PPSA12345","PPSA99386",roots,1));
    assert(!niak_title_is_launchable("PPSA99386","PPSA99386",roots,1));
    assert(!niak_title_is_launchable("NPXS00001","PPSA99386",roots,1));
    assert(!niak_title_is_launchable("PPSA1234/","PPSA99386",roots,1));
    assert(!niak_title_is_launchable("XXXX12345","PPSA99386",roots,1));
    assert(!niak_title_is_launchable(NULL,"PPSA99386",roots,1));
    assert(!niak_title_is_launchable("PPSA12345","PPSA99386",NULL,1));
    // Symlink to a real installed title must not be treated as an install.
    char shortcut[256];
    snprintf(shortcut,sizeof(shortcut),"%s/CUSA11111",root);
    assert(symlink(base,shortcut)==0);
    assert(!niak_title_is_launchable("CUSA11111","PPSA99386",roots,1));
    assert(unlink(shortcut)==0);
    // NPXS system services cannot launch unless verified by their OWN param.
    snprintf(base,sizeof(base),"%s/NPXS00001",root);
    assert(mkdir(base,0700)==0);
    snprintf(meta_dir,sizeof(meta_dir),"%s/sce_sys",base);
    assert(mkdir(meta_dir,0700)==0);
    snprintf(param,sizeof(param),"%s/param.json",meta_dir);
    file_at(param,"{\"applicationCategoryType\":0,\"titleName\":\"System\"}");
    assert(!niak_title_is_launchable("NPXS00001","PPSA99386",roots,1));
    file_at(param,"{\"other\":{\"applicationCategoryType\":65536},"
                  "\"applicationCategoryType\":0}");
    assert(!niak_title_is_launchable("NPXS00001","PPSA99386",roots,1));
    file_at(param,"{\"applicationCategoryType\":65536,\"titleName\":\"Media\"}");
    assert(niak_title_is_launchable("NPXS00001","PPSA99386",roots,1));
    file_at(param,"{\"titleId\":\"NPXS00002\",\"applicationCategoryType\":65536}");
    assert(!niak_title_is_launchable("NPXS00001","PPSA99386",roots,1));
    file_at(param,"{\"titleId\":\"NPXS00001\",\"applicationCategoryType\":65536}");
    assert(niak_title_is_launchable("NPXS00001","PPSA99386",roots,1));
    // A symlinked sce_sys directory must not spoof the local title's class.
    char saved_dir[320];
    snprintf(saved_dir,sizeof(saved_dir),"%s/sce_sys.saved",base);
    assert(rename(meta_dir,saved_dir)==0);
    assert(symlink(saved_dir,meta_dir)==0);
    assert(!niak_title_is_launchable("NPXS00001","PPSA99386",roots,1));
    assert(unlink(meta_dir)==0);
    assert(rename(saved_dir,meta_dir)==0);
    file_at(param,"{\"applicationCategoryType\":\"65792\","
                  "\"localizedParameters\":{\"en-US\":{\"titleName\":\"Video\"}}}");
    assert(niak_title_is_launchable("NPXS00001","PPSA99386",roots,1));
    // A symlinked param.json must not authorize a title by swapping files.
    assert(unlink(param)==0);
    assert(symlink("/etc/passwd",param)==0);
    assert(!niak_title_is_launchable("NPXS00001","PPSA99386",roots,1));
    assert(unlink(param)==0);
    file_at(param,"{\"titleId\":\"NPXS00001\",\"applicationCategoryType\":65536}");
    assert(niak_title_is_launchable("NPXS00001","PPSA99386",roots,1));
    // 64 KiB remains a hard input bound even if valid metadata is at the start.
    char huge[65600];
    memset(huge,' ',sizeof(huge));
    huge[0]='{';huge[1]='"';huge[2]='a';huge[sizeof(huge)-1]='}';
    FILE *fp=fopen(param,"wb");assert(fp);
    assert(fwrite(huge,1,sizeof(huge),fp)==sizeof(huge));
    assert(fclose(fp)==0);
    assert(!niak_title_is_launchable("NPXS00001","PPSA99386",roots,1));
    assert(unlink(param)==0);
    assert(rmdir(meta_dir)==0);
    assert(rmdir(base)==0);
    snprintf(base,sizeof(base),"%s/PPSA12345",root);
    assert(rmdir(base)==0);
    assert(rmdir(root)==0);
    return 0;
}
```

`native/title/title_category.h`:

```h
/* SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
 * Fail closed: allow only a top-level, unique, correctly formatted
 * applicationCategoryType in an installed PS5 param.json.
 * Strings, nested metadata and duplicate keys must not authorize NPXS apps.
 */
#ifndef NIAK_TITLE_CATEGORY_H
#define NIAK_TITLE_CATEGORY_H
#include <ctype.h>
#include <stddef.h>
#include <string.h>

static inline const char *niak_json_space(const char *p) {
    while(*p && isspace((unsigned char)*p))++p;
    return p;
}
static inline const char *niak_json_string_end(const char *p) {
    if(*p++!='"')return NULL;
    while(*p) {
        if((unsigned char)*p<32u)return NULL;
        if(*p=='"')return p+1;
        if(*p=='\\') {
            ++p;
            if(!*p)return NULL;
        }
        ++p;
    }
    return NULL;
}
/* Skip an arbitrary non-category value without treating an inner object's
 * applicationCategoryType as a top-level property. A small stack rejects
 * unbalanced nested structures, and the caller checks the next delimiter. */
static inline const char *niak_json_skip_value(const char *p) {
    const char *start=p;
    char closing[32];
    unsigned depth=0;
    while(*p) {
        if(*p=='"') {
            p=niak_json_string_end(p);
            if(!p)return NULL;
            continue;
        }
        if(*p=='{' || *p=='[') {
            if(depth==sizeof(closing))return NULL;
            closing[depth++]=(*p=='{' ? '}' : ']');
            ++p;
            continue;
        }
        if(*p=='}' || *p==']') {
            if(!depth) {
                if(*p=='}')break;
                return NULL;
            }
            if(closing[depth-1]!=*p)return NULL;
            --depth;++p;
            continue;
        }
        if(*p==',' && !depth)break;
        ++p;
    }
    return depth==0 && niak_json_space(start)!=p?p:NULL;
}
static inline int niak_is_installed_media_category_for_title(
    const char *json,const char *expected_title) {
    static const char key[]="applicationCategoryType";
    static const char title_key[]="titleId";
    if(!json)return 0;
    const char *p=niak_json_space(json);
    if(*p++!='{')return 0;
    int found=0,allowed=0,found_title=0;
    for(;;) {
        p=niak_json_space(p);
        if(*p=='}') {
            p=niak_json_space(p+1);
            return !*p && found && allowed;
        }
        if(*p!='"')return 0;
        const char *begin=p+1;
        const char *end=niak_json_string_end(p);
        if(!end)return 0;
        const size_t key_len=(size_t)((end-1)-begin);
        const int is_category=key_len==sizeof(key)-1 &&
                              memcmp(begin,key,sizeof(key)-1)==0;
        const int is_title=key_len==sizeof(title_key)-1 &&
                            memcmp(begin,title_key,sizeof(title_key)-1)==0;
        p=niak_json_space(end);
        if(*p++!=':')return 0;
        p=niak_json_space(p);
        if(is_category) {
            if(found++)return 0; // duplicate, possibly contradictory key
            const int quoted=*p=='"';
            if(quoted)++p;
            unsigned value=0,digits=0;
            while(*p>='0'&&*p<='9') {
                if(++digits>6)return 0;
                value=value*10u+(unsigned)(*p-'0');
                ++p;
            }
            if(!digits)return 0;
            if(quoted) {
                if(*p++!='"')return 0;
            }
            p=niak_json_space(p);
            allowed=value==65536u||value==65792u||value==66048u;
        } else if(is_title && expected_title) {
            if(found_title++)return 0; // conflicting title identity
            const char *end_value=niak_json_string_end(p);
            if(!end_value)return 0;
            const size_t length=(size_t)(end_value-p-2);
            if(length!=9 || memcmp(p+1,expected_title,9)!=0)return 0;
            p=niak_json_space(end_value);
        } else {
            p=niak_json_skip_value(p);
            if(!p)return 0;
            p=niak_json_space(p);
        }
        if(*p==',') {
            p=niak_json_space(p+1);
            if(*p=='}')return 0; // invalid trailing comma
            continue;
        }
        if(*p!='}')return 0;
    }
}
/* Legacy category-only wrapper, used by standalone parser tests. */
static inline int niak_is_installed_media_category(const char *json) {
    return niak_is_installed_media_category_for_title(json,NULL);
}
#endif
```

```cpp
static Index read_titles(){
 Index index;
 for(const char *source : {"/app0/assets/niak-ps-titles.tsv",
                             "/app0/assets/niak-local-titles.tsv",
                             "/data/homebrew/PPSA99386/assets/niak-local-titles.tsv"}) {

 while(std::fgets(line,sizeof(line),f)){
  if(!std::strchr(line,'\n') && !std::feof(f)){
   int c;while((c=std::fgetc(f))!=EOF && c!='\n'){} continue;
  }
  char *v[5]={};int fields=0;char *current=line;

   *next=0;v[fields++]=current;current=next+1;
  }

  auto is_category=[](const char *value) {
      return std::strcmp(value,"Jeu")==0 ||
             std::strcmp(value,"Application")==0;
  };
  if(it==index.end()) {
   NiakTitleMetadata data{v[1],v[2],v[3],v[4],{}};
   if(local && is_category(v[2])) {
      data.category=v[2];
      data.genre.clear(); // A classification is not a genre.
   }
   index.emplace(v[0],std::move(data));
  } else if(local) {

   if(v[2][0]) {

       else it->second.genre=v[2];
   }
   if(v[3][0])it->second.publisher=v[3];
   if(v[4][0])it->second.released=v[4];
  }
 }
 std::fclose(f);
 }
 return index;
}

namespace {
std::string trimmed(std::string v) {
 const auto a=v.find_first_not_of(" \t\r\n");
 if(a==std::string::npos)return {};
 const auto b=v.find_last_not_of(" \t\r\n");
 return v.substr(a,b-a+1);
}
std::string translated_genre(std::string genre) {
 static const std::unordered_map<std::string,std::string> vocabulary={
  {"strategy","Stratégie"},{"real time strategy","Stratégie en temps réel"},
  {"turn based strategy","Stratégie au tour par tour"},
  {"turn based","Tour par tour"},{"grand strategy","Grande stratégie"},
  {"tactical","Tactique"},{"tactical rpg","Jeu de rôle tactique"},

  {"adventure","Aventure"},{"simulation","Simulation"},
  {"sports","Sport"},{"sport","Sport"},{"racing","Course"},
  {"racing simulation","Simulation de course"},{"driving","Conduite"},
  {"puzzle","Réflexion"},{"platformer","Plateforme"},
  {"platform","Plateforme"},{"fighting","Combat"},
  {"shooter","Tir"},{"first person shooter","Tir à la première personne"},
  {"third person shooter","Tir à la troisième personne"},
  {"fps","Tir à la première personne"},{"tps","Tir à la troisième personne"},
  {"sandbox","Bac à sable"},{"survival","Survie"},
  {"horror","Horreur"},{"indie","Indépendant"},
  {"casual","Occasionnel"},{"arcade","Arcade"},
  {"multiplayer","Multijoueur"},{"party","Jeu de groupe"},
  {"educational","Éducatif"},{"visual novel","Roman visuel"},
  {"music","Musique"},{"rhythm","Rythme"},
  {"city builder","Construction de villes"},{"management","Gestion"},
  {"building","Construction"},{"other","Autre"},
  {"open world","Monde ouvert"},{"survival horror","Survival horror"},
  {"hack and slash","Action-combat"},{"platform","Plateforme"},
  {"family","Famille"},{"board game","Jeu de société"},
  {"party game","Jeu de groupe"},{"massively multiplayer","Jeu massivement multijoueur"},
  {"online","En ligne"},{"co op","Coopération"},
  {"roguelike","Roguelike"},{"roguelite","Roguelite"}};
 std::string result;
 std::size_t begin=0;
 while(begin<genre.size()) {
  const auto end=genre.find_first_of(",;|",begin);
  std::string word=trimmed(genre.substr(begin,end==std::string::npos ?
      std::string::npos:end-begin));
  std::string lower=word;
  std::transform(lower.begin(),lower.end(),lower.begin(),[](unsigned char c) {
   return char(c<128 ? std::tolower(c) : c);
  });
  const auto it=vocabulary.find(lower);
  if(!result.empty())result+=", ";
  result+=it!=vocabulary.end()?it->second:word;
  if(end==std::string::npos)break;
  begin=end+1;
 }
 return result;
}
std::string french_date(const std::string &date) {
 // Locale FR: YYYY-MM-DD -> D/M/YYYY (no invented day if month-only).
 if(date.size()>=10 && date[4]=='-' && date[7]=='-' &&
    std::all_of(date.begin(),date.begin()+4,[](unsigned char c){return c>='0'&&c<='9';})) {
  const int m=std::atoi(date.substr(5,2).c_str());
  const int d=std::atoi(date.substr(8,2).c_str());
  if(m>=1&&m<=12&&d>=1&&d<=31)
   return std::to_string(d)+"/"+std::to_string(m)+"/"+date.substr(0,4);
 }
 return date;
}
}

 if(!v.released.empty()){if(!text.empty())text+=" · ";text+="Sortie : "+french_date(v.released);}
 return text;
}

static std::string niak_short_overview(std::string description) {
 // Imported, older indexes may contain a full English essay. The UI
 // displays only 2-3 sourced sentences, regardless of translation provider.
 std::size_t sentences=0;
 for(std::size_t i=0;i+1<description.size();++i) {
   if((description[i]=='.'||description[i]=='!'||description[i]=='?') &&
      description[i+1]==' ' && ++sentences>=3) {
     description.resize(i+1);
     break;
   }
 }
 if(description.size()>360) {
   const auto boundary=description.rfind(' ',360);
   description.resize(boundary!=std::string::npos && boundary>180?
                      boundary:360);
 }
 return description;
}
std::string niak_title_overview(const char *id) {
 if(!id || std::strlen(id)!=9)return {};
 // Sourced French descriptions ship offline, with a traceable URL for
 // editorial checking. No scraping or runtime browser access from the PS5.
 // This list is intentionally small: never invent descriptions for unknown IDs.
 static const auto sourced=[](){
   std::unordered_map<std::string,std::string> data;
   for(const char *path : {"/app0/assets/niak-overviews-fr-sourced.tsv",
       "/data/homebrew/PPSA99386/assets/niak-overviews-fr-sourced.tsv"}) {
     FILE *f=std::fopen(path,"rb");if(!f)continue;
     char line[1800];
     while(std::fgets(line,sizeof(line),f)) {
       char *first=std::strchr(line,'\t');if(!first||first-line!=9)continue;
       char *second=std::strchr(first+1,'\t');if(!second)continue;
       *first=0;*second=0;
       // Allow only explicitly sourced French publisher/editorial pages.
       if(std::strncmp(first+1,"https://www.jeuxvideo.com/",26)!=0 &&
          std::strncmp(first+1,"https://www.playstation.com/fr-fr/",34)!=0)
         continue;
       char *description=second+1;
       description[std::strcspn(description,"\r\n")]=0;
       if(*description)data.emplace(line,description);
     }
     std::fclose(f);
   }
   return data;
 }();
 const auto fr_sourced=sourced.find(id);
 if(fr_sourced!=sourced.end())
   return niak_short_overview(fr_sourced->second);
 // Explicit local French translation has priority over LaunchBox original.
 // A missing/private file never triggers network requests on the PS5.
 static const auto french=[]() {
   std::unordered_map<std::string,std::string> data;
   FILE *f=std::fopen(
       "/data/homebrew/PPSA99386/assets/niak-overviews-fr.tsv","rb");
   if(!f)f=std::fopen("/app0/assets/niak-overviews-fr.tsv","rb");
   if(!f)return data;
   char line[2048];
   while(std::fgets(line,sizeof(line),f)) {
     char *first=std::strchr(line,'\t');
     if(!first || first-line!=9)continue;
     char *second=std::strchr(first+1,'\t');
     if(!second || second-first!=65)continue; // SHA-256 provenance
     *first=0;*second=0;
     bool sha_ok=true;
     for(char *p=first+1;p<second;++p)
       if(!std::isxdigit(static_cast<unsigned char>(*p)))sha_ok=false;
     if(!sha_ok)continue;
     char *translation=second+1;
     translation[std::strcspn(translation,"\r\n")]=0;
     if(*translation)data.emplace(line,translation);
   }
   std::fclose(f);return data;
 }();
 const auto localized=french.find(id);
 if(localized!=french.end())return niak_short_overview(localized->second);
 static const auto index=[]() {
   std::unordered_map<std::string,std::string> data;
   // Read bundled fresh LaunchBox descriptions first. An older FTP overlay
   // is allowed to improve them, but its "-" or missing Overview column
   // must not permanently hide bundled descriptions.
   const char *const sources[]={"/app0/assets/niak-launchbox-cases.tsv",
       "/data/homebrew/PPSA99386/assets/niak-launchbox-cases.tsv"};
   for(const char *source:sources) {
   FILE *f=std::fopen(source,"rb");if(!f)continue;
   char line[8192];
   while(std::fgets(line,sizeof(line),f)) {
     if(!std::strchr(line,'\n')&&!std::feof(f)) {
       int ch;while((ch=std::fgetc(f))!=EOF&&ch!='\n'){}
       continue;
     }
     char *tab=std::strchr(line,'\t');
     if(!tab)continue;
     *tab=0;
     if(std::strlen(line)!=9||line[0]=='#')continue;
     char *overview=tab+1;
     tab=std::strchr(overview,'\t');
     if(tab)*tab=0;
     if(*overview && std::strcmp(overview,"-")!=0)
       data[std::string(line)]=overview;
   }
   std::fclose(f);
   }
   return data;
 }();
 const auto it=index.find(id);
 return it==index.end()?std::string{}:niak_short_overview(it->second);
}
```

`native/title/title_permissions.h`:

```h
/* SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
 * Only locally installed game directories and explicitly classified
 * NPXS media applications can be launched by the loopback broker.
 * Injectable trusted roots allow full filesystem permission tests on host.
 */
#ifndef NIAK_TITLE_PERMISSIONS_H
#define NIAK_TITLE_PERMISSIONS_H
#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include "title_category.h"

static inline int niak_title_is_launchable(
    const char *id,const char *own_title,
    const char *const *roots,size_t root_count) {
    if(!id || !own_title || !roots || strlen(id)!=9 ||
       strcmp(id,own_title)==0 ||
       (strncmp(id,"PPSA",4)!=0 && strncmp(id,"CUSA",4)!=0 &&
        strncmp(id,"LAPY",4)!=0 && strncmp(id,"FAKE",4)!=0 &&
        strncmp(id,"NPXS",4)!=0))return 0;
    for(int i=4;i<9;++i)
        if(id[i]<'0'||id[i]>'9')return 0;
    for(size_t i=0;i<root_count;++i) {
        char path[192];
        if(!roots[i])continue;
        const size_t root_len=strlen(roots[i]);
        if(root_len==0)continue;
        const int len=snprintf(path,sizeof(path),"%s%s%s",roots[i],
                               roots[i][root_len-1]=='/'?"":"/",id);
        if(len<=0 || (size_t)len>=sizeof(path))continue;
        /* Resolve each trusted component relative to an already-opened
         * directory. A symlink swap cannot replace the checked inode.
         */
        const int title_fd=open(path,O_RDONLY|O_DIRECTORY|O_NOFOLLOW);
        if(title_fd<0)continue;
        struct stat installed;
        if(fstat(title_fd,&installed)!=0 || !S_ISDIR(installed.st_mode)){
            close(title_fd);continue;
        }
        if(strncmp(id,"NPXS",4)!=0){close(title_fd);return 1;}
        const int sys_fd=openat(title_fd,"sce_sys",
                                O_RDONLY|O_DIRECTORY|O_NOFOLLOW);
        close(title_fd);
        if(sys_fd<0)continue;
        const int param_fd=openat(sys_fd,"param.json",
                                  O_RDONLY|O_NONBLOCK|O_NOFOLLOW);
        close(sys_fd);
        if(param_fd<0)continue;
        struct stat meta_stat;
        if(fstat(param_fd,&meta_stat)!=0 ||
           !S_ISREG(meta_stat.st_mode) ||
           meta_stat.st_size<30 || meta_stat.st_size>65536){
            close(param_fd);continue;
        }
        FILE *meta=fdopen(param_fd,"rb");
        if(!meta){close(param_fd);continue;}
        char data[65537]={0};
        const size_t size=fread(data,1,sizeof(data)-1,meta);
        const int bad=ferror(meta) || size!=(size_t)meta_stat.st_size;
        fclose(meta);
        if(!bad && niak_is_installed_media_category_for_title(data,id))return 1;
    }
    return 0;
}
#endif

```

`native/title/translate_overviews.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Translate ONLY public LaunchBox game overviews, via the owner's DeepL API key.

No title IDs, console names, usernames or personal metadata are sent to DeepL.
This is an explicit, opt-in FTP enrichment; the key stays in the Mac's env.
"""
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import urllib.request

VALID_ID=re.compile(r"^(?:PPSA|CUSA)[0-9]{5}$")
def safe_overview(text):
    """Translate at most three short sentences of publicly supplied text."""
    compact=" ".join(str(text).replace("\t"," ").replace("\r"," ").replace("\n"," ").split())
    return " ".join(re.split(r"(?<=[.!?])\s+",compact)[:3])[:360].rstrip()

def eligible_rows(index,installed):
    result={}
    for line in index.decode("utf8","replace").splitlines():
        row=line.split("\t",2)
        if len(row)<3:continue
        ident,overview=row[:2]
        if ident in installed and VALID_ID.fullmatch(ident):
            overview=safe_overview(overview)
            if overview and overview!="-":result[ident]=overview
    return result

def translation_file(index,installed,key=None,fetch=None):
    """Return a UTF-8 TSV or None. Fail closed without valid API credentials."""
    key=key if key is not None else os.environ.get("NIAK_DEEPL_API_KEY","")
    if not key or not key.strip():return None
    rows=eligible_rows(index,installed)
    if not rows:return None
    endpoint=("https://api-free.deepl.com" if key.endswith(":fx")
              else "https://api.deepl.com")+"/v2/translate"
    call=fetch or urllib.request.urlopen
    result={}
    # DeepL supports <=50 separate texts per request, 128 KiB total.
    entries=sorted(rows.items())
    for offset in range(0,len(entries),25):
        part=entries[offset:offset+25]
        data=json.dumps({"text":[text for _,text in part],
                         "target_lang":"FR","preserve_formatting":True},
                        ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf8")
        req=urllib.request.Request(endpoint,data=data,method="POST",headers={
            "Authorization":"DeepL-Auth-Key "+key,
            "Content-Type":"application/json",
            "User-Agent":"NiakPS5-private-translation/1.0"})
        try:
            with call(req,timeout=25) as response:
                payload=response.read(64*1024+1)
            if len(payload)>64*1024:break
            translations=json.loads(payload).get("translations",[])
            if len(translations)!=len(part):break
            for (ident,source),item in zip(part,translations):
                if not isinstance(item,dict):continue
                fr=safe_overview(item.get("text",""))
                if not fr:continue
                digest=hashlib.sha256(source.encode("utf8")).hexdigest()
                result[ident]=(digest,fr)
        except (OSError,ValueError,KeyError,TypeError):
            break  # No retries that could bill twice.
    if not result:return None
    return "".join(f"{ident}\t{digest}\t{fr}\n"
                   for ident,(digest,fr) in sorted(result.items())).encode("utf8")

```

`native/title/validate_preview.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Strict six-image OpenGL preview contract for missing PS4/PS5 case faces."""
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image, ImageStat, ImageChops
import sys

EXPECTED_FILES={
    "ps4-front.png","ps4-back.png","ps4-spine.png",
    "ps5-front.png","ps5-back.png","ps5-spine.png",
}
if len(sys.argv)!=2:
    raise SystemExit("Usage: validate_preview.py build/niak-preview")
root=Path(sys.argv[1])
found={p.name for p in root.glob("*.png")}
if found!=EXPECTED_FILES:
    raise SystemExit(
        f"Expected exactly 6 PNG captures; "
        f"missing={sorted(EXPECTED_FILES-found)} extra={sorted(found-EXPECTED_FILES)}")

def image(filename):
    with Image.open(root/filename) as im:
        if im.size!=(1920,1080):
            raise SystemExit(f"{filename}: expected 1920x1080")
        rgb=im.convert("RGB")
        if sum(ImageStat.Stat(rgb.resize((64,36))).stddev)<10:
            raise SystemExit(f"{filename}: blank OpenGL capture")
        return rgb

def difference(a,b):
    region=(1160,90,1850,760)
    return sum(ImageStat.Stat(ImageChops.difference(
        a.crop(region),b.crop(region))).mean)

for platform in ("ps4","ps5"):
    front=image(f"{platform}-front.png")
    back=image(f"{platform}-back.png")
    spine=image(f"{platform}-spine.png")
    if min(difference(front,back),difference(front,spine),
           difference(back,spine))<7:
        raise SystemExit(f"{platform}: front/back/spine are not distinguishable")
    # The back's PRINTED artwork gallery must contain actual image details,
    # rather than an opaque empty field or plastic. Crop within the case,
    # away from its edge, footer and the wallpaper.
    gallery=back.crop((1450,230,1680,465)).resize((48,48))
    if sum(ImageStat.Stat(gallery).stddev)<12:
        raise SystemExit(f"{platform}: reconstructed back artwork block missing")
print("NIAK_NATIVE_OPENGL_PREVIEW: PASS — exactly 6 case captures")

```

`native/title/vendor/console_curl.c`:

```c
/*
 * ps5-native-app-boilerplate - libcurl support for PS5 native titles.
 * Copyright (C) 2026 BlackBearReloaded
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
 *
 * What PacBrew's libcurl 8.18.0 / OpenSSL 3.5.2 archives need to run in a
 * native title; see console_curl.h. Taken from ProsperoRadio (elevated) and
 * ProsperoLichess (sandboxed), where each piece was found on hardware. When a
 * PacBrew update brings new undefined symbols, the linker names them; a symbol
 * that links but resolves to libScePosixForWebKit is a null import at run time
 * and needs a definition here too.
 */

#include "console_curl.h"

#include <arpa/inet.h>
#include <errno.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <fnmatch.h>
#include <netdb.h>
#include <netinet/in.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <stdarg.h>
#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <sys/socket.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <unistd.h>

extern int sceNetPoolCreate(const char *name, int size, int flags);
extern int sceNetPoolDestroy(int pool);
extern int sceNetResolverCreate(const char *name, int pool, int flags);
extern int sceNetResolverStartNtoa(int resolver, const char *hostname, struct in_addr *address,
                                   int timeout_us, int retries, int flags);
extern int sceNetResolverDestroy(int resolver);
extern const char *sceKernelGetFsSandboxRandomWord(void);

/* ---- Certificate list ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */

static pthread_mutex_t console_curl_ca_lock = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
static char console_curl_ca_path[160];

static int console_curl_readable(const char *path)
{
    struct stat facts;
    return stat(path, &facts) == 0 && S_ISREG(facts.st_mode);
}

const char *console_curl_ca_file(void)
{
    pthread_mutex_lock(&console_curl_ca_lock);
    if (console_curl_ca_path[0] == '\0' || !console_curl_readable(console_curl_ca_path))
    {
        snprintf(console_curl_ca_path, sizeof(console_curl_ca_path),
                 "/system/common/cert/CA_LIST.cer");
        if (!console_curl_readable(console_curl_ca_path))
        {
            const char *word = sceKernelGetFsSandboxRandomWord();
            snprintf(console_curl_ca_path, sizeof(console_curl_ca_path),
                     "/%s/common/cert/CA_LIST.cer", word != NULL ? word : "");
        }
    }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&console_curl_ca_lock);
    return console_curl_ca_path;
}

/* ---- Per-handle setup ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */

enum
{
    CONSOLE_SO_NBIO = 0x1200 /* the console's own non-blocking socket option */
};

int console_curl_nonblocking(int socket)
{
    const int on = 1;
    return setsockopt(socket, SOL_SOCKET, CONSOLE_SO_NBIO, &on, sizeof(on));
}

static int console_curl_on_socket(void *user, curl_socket_t socket, curlsocktype purpose)
{
    (void)user;
    (void)purpose;
    /* Keep going if it fails: the transfer still works, only slowly. */
    (void)console_curl_nonblocking(socket);
    return CURL_SOCKOPT_OK;
}

void console_curl_setup(CURL *easy)
{
    (void)curl_easy_setopt(easy, CURLOPT_NOSIGNAL, 1L);
    (void)curl_easy_setopt(easy, CURLOPT_CAINFO, console_curl_ca_file());
    (void)curl_easy_setopt(easy, CURLOPT_SOCKOPTFUNCTION, console_curl_on_socket);
}

/* ---- fcntl on sockets ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */

/* In a sandboxed title the console's libc refuses fcntl on sockets with EINVAL.
 * curl then fails every connect ("fcntl set CLOEXEC: Invalid argument") and its
 * sockets stay blocking. Linked with --wrap=fcntl, every fcntl call in the app
 * and the archives comes here; only a refused call is treated as a socket. */

extern int __real_fcntl(int descriptor, int command, ...);

static int console_curl_socket_flags(int socket, int command, int value)
{
    switch (command)
    {
    case F_GETFD:
    case F_SETFD:
        return 0; /* a title never execs another program */
    case F_SETFL:
    {
        const int on = (value & O_NONBLOCK) != 0;
        return setsockopt(socket, SOL_SOCKET, CONSOLE_SO_NBIO, &on, sizeof(on));
    }
    case F_GETFL:
    {
        int on = 0;
        socklen_t length = sizeof(on);
        if (getsockopt(socket, SOL_SOCKET, CONSOLE_SO_NBIO, &on, &length) < 0)
            return -1;
        return O_RDWR | (on ? O_NONBLOCK : 0);
    }
    default:
        errno = EINVAL;
        return -1;
    }
}

int __wrap_fcntl(int descriptor, int command, ...)
{
    va_list arguments;
    va_start(arguments, command);
    /* Every command curl and its libraries use takes an int or a pointer. */
    const intptr_t argument = va_arg(arguments, intptr_t);
    va_end(arguments);
    const int result = __real_fcntl(descriptor, command, argument);
    if (result >= 0 || errno != EINVAL)
        return result;
    if (command == F_GETFD || command == F_SETFD || command == F_SETFL || command == F_GETFL)
        return console_curl_socket_flags(descriptor, command, (int)argument);
    return result;
}

/* ---- Name lookup --------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

/* IPv4, one address per name, through sceNetResolver on the calling thread. */
static int console_curl_lookup(const char *name, struct in_addr *address)
{
    if (inet_pton(AF_INET, name, address) == 1)
        return 0;
    const int pool = sceNetPoolCreate("console_curl_dns", 16 * 1024, 0);
    if (pool < 0)
        return EAI_MEMORY;
    int result = EAI_FAIL;
    const int resolver = sceNetResolverCreate("console_curl_dns", pool, 0);
    if (resolver >= 0)
    {
        /* 5 s per try, 2 retries. */
        result =
            sceNetResolverStartNtoa(resolver, name, address, 5000000, 2, 0) < 0 ? EAI_NONAME : 0;
        (void)sceNetResolverDestroy(resolver);
    }
    (void)sceNetPoolDestroy(pool);
    return result;
}

int getaddrinfo(const char *node, const char *service, const struct addrinfo *hints,
                struct addrinfo **result)
{
    *result = NULL;
    const int family = hints != NULL ? hints->ai_family : AF_UNSPEC;
    if (family != AF_UNSPEC && family != AF_INET)
        return EAI_FAMILY;

    struct in_addr address;
    address.s_addr = htonl(INADDR_LOOPBACK);
    if (node != NULL)
    {
        if (hints != NULL && (hints->ai_flags & AI_NUMERICHOST) != 0)
        {
            if (inet_pton(AF_INET, node, &address) != 1)
                return EAI_NONAME;
        }
        else
        {
            const int failed = console_curl_lookup(node, &address);
            if (failed != 0)
                return failed;
        }
    }
    else if (hints != NULL && (hints->ai_flags & AI_PASSIVE) != 0)
    {
        address.s_addr = htonl(INADDR_ANY);
    }

    /* The entry and its address in one allocation: freeaddrinfo frees once. */
    struct addrinfo *entry = calloc(1, sizeof(struct addrinfo) + sizeof(struct sockaddr_in));
    if (entry == NULL)
        return EAI_MEMORY;
    struct sockaddr_in *in = (struct sockaddr_in *)(entry + 1);
    in->sin_len = sizeof(*in);
    in->sin_family = AF_INET;
    in->sin_port = htons((uint16_t)(service != NULL ? atoi(service) : 0));
    in->sin_addr = address;
    entry->ai_family = AF_INET;
    entry->ai_socktype =
        hints != NULL && hints->ai_socktype != 0 ? hints->ai_socktype : SOCK_STREAM;
    entry->ai_protocol = hints != NULL ? hints->ai_protocol : 0;
    entry->ai_addrlen = sizeof(*in);
    entry->ai_addr = (struct sockaddr *)in;
    *result = entry;
    return 0;
}

void freeaddrinfo(struct addrinfo *entry)
{
    while (entry != NULL)
    {
        struct addrinfo *next = entry->ai_next;
        free(entry);
        entry = next;
    }
}

const char *gai_strerror(int code)
{
    switch (code)
    {
    case 0:
        return "no error";
    case EAI_NONAME:
        return "the name was not found";
    case EAI_FAMILY:
        return "address family not supported";
    case EAI_MEMORY:
        return "out of memory";
    default:
        return "the name lookup failed";
    }
}

struct hostent *gethostbyname(const char *name)
{
    (void)name;
    return NULL; /* libcurl uses getaddrinfo */
}

/* Numeric only: enough for libcurl's record of the connected address. */
int getnameinfo(const struct sockaddr *address, socklen_t length, char *host, size_t host_size,
                char *service, size_t service_size, int flags)
{
    (void)flags;
    if (address == NULL || address->sa_family != AF_INET || length < sizeof(struct sockaddr_in))
        return EAI_FAMILY;
    const struct sockaddr_in *in = (const struct sockaddr_in *)address;
    if (host != NULL && host_size != 0 &&
        inet_ntop(AF_INET, &in->sin_addr, host, (socklen_t)host_size) == NULL)
        return EAI_FAIL;
    if (service != NULL && service_size != 0)
        snprintf(service, service_size, "%u", (unsigned)ntohs(in->sin_port));
    return 0;
}

/* '*' and '?' only: all libcurl's wildcard matching asks for. */
int fnmatch(const char *pattern, const char *text, int flags)
{
    for (; *pattern != '\0'; ++pattern, ++text)
    {
        if (*pattern == '*')
        {
            while (*pattern == '*')
                ++pattern;
            if (*pattern == '\0')
                return 0;
            for (; *text != '\0'; ++text)
            {
                if (fnmatch(pattern, text, flags) == 0)
                    return 0;
            }
            return FNM_NOMATCH;
        }
        if (*text == '\0' || (*pattern != '?' && *pattern != *text))
            return FNM_NOMATCH;
    }
    return *text == '\0' ? 0 : FNM_NOMATCH;
}

/* ---- libc stand-ins ------------------------------------------------------------------------ */

/* No user database: "no such user", so curl looks for no home folder. */
struct passwd;
int getpwuid_r(unsigned user, struct passwd *entry, char *buffer, size_t size,
               struct passwd **result)
{
    (void)user;
    (void)entry;
    (void)buffer;
    (void)size;
    *result = NULL;
    return ENOENT;
}

/* The archives call _setjmp/_longjmp; the console exports setjmp/longjmp. A
 * plain jump keeps the caller's frame, which setjmp needs. x86-64 only. */
__asm__(".text\n"
        ".globl _setjmp\n"
        "_setjmp:\n"
        "    jmp *setjmp@GOTPCREL(%rip)\n"
        ".globl _longjmp\n"
        "_longjmp:\n"
        "    jmp *longjmp@GOTPCREL(%rip)\n");

void closelog(void)
{
}

int dladdr(const void *address, void *info)
{
    (void)address;
    (void)info;
    return 0;
}

unsigned if_nametoindex(const char *name)
{
    (void)name;
    return 0;
}

int pipe2(int descriptors[2], int flags)
{
    if (pipe(descriptors) != 0)
        return -1;
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; ++i)
    {
        if ((flags & O_NONBLOCK) != 0)
            (void)fcntl(descriptors[i], F_SETFL, fcntl(descriptors[i], F_GETFL) | O_NONBLOCK);
        if ((flags & O_CLOEXEC) != 0)
            (void)fcntl(descriptors[i], F_SETFD, FD_CLOEXEC);
    }
    return 0;
}

/* HTTP/3 only; curl falls back. */
ssize_t recvmmsg(int socket, struct mmsghdr *restrict messages, size_t count, int flags,
                 const struct timespec *restrict timeout)

    (void)socket;

    (void)timeout;

    return -1;
}

/* isatty and mkstemp (which link from libScePosixForWebKit, a module a

/* zstd's optional tracing hooks; 0 means "not traced". */

/* OpenSSL checks certificate dates with it, so it must be right. Days since
 * 1970 to a civil date (Howard Hinnant's algorithm). */
struct tm *gmtime_r(const time_t *when, struct tm *out)
{
    long long seconds = (long long)*when;
    long long days = seconds / 86400;
    long long rest = seconds % 86400;
    if (rest < 0)
    {
        rest += 86400;
        --days;
    }
    memset(out, 0, sizeof(*out));
    out->tm_hour = (int)(rest / 3600);
    out->tm_min = (int)(rest % 3600 / 60);
    out->tm_sec = (int)(rest % 60);
    out->tm_wday = (int)(((days % 7) + 11) % 7);
    const long long z = days + 719468;
    const long long era = (z >= 0 ? z : z - 146096) / 146097;
    const long long doe = z - era * 146097;
    const long long yoe = (doe - doe / 1460 + doe / 36524 - doe / 146096) / 365;
    const long long doy = doe - (365 * yoe + yoe / 4 - yoe / 100);
    const long long mp = (5 * doy + 2) / 153;
    const long long month = mp < 10 ? mp + 3 : mp - 9;
    const long long year = yoe + era * 400 + (month <= 2 ? 1 : 0);
    out->tm_mday = (int)(doy - (153 * mp + 2) / 5 + 1);
    out->tm_mon = (int)(month - 1);
    out->tm_year = (int)(year - 1900);
    const int leap = (year % 4 == 0 && year % 100 != 0) || year % 400 == 0;
    static const int before[12] = {0, 31, 59, 90, 120, 151, 181, 212, 243, 273, 304, 334};
    out->tm_yday = before[out->tm_mon] + out->tm_mday - 1 + (leap && out->tm_mon > 1 ? 1 : 0);
    return out;
}
```

`native/title/vendor/console_curl.h`:

```h
/*
 * ps5-native-app-boilerplate - libcurl support for PS5 native titles.
 * Copyright (C) 2026 BlackBearReloaded
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-or-later
 *
 * PacBrew's libcurl (with OpenSSL, zlib, zstd and libpsl) links into a native
 * title, but needs console_curl.c beside it to run:
 *
 *   - getaddrinfo and friends on the system resolver (the SDK's stubs import
 *     them from a module a native title does not load: a call jumps to 0);
 *   - small stand-ins for libc functions the archives ask for;
 *   - an fcntl wrapper that answers curl's socket calls, which the console's
 *     libc refuses in a sandboxed title. Link with --wrap=fcntl:
 *     APP_WRAP_SYMBOLS += fcntl in the Makefile;
 *   - the path of the console's certificate list, for CURLOPT_CAINFO.
 *
 * In the Makefile: PACBREW_PACKAGES += libcurl and APP_WRAP_SYMBOLS += fcntl.
 * Call console_curl_setup() on every handle. See docs/UPDATE_CHECK.md.
 */

#ifndef CONSOLE_CURL_H
#define CONSOLE_CURL_H

#include <curl/curl.h>

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C"
{
#endif

    /* What every curl handle needs on the console; call it after curl_easy_init():
     *   CURLOPT_NOSIGNAL          no signals on the console;
     *   CURLOPT_CAINFO            console_curl_ca_file();
     *   CURLOPT_SOCKOPTFUNCTION   makes each socket non-blocking with the console's SO_NBIO
     *                             option. Without it a socket can stay blocking, and a finished
     *                             request then waits until the server closes the connection.
     * An app that needs its own CURLOPT_SOCKOPTFUNCTION calls console_curl_nonblocking() in it. */
    void console_curl_setup(CURL *easy);

    /* Sets SO_NBIO on a socket. 0 on success. */
    int console_curl_nonblocking(int socket);

    /* The console's certificate authorities as a PEM file OpenSSL reads, for
     * CURLOPT_CAINFO: /system/common/cert/CA_LIST.cer with filesystem access
     * (elevated), /<sandbox word>/common/cert/CA_LIST.cer in the sandbox.
     * Checked again on every call, so it follows a change of root. */
    const char *console_curl_ca_file(void);

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif

#endif /* CONSOLE_CURL_H */
```

`native/title/vendor/lodepng.cpp`:

```cpp
/*
LodePNG version 20261006

Copyright (c) 2005-2026 Lode Vandevenne

This software is provided 'as-is', without any express or implied
warranty. In no event will the authors be held liable for any damages
arising from the use of this software.

Permission is granted to anyone to use this software for any purpose,
including commercial applications, and to alter it and redistribute it
freely, subject to the following restrictions:

    1. The origin of this software must not be misrepresented; you must not
    claim that you wrote the original software. If you use this software
    in a product, an acknowledgment in the product documentation would be
    appreciated but is not required.

    2. Altered source versions must be plainly marked as such, and must not be
    misrepresented as being the original software.

    3. This notice may not be removed or altered from any source
    distribution.
*/

/*
The manual and changelog are in the header file "lodepng.h"
Rename this file to lodepng.cpp to use it for C++, or to lodepng.c to use it for C.
*/

#include "lodepng.h"

#ifdef LODEPNG_COMPILE_DISK
#include <limits.h> /* LONG_MAX */
#include <stdio.h> /* file handling */
#endif /* LODEPNG_COMPILE_DISK */

#ifdef LODEPNG_COMPILE_ALLOCATORS
#include <stdlib.h> /* allocations */
#endif /* LODEPNG_COMPILE_ALLOCATORS */

#if defined(_MSC_VER) && (_MSC_VER >= 1310) /*Visual Studio: A few warning types are not desired here.*/
#pragma warning( disable : 4244 ) /*implicit conversions: not warned by gcc -Wall -Wextra and requires too much casts*/
#pragma warning( disable : 4996 ) /*VS does not like fopen, but fopen_s is not standard C so unusable here*/
#endif /*_MSC_VER */

const char* LODEPNG_VERSION_STRING = "20261006";

/*
This source file is divided into the following large parts. The code sections
with the "LODEPNG_COMPILE_" #defines divide this up further in an intermixed way.
-Tools for C and common code for PNG and Zlib
-C Code for Zlib (huffman, deflate, ...)
-C Code for PNG (file format chunks, adam7, PNG filters, color conversions, ...)
-The C++ wrapper around all of the above
*/

/* ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
/* ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
/* // Tools for C, and common code for PNG and Zlib.                       // */
/* ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
/* ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */

/*The malloc, realloc and free functions defined here with "lodepng_" in front
of the name, so that you can easily change them to others related to your
platform if needed. Everything else in the code calls these. Pass
-DLODEPNG_NO_COMPILE_ALLOCATORS to the compiler, or comment out
#define LODEPNG_COMPILE_ALLOCATORS in the header, to disable the ones here and
define them in your own project's source files without needing to change
lodepng source code. Don't forget to remove "static" if you copypaste them
from here.*/

#ifdef LODEPNG_COMPILE_ALLOCATORS
static void* lodepng_malloc(size_t size) {
#ifdef LODEPNG_MAX_ALLOC
  if(size > LODEPNG_MAX_ALLOC) return 0;
#endif
  return malloc(size);
}

/* NOTE: when realloc returns NULL, it leaves the original memory untouched */
static void* lodepng_realloc(void* ptr, size_t new_size) {
#ifdef LODEPNG_MAX_ALLOC
  if(new_size > LODEPNG_MAX_ALLOC) return 0;
#endif
  return realloc(ptr, new_size);
}

static void lodepng_free(void* ptr) {
  free(ptr);
}
#else /*LODEPNG_COMPILE_ALLOCATORS*/
/* TODO: support giving additional void* payload to the custom allocators */
void* lodepng_malloc(size_t size);
void* lodepng_realloc(void* ptr, size_t new_size);
void lodepng_free(void* ptr);
#endif /*LODEPNG_COMPILE_ALLOCATORS*/

/* convince the compiler to inline a function, for use when this measurably improves performance */
/* inline is not available in C90, but use it when supported by the compiler */
#if (defined(__STDC_VERSION__) && (__STDC_VERSION__ >= 199901L)) || (defined(__cplusplus) && (__cplusplus >= 199711L))
#define LODEPNG_INLINE inline
#else
#define LODEPNG_INLINE /* not available */
#endif

/* restrict is not available in C90, but use it when supported by the compiler */
#if (defined(__GNUC__) && (__GNUC__ > 3 || (__GNUC__ == 3 && __GNUC_MINOR__ >= 1))) ||\
    (defined(_MSC_VER) && (_MSC_VER >= 1400)) || \
    (defined(__WATCOMC__) && (__WATCOMC__ >= 1250) && !defined(__cplusplus))
#define LODEPNG_RESTRICT __restrict
#else
#define LODEPNG_RESTRICT /* not available */
#endif

/* Replacements for C library functions such as memcpy and strlen, to support platforms
where a full C library is not available. The compiler can recognize them and compile
to something as fast. */

static void lodepng_memcpy(void* LODEPNG_RESTRICT dst,
                           const void* LODEPNG_RESTRICT src, size_t size) {
  size_t i;
  for(i = 0; i < size; i++) ((char*)dst)[i] = ((const char*)src)[i];
}

static void lodepng_memset(void* LODEPNG_RESTRICT dst,
                           int value, size_t num) {
  size_t i;
  for(i = 0; i < num; i++) ((char*)dst)[i] = (char)value;
}

/* does not check memory out of bounds, do not use on untrusted data */
static size_t lodepng_strlen(const char* a) {
  const char* orig = a;
  /* avoid warning about unused function in case of disabled COMPILE... macros */
  (void)(&lodepng_strlen);
  while(*a) a++;
  return (size_t)(a - orig);
}

#define LODEPNG_MAX(a, b) (((a) > (b)) ? (a) : (b))
#define LODEPNG_MIN(a, b) (((a) < (b)) ? (a) : (b))

/* Safely check if adding two integers will overflow (no undefined
behavior, compiler removing the code, etc...) and output result.
Returns 1 if it overflows, 0 if ok */
static int lodepng_addofl(size_t a, size_t b, size_t* result) {
  *result = a + b; /* Unsigned addition is well defined and safe in C90 */
  return *result < a;
}

#if defined(LODEPNG_COMPILE_ENCODER) || defined(LODEPNG_COMPILE_ZLIB)
/* Safely check if adding two integers overflows (without returning result).
Returns 1 if it overflows, 0 if ok */
static int lodepng_addofls(size_t a, size_t b) {
  size_t result = a + b;
  return result < a;
}
#endif /*defined(LODEPNG_COMPILE_ENCODER) || defined(LODEPNG_COMPILE_ZLIB)*/

#if defined(LODEPNG_COMPILE_DECODER) || defined(LODEPNG_COMPILE_ZLIB)
/* Safely check if multiplying two integers will overflow (no undefined
behavior, compiler removing the code, etc...) and output result. */
static int lodepng_mulofl(size_t a, size_t b, size_t* result) {
  *result = a * b; /* Unsigned multiplication is well defined and safe in C90 */
  return (a != 0 && *result / a != b);
}
#endif /*defined(LODEPNG_COMPILE_DECODER) || defined(LODEPNG_COMPILE_ZLIB)*/

#if defined(LODEPNG_COMPILE_DECODER) && defined(LODEPNG_COMPILE_ZLIB)
/* Safely check if a + b > c, even if overflow could happen. */
static int lodepng_gtofl(size_t a, size_t b, size_t c) {
  size_t d;
  if(lodepng_addofl(a, b, &d)) return 1;
  return d > c;
}
#endif /*defined(LODEPNG_COMPILE_DECODER) && defined(LODEPNG_COMPILE_ZLIB)*/


/*
Often in case of an error a value is assigned to a variable and then it breaks
out of a loop (to go to the cleanup phase of a function). This macro does that.
It makes the error handling code shorter and more readable.

Example: if(!uivector_resize(&lz77_encoded, datasize)) ERROR_BREAK(83);
*/
#define CERROR_BREAK(errorvar, code){\
  errorvar = code;\
  break;\
}

/*version of CERROR_BREAK that assumes the common case where the error variable is named "error"*/
#define ERROR_BREAK(code) CERROR_BREAK(error, code)

/*Set error var to the error code, and return it.*/
#define CERROR_RETURN_ERROR(errorvar, code){\
  errorvar = code;\
  return code;\
}

/*Try the code, if it returns error, also return the error.*/
#define CERROR_TRY_RETURN(call){\
  unsigned error_ = call;\
  if(error_) return error_;\
}

/*Set error var to the error code, and return from the void function.*/
#define CERROR_RETURN(errorvar, code){\
  errorvar = code;\
  return;\
}

/*
About uivector, ucvector and string:
-All of them wrap dynamic arrays or text strings in a similar way.
-LodePNG was originally written in C++. The vectors replace the std::vectors that were used in the C++ version.
-The string tools are made to avoid problems with compilers that declare things like strncat as deprecated.
-They're not used in the interface, only internally in this file as static functions.
-As with many other structs in this file, the init and cleanup functions serve as ctor and dtor.
*/

#ifdef LODEPNG_COMPILE_ZLIB
#ifdef LODEPNG_COMPILE_ENCODER
/*dynamic vector of unsigned ints*/
typedef struct uivector {
  unsigned* data;
  size_t size; /*size in number of unsigned longs*/
  size_t allocsize; /*allocated size in bytes*/
} uivector;

static void uivector_cleanup(void* p) {
  ((uivector*)p)->size = ((uivector*)p)->allocsize = 0;
  lodepng_free(((uivector*)p)->data);
  ((uivector*)p)->data = NULL;
}

/*returns 1 if success, 0 if failure ==> nothing done*/
static unsigned uivector_resize(uivector* p, size_t size) {
  size_t allocsize;
  if(lodepng_mulofl(size, sizeof(unsigned), &allocsize)) return 0;
  if(allocsize > p->allocsize) {
    size_t newsize;
    void* data;
    if(lodepng_addofl(allocsize, p->allocsize >> 1u, &newsize)) return 0;
    data = lodepng_realloc(p->data, newsize);
    if(data) {
      p->allocsize = newsize;
      p->data = (unsigned*)data;
    }
    else return 0; /*error: not enough memory*/
  }
  p->size = size;
  return 1; /*success*/
}

static void uivector_init(uivector* p) {
  p->data = NULL;
  p->size = p->allocsize = 0;
}

/*returns 1 if success, 0 if failure ==> nothing done*/
static unsigned uivector_push_back(uivector* p, unsigned c) {
  if(lodepng_addofls(p->size, 1u) || !uivector_resize(p, p->size + 1u)) return 0;
  p->data[p->size - 1] = c;
  return 1;
}
#endif /*LODEPNG_COMPILE_ENCODER*/
#endif /*LODEPNG_COMPILE_ZLIB*/

/* /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */

/*dynamic vector of unsigned chars*/
typedef struct ucvector {
  unsigned char* data;
  size_t size; /*used size*/
  size_t allocsize; /*allocated size*/
} ucvector;

/*returns 1 if success, 0 if failure ==> nothing done*/
static unsigned ucvector_reserve(ucvector* p, size_t size) {
  if(size > p->allocsize) {
    size_t newsize;
    void* data;
    if(lodepng_addofl(size, p->allocsize >> 1u, &newsize)) return 0;
    data = lodepng_realloc(p->data, newsize);
    if(data) {
      p->allocsize = newsize;
      p->data = (unsigned char*)data;
    }
    else return 0; /*error: not enough memory*/
  }
  return 1; /*success*/
}

/*returns 1 if success, 0 if failure ==> nothing done*/
static unsigned ucvector_resize(ucvector* p, size_t size) {
  p->size = size;
  return ucvector_reserve(p, size);
}

static ucvector ucvector_init(unsigned char* buffer, size_t size) {
  ucvector v;
  v.data = buffer;
  v.allocsize = v.size = size;
  return v;
}

/* ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */

#ifdef LODEPNG_COMPILE_PNG
#ifdef LODEPNG_COMPILE_ANCILLARY_CHUNKS

/*also appends null termination character*/
static char* alloc_string_sized(const char* in, size_t insize) {
  char* out = (char*)lodepng_malloc(insize + 1);
  if(out) {
    lodepng_memcpy(out, in, insize);
    out[insize] = 0;
  }
  return out;
}

/* dynamically allocates a new string with a copy of the null terminated input text */
static char* alloc_string(const char* in) {
  return alloc_string_sized(in, lodepng_strlen(in));
}
#endif /*LODEPNG_COMPILE_ANCILLARY_CHUNKS*/
#endif /*LODEPNG_COMPILE_PNG*/

/* ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */

#if defined(LODEPNG_COMPILE_DECODER) || defined(LODEPNG_COMPILE_PNG)
static unsigned lodepng_read32bitInt(const unsigned char* buffer) {
  return (((unsigned)buffer[0] << 24u) | ((unsigned)buffer[1] << 16u) |
         ((unsigned)buffer[2] << 8u) | (unsigned)buffer[3]);
}
#endif /*defined(LODEPNG_COMPILE_DECODER) || defined(LODEPNG_COMPILE_PNG)*/

#if defined(LODEPNG_COMPILE_PNG) || defined(LODEPNG_COMPILE_ENCODER)
/*buffer must have at least 4 allocated bytes available*/
static void lodepng_set32bitInt(unsigned char* buffer, unsigned value) {
  buffer[0] = (unsigned char)((value >> 24) & 0xff);
  buffer[1] = (unsigned char)((value >> 16) & 0xff);
  buffer[2] = (unsigned char)((value >>  8) & 0xff);
  buffer[3] = (unsigned char)((value      ) & 0xff);
}
#endif /*defined(LODEPNG_COMPILE_PNG) || defined(LODEPNG_COMPILE_ENCODER)*/

/* ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */
/* / File IO                                                                / */
/* ////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////// */

#ifdef LODEPNG_COMPILE_DISK

/* returns negative value on error. This should be pure C compatible, so no fstat. */
static long lodepng_filesize(FILE* file) {
  long size;
  if(fseek(file, 0, SEEK_END) != 0) return -1;
  size = ftell(file);
  /* It may give LONG_MAX as directory size, this is invalid for us. */
  if(size == LONG_MAX) return -1;
  if(fseek(file, 0, SEEK_SET) != 0) return -1;
  return size;
}

/* Allocates the output buffer to the file size and reads the file into it. Returns error code.*/
static unsigned lodepng_load_file_(unsigned char** out, size_t* outsize, FILE* file) {
  long size = lodepng_filesize(file);
  if(size < 0) return 78;
  *outsize = (size_t)size;
  *out = (unsigned char*)lodepng_malloc((size_t)size);
  if(!(*out) && size > 0) return 83; /*the above malloc failed*/
  if(fread(*out, 1, *outsize, file) != *outsize) return 78;
  return 0; /*ok*/
}

unsigned lodepng_load_file(unsigned char** out, size_t* outsize, const char* filename) {
  unsigned error;
  FILE* file = fopen(filename, "rb");
  if(!file) return 78;
  error = lodepng_load_file_(out, outsize, file);
  fclose(file);
  return error;
}

/*write given buffer to the file, overwriting the file, it doesn't append to it.*/
unsigned lodepng_save_file(const unsigned char* buffer, size_t buffersize, const char* filename) {
  FILE* file = fopen(filename, "wb" );
  if(!file) return 79;
  fwrite(buffer, 1, buffersize, file);
  fclose(file);
  return 0;
}

#endif /*LODEPNG_COMPILE_DISK*/
```
